p-338.principle: Ibu ice nwere ike ịdagide bụ $P\propto h^2$, ya mere ma ọ bụrụ na ogo $h$ bụ ugboro abụọ, ọ na-eburu ihe dị ka ugboro 4.
p-338.example: A na-asị n'ozuzu na 5cm bụ naanị ihe onye na-agagharị n'ụkwụ nwere ike ịnagide, na 10cm ma ọ bụ karịa dị mkpa ka ọtụtụ mmadụ nwee ike ịga n'ụzọ dị nchebe, ma ọ bụrụ na ogo na-abawanye site na 5cm ruo 10cm, ike nkwado na-abawanye ihe dị ka ugboro 4.
p-338.actionItem: Taa tupu ịpụ n'elu ice, buru ụzọ lelee ntuziaka mpaghara na ogo ice, ma ọ bụrụ na ịnwere obi abụọ, ejila pụọ.

p-339.title: Tụọ lantern site na lumens, ogologo oge ọ na-ere site na Wh
p-339.summary: Tụnyere ìhè lantern site na lumens (lm), na ogologo oge ọ na-ere site n'ike batrị (Wh) kewara site na ike ọ na-eji.
p-339.principle: Arụmọrụ bụ $\eta=\mathrm{lm}/\mathrm{W}$, ma oge ojiji bụ $t=\frac{E}{P}$.
p-339.example: Ọ bụrụ na 300 lm na-apụta na arụmọrụ 100 lm/W, ọ bụ 3W. Batrị 3.7V 5,000 mAh (ihe dị ka 18.5Wh) na-ere n'echiche ihe dị ka awa 6.
p-339.actionItem: Taa lelee lumens na Wh nke batrị (ma ọ bụ mAh×V) n'ime nkọwa lantern gị ma gbakọọ oge ojiji.

p-340.title: Ụbọchị anyanwụ na-adakarị n'oge kacha n'oge abụghị winter solstice
p-340.summary: Anyanwụ na-ada n'oge kacha n'oge n'oge mmalite December, ihe dị ka izu abụọ tupu winter solstice (ihe dị ka December 21), mgbe ụbọchị kacha mkpụmkpụ. N'aka nke ọzọ, anyanwụ na-apụta n'oge kacha ọdịda n'oge mmalite January.
p-340.principle: Oge anyanwụ na-abịa n'ebe ndịda kpọmkwem na-agbagha site na equation of time $E$, ya mere oke oge anyanwụ na-ada na nke na-apụta dị iche na solstice.
p-340.example: Na Seoul, anyanwụ na-ada n'oge kacha n'oge n'oge mmalite December ihe dị ka 17:16 ma n'oge solstice ọ bụ ihe dị ka 17:20, ihe dị ka nkeji 4 n'oge ọzọ, ma oge ìhè anyanwụ kacha mkpụmkpụ n'oge solstice.
p-340.actionItem: Taa lelee oge anyanwụ na-ada, ma lelee ma oge anyanwụ na-ada na-aghọ nke ọzọ n'oge ruo n'etiti December.

p-341.title: Ihe nha nri n'ụlọ ndị na-esi nri na-efunahụ ihe nri dị ntakịrị karịa iji iko tụọ
p-341.summary: Ntụ ọka e ji iko wepụta na-agbanwe nke ukwuu dabere n'otú e si kpachie ya, ma ihe nha nri na-atụ n'ụzọ ziri ezi n'ogo g, ya mere a na-efunahụ ihe nri dị ntakịrị.
p-341.principle: Ibu bụ $m=\rho V$ ma njupụta $\rho$ nke ntụ ọka na-agbanwe karịa 20% dabere n'otú e si kpachie ya, ya mere ọbụlagodi otu olu, ibu dị iche.
p-341.example: Otu iko ntụ ọka (ihe dị ka 240mL) bụ ihe dị ka 100 ruo 150g dabere n'otú e si wepụta ya, ọdịiche ruo ihe dị nso 50%, na-eme ka ntụ ọka ghọọ nke siri ike ma ọ bụ nke dị mmiri.
p-341.actionItem: Ọ bụrụ na ị na-eme achịcha ma ọ bụ kuki taa, tụọ ihe nri n'ogo g site na ihe nha nri kama iko.

p-342.title: Ịtinye smartphone n'ime iko iko na-eme ka olu dịkwuo elu
p-342.summary: Mgbe ị tinye smartphone n'ime iko iko efu, ụda na-ezukọ ma na-aga n'ihu, ma na-ada ụda n'ime iko, ya mere ọ na-ada ụda karịa. Mmetụta ya bụ ihe dị ka dB ole na ole.
p-342.principle: Ọkpọkọ e mechiri n'otu akụkụ na-ada ụda na ihe dị ka $f=\frac{c}{4L}$, ma iko na-achịkọta ụda n'otu akụkụ, na-eme ka ntụzịaka dịkwuo elu.
p-342.example: Maka iko nwere omimi 10cm, ihe dị ka $f=\frac{343}{4\times0.1}\approx860\ \mathrm{Hz}$ na-esiwanye ike, ma olu nwere ike ịbawanye ihe dị ka 3 ruo 6dB (ike ụda ugboro 2 ruo 4), ma ọ dị iche n'etiti ngwaahịa.
p-342.actionItem: Taa tinye ụda smartphone gị n'ime iko ka ọ chee ihu n'ime ya ma tụnyere ogo olu.

p-343.title: Ọkụ okpomọkụ dị ala nwere ike ịpụta ọbụlagodi na 44°C n'ime awa ole na ole
p-343.summary: Ọbụlagodi okpomọkụ na-adịghị ere ọkụ dị ka blanket eletrik ma ọ bụ hot pack, ọ bụrụ na ọ metụ otu ebe ogologo oge, ọ na-emebi akpụkpọ ahụ miri emi. Ọ na-esiri ike ịmata n'ihi na mgbu dị nta.
p-343.principle: Mmebi akpụkpọ ahụ na-eme site na nkwụsị okpomọkụ n'ihi kọntaktị, ebe okpomọkụ na oge ikpughe na-agbakwunye, ma ọ bụ ezie na okpomọkụ dị ala, ogologo oge na-eme ka mmebi dịkwuo ukwuu.
p-343.example: A maara na ọkụ nwere ike ịpụta ma ọ bụrụ na ọ metụ na ihe dị ka 44°C ihe dị ka awa 6 ma ọ bụ karịa, ma hot pack dị nso na 60°C dị ize ndụ n'oge dị mkpụmkpụ nke ukwuu.
p-343.actionItem: Taa etinyela hot pack ma ọ bụ blanket eletrik ozugbo n'akpụkpọ ahụ; debe ha n'elu uwe ma ọ bụ akwa, ma gbanyụọ ha tupu ị hie ụra.

p-344.title: Avalanche na-adịkarị mgbe mkpọda dị 30 ruo 45°
p-344.summary: Avalanche na-adịkarị mgbe mkpọda snow dị 30 ruo 45°. Ọ bụrụ na ọ dị nwayọọ nke ukwuu, snow na-anọgide, ma ọ bụrụ na ọ dị mkpa nke ukwuu, snow na-agbadata tupu ọ chịkọta.
p-344.principle: Mgbe nrụgide shear $\tau=\rho g h\sin\theta\cos\theta$ nke ala snow gafere nguzogide mkpọtụ, ọ na-ase, ma ka akụkụ mkpọda $\theta$ na-abawanye, $\tau$ na-abawanye ma ọ bụ kacha elu na ihe dị ka 45°.
p-344.example: Ọ bụrụ na snow nwere njupụta 300kg/m³ na ogo 1m dị n'elu mkpọda 38°, $\tau\approx300\times9.81\times1\times0.485\approx1.4\ \mathrm{kPa}$, ma ọ bụrụ na uru a gafere ike nke ala snow, avalanche na-eme.
p-344.actionItem: Ọ bụrụ na ị na-aga n'ugwu snow taa, tupu ịpụ lelee amụma avalanche na mkpọda, ma zere mkpọda karịrị 30°.

p-345.title: Ka tripod dị ọkụ, ka ọ dịkwuo mkpa itinye ibu na ya
p-345.summary: Tripod dị ọkụ nwere ike ịdaba site na ifufe. Ịkwanye ibu dị ka akpa n'okpuru etiti iji belata etiti ibu na-eme ka ọ kwụsie ike karị.
p-345.principle: Tripod na-ada mgbe ike dị n'ogo $h$ gafere oge nloghachi $mgr$ gburugburu akụkụ ụkwụ. Ike achọrọ iji tụda ya bụ $F=\frac{mgr}{h}$, ya mere ka etiti ibu dị ala, ka ike buru ibu dị mkpa.
p-345.example: Ọ bụrụ na tripod nke 1.5kg (etiti ibu 1.2m, radius ụkwụ 0.4m) nwere akpa 3kg e kwụọ n'ogo 0.3m, etiti ibu na-agbadata ruo 0.6m, ma ike achọrọ iji tụda ya na-aba site na ihe dị ka 4.9N ruo ihe dị ka 14.7N, ihe dị ka ugboro 3.
p-345.actionItem: Taa mgbe ị na-eji tripod, kwụọ akpa gị na hook dị n'okpuru center column ka ọ kwụ ala nke ọma n'ebe na-emetụghị ala.

p-346.title: Otu onye bụ ọkụ ọkụ 100W
p-346.summary: Mmadụ na-emepụta ihe dị ka 100W nke okpomọkụ ọbụlagodi mgbe ọ na-ezu ike, ya mere ụlọ nwere ọtụtụ mmadụ na-ekpo ọkụ ngwa ngwa na-enweghị ọkụ.
p-346.principle: Ike nri a riri na-ekpochapụ ka ọ bụrụ okpomọkụ, ma ọnụ ọgụgụ metabolism isi bụ ihe dị ka $P=E/t\approx80\text{-}120\ \mathrm{W}$.
p-346.example: 2,000kcal n'ụbọchị bụ $\frac{8.37\ \mathrm{MJ}}{86400\ \mathrm{s}}\approx97\ \mathrm{W}$. Ụlọ nwere mmadụ 20 bụ ihe dị ka 2kW, nke hà otu obere heater eletrik.
p-346.actionItem: Ọ bụrụ na ị nwere nzukọ ndị mmadụ taa, belata ntọala ọkụ 1 ruo 2°C.

p-347.title: Hichaa ala ite mmiri tupu itinye ya n'ọkụ
p-347.summary: Mmiri dị n'ala ite na-agbapụta n'elu ọkụ ma were okpomọkụ ukwuu, na-efunahụ oge na gas, ma mmiri na-agba nwere ike ịdị ize ndụ.
p-347.principle: Mgbe mmiri na-agbapụta, ọ chọrọ okpomọkụ zoro ezo $Q=mL$, ma okpomọkụ nke ime ka mmiri ghọọ ikuku bụ $L\approx2.26\ \mathrm{kJ/g}$.
p-347.example: Ọ bụrụ na e nwere mmiri 10g n'ala, ọ na-achọ $Q=10\times2.26=22.6\ \mathrm{kJ}$, nke bụ okpomọkụ nke ihe dị ka sekọnd 11 na ike ọkụ bara uru 2kW.
p-347.actionItem: Taa tupu itinye ite n'ọkụ, jiri akwa hichaa mmiri dị n'ala ya.

p-348.title: Ihe kpatara otu bọlbụ ọ bụla n'osisi Krismas ji na-eme ka eriri niile gbanyụọ
p-348.summary: N'eriri nke bọlbụ jikọtara n'usoro, ọ bụrụ na otu agbajiri, enweghị ụzọ ọkụ eletrik ga-agafe, ya mere eriri dum na-agbanyụ.
p-348.principle: Ọkụ eletrik n'usoro bụ otu n'ihe niile, ma $I=\frac{V}{R_1+R_2+\cdots}$. Ọ bụrụ na otu ebe agbajiri, nguzogide na-aghọ enweghị ngwụcha ma $I=0$.
p-348.example: Ọ bụrụ na ejikọọ bọlbụ 50 nke 2.4V n'usoro, ha na-ekere òkè ihe dị ka 120V. Ọ bụrụ na e wepụrụ otu, ọkụ eletrik na 49 ndị ọzọ na-aghọkwa 0.
p-348.actionItem: Taa maka eriri bọlbụ gbanyụrụ, wepụ plọg, pịa bọlbụ ndị adịghị aka ike ka ha banye nke ọma, ma ọ bụ gbanwee ha na bọlbụ ọzọ.

p-349.title: Ihe kpatara ume 'Ho~' na 'Hu~' ji dị iche n'okpomọkụ
p-349.summary: 'Ho~' nke e ji ọnụ mepere nke ọma na-ekupụ na-ekpo ọkụ, ma 'Hu~' nke e ji egbugbere ọnụ kpọkọtara na-ekupụ na-adị mma ma dị oyi.
p-349.principle: Mgbe ị kpọkọtara egbugbere ọnụ, ọ na-aghọ jet ngwa ngwa nke na-adọta ikuku gburugburu (entrainment). Okpomọkụ ngwakọta na-ada dị ka $T=\frac{m_1T_1+m_2T_2}{m_1+m_2}$, ma a na-agbakwunye ntakịrị oyi nke mgbasa.
p-349.example: Ọ bụrụ na ume 34°C gwakọtara 1:1 na ikuku ime ụlọ 20°C, ọ na-aghọ ihe dị ka 27°C, ya mere ifufe na-emetụ aka na-adị ala nke ihe dị ka 7°C.
p-349.actionItem: Taa jiri ume 'Ho~' na 'Hu~' na-agbanwe n'azụ aka gị ka ị mata ọdịiche okpomọkụ.

p-350.title: Ọsọ sled snow na-adabere naanị n'elu
p-350.summary: Ọ bụrụ na enweghị mkpọtụ, ọsọ sled snow n'ala na-adabere naanị n'ogo ọ si agbadata, ọ nweghị njikọ na ibu ahụ. N'ezie, ọ na-adị nwayọọ n'ihi mkpọtụ na nguzogide ikuku.
p-350.principle: Ike ọnọdụ na-aghọ ike mmegharị, ya mere site na $mgh=\frac12mv^2$, $v=\sqrt{2gh}$.
p-350.example: Na ogo 5m, $v=\sqrt{2\times9.81\times5}\approx9.9\ \mathrm{m/s}$, ya bụ ihe dị ka 36km/h, ma ọsọ n'ezie dị ala karịa nke a.
p-350.actionItem: Ọ bụrụ na ị na-eji sled snow taa, họrọ ebe dị nwayọọ na-enweghị ihe mgbochi ma yiri okpu ike.

p-351.title: Mgbe ị na-ahọrọ matrasi, dinaa n'elu ya nkeji 10 ma lelee oghere dị n'ukwu
p-351.summary: Mgbe ị na-azụta matrasi, dinaa n'elu ya ihe dị ka nkeji 10 ma lelee ma ọbụ aka gị nwere ike ịbanye n'etiti ukwu na matrasi n'ụzọ dị mfe. Ọ bụrụ na oghere buru ibu, ukwu na-ebili ma nrụgide na-ezukọ n'otu ebe.
p-351.principle: Nrụgide bụ $P=\frac{F}{A}$, na-ebelata ka mpaghara nkwado $A$ na-abawanye. Matrasi na-ekesa ibu site na ọnụọgụ opupu $k$ na nhazi akwa.
p-351.example: Ọ bụrụ na ibu 70kg (ihe dị ka 686N) dabere naanị n'ebe 0.1m², ọ bụ ihe dị ka 6.9kPa, ma ọ bụrụ na e kesara ya n'ebe 0.3m², ọ bụ ihe dị ka 2.3kPa, otu ụzọ n'ụzọ atọ.
p-351.actionItem: Taa mgbe ị na-ahọrọ matrasi, dinaakwa n'akụkụ ma lelee nkeji 10 ma ihu, ukwu na ọkpụkpụ ukwu na-enweta nkwado n'otu aka.

p-352.title: Fan dị n'elu stove na-agba ọsọ n'enweghị eletrik
p-352.summary: Fan e debere n'elu stove na-agba ọsọ site na okpomọkụ stove naanị, na-enweghị waya ma ọ bụ batrị, na-agbasa okpomọkụ n'ime ụlọ.
p-352.principle: Site na mmetụta Seebeck, ọdịiche okpomọkụ $\Delta T$ n'etiti njikọ abụọ na-emepụta voltage $V=S\Delta T$, ma voltage a na-agba moto.
p-352.example: Maka module thermoelectric nwere ọnụọgụ Seebeck ihe dị ka 0.05V/K, ọdịiche okpomọkụ 100K na-emepụta voltage mepere emepe ihe dị ka 5V, ma mmepụta bụ ole na ole W ma ọ bụ ihe dị ala.
p-352.actionItem: Taa tinye fan dị n'elu stove n'ebe dị n'ime oke okpomọkụ e kwere e dere na ngwaahịa, ma debe ya ebe aka ụmụaka adịghị eru.

p-353.title: Stove ite okooko nke tealight adịghị ekpo ụlọ
p-353.summary: Stove e ji tealights ole na ole na ite okooko mee anaghị emepụta okpomọkụ zuru ezu ka o kpoo ụlọ, ma ọ na-abawanye naanị ize ndụ ọkụ na carbon monoxide.
p-353.principle: Kandụl na-emepụta okpomọkụ naanị dị ka okpomọkụ ọkụ nke mmanụ ọkụ $P=\dot m\,\Delta H$, ma otu tealight bụ ihe dị ka 40W.
p-353.example: Otu tealight na-ere ihe dị ka 14g wax (ihe dị ka 0.6MJ) n'ime awa 4, bụ ihe dị ka 40W, ma 4 bụ ihe dị ka 160W, nke bụ naanị ole na ole pasent nke 1 ruo 3kW achọrọ maka ịkpo ụlọ.
p-353.actionItem: Taa kama itinye stove ite okooko, mechie oghere dị n'akụkụ windo iji belata okpomọkụ na-apụ.

p-354.title: Cork champagne na-efe ọsọ 50km n'otu awa
p-354.summary: N'ime bottle champagne, a na-akpachi ya ihe dị ka nrụgide ikuku 6, ya mere mgbe cork wepụrụ, ọ na-efe ọsọ dị nso 50km n'otu awa ma nwee ike mebie anya.
p-354.principle: Ọdịiche nrụgide na-agba cork ọsọ site na ike $F=\Delta P\cdot A$, ma ọrụ gas na-eme mgbe ọ na-agbasa na-aghọ ike mmegharị $\frac12mv^2$.
p-354.example: Ọ bụrụ na ọdịiche nrụgide bụ ihe dị ka 5bar, mpaghara cross-section cork bụ ihe dị ka $2.5\times10^{-4}\ \mathrm{m^2}$, $F\approx127\ \mathrm{N}$, ma ọ bụrụ na cork na-efe n'ihe dị ka 14m/s (50km/h), ike mmegharị bụ ihe dị ka 0.9J.
p-354.actionItem: Taa mgbe ị na-emepe champagne, tụgharịa bottle ihe dị ka 45°, jiri nkịtị aka pịa cork, ma jiri nwayọọ tụgharịa bottle, echee onye ọ bụla ihu.

p-355.title: N'oge ụra, ụda ọcha na-ekpuchi ụda na mberede
p-355.summary: Ụda ọcha dị nwayọọ nwere ike belata ọdịiche dị n'etiti ụda na mberede na ụda azụ ma nyere aka ka ị ghara ịtụpụ n'ụra. Mmetụta ya dị iche n'etiti ndị mmadụ.
p-355.principle: Site na auditory masking, mkpọtụ na-agbasa na-ebuli ọnọdụ ntị nke ụda ndị ọzọ. A na-egosipụta ọdịiche ụda dị ka $\Delta L=L_\mathrm{sound}-L_\mathrm{bg}$.
p-355.example: Na ụda azụ 30dB, ụda ọnụ ụzọ mechiri nke 70dB bụ ọdịiche 40dB, ma ọ bụrụ na e nwere ụda ọcha 45dB, ọdịiche na-ebelata ruo 25dB, ya mere ọ na-ewe iwe ntakịrị.
p-355.actionItem: Taa n'abalị, kpọọ ụda ọcha n'olu dị nwayọọ nke ihe dị ka 40dB n'ntị gị, tọọ timer, ma debe ya ebe dị anya site na ntị nwa ọhụrụ.

p-356.title: Crampon bụ ihe mgbochi mgbụ nke na-abanye n'ice
p-356.summary: Crampon anaghị abawanye mkpọtụ, kama mkpịsị dị nkọ na-abanye n'ice ma jide ya n'ụzọ anụ ahụ iji gbochie ịsị.
p-356.principle: Akpụkpọ ụkwụ n'elu ice nwere oke ịsị nke $\tan\theta=\mu$, ebe ọnụọgụ mkpọtụ $\mu$ dị obere nke ukwuu, ma spike na-eji nguzogide shear nke ice jide.
p-356.example: Ọnụọgụ mkpọtụ nke akpụkpọ ụkwụ nkịtị na ice bụ ihe dị ka 0.1, ya mere ọbụlagodi ihe dị ka 5.7° ($\tan^{-1}0.1$) na-eme ka ọ sị, ma mkpịsị crampon nwere ike ịnọgide na mkpọda ice dị oke elu karịa.
p-356.actionItem: Taa tupu ịrịgo ugwu, lelee ma mkpịsị crampon adịghị adịghị nkọ, na ma eriri na-agbanye nke ọma.

p-357.title: Họrọ laser pointer nke dị 1mW ma ọ bụ ihe dị ala
p-357.summary: Laser pointer dị nchebe maka anya bụ ngwaahịa Class 2 nke ike ya bụ 1mW ma ọ bụ ihe dị ala. Ọ bụrụ na ike dị elu, ọbụlagodi mmeghachi omume nke ịkpụ anya adịghị egbochi ya nke ọma.
p-357.principle: Mmeghachi omume ịkpụ anya bụ ihe dị ka sekọnd 0.25, ma ike na-abanye n'anya bụ $E=P\,t$. Ka nkewa beam dị obere, ka ike $I=P/A$ na-abawanye.
p-357.example: 1mW maka sekọnd 0.25 bụ $E=0.25\ \mathrm{mJ}$. Beam nwere dayameta 3mm bụ $I=1\ \mathrm{mW}/7.1\times10^{-6}\ \mathrm{m^2}\approx140\ \mathrm{W/m^2}$. Ngwaahịa ọnụ ala nwere ike ịnwe ike dị elu karịa nke e dere.
p-357.actionItem: Taa lelee akara 'Class 2, 1mW ma ọ bụ ihe dị ala' na laser pointer gị, ma ejila ya chee mmadụ, anụmanụ, ma ọ bụ ụgbọ ala ihu.

p-358.title: Ka ọnụ ọkụ stove nkụ osisi ma ọ bụ coal dị elu, ka ọ na-ere nke ọma
p-358.summary: Ka chimney dị elu ma ikuku dị n'ime na-ekpo ọkụ, ka ike ịdọta elu (draft) na-abawanye, ya mere ọkụ na-ere nke ọma ma anwụrụ ọkụ na-apụ nke ọma.
p-358.principle: Site na mmetụta chimney, nrụgide draft bụ $\Delta P=gh(\rho_\mathrm{out}-\rho_\mathrm{in})$, nke dị n'ụzọ n'ogo $h$ na ọdịiche njupụta.
p-358.example: Ọ bụrụ na ogo bụ 5m, n'èzí 0°C (1.29kg/m³), ikuku na-apụ 200°C (ihe dị ka 0.75kg/m³), $\Delta P\approx9.81\times5\times0.54\approx27\ \mathrm{Pa}$.
p-358.actionItem: Ọ bụrụ na ị na-eji stove taa, lelee njikọ ọkpọkọ chimney ma lelee batrị nke alarm carbon monoxide.

p-359.title: Ọbụlagodi n'ihu igwe dị n'okpuru efu, uwe a kpọgbuo na-akpọnwụ ka ọ na-agbado
p-359.summary: Uwe a kpọgbuo n'okpuru efu na-agbado, ma ọ na-akpọnwụ nwayọọ nwayọọ site na sublimation, ebe ice na-aghọ ikuku mmiri na-agabeghị mmiri. Ịchọghị ihe na-akpọnwụ uwe.
p-359.principle: Maka sublimation nke ice na-aghọ gas ozugbo $\mathrm{H_2O(s)\rightarrow H_2O(g)}$, achọrọ $L_s\approx2.83\ \mathrm{kJ/g}$, ma ọ dị ngwa ngwa mgbe ikuku akọrọ ma ifufe dị.
p-359.example: 1kg mmiri chọrọ ihe dị ka 2.83MJ ka ọ sublime. Ọ bụ ezie na ọ na-ewe ogologo oge karịa otu oge ihe na-akpọnwụ uwe (ihe dị ka 2 ruo 3kWh), ọ naghị eji eletrik.
p-359.actionItem: Taa n'ụbọchị doro anya, akọrọ n'okpuru efu, kpọgbuo uwe, ma mgbe ha kọrọ, maa ha jijiji ma mechaa ha n'ime ụlọ.

p-360.title: Hichaa snow dị n'elu ụgbọ ala tupu ị na-anya ya
p-360.summary: Snow chịkọtara n'elu ụlọ ụgbọ ala na-efe n'azụ dị ka ibe mgbe ị na-anya ụgbọ ma nwee ike ịkụ ụgbọ ala dị n'azụ ma ọ bụ kpuchie iko ihu. Hichaa elu, bonnet na iko tupu ị pụọ.
p-360.principle: Ọsọ ifufe na-esite na ịnya ụgbọ na-akwụsị ibe snow n'azụ, ma ha na-akụ ụgbọ ala dị n'azụ na ike mmegharị $E=\frac12mv^2$.
p-360.example: Ọ bụrụ na snow dị 5cm (a na-eche njupụta 100kg/m³) n'elu 2m², ọ bụ ihe dị ka 10kg. Mgbe ọ kụrụ na ọsọ nsụgharị 80km/h (22.2m/s), ọ bụ ihe dị ka 2.5kJ.
p-360.actionItem: Ọ bụrụ na snow dara taa, tupu ịnya ụgbọ, jiri brush dị nro hichaa snow niile dị n'elu, bonnet na iko.

p-361.title: Ihe kpatara olu mmadụ ji na-ebuwanye elu mgbe ụlọ nri na-adị mkpọtụ
p-361.summary: Mgbe mkpọtụ na-abawanye, mmadụ na-ebuli olu ya n'enweghị ịmata, a na-akpọ nke a mmetụta Lombard. Ọ bụrụ na onye ọ bụla na-eme ya, mkpọtụ na-abawanye karịa.
p-361.principle: Site na mmetụta Lombard, nrụgide ụda na-arị elu dabere na mkpọtụ, ma ka a nụ olu, a ga-ejigide ọnụọgụ ihe mgbaama na mkpọtụ $\mathrm{SNR}=L_s-L_n$.
p-361.example: A maara na mgbe mkpọtụ na-arị site na 60dB ruo 80dB, ya bụ 20dB, okwu na-ebuwanye ihe dị ka 6 ruo 10dB. Ụlọ nri nwere ike ịrị ruo 70 ruo 80dB.
p-361.actionItem: Na nzukọ taa, họrọ oche n'akuku dị anya site na ndị na-ekwu okwu, tụgharịa ahụ gị n'ebe onye ọzọ nọ ma kwuo okwu n'olu dị ala.

p-362.title: Anyanwụ mbụ nke afọ ọhụrụ na-apụta n'oge n'ebe ọwụwa anyanwụ karịa
p-362.summary: Anyanwụ na-apụta mbụ n'ebe ọwụwa anyanwụ. N'otu latitude, n'ihu ọwụwa anyanwụ, ọpụpụ anyanwụ na-adị ngwa ihe dị ka nkeji 4 maka longitude 1° ọ bụla.
p-362.principle: Ụwa na-agbagharị $15^\circ$ n'otu awa, ya mere ọdịiche longitude $1^\circ$ bụ $\frac{60\ \mathrm{min}}{15}=4\ \mathrm{min}$.
p-362.example: Homigot, nke dị na longitude 129.6°E, dị ihe dị ka 2.6° n'ọwụwa anyanwụ nke Seoul (127°E), ya mere anyanwụ na-apụta ihe dị ka nkeji 10 n'oge, ma ọdịiche n'ezie dị iche ntakịrị dabere na ọdịiche latitude.
p-362.actionItem: Ọ bụrụ na ị na-aga ịhụ anyanwụ mbụ nke afọ ọhụrụ taa, buru ụzọ lelee oge anyanwụ na-apụta n'ebe ị na-aga.

p-363.title: Nkeji nrụgide ikuku bar, psi, kPa, ịgbanwe ha n'otu oge
p-363.summary: A na-ede nrụgide ikuku nke taya n'ime bar, psi, kPa na ndị ọzọ. Ọ bụrụ na ị cheta otu uru mgbanwe, ị nwere ike ịgbanwe nkeji ọ bụla.
p-363.example: 2.3bar bụ 230kPa ma $2.3\times14.5\approx33\ \mathrm{psi}$. 35psi bụ ihe dị ka 2.41bar.
p-363.actionItem: Taa lelee tebụl nrụgide ikuku a na-akwado dị na ọnụ ụzọ ọnụ ọdụ onye na-anya ụgbọ, ma jiri tire pressure gauge lelee uru n'ezie.

p-364.title: Gbakọọ oge ịkwụ ụgwọ ụgbọ ala eletrik n'ụlọ site na kWh÷kW
p-364.summary: Enwere ike ịchọta oge ịkwụ ụgwọ site n'ikewa ike a ga-emejupụta (kWh) site na mmepụta charger (kW). N'ihi mfu, n'ezie ọ na-ewe ntakịrị oge karịa.
p-364.principle: $t=\frac{E}{P}$, ma ọ bụrụ na e nwere arụmọrụ ịkwụ ụgwọ $\eta$, $t=\frac{E}{\eta P}$.
p-364.example: Ọ bụrụ na ị na-emejupụta batrị 60kWh site na 10% ruo 80%, $E=42\ \mathrm{kWh}$, ma site na charger 7kW (arụmọrụ 90%), $t=\frac{42}{0.9\times7}\approx6.7$ awa.
p-364.actionItem: Taa lelee ike batrị ụgbọ ala gị (kWh) na mmepụta charger (kW) ma gbakọọ oge ịkwụ ụgwọ.

p-365.title: Mgbe ị na-agbaze snow maka mmiri, buru ụzọ tinye otu iko mmiri
p-365.summary: Snow nwere oghere ikuku ọtụtụ, ya mere ọ naghị ebufe okpomọkụ nke ọma, ma ọ bụrụ na ị tinye ya ozugbo n'ime ite efu, ala ite nwere ike ọkụ. Ọ bụrụ na ị buru ụzọ tinye obere mmiri, kọntaktị okpomọkụ ka mma ma ọ na-agbaze ngwa ngwa nke ukwuu.
p-365.principle: Conductivity okpomọkụ nke snow dị ala ma oghere buru ibu, ya mere mpaghara kọntaktị na ite dị nta. Iji gbazee ya, achọrọ okpomọkụ ngwakọta $L_f=334\ \mathrm{kJ/kg}$.
p-365.example: Ime 1L mmiri na-achọ ihe dị ka 334kJ, nke hà okpomọkụ iji welie ya 80°C. Ebe ọ bụ na naanị ihe dị ka 10% nke olu snow bụ mmiri, a chọrọ ihe dị ka 10L snow.
p-365.actionItem: Ọ bụrụ na ị ga-eme mmiri site na snow taa, buru ụzọ kpoo otu iko mmiri, wee tinye snow dị ọcha nwayọọ nwayọọ (ị ga-asị ya tupu ị ṅụọ ya).

p-366.title: N'ịrị ugwu snow, bulie ọsọ nwayọọ ma rịgoo n'enweghị ịkwụsị
p-366.summary: N'ịrị ugwu snow, ọ bụrụ na ị kwụsị, ọ na-esiri ike ịmalitegharị, ma ọ bụrụ na ị buliri ọsọ n'ike, wiil na-agba n'ebe ahụ. Debe ebe dị anya n'ihu ịrị ugwu ma rịgoo nwayọọ n'ọsọ edoro.
p-366.principle: Ebe ọ bụ na mkpọtụ nkwụsị $F\le\mu_sN$ dị elu karịa mkpọtụ mmegharị $F=\mu_kN$ ($\mu_s>\mu_k$), mgbe wiil na-agba n'ebe ahụ, ike jikọrọ ụkwụ na ala na-ada ngwa ngwa.
p-366.example: Mgbe $\mu\approx0.2$ n'okporo ụzọ snow a kpachiri, na mkpọda 10% ($\theta\approx5.7^\circ$), akụkụ ike ndọda bụ ihe dị ka $0.1\,mg$ ma mkpọtụ bụ ihe dị ka $0.2\,mg$, ya mere oke dị naanị ihe dị ka $0.1\,mg$.
p-366.actionItem: Taa n'ihu ịrị ugwu snow, debe ebe zuru ezu site na ụgbọ ala dị n'ihu gị, ma rịgoo n'otu ọsọ ka ị ghara ịkwụsị n'etiti.

c-001.title: Egwula baking soda na vinegar ọnụ, jiri ha dị iche
c-001.summary: Ọ bụrụ na ịgwakọta ha abụọ, naanị ụfụfụ na-apụta ma ike nhicha ha na-ekagbu onwe ya. Ọ ka mma iji baking soda maka mmanụ ma jiri vinegar maka ọkpụkpụ mmiri siri ike, nke ọ bụla dị iche.
c-001.principle: Ihe dị mfe alkali ($\mathrm{NaHCO_3}$) na acid dị mfe ($\mathrm{CH_3COOH}$) na-eme neutralization ghọọ ngwọta sodium acetate nke fọrọ nke nta ka ọ bụrụ neutral: $\mathrm{NaHCO_3 + CH_3COOH \to CH_3COONa + H_2O + CO_2\uparrow}$
c-001.example: Ọ bụrụ na ị gwakọta otu ngaji baking soda (ihe dị ka 12g) na ọkara iko vinegar, mgbe ụfụfụ gwụrụ pH na-agbada ruo ihe dị ka 8 ma ọ bụ ala, ọ naghịkwa agbaze mmanụ ma ọ bụ ọkpụkpụ mmiri nke ọma. Ọ bụrụ na ị jiri ha dị iche, a na-ewepụ ntụpọ abụọ ahụ n'otu ọnụ ọgụgụ.
c-001.actionItem: Taa, jiri naanị akpụkpọ baking soda na mmanụ sink, ma jiri naanị akwa kichin e fesara vinegar na ọkpụkpụ mmiri famfo, nke ọ bụla dị iche.

c-002.title: Ejikọla bleach na ihe nhicha acid mgbe ọ bụla
c-002.summary: Ọ bụrụ na ịgwakọta sodium hypochlorite (bleach) na ihe nhicha ụlọ mposi nwere acid, a na-emepụta gas chlorine na-egbu egbu. Jiri otu naanị n'otu oge, ma sachaa nke ọma na mmiri n'etiti.
c-002.principle: Mgbe hypochlorite zutere acid, ọ na-aghọ chlorine: $\mathrm{NaOCl + 2HCl \to NaCl + Cl_2\uparrow + H_2O}$
c-002.example: Gas chlorine na-akpasu anya na akpịrị ọbụna na ihe dị ka 3ppm, na na 30ppm ma ọ bụ karịa ọ na-akpata ụkwara siri ike na nsogbu iku ume. N'ime ụlọ mposi pere mpe, ọ nwere ike iru ọkwa dị egwu n'ime nkeji ole na ole.
c-002.actionItem: N'ime ụlọ mposi, kewaa bleach na ndị nhicha acid (hydrochloric, citric) n'ebe dị iche iche na shelf, ma tupu ojiji, lelee okwu 'ejikọla' dị na akara.

c-003.title: Ijikọ bleach na ammonia ma ọ bụ ihe nhicha iko dịkwa ize ndụ
c-003.summary: Ọ bụrụ na ịgwakọta bleach na ihe nhicha iko nwere ammonia, a na-emepụta gas chloramine na-egbu egbu. Meghee windo, ejikwala ngwaahịa abụọ ahụ n'usoro n'otu ụbọchị.
c-003.principle: $\mathrm{NaOCl + NH_3 \to NH_2Cl + NaOH}$ na-emepụta chloramine ($\mathrm{NH_2Cl}$), nke na-akpasu ụzọ ume.
c-003.example: Ọbụna ịgwakọta obere bleach na ihe nhicha nwere ihe dị ka 5% ammonia, n'ime ụlọ mposi mechiri emechi ụkwara na mgbu anya nwere ike ịpụta n'ime nkeji ole na ole. Mgbe ejiri bleach n'ebe mmamịrị metụrụ, otu ụkpụrụ ahụ na-emepụta gas na-esi isi.
c-003.actionItem: Chọọ 'ammonia' n'ime ndepụta ihe nhicha, dee ya ka ejila ya na bleach n'otu ụbọchị, ma meghee windo mgbe ị na-ehicha.

c-004.title: Maka njem, họrọ hand sanitizer nwere ethanol 60% ma ọ bụ karịa
c-004.summary: Ebe mmiri na-adịghị, alcohol hand sanitizer bụ nzaghachi, mana ọ bụrụ na ethanol dị n'okpuru 60%, ịdị irè ya na-ebelata nke ukwuu. N'ụgbọ elu, kewaa ya n'ime akpa nwere 100mL ma ọ bụ ihe pere mpe.
c-004.principle: Ethanol na-emebi protein nke nje ma na-agbaze akpụkpọ mmanụ ha. Ọ na-ere ọkụ ngwa ngwa, mmeghachi omume ọkụ ya bụ $\mathrm{C_2H_5OH + 3O_2 \to 2CO_2 + 3H_2O}$.
c-004.example: Ngwaahịa ndị nwere ethanol 60~80% na-arụ ọrụ ma ọ bụrụ na e kpụchaa ya ihe dị ka sekọnd 20 hapụ ya ruo mgbe ọ kpọrọ nkụ kpamkpam. N'aka nwere ájá a na-ahụ anya, mmiri na ncha dị mma karịa sanitizer.
c-004.actionItem: Taa, lelee ethanol (%) n'akara sanitizer ị ga-etinye n'akpa njem, ma kewaa ya n'ime akpa nwere 100mL ma ọ bụ ihe pere mpe.

c-005.title: Mgbe ị na-ahọrọ ihe nhicha, lelee pH n'akara
c-005.summary: pH nke ihe nhicha kichin na ụlọ mposi dị iche dabere n'ojiji. Ọ bụrụ na ị họrọ alkali maka mmanụ na acid maka ọkpụkpụ mmiri, otu ego na-asachapụ nke ọma.
c-005.principle: $\mathrm{pH = -\log[H^+]}$ ma ọ bụrụ na pH dara 1, ịdị mkpa $\mathrm{H^+}$ na-abawanye okpukpu 10. Abụba na-aghọ saponification n'ime alkali: $\mathrm{RCOOR' + NaOH \to RCOONa + R'OH}$
c-005.example: Ihe nhicha alkali nwere pH 11~12 na-arụ ọrụ nke ọma na mmanụ, ndị acid nwere pH 2~3 na-arụ ọrụ na ọkpụkpụ lime. Ncha mwepụ efere neutral (pH 6~8) dị nro n'aka mana ọ na-ewe oge na mmanụ siri ike.
c-005.actionItem: Mgbe ị na-azụ ahịa n'ọdịnihu, lelee akara pH na 'ojiji' n'akara ihe nhicha, ma dee pH nke ihe nhicha 3 dị n'ụlọ gị.

c-006.title: Saa uwe na mmiri oyi 30℃ ka ibelata ume okpomọkụ
c-006.summary: Ncha ọgbara ọhụrụ na-arụ ọrụ nke ọma na enzyme na ihe dị ka 30℃, yabụ ọ dịghị mkpa ịkwanye uwe kwa ụbọchị ruo 60℃. Ka mmiri na-ekpo ọkụ nke nta, eletrik na-ebelata.
c-006.principle: Okpomọkụ achọrọ iji kpoo mmiri bụ $Q = mc\Delta T$ ($c = 4.18\ \mathrm{kJ/(kg\cdot K)}$), enzyme na-agbaji protein na-arụkwa ọrụ nke ọma na 30~40℃.
c-006.example: Ịkpo lita mmiri 10 site na 15℃ ruo 30℃ na-ewe ihe dị ka 627kJ, ruo 60℃ ihe dị ka 1,881kJ, ya bụ ọdịiche okpukpu 3. Ọ bụrụ na ị na-asa uwe ugboro 4 kwa izu, nchekwa na-achịkọta ihe karịrị ugboro 200 n'afọ.
c-006.actionItem: Taa, setịpụ okpomọkụ igwe nsacha ka ọ bụrụ 30℃ (ma ọ bụ mmiri oyi), ma bulie ya ruo 40℃ naanị maka uwe nwere ọsụsọ dị arọ.

c-007.title: Wepụ ọkpụkpụ mmiri na kettle eletrik site na otu ngaji citric acid
c-007.summary: Lime ọcha dị n'ime kettle na-agbaze na citric acid. Ọ nwere isi dị ntakịrị karịa vinegar ma ọ dị ọnụ ala, yabụ ọ bara uru ịnwale ya tupu ịzụta kettle ọhụrụ.
c-007.principle: Ọkpụkpụ calcium carbonate na-agbaze n'ime acid: $\mathrm{3CaCO_3 + 2C_6H_8O_7 \to Ca_3(C_6H_5O_7)_2 + 3H_2O + 3CO_2\uparrow}$
c-007.example: Ọ bụrụ na itinye otu ngaji citric acid (ihe dị ka 10g) n'ime 500mL mmiri, sie ya, hapụ ya nkeji 20, ọtụtụ ọkpụkpụ nwere ọkpụrụkpụ ihe dị ka 1mm na-agbaze. Otu kilogram citric acid nke ọnụ ahịa ya dị ihe dị ka KRW 5,000 nwere ike iji ya ọtụtụ ugboro.
c-007.actionItem: Taa, tinye mmiri na otu ngaji citric acid n'ime kettle, sie ya, hapụ ya nkeji 20, wụpụ mmiri ahụ, saa ya ugboro abụọ ma ọ bụ atọ.

c-008.title: Gịnị bụ ọcha ncha fọdụrụ na uwe na ụlọ mposi
c-008.summary: N'ime mmiri siri ike (hard water), fatty acid nke ncha na-ejikọta na calcium ghọọ ihe fọdụrụ nke na-agbazeghị na mmiri. Enwere ike ibelata ya site n'iji ncha sịntetịk ma ọ bụ ịsacha na vinegar.
c-008.principle: $\mathrm{Ca^{2+} + 2C_{17}H_{35}COO^- \to Ca(C_{17}H_{35}COO)_2\downarrow}$ na-emepụta ihe nrụsị (precipitate), ụfụfụ ahụkwa na-ebelata.
c-008.example: N'ebe ịdị ike mmiri dị 200mg/L (dabere na CaCO₃) ma ọ bụ karịa, ụfụfụ si n'otu ọnụ ọgụgụ ncha nwere ike ịbelata ruo ọkara ma ọ bụ ihe pere mpe. Ihe ọcha dị na tile ụlọ mposi na-agbaze na ihe nhicha acid.
c-008.actionItem: Taa, fesaa vinegar ma ọ bụ mmiri citric acid n'ihe ọcha dị na tile ụlọ mposi, hapụ ya nkeji 5, wee hichaa ya.

c-009.title: Belata chlorine fọdụrụ na mmiri famfo site n'ịhapụ ma ọ bụ isi ya
c-009.summary: Mmiri famfo nwere obere chlorine fọdụrụ maka ịnwụchapụ nje. Ọ dị mma, mana ọ bụrụ na ịnaghị amasị isi ya, a na-ebelata ya site n'ịhapụ mmiri ahụ n'ọnụ ma ọ bụ isi ya.
c-009.principle: Hypochlorous acid na-agbaji mgbe oge gafere ma ọ bụ mgbe ìhè metụrụ ya: $\mathrm{2HOCl \to 2HCl + O_2\uparrow}$
c-009.example: Chlorine fọdụrụ na famfo na-abụkarị 0.1~0.5mg/L. Ọ bụrụ na ị wụsa mmiri n'ime kettle hapụ ya ọtụtụ awa ma ọ bụ sie ya nkeji 5 n'ọnụ meghere, isi na-ebelata nke ukwuu.
c-009.actionItem: N'anyasị taa, wụsa mmiri n'ime kettle hapụ ya n'ọnụ meghere, echi tupu ị ṅụọ, tụnyere isi.

c-010.title: Ihe mere ntutu ji siri ike mgbe e sachara n'ime mmiri siri ike n'ala ọzọ
c-010.summary: Mmiri n'ebe lime dị ọtụtụ dị ka Europe nwere calcium na magnesium dị ukwuu, yabụ ụfụfụ shampoo dị nta ma ntutu na-esiri ike. Ọ na-enye aka ime ọgwụgwọ acid n'ogo ịsacha.
c-010.principle: $\mathrm{Ca^{2+}, Mg^{2+}}$ nke mmiri siri ike na-ejikọta na anionic surfactant nke shampoo ma mepụta ihe nrụsị. A na-egosipụta ịdị ike mmiri site na $\mathrm{mg/L\ CaCO_3}$.
c-010.example: Ọ bụrụ na ịdị ike dị 300mg/L ma ọ bụ karịa, a na-ekewa ya dị ka 'siri ike nke ukwuu', nke karịrị mmiri famfo Korea (na-abụkarị 50~100mg/L) okpukpu 3 ma ọ bụ karịa. Ọ bụrụ na ịgwakọta otu ngaji apple cider vinegar n'ime lita mmiri 1 saa ya ikpeazụ, ịsiri ike na-ebelata.
c-010.actionItem: N'akpa njem ọzọ, kwanye obere ntụ citric acid ma ọ bụ obere karama vinegar, ma jụọ ebe obibi ịdị ike mmiri ebe ahụ.

c-011.title: A na-eme ka ion-exchange resin nke ihe nzacha mmiri dị nro dịghachi site na nnu
c-011.summary: Ihe nzacha shower na ụfọdụ ihe nzacha mmiri na-ejide calcium site na ion-exchange resin. Enwere ụdị a na-emegharị site na mmiri nnu na ụdị a na-agbanwe, yabụ lelee tupu ịzụta.
c-011.principle: Resin na-ejide calcium ma wepụta sodium: $\mathrm{2R\text{-}Na + Ca^{2+} \to R_2Ca + 2Na^+}$. Mgbe ọ jupụtara, a na-eweghachi ya site na mmiri nnu siri ike.
c-011.example: Ọ bụrụ na otu ihe nzacha a na-agbanwe nwere ọnụ ahịa KRW 10,000 ma a na-agbanwe ya otu ugboro n'ọnwa, ọnụ ahịa afọ bụ KRW 120,000. Ụdị a na-emegharị nwere ike ịrụ ọrụ ọtụtụ afọ site n'ọnụ ahịa nnu kilogram ole na ole naanị.
c-011.actionItem: Tụnyere 'oge mgbanwe' na 'ma enwere ike imegharị' nke ihe nzacha ị chọrọ ịzụta, gbakọọ ọnụ ahịa afọ.

c-012.title: Ihe na-ekpo ọkụ nwere ọkpụkpụ mmiri na-eji ume dị ukwuu ma na-emebi n'oge
c-012.summary: Ọ bụrụ na lime chịkọtara n'elu efere ọkụ nke kettle eletrik ma ọ bụ humidifier, okpomọkụ na-agafe n'ime mmiri dị ntakịrị, oge ịkpo ọkụ na-abawanye, akụkụ na-ekpo ọkụ karịa. Iwepụ ya mgbe niile bara uru maka ume na ndụ ogologo oge.
c-012.principle: Ntufu okpomọkụ bụ $q = \dfrac{kA\Delta T}{d}$, ọkpụkpụ mmiri ($k \approx 1\text{-}3\ \mathrm{W/(m\cdot K)}$) bụ ihe mkpuchi nke na-egbochi okpomọkụ karịa ígwè nke ukwuu.
c-012.example: Ọ bụrụ na ọkpụkpụ chịkọtara 2mm ma ọ bụ karịa, oge ịkpo ọkụ ruo otu okpomọkụ nwere ike ịbawanye site na pasent ole na ole, okpomọkụ nke ihe na-ekpo ọkụ na-ebili ma ndụ ya na-ebelata. Ịsa ya na citric acid otu ugboro n'ọnwa zuru ezu.
c-012.actionItem: Na kalenda, debanye aha ihe na-emegharị: 'Sọndee mbụ nke ọnwa ọ bụla, saa kettle na humidifier na citric acid'.

c-013.title: Gbaze ice na nnu: fesa obere tupu ọ ghọọ ice
c-013.summary: Ọ bụrụ na ị fesa obere nnu tupu snow ma ọ bụ tupu ịghọ ice, a chọrọ obere karịa mgbe a na-agbaze ice nke gbaziri agbazi. Ihe kpatara ya bụ ebe mmiri na-aghọ ice na-agbada.
c-013.principle: Mbelata ebe ịghọ ice $\Delta T_f = i K_f m$ ($K_f = 1.86\ \mathrm{K\cdot kg/mol}$, $i \approx 2$ nke NaCl)
c-013.example: Mmiri nnu nwere 10% ibu nwere $m \approx 1.9\ \mathrm{mol/kg}$, yabụ $\Delta T_f \approx 7\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$, ya bụ ọ na-amalite ịghọ ice na ihe dị ka -7℃. N'okpuru -10℃ ịdị irè na-ebelata nke ukwuu, n'oge ahụ jiri ájá.
c-013.actionItem: Ọ bụrụ na amụma ihu igwe na-egosi oyi n'okpuru efu n'abalị taa, fesa obere nnu n'ala steepụ ọnụ ụzọ.

c-014.title: Nnu calcium chloride na nnu nkịtị: ihe ị ga-eji n'ebe ole
c-014.summary: Calcium chloride na-arụ ọrụ ruo okpomọkụ dị ala karịa, mana ọ na-emebi sịmenti na ígwè karịa. Họrọ dabere n'okpomọkụ na ebe.
c-014.principle: Calcium chloride na-ewepụta okpomọkụ mgbe ọ na-agbaze na mmiri: $\mathrm{CaCl_2 \to Ca^{2+} + 2Cl^-}$, $\Delta H \approx -82\ \mathrm{kJ/mol}$
c-014.example: Ịdị irè n'ezie bụ NaCl ruo ihe dị ka -10℃, $\mathrm{CaCl_2}$ ruo ihe dị ka -25℃. Nso sịmenti ọhụrụ ma ọ bụ ntụpọ ígwè, belata iji chloride jiri ájá.
c-014.actionItem: Taa, lelee ihe dị n'akpa nnu ịgbaze ice (sodium chloride/calcium chloride), ma kaa akara dị iche ka ejila ya nso ntụpọ ígwè dị nso n'ọnụ ụzọ.

c-015.title: Saa ụkwụ anụ ụlọ na aka site na nnu ịgbaze ice
c-015.summary: Nnu chloride a fesara n'okporo ụzọ na-akpọnwụ ụkwụ ụkwụ, ma ọ bụrụ na anụ lanye ya, ọ nwere ike ime ka ọ gbọọ agbọ. Saa na mmiri ọkụ ọkụ mgbe ị na-aga ije.
c-015.principle: Chloride na-adọta mmiri akpụkpọ ma na-akpọnwụ ya. Mmiri nnu agbazere fọdụrụ site n'otu ụkpụrụ dị ka mbelata ebe ịghọ ice $\Delta T_f = i K_f m$.
c-015.example: Calcium chloride na-ewepụta okpomọkụ mgbe ọ na-agbaze, yabụ ma ọ metụ akpụkpọ jụụ, ọ nwere ike ịkpasu iwe. Ọ bụrụ na ịsa ụkwụ na mmiri ọkụ ọkụ sekọnd 30 ma kpoo nkụ, ọtụtụ oge ọ zuru.
c-015.actionItem: Mgbe ije taa, saa ụkwụ anụ ụlọ na mmiri ọkụ ọkụ, gị onwe gị hichaakwa ala akpụkpọ ụkwụ na akwa mmiri.

c-016.title: Tupu njem ogologo oge n'oge oyi, lelee ebe mmiri ịsacha windshield na-aghọ ice
c-016.summary: Mmiri ịsacha windshield nwere naanị mmiri na-aghọ ice na 0℃ ma na-egbochi ọhụụ. Mmiri ịsacha windshield maka oyi nwere alcohol na-ebelata ebe ịghọ ice.
c-016.principle: Ebe $\Delta T_f = K_f m$, ọ bụrụ na alcohol dị ukwuu ebe ịghọ ice na-agbada, mana ọ na-ere ọkụ ngwa ngwa ($\mathrm{C_2H_5OH + 3O_2 \to 2CO_2 + 3H_2O}$).
c-016.example: Ngwaahịa e dere -20℃ ma ọ bụ -30℃ n'akara ya anaghị aghọ ice ruo okpomọkụ ahụ, mana ọ bụrụ na agwakọta ya na mmiri, ebe ịghọ ice na-ebili. Ikuku nke ngwaahịa methanol na-egbu egbu, yabụ lekọta ikuku.
c-016.actionItem: Tupu ịpụ, lelee mmiri fọdụrụ n'ime tank windshield na akara ebe ịghọ ice n'akara.

c-017.title: Antifreeze: lelee ọnụọgụ ngwakọta na akara ụkpụrụ tupu ịzụta
c-017.summary: Ọ bụrụ na ịgwakọta antifreeze (ethylene glycol) na mmiri jụụ, ebe ịghọ ice na-agbada ma ebe esi na-ebili. Ga-eso ọnụọgụ na ụkpụrụ ka ọ rụọ ọrụ, ejikọkwala ụdị dị iche.
c-017.principle: $\Delta T_f = i K_f m$, na ethylene glycol (ihe dị ka 50 vol%) ebe ịghọ ice dị ihe dị ka -37℃ ma ebe esi dị ihe dị ka 106℃.
c-017.example: Ọ bụrụ na ejiri naanị ihe zuru oke, ebe ịghọ ice na-ebilikwa ma ntufu okpomọkụ na-ebelata. Ethylene glycol na-atọ ụtọ, yabụ ọ na-egbu anụ ụlọ, hichaa ya ozugbo ọ wụpụrụ.
c-017.actionItem: Lelee ụkpụrụ antifreeze a na-akwado na ọnụọgụ ngwakọta n'akwụkwọ ntuziaka ụgbọ ala, wee jụọ mgbe a na-eme atụmatụ ọnụ ahịa n'ụlọ ọrụ.

c-018.title: Enwere ike ịkọ ntụpọ mmiri windo n'oge oyi site na dew point
c-018.summary: Ọ bụrụ na ikuku na-ekpo mmiri dị n'ime ụlọ metụrụ iko oyi, ntụpọ mmiri na-etolite ma na-akpata mold na mfu okpomọkụ. Ọ bụrụ na idozi ọnụ ọgụgụ ikuku mmiri n'ime ụlọ nke ọma, a naghị ata ahịhịa n'ịkpo ọkụ.
c-018.principle: Dew point fọrọ nke nta ka ọ gbaso usoro $T_d \approx T - \dfrac{100-\mathrm{RH}}{5}$ ($\mathrm{RH}>50\%$), na condensation bụ $\mathrm{H_2O(g) \to H_2O(l)}$.
c-018.example: Ọ bụrụ na n'ime ụlọ bụ 22℃ ma ikuku mmiri bụ 60%, dew point dị ihe dị ka 14℃. Ọ bụrụ na elu n'ime windo bụ 10℃, ntụpọ mmiri ga-apụta, yabụ ọ bụrụ na ịbelata ikuku mmiri ruo 40~50%, dew point dị ihe dị ka 10~12℃ ma a na-egbochi ọtụtụ.
c-018.actionItem: Taa, setịpụ ikuku mmiri a chọrọ nke humidifier ka ọ bụrụ 40~50% ma lelee uru hygrometer n'anyasị.

c-019.title: Wepụ mold silicone ụlọ mposi nke ọma site na bleach ewepụrụ ewepụ
c-019.summary: Mold ojii gbasara n'elu silicone na-apụ agba site na bleach nwere oxidizing. Gbaa mbọ nke ọma ka ikuku gaa, ejikwala ya na ngwaahịa acid.
c-019.principle: Oxidation nke hypochlorite: $\mathrm{NaOCl \to Na^+ + OCl^-}$, ma $\mathrm{OCl^-}$ na-eme oxidation nke agba mold na mkpụrụ ndụ ya.
c-019.example: Kwụsị bleach ahịa (ihe dị ka 4~5%) na mmiri 1:10, tinye ya, mgbe nkeji 10 saa ya nke ọma na mmiri. Mold na-etolite na ikuku mmiri nwere ike 60~70% ma ọ bụ karịa, yabụ ịhapụ ikuku mgbe shawa na-egbochi nlaghachi.
c-019.actionItem: Taa, meghee windo ụlọ mposi, yiri aka, hichaa mold silicone na ngwọta bleach 1:10, mgbe nkeji 10 saa ya.

c-020.title: Wepụ mold na agba odo nke ọma site na sodium percarbonate
c-020.summary: Sodium percarbonate, bleach oxygen, anaghị akpasu iwe dị ka bleach ma enweghị ihe egwu gas chlorine, yabụ ọ dị mfe iji ya na uwe nwere agba. Ọ na-arụ ọrụ nke ọma na mmiri ọkụ.
c-020.principle: Sodium percarbonate na-agbaji ma wepụta hydrogen peroxide: $\mathrm{2Na_2CO_3\cdot 3H_2O_2 \to 2Na_2CO_3 + 3H_2O_2}$, $\mathrm{2H_2O_2 \to 2H_2O + O_2\uparrow}$
c-020.example: Ọ bụrụ na ị gbazee otu ngaji sodium percarbonate (ihe dị ka 10g) n'ime lita mmiri 1 nke 40~50℃ tinye ya nkeji 30 ruo awa 1, ntụpọ ọsụsọ na mold na-apụ. Ejila ya na ajị anụ na silk.
c-020.actionItem: Taa, gbazee otu ngaji sodium percarbonate na mmiri 40~50℃ tinye sọks ma ọ bụ akwa kichin nwere agba odo nkeji 30.

c-021.title: Ihe na-amị mmiri n'ime kọbọd uwe na-adịte aka n'ebe pere mpe
c-021.summary: Ihe na-amị mmiri calcium chloride na-amị mmiri dị n'ikuku ma ghọọ mmiri. Ọ bụrụ na ejiri ya n'ebe pere mpe e mechiri dị ka kọbọd uwe ma ọ bụ igbe akpụkpọ ụkwụ kama nnukwu ụlọ, ọ na-arụ ọrụ nke ọma.
c-021.principle: $\mathrm{CaCl_2(s) + 6H_2O(g) \to CaCl_2\cdot 6H_2O}$ na-amị mmiri, ma ọ bụrụ na ọ mị karịa ọ na-agbaze ghọọ mmiri.
c-021.example: Calcium chloride na-amị mmiri ọtụtụ ugboro ibu ya. Ọ bụrụ na etinye ya n'ebe a na-emeghe ọnụ ụzọ ugboro ugboro, ọ na-eju ngwa ngwa, yabụ ọ bara uru iji ya karịa otu ọnwa n'ebe pere mpe e mechiri. Wụpụ mmiri chịkọtara na-ametụghị akpụkpọ ma ọ bụ ígwè.
c-021.actionItem: Taa, tinye otu ihe na-amị mmiri n'okpuru kọbọd uwe, belata ugboro ị na-emeghe na ime mmechi ọnụ ụzọ.

c-022.title: Obere akpa dị n'ime nri: silica gel na quicklime dị iche
c-022.summary: Silica gel na quicklime bụ ihe nkụ abụọ a na-ahụkarị n'ime nkwakọ nri, ma ejila nke ọ bụla ri nri. Quicklime na-ekpo ọkụ mgbe ọ zutere mmiri, yabụ lezie anya na anya na ọnụ karịsịa.
c-022.principle: Quicklime: $\mathrm{CaO + H_2O \to Ca(OH)_2}$ (na-ewepụta okpomọkụ, $\Delta H \approx -64\ \mathrm{kJ/mol}$). Silica gel na-adọta ụmụ mmiri n'elu ya (adsorption).
c-022.example: Enwere ike iji silica gel ọzọ ma ọ bụrụ na e kpochapụrụ ya n'oven 100~120℃ awa 1~2. Ọ bụrụ na akpa quicklime jụrụ mmiri, ọ na-aghọ mmiri alkali siri ike, yabụ tụfuo ya na-ametụghị mmiri.
c-022.actionItem: Wepụta akpa ihe nkụ n'ime drowa kichin, lelee akara 'silica gel/quicklime', ma debe ha ebe ụmụaka na-erughị.

c-023.title: Gbochie ụzụ n'iko anya na goggles site na otu ntụpọ surfactant
c-023.summary: Ụzụ na-etolite n'ime lens mgbe ị na-abanye n'ime ụlọ dị ọkụ site n'èzí oyi n'oge oyi bụ obere ntụpọ mmiri na-akpata. Ọ bụrụ na e kpuchie ya na fim surfactant, ntụpọ mmiri na-agbasa n'ime fim dị gịrịgịrị ma ọhụụ na-aga n'ihu.
c-023.principle: Ọ bụrụ na contact angle ka ukwuu, ntụpọ mmiri na-etolite. Surfactant na-ebelata surface tension $\gamma$ ka ntụpọ mmiri gbasaa.
c-023.example: Ọ bụrụ na ị tee naanị otu ntụpọ ncha mwepụ efere n'ime lens dị gịrịgịrị ma hichaa ya na akwa kpọrọ nkụ, ụzụ na-ebelata awa ole na ole. Lens nwere coating nwere ike ịmebi, yabụ lelee ntuziaka onye mepụtara.
c-023.actionItem: Tupu ịpụ taa, kpọchie elu mkpuchi imi nke ọma n'imi, ma tee otu ntụpọ ncha n'iko anya hichaa.

c-024.title: Ọ bụrụ na ị gbasaa nri dị gịrịgịrị kpọọ ya oyi ngwa ngwa, ọ naghị emebi nke ukwuu
c-024.summary: Ọ bụrụ na ọ na-aghọ oyi nwayọ, nnukwu kristal ice na-adọwa mkpụrụ ndụ, mmiri na-apụ mgbe agbaze ma nri na-esiri ike. Ọ bụrụ na gbasaa dị gịrịgịrị kpọọ ya oyi ngwa ngwa, obere kristal na-etolite ma ogo na-adịgide.
c-024.principle: Nha kristal na-adabere n'ọsọ nke ịkpọpụta oyi. Mgbanwe ọnọdụ $\mathrm{H_2O(l) \to H_2O(s)}$, a ga-ewepụrịrị okpomọkụ nke $\Delta H_{fus} = 6.01\ \mathrm{kJ/mol}$.
c-024.example: Ọ bụrụ na ị gbasaa ọka ofe ma ọ bụ anụ fọdụrụ n'akpa zipper na ọkpụrụkpụ 2cm kpọọ ya oyi n'elu tray ígwè, ọ na-aghọ oyi awa ole na ole ngwa ngwa karịa ma ọ bụrụ na kpọọ ya n'otu mpempe, mfu mmiri anụ mgbe agbaze na-ebelatakwa. Ọkọlọtọ nchekwa bụ -18℃ ma ọ bụ n'okpuru.
c-024.actionItem: Taa, gbasaa otu nri fọdụrụ dị gịrịgịrị n'akpa zipper, dee ụbọchị, ma kpọọ ya oyi.

c-025.title: Otu esi emeso ube akwụkwọ nwere ọkụ ma ọ bụ agba akwụkwọ ndụ
c-025.summary: Ọkụ na akụkụ akwụkwọ ndụ nke ube akwụkwọ nwere solanine na-egbu egbu dị ukwuu. Ọ naghị agbaji ngwa ngwa ọbụna ma esie ma ọ bụ sie ya n'mmanụ, yabụ bipụ ya n'ụzọ dị ọkpụrụkpụ.
c-025.principle: Solanine na-anagide okpomọkụ, ọ na-agbajikwa naanị na ihe dị ka $290\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$. Ọ bụrụ na ìhè metụrụ ya, mmepụta solanine na-abawanye na chlorophyll.
c-025.example: Ọ bụrụ na ị bipụ nke ọma karịa 1cm gburugburu ọkụ na akụkụ akwụkwọ ndụ, a na-ewepụ ọtụtụ ya. Ọ bụrụ na akpụkpọ niile bụ akwụkwọ ndụ ma ọ bụ ọ na-agụ ilu, tụfuo ube. Ọ bụrụ na debe ya n'ebe gbara ọchịchịrị na jụụ (8~10℃), ọkụ na-apụta nwayọ.
c-025.actionItem: Taa, kechie ube akwụkwọ n'akwụkwọ akụkọ debe ya n'ebe gbara ọchịchịrị na jụụ, ma bipụ ma ọ bụ tụfuo ube nwere ọkụ.

c-026.title: Chịkwaa agba aja aja nke apụl na avocado site na otu ntụpọ mmiri lemon
c-026.summary: Mkpụrụ osisi e gbuturu na-aghọ agba aja aja n'ihi mmeghachi omume enzyme na-ejikọta na oxygen. Ọ bụrụ na agbakwunye acid, mmeghachi omume na-ebelata ma ọ dị mma iri.
c-026.principle: Polyphenol oxidase: $\mathrm{2\,catechol + O_2 \to 2\,o\text{-}benzoquinone + 2H_2O}$. Ascorbic acid (vitamin C) na-eweghachi quinone ka ọ bụrụ nke mbụ (reduction).
c-026.example: Na pH 4 ma ọ bụ n'okpuru, ọrụ enzyme na-ebelata nke ukwuu. Ọ bụrụ na ị gbutu otu apụl fesaa otu obere ngaji mmiri lemon, agba aja aja na-egbu oge awa 2~3. Akụkụ ghọrọ agba aja aja enweghị nnukwu nsogbu maka nri ma ọ bụ nchekwa.
c-026.actionItem: Ọ bụrụ na ị gbutu apụl ma ọ bụ avocado taa, tinye ya nwa oge n'ime mmiri lemon ma ọ bụ mmiri nnu.

c-027.title: Pressure cooker na-ebuli ebe esi iji belata oge isi nri na gas
c-027.summary: N'ime ite mechiri emechi, nrụgide na-abawanye ma mmiri na-esi na okpomọkụ karịrị 100℃. Ọ bụrụ na okpomọkụ bilie, ọsọ mmeghachi omume kemịkalụ na-abawanye.
c-027.principle: Dabere n'mmekọrịta Clausius-Clapeyron, na ihe dị ka 2atm (zuru ezu) mmiri na-esi na ihe dị ka $120\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$. Ọsọ mmeghachi omume bụ $k = Ae^{-E_a/RT}$.
c-027.example: Ọ bụrụ na okpomọkụ bilie 10℃, ọsọ mmeghachi omume na-abawanye okpukpu 2, yabụ ọ bụrụ na ọ bilie 20℃ ọ na-abawanye ihe dị ka okpukpu 4. Agwa ma ọ bụ anụ siri ike nke na-ewe nkeji 60 n'ite nkịtị na-ebelata ruo ihe dị ka nkeji 20 na pressure cooker, ojiji gas na-ebelatakwa nke ukwuu.
c-027.actionItem: Taa, nwaa nri na-ewe ogologo oge isi (agwa, shank wdg) na pressure cooker ma tụnyere oge.

c-028.title: Ihe kpatara jam nwere shuga dị ukwuu ji adịte aka na-enweghị mold
c-028.summary: N'ihi na shuga na-ejide mmiri, mmiri nje pere mpe pụrụ iji na-ebelata. Ọ bụrụ na e kpochapụ karama ma soro ọnụọgụ shuga, enwere ike idebe ya ogologo oge na friji.
c-028.principle: Ọ bụrụ na water activity $a_w = \dfrac{p}{p_0}$ dara n'okpuru 0.85, ọtụtụ nje anaghị eto, mold na-etokwa ruo ihe dị ka 0.8.
c-028.example: Jam nwere ihe dị ka 60% shuga nwere $a_w \approx 0.80$, nke na-egbochi nje mana mold ga-ekwe omume. Ọ bụrụ na etinye ya n'ime karama e kpochapụrụ na mmiri ọkụ, na friji tupu imeghe, ma rie ya n'ime izu 2~3 mgbe imeghe, a na-ebelata mfu.
c-028.actionItem: Taa, sie mkpụrụ osisi fọdụrụ na shuga 40~50% mee jam, tinye ya n'ime karama e kpochapụrụ ma dee ụbọchị.

c-029.title: Mmanụ pan fry: buru ụzọ hichaa ya wee saa na mmiri ọkụ ọkụ
c-029.summary: Mmanụ jụrụ oyi na-ekpo ike ma a naghị ehicha ya n'ụzọ dị mfe na ncha na mmiri. Ọ bụrụ na buru ụzọ hichaa ya na akwa kichin wee jiri mmiri ọkụ ọkụ na ncha, a na-echekwa ncha na mmiri.
c-029.principle: Abụba na-eme mmeghachi omume na alkali na surfactant ghọọ ncha dị mfe ịsa: $\mathrm{C_3H_5(OOCR)_3 + 3NaOH \to C_3H_5(OH)_3 + 3RCOONa}$
c-029.example: Abụba ezi na-amalite agbaze na ihe dị ka 30~40℃, yabụ mmiri nke ihe dị ka 40℃ na-agbaze mmanụ. Ọ bụrụ na buru ụzọ hichaa ya, mmiri ịsa efere na-ebelata ruo ọkara ma a na-egbochikwa mkpọchi ọwa mmiri.
c-029.actionItem: Tupu ịsa efere taa, buru ụzọ hichaa mmanụ pan na akwa kichin wee saa ya na mmiri ọkụ ọkụ.

c-030.title: Ọ bụrụ na ịkwụsị n'agba ọlaedo dị nro mgbe ị na-eri nri n'mmanụ na ịsa, acrylamide na-ebelata
c-030.summary: Ọ bụrụ na ị sie ube akwụkwọ ma ọ bụ achịcha na okpomọkụ dị elu ruo agba aja aja gbara ọchịchịrị, acrylamide na-abawanye. Ọ bụrụ na ịkwụsị n'agba ọlaedo, e debere ụtọ ma mmepụta na-ebelata.
c-030.principle: Asparagine na reducing sugar na-eme mmeghachi omume Maillard na $120\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ ma ọ bụ karịa, a na-emepụtakwa acrylamide ($\mathrm{C_3H_5NO}$).
c-030.example: Ọ bụrụ na ịkwụsị n'agba ọlaedo na 175℃ ma ọ bụ n'okpuru mgbe ị na-eri ube akwụkwọ n'mmanụ, ma ghara idebe ube akwụkwọ na friji, shuga anaghị abawanye ma ọnụ ọgụgụ acrylamide nwere ike ibelata nke ukwuu. Ọ ka mma izere akụkụ agba aja aja gbara ọchịchịrị na ndị gbara ọkụ.
c-030.actionItem: Taa, wepụta toast ma ọ bụ ube akwụkwọ a gbara tupu ọ ghọọ agba aja aja gbara ọchịchịrị, bipụkwa akụkụ ọkụ ọkụ.

c-031.title: Hot pack nke otu ojiji na-enye okpomọkụ site na nchara ígwè
c-031.summary: Ntụ ígwè n'ime hot pack na-eme oxidation mgbe ọ zutere oxygen dị n'ikuku, na-enye okpomọkụ. Ọ dị mma n'njem oyi, mana ọ bụrụ na ịgbado ya n'akpụkpọ ogologo oge enwere ihe egwu ọkụ nke okpomọkụ dị ala.
c-031.principle: $\mathrm{4Fe + 3O_2 + 6H_2O \to 4Fe(OH)_3}$ bụ mmeghachi omume na-enye okpomọkụ, activated carbon na nnu na-eme ka mmeghachi omume dị ngwa.
c-031.example: Okpomọkụ kacha elu bụ ihe dị ka 50~60℃ ma ọ na-adịte aka awa ole na ole. Gbado ya n'elu uwe pụọ ná uwe ime, wepụ ya mgbe ị na-ehi ụra iji gbochie ọkụ nke okpomọkụ dị ala. Tupu imeghe, nkwakọ mechiri emechi na-egbochi ikuku.
c-031.actionItem: Ọ bụrụ na ị ga-eji hot pack taa, gbado ya n'elu uwe ma lelee ọnọdụ akpụkpọ awa nile.

c-032.title: Ihe na-ewepụ isi nke icheku bụ adsorption, ọ bụghị nkewa
c-032.summary: Icheku na activated carbon na-ejide ụmụ isi n'elu ha iji belata ya. Ọ bụrụ na ha jupụtara, ịdị irè na-efu, yabụ soro oge mgbanwe ma ọ bụ nbudo ọzọ.
c-032.principle: Adsorption bụ ịrapara nke ụmụ ihe n'elu, ma elu activated carbon na-erute $500\text{-}1500\ \mathrm{m^2/g}$.
c-032.example: 100g nke activated carbon nwere ike inwe elu nha ọhịa egwuregwu bọọlụ, yabụ ọ na-ejide isi nke otu akụkụ friji. Ọ bụrụ na ịkpọọ icheku n'anyanwụ otu ugboro n'ọnwa, akụkụ ụfọdụ na-emegharị, ma gbanwee ya kwa ọnwa 3~6.
c-032.actionItem: Dee ụbọchị ịgbanwe ihe na-ewepụ isi friji n'akara, ma setịpụ ncheta mgbe ọnwa 3.

c-033.title: Itinye osikapa n'mmiri nkeji 30 na-ebelata ume isi nri
c-033.summary: Osikapa tinyere n'mmiri ejirila mmiri ọ ṅụrụ, yabụ oge ịkpo ọkụ na-ebelata ma osikapa na-esi nke ọma. Ojiji igwe isi osikapa eletrik ma ọ bụ gas na-ebelata nwayọ nwayọ.
c-033.principle: Starch na-amị mmiri na-aghọ gelatinizing: $\mathrm{(C_6H_{10}O_5)_n + nH_2O \to}$ gel ọ mụbara. Gelatinization na-eme na ihe dị ka $60\text{-}70\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$.
c-033.example: Ọ bụrụ na itinye osikapa n'mmiri nkeji 30, ọ na-amị ihe dị ka 20~25% mmiri dabere n'ibu ma mmiri na-eru n'ime. Oge isi nri na-ebelata nkeji ole na ole karịa ma ọ bụrụ na etinyeghị ya, yabụ ọ bụrụ na ị na-esi kwa ụbọchị, a na-echekwa ọtụtụ nkeji n'ọnwa. N'oge oyi, mmiri ọkụ ọkụ dị ngwa karịa.
c-033.actionItem: N'anyasị taa, saa osikapa tinye ya n'mmiri nkeji 30 wee sie, ma tụnyere oge isi nri.

c-034.title: Sekọnd 20 nke ịsa aka bụ oge ncha chọrọ iji gbaa ntụpọ gburugburu
c-034.summary: Ụmụ ncha nwere otu akụkụ na-ahụ mmanụ n'anya na nke ọzọ na-ahụ mmiri n'anya, yabụ ha na-agba ntụpọ na nje gburugburu ma sachapụ ha. Usoro a chọrọ esemokwu na oge.
c-034.principle: Ncha na-emepụta micelles n'elu critical micelle concentration (CMC) na-ekechi mmanụ: $\mathrm{RCOONa \to RCOO^- + Na^+}$
c-034.example: Ọ bụrụ na ị tee ncha n'ọbụ aka, azụ aka, n'etiti mkpịsị aka, na n'okpuru ntu aka ma kụọ sekọnd 20 (ụda ụbọchị ọmụmụ ugboro abụọ), nje nkịtị na-ebelata nke ukwuu. Okpomọkụ mmiri zuru ezu ma ọ bụrụ na edozi ya iji chebe akpụkpọ, ọ bụghị maka ịdị irè.
c-034.actionItem: Taa, mgbe ị na-asa aka, gụọ sekọnd 20 site na timer ma ọ bụ ụda, kụọ ruo n'okpuru ntu aka.

c-035.title: Ihe nchebe egbugbere ọnụ n'oge oyi na-eme fim, ọ bụghị mmiri
c-035.summary: Lip balm hydrocarbon dị ka Vaseline na-eme fim na-egbochi mmiri (hydrophobic) nke na-egbochi mmiri ịpụ n'egbugbere ọnụ. Ọ na-arụ ọrụ nke ọma ma ọ bụrụ na etinye ya n'egbugbere ọnụ nwere mmiri ma ọ bụ n'elu akpụkpọ na-ekpuchi.
c-035.principle: Ọsọ ọgbụgba na-adaba n'ọdịiche nrụgide mmiri n'elu akpụkpọ, na fim petroleum hydrocarbon $\mathrm{C_nH_{2n+2}}$ anaghị agwakọta na mmiri yabụ ọ na-egbu oge ọgbụgba a.
c-035.example: N'ime ụlọ oyi kpọrọ nkụ (ikuku mmiri nsonaazụ ihe dị ka 20%), mmiri egbugbere ọnụ efu na-agbụ ngwa ngwa. Ọ bụrụ na tee Vaseline dị gịrịgịrị, ọgbụgba na-ebelata nke ukwuu ma ọ dịghị agbaji.
c-035.actionItem: Tupu ihi ụra taa, mịrị egbugbere ọnụ na mmiri wee tee otu mkpụrụ lip balm dị gịrịgịrị.

c-036.title: Tee hand cream mgbe aka nwere mmiri ka ọ dịte aka
c-036.summary: Ọ bụrụ na ị tee ya n'aka nwere mmiri, mmetụta moisturizer na-ejide mmiri na-abawanye. N'otu ọnụ ọgụgụ aka na-adị mmiri karịa, yabụ cream na-ebelata.
c-036.principle: Mfu mmiri akpụkpọ na-agbaso iwu diffusion $J = -D\dfrac{dC}{dx}$, glycerin na-adọta mmiri ma Vaseline na-egbochi ọgbụgba.
c-036.example: Ọ bụrụ na ị tee ọnụ ọgụgụ mkpụrụ agwa n'ime nkeji 3 mgbe shawa ma ọ bụ ịsa aka, mgbe ị kpọpụsịrị nwayọ na akwa, a ga-ebelata ọnụ ọgụgụ a na-ete ugboro abụọ ma ọ bụ atọ n'ụbọchị ọbụna n'oge oyi kpọrọ nkụ. Ịyi gloves na ihi ụra na-arụ ọrụ nke ukwuu.
c-036.actionItem: Mgbe ịsachara aka taa, tupu ikpọọ ha nkụ kpamkpam, tee hand cream ọnụ ọgụgụ mkpụrụ agwa.

c-037.title: Họrọ ncha ịsa ihu nwere acid dị mfe dị ka akpụkpọ (pH 5.5 ma ọ bụ nso)
c-037.summary: Elu akpụkpọ nwere fim nchebe acid dị mfe, ncha nwere pH dị elu nwere ike imebi ya. N'oge oyi kpọrọ nkụ, ihe nhicha acid dị mfe na-akpasu iwe obere.
c-037.principle: $\mathrm{pH = -\log[H^+]}$. Elu akpụkpọ nwere pH 4.5~5.5, ncha nkịtị nwere pH 9~10, yabụ $\mathrm{[H^+]}$ dị ala ihe dị ka puku iri ugboro.
c-037.example: pH 5.5 na pH 9.5 nwere ọdịiche hydrogen ion nke $10^4$ ugboro. Ihe ịsa ihu e dere 'acid dị mfe' n'akara ya na-ahapụ akpụkpọ na obere ịdọ mgbe ịsa ma na-ebelata ọnụ ọgụgụ moisturizer.
c-037.actionItem: Mgbe ị na-azụ ncha ịsa ihu n'ọdịnihu, lelee uru pH n'nkọwa ngwaahịa, dee otú akpụkpọ na-adọ mgbe ịsa.

c-038.title: Ihe kpatara ike power bank ji ebelata n'oyi
c-038.summary: N'okpomọkụ dị ala, mmeghachi omume kemịkalụ na mmegharị ion nke lithium-ion battery na-egbu oge, yabụ ike enwere ike iji na-ebelata. Ọ bụrụ na itinye ya n'akpa dị n'ime, ọ naghị ewepụ ọkụ nke ukwuu.
c-038.principle: N'ime ọsọ mmeghachi omume $k = Ae^{-E_a/RT}$, ọ bụrụ na $T$ ebelata, $k$ na-aghọ obere ma nguzogide dị n'ime batrị na-abawanye.
c-038.example: Na ihe dị ka 0℃ ike nwere ike ibelata 20~30%, na -10℃ karịa nke ahụ. Power bank 10,000 mAh nwere ike inye ihe dị ka 7,000 mAh naanị n'èzí n'oge oyi, yabụ ọ dị ka ugboro ịchaji na-ebelata.
c-038.actionItem: Mgbe ị na-apụ taa, tinye power bank na ekwentị n'akpa dị n'ime uwe nke ka okpomọkụ ahụ kpoo ha.

c-039.title: A na-agbakọ power bank n'ụgbọ elu na Wh
c-039.summary: Enwere ike iburu lithium battery n'ibu aka naanị ọ bụghị n'ibu etinyere n'ụlọ nchekwa, oke ike dị n'ụdị Wh. Ilele mAh naanị na-ewe iwe, yabụ gbakọọ onwe gị.
c-039.principle: $\mathrm{Wh = V \times Ah}$ (lithium-ion nominal 3.7V). N'okpuru 100Wh a kwadoro, 100~160Wh chọrọ nkwado ụgbọ elu.
c-039.example: 20,000 mAh = 20 Ah × 3.7V = 74Wh enweghị nsogbu, 27,000 mAh bụkwa 99.9Wh, nso oke. 30,000 mAh (111Wh) chọrọ nkwado.
c-039.actionItem: Taa, mụbaa mAh nke power bank gị site na 3.7V ka ọ bụrụ Wh, ma lelee ma Wh dị n'akara.

c-040.title: Gbochie nsị carbon monoxide mgbe ị na-eji ngwa ọkụ na icheku n'oge oyi
c-040.summary: Ọ bụrụ na mmanụ ọkụ ọ na-agaghị n'ihe zuru ezu n'ebe ikuku na-agaghị, a na-emepụta carbon monoxide na-enweghị isi. Ejila icheku, briquette, ma ọ bụ ọkụ ogige n'ime ụlọ.
c-040.principle: Ọ bụrụ na oxygen adịghị, $\mathrm{2C + O_2 \to 2CO}$ na-emepụta carbon monoxide, CO na-ejikọta na hemoglobin ihe dị ka okpukpu 200 karịa oxygen.
c-040.example: Na 200ppm nke CO n'ikuku, isi ọwụwa na-amalite n'ime awa ole na ole, na 800ppm ma ọ bụ karịa ọ dị ize ndụ n'ime otu awa. Lelee njikọ ọkpọkọ anwụrụ boiler na ikuku, ma tinye ngwa ọkwa CO.
c-040.actionItem: Taa, lelee ọnọdụ njikọ ọkpọkọ anwụrụ boiler ma lelee batrị ngwa ọkwa CO.

c-041.title: Ọ bụrụ na ire ọkụ gas bụ odo odo, a na-efu mmanụ ọkụ
c-041.summary: Ire ọkụ gas nkịtị bụ nchara anụnụ; ọ bụrụ na odo odo ma ọ bụ oroma, ọkụ ọ na-agaghị zuru ezu, nke na-abawanye ụsị na carbon monoxide. Nhicha burner na-eweghachi ịdị irè.
c-041.principle: Ọkụ zuru ezu: $\mathrm{CH_4 + 2O_2 \to CO_2 + 2H_2O}$. Mgbe oxygen adịghị $\mathrm{CH_4 + \tfrac{3}{2}O_2 \to CO + 2H_2O}$.
c-041.example: Ọ bụrụ na ire ọkụ bụ odo odo ma ala ite na-aghọ ojii site n'ụsị, okpomọkụ na-aga ala ma mmanụ ọkụ ka bụ otu ma ọ bụ na-abawanye. Ọ bụrụ na wepụ nri fọdụrụ n'oghere burner site na ngwa eze, ọtụtụ oge ire ọkụ na-alaghachi n'nchara anụnụ.
c-041.actionItem: Taa, hichaa oghere burner nke ọkụ gas site na ngwa eze ma lelee agba ire ọkụ.

c-042.title: Batrị lead-acid ụgbọ ala: gbochie ịgwụ ọkụ n'oge oyi iji chekwaa ọnụ ahịa mgbanwe
c-042.summary: Ọ bụrụ na oyi na ịkwọ ụgbọ dị mkpụmkpụ na-emegharị, batrị lead-acid na-agwụ ọkụ ma ndụ ya na-ebelata. Mgbe ọ gwụrụ, electrolyte na-aghọ mmiri ma nwee ike ịghọ ice n'ihu igwe n'okpuru efu.
c-042.principle: Ịgwụ ọkụ: $\mathrm{Pb + PbO_2 + 2H_2SO_4 \to 2PbSO_4 + 2H_2O}$. Sulfuric acid na-agwụ, yabụ ebe ịghọ ice nke electrolyte na-ebili.
c-042.example: Electrolyte nke batrị jupụtara na-aghọ ice na ihe dị ka -60℃, mana ọ bụrụ na ọ gwụrụ ọ nwere ike ịghọ ice na ihe dị ka -7℃. Ọ bụrụ na ị kwọ ụgbọ karịa nkeji 30 otu ugboro n'izu ma ọ bụ tinye ọkụ site na charger, a pụrụ igbu oge ọnụ ahịa mgbanwe nke dị ihe dị ka KRW 100,000.
c-042.actionItem: Taa, tupu ịmalite ụgbọ ala, gbanyụọ ngwa ọkụ, heating wire, na audio, ma hazie ịkwọ ụgbọ nkeji 30 otu ugboro n'izu.

c-043.title: Seasoning nke ite ígwè bụ mmeghachi omume polymerization nke mmanụ na-akpọnwụ
c-043.summary: N'ite ígwè ọhụrụ, ọ bụrụ na ị gbaa mmanụ dị gịrịgịrị n'okpomọkụ dị elu mee fim siri ike, nchara na ịrapara na-ebelata. Ọ bụrụ na ị tee ya ọkpụrụkpụ, ọ na-aghọ nke nwere nnu.
c-043.principle: Unsaturated fatty acid na-eme mmeghachi omume na oxygen na-aghọ polymerizing. A na-emepụta nchara dị ka $\mathrm{4Fe + 3O_2 + 6H_2O \to 4Fe(OH)_3}$.
c-043.example: Ọ bụrụ na ị tee obere mmanụ n'ọnụ ọgụgụ pere mpe wee hichaa na akwa kichin, gbaa ya n'oven 220℃ awa 1, fim na-etolite. Mgbe ojiji, ọ bụrụ na ị kpọpụsịa mmiri ozugbo, enwere ike iji ite e mere seasoning ọtụtụ afọ, yabụ ọ dị ọnụ ala.
c-043.actionItem: Mgbe ịsachara ite ígwè taa, tụkwasị ya n'ọkụ ka mmiri gbaa, ma hichaa mmanụ dị gịrịgịrị n'elu ya.

c-044.title: Hichaa ngaji ọlaọcha agbanweela agba site na foil aluminium na baking soda
c-044.summary: A na-eweghachi silver sulfide ojii n'elu ọlaọcha ka ọ bụrụ ọlaọcha site na mmeghachi omume eletrik-kemịkalụ. A naghị egbu, yabụ ọlaọcha na-ewepụ obere. Isi sulfur ga-apụta, yabụ meghee ikuku.
c-044.example: Gbazee otu ngaji baking soda n'ime 500mL mmiri ọkụ, tinye ọlaọcha ka ọ metụ foil nkeji 2~5. Ejila ya na pearl, nkume bara uru, ma ọ bụ ihe nwere aka e rapara.
c-044.actionItem: Taa, tinye otu ngaji ọlaọcha agbanweela agba n'ime mmiri ọkụ nwere baking soda na foil.

c-045.title: Erila nchara akwụkwọ ndụ nke ite ọla edo na-acha ọbara ọbara
c-045.summary: Ọ bụrụ na ọla edo zutere acid na ikuku mmiri, nchara akwụkwọ ndụ (verdigris) na-etolite, ọ na-egbukwa egbu. Ahapụla nri acid n'ime ọla edo ogologo oge, ma lelee ọnọdụ coating dị n'ime.
c-045.principle: Copper oxide na-agbaze na vinegar: $\mathrm{CuO + 2CH_3COOH \to Cu(CH_3COO)_2 + H_2O}$. Verdigris bụ $\mathrm{Cu_2(OH)_2CO_3}$.
c-045.example: Ite ọla edo nke e kpuchiri n'ime ya na tin ma ọ bụ stainless steel dị mma. A na-ehicha nchara akwụkwọ ndụ n'èzí site na ngwakọta vinegar 1 : nnu 1 nkeji 5 wee saa. Ọ bụrụ na coating dị n'ime pụrụ, ejila ya sie nri.
c-045.actionItem: Taa, lelee ọnọdụ coating dị n'ime ite ọla edo, ma ọ bụrụ na ọ pụrụ, ejila ya sie nri.

c-046.title: Ite nri rapara: itinye baking soda ịgbaze na-ebelata ume
c-046.summary: Kama ịkpụ ogologo oge n'ike na mmiri ọkụ, isi na ngwọta alkali dị mfe na-ewepu ntụpọ ọkụ n'obere ike. Ite aluminium na-agbanwe agba, yabụ zere ya.
c-046.principle: Mgbe e kpoo ya, $\mathrm{2NaHCO_3 \to Na_2CO_3 + H_2O + CO_2\uparrow}$ na-emepụta sodium carbonate ma pH na-ebili ruo ihe dị ka 11.
c-046.example: Ọ bụrụ na itinye ngaji 2 baking soda n'ime 500mL mmiri sie ya na obere ọkụ nkeji 10, ntụpọ ọkụ na-agbaze. Ọ ka mma karịa ịhapụ famfo na-asọ ogologo oge ka ị na-akpụ, n'ihi na mmiri na ncha na-ebelata ma a na-echekwa ojiji mmiri ọkụ.
c-046.actionItem: Taa, tinye mmiri na ngaji 2 baking soda n'ime ite gbara ọkụ, sie nkeji 10, hapụ ka ọ jụọ, wee hichaa.

c-047.title: Uwe nwere ọbara: buru ụzọ jiri mmiri oyi
c-047.summary: A na-ewepụ ntụpọ ọbara ma ọ bụrụ na buru ụzọ saa ya na mmiri oyi nke 20℃ ma ọ bụ n'okpuru, ọ bụghị mmiri ọkụ ọkụ.
c-047.principle: Protein ọbara dị ka hemoglobin na fibrinogen na-eme denaturing na coagulating mgbe okpomọkụ metụrụ ha, na-arapara n'eriri akwa. Hydrogen peroxide na-agbaji mgbe ọ zutere catalase n'ọbara: $\mathrm{2H_2O_2 \xrightarrow{catalase} 2H_2O + O_2\uparrow}$
c-047.example: Uwe owu a sachara na mmiri ọkụ 60℃ ntụpọ ọbara na-ekpo ike ghọọ agba aja aja, mana ọ bụrụ na itinye ya n'mmiri oyi 15℃ nkeji 5 wee tụnye ntụpọ ole na ole nke 3% hydrogen peroxide, ụfụfụ (oxygen) na-ebili ma ọtụtụ ya na-apụ. Jiri ya n'uwe ọcha naanị, n'uwe nwere agba buru ụzọ nwaa n'ebe a na-adịghị ahụ.
c-047.actionItem: Ọ bụrụ na ntụpọ pụta taa, kama mmiri ọkụ ọkụ hapụ mmiri oyi na-asọ, saa site n'azụ gaa n'ihu.

c-048.title: Jiri ncha nsacha dabere n'ịdị ike mmiri, naanị ọnụ ọgụgụ kwesịrị ekwesị
c-048.summary: Ọ bụrụ na ịgbakwunye ncha karịa ọnụ ọgụgụ a na-akwado, ike nhicha fọrọ nke nta ka ọ bụrụ otu, naanị mmiri ịsa na ọnụ ahịa ncha na-abawanye.
c-048.principle: Surfactant nke ncha anaghị ewepụ ntụpọ ọzọ ma ọ gafere critical micelle concentration (CMC). Calcium ion nke mmiri siri ike na-eme ka ihe ncha ghọọ ntụpọ: $\mathrm{Ca^{2+} + 2C_{17}H_{35}COO^- \to Ca(C_{17}H_{35}COO)_2\downarrow}$
c-048.example: N'igwe nsacha 2kg, ọbụna ma etinye 80mL ncha kama ọnụ ọgụgụ a na-akwado 40mL, mmetụta nsacha fọrọ nke nta ka ọ bụrụ otu, mana ncha fọdụrụ chọrọ ịsa ọzọ otu ugboro. Ọ bụrụ na ị na-asa uwe ugboro 20 n'ọnwa ma chekwaa 40mL oge ọ bụla, a na-echekwa lita 9.6 n'afọ, ihe dị ka KRW 20,000.
c-048.actionItem: Tupu ịsa uwe taa, lelee akara dị na mkpuchi ncha ma tụọ naanị ọnụ ọgụgụ a na-akwado.

c-049.title: A na-emepụta ájá dị nro nke ukwuu n'ikuku
c-049.summary: Akụkụ buru ibu nke PM2.5 abụghị site na ọkpọkọ anwụrụ, a na-emepụta ya site na mmeghachi omume kemịkalụ n'ikuku, yabụ n'oge ájá dị ukwuu n'oge opupu ihe ubi, mkpuchi ihu KF94 bara uru.
c-049.principle: Sulfur oxides na nitrogen oxides na-eme mmeghachi omume na ammonia ma mepụta secondary particles: $\mathrm{NH_3 + HNO_3 \to NH_4NO_3}$, $\mathrm{2NH_3 + H_2SO_4 \to (NH_4)_2SO_4}$
c-049.example: N'oge ájá dị nro nke ukwuu n'Korea, ammonium nitrate na ammonium sulfate oge ụfọdụ na-eru fọrọ nke nta ka ọkara nke PM2.5. KF94 na-enyocha karịa 94% nke ụmụ 0.4μm, ma ọ na-arụ ọrụ ma ọ rapara ihu nke ọma.
c-049.actionItem: Ọ bụrụ na amụma ájá taa bụ 'ọjọọ', tupu ịpụ pịa ntụpọ imi nke mkpuchi ihu ka ọ rapara n'enweghị oghere.

c-050.title: Coating na-egbochi mmiri nke iko ụgbọ ala bụ fim silane na-achụpụ mmiri
c-050.summary: Coating na-egbochi mmiri na-eme fim nke ụmụ siloxane na fluorine n'elu iko ka mmiri ozuzo na snow ghọọ ntụpọ gbadaa. Ọhụụ na-adị mma, yabụ ịkwọ ụgbọ n'oge oyi na-adị nchebe.
c-050.principle: Otu $\mathrm{Si{-}OH}$ nke iko na silane na-ejikọta ma mee fim $\mathrm{Si{-}O{-}Si}$, ma ụdọ hydrophobic nke mpụga na-abawanye contact angle $\theta$ nke ntụpọ mmiri ruo ihe dị ka $100^\circ$ ma ọ bụ karịa.
c-050.example: Contact angle nke iko enweghị coating bụ ihe dị ka $30^\circ$, mmiri na-agbasa, mana iko nwere coating bụ $100^\circ$ ma ọ bụ karịa, yabụ n'ikuku 60~80km n'otu awa ntụpọ mmiri na-efe. Coating na-agwụ n'ime ọnwa ole na ole.
c-050.actionItem: Izu a, hichaa iko n'ihu iji wepụ fim mmanụ, tee ihe na-egbochi mmiri dị gịrịgịrị, ma hichaa ya na akwa kpọrọ nkụ.

c-051.title: Ihe kpatara owu na polyester ji kpọọ nkụ n'ọsọ dị iche
c-051.summary: Ọ bụrụ na ị họrọ polyester maka uwe egwuregwu na owu maka uwe ime na akwa nhicha, njikwa ọsụsọ na mmiri na-adị mfe.
c-051.principle: Cellulose nke owu nwere otu -OH dị ukwuu, na-eme hydrogen bond na mmiri ma na-amị ihe dị ka 25% mmiri, mana polyester bụ hydrophobic dabere na ester bonds ma na-amị naanị ihe dị ka 0.4%. $\mathrm{HO{-}R + H_2O \rightleftharpoons HO{-}R{\cdots}H_2O}$
c-051.example: Ọ bụrụ na ị gbanye uwe nwere ọkpa dị 100g n'ọsụsọ, owu na-ejide ọsụsọ ma ọ na-ewe awa 2 ma ọ bụ karịa ịkpọnwụ, mana polyester na-akpọnwụ n'ime ihe dị ka awa 1. N'aka nke ọzọ, ụmụ isi na-anọkwa n'eriri polyester, yabụ ọ chọrọ ịsa.
c-051.actionItem: Mgbe ị na-azụ uwe ọzọ, lelee ọnụ ọgụgụ ngwakọta ihe dị n'akara, maka nke egwuregwu lelee ma ọnụọgụ polyester dị elu.

c-052.title: A na-agbakọ ọnụ ahịa gas obodo dabere n'okpomọkụ ọ bụghị ibu
c-052.summary: A na-agbakọ ọnụ ahịa gas obodo dabere n'okpomọkụ, ya bụ ibu e ji (㎥) mụbaa na coefficient mgbanwe okpomọkụ (MJ/㎥). Ọ bụrụ na ị maara nke ngalaba okpomọkụ n'akwụkwọ ọnụ ahịa, ịtụnyere ojiji ọkụ dị mfe.
c-052.principle: Ọkụ methane: $\mathrm{CH_4 + 2O_2 \to CO_2 + 2H_2O}$, $\Delta H \approx -890\ \mathrm{kJ/mol}$. 1㎥ nke gas obodo bụ ihe dị ka $42\ \mathrm{MJ}$.
c-052.example: Ọ bụrụ na ojiji gas ọnwa bụ 50㎥, ọ bụ ihe dị ka $50 \times 42 = 2100\ \mathrm{MJ}$. Ọ bụrụ na belata okpomọkụ nhazi boiler ma belata ojiji 10%, a na-echekwa ihe dị ka 210MJ.
c-052.actionItem: Taa, chọta ojiji ọnwa a (㎥) n'akwụkwọ ọnụ ahịa gas, tụnyere ọnwa gara aga, ma dee ya.

c-053.title: Iwepụ nchara site na citric acid
c-053.summary: Nchara ọbara ọbara n'obere ngwa ígwè na-apụkarị ma ọ bụrụ na etinye ha n'ime ngwọta citric acid.
c-053.principle: Iron(III) oxide na-agbaze site n'ime chelate na citric acid: $\mathrm{Fe_2O_3 + 6H^+ \to 2Fe^{3+} + 3H_2O}$, mgbe ahụ $\mathrm{Fe^{3+}}$ na-ejikọta na citrate ions.
c-053.example: Gbazee 25g nke citric acid (5%) n'ime 500mL mmiri, tinye mkpa ígwè nwere nchara awa 4~6 wee kpụọ na brush, nchara na-apụ. Ejikọtala ya na ihe nhicha chlorine mgbe ọ bụla, ma mgbe ịkpụchara, kpoo ya nkụ ozugbo tee obere mmanụ.
c-053.actionItem: Taa, tinye otu obere ngwa nwere nchara n'ime 5% citric acid, echi kpoo ya nkụ ma tee ya mmanụ.

c-054.title: Bleach oxygen na-arụ ọrụ na mmiri ọkụ ọkụ
c-054.summary: Sodium percarbonate na-arụ ọrụ nke ọma na mmiri nke ihe dị ka 40℃, na-eweghachi uwe ọcha n'ọnụ ahịa dị ọnụ ala.
c-054.principle: Sodium percarbonate na-ekewa n'ime mmiri ghọọ hydrogen peroxide na sodium carbonate: $\mathrm{2Na_2CO_3\cdot 3H_2O_2 \to 2Na_2CO_3 + 3H_2O_2}$, mgbe ahụ $\mathrm{H_2O_2 \to H_2O + \tfrac12 O_2}$
c-054.example: Ọ bụrụ na ị gbazee 25g nke sodium percarbonate n'ime lita 5 mmiri 40℃ tinye sọks ọcha nwere agba odo awa 1, ọ na-aghọ ọcha. Ọnụ ahịa ya dị ala karịa bleach ahịa, enweghị isi chlorine, ma ejila ya na ajị anụ na silk.
c-054.actionItem: Taa, tinye uwe ọcha otu ugboro n'mmiri 40℃ nwere 5g/L nke sodium percarbonate.

c-055.title: Oge pollen: saa imi na saline anụ ahụ
c-055.summary: Maka alerji opupu ihe ubi, ọ bụrụ na ị saa imi na 0.9% saline, pollen rapara n'ime mucous membrane na-asachapụ.
c-055.principle: 0.9% NaCl, nke nwere otu osmotic pressure dị ka mmiri anụ ahụ (isotonic), anaghị agba ma ọ bụ mịchaa mkpụrụ ndụ mucous membrane. Osmotic pressure: $\Pi = iMRT$
c-055.example: Gbazee nnu 4.5g (0.9%) n'ime 500mL mmiri e siri jụọ, ma zere iji mmiri famfo ozugbo. Mmiri na-enweghị nnu bụ hypotonic ma na-akpasu imi iwe.
c-055.actionItem: Mgbe ị lọtara ụlọ taa, saa imi nke ọ bụla otu ugboro site na ihe fesa saline ahịa.

c-056.title: Isi akpụkpọ ụkwụ abụghị site na ọsụsọ, nje riri ọsụsọ na-emepụta ya
c-056.summary: Ọsụsọ n'onwe ya fọrọ nke nta ka ọ ghara inwe isi; nje dị n'ime akpụkpọ ụkwụ na-agbaji abụba na protein ọsụsọ ma mepụta fatty acid na-esi isi. Baking soda na-eme neutralizing isi acid a ma belata mmiri.
c-056.principle: Fatty acid na-esi isi nwere ụdọ dị mkpụmkpụ (dịka isovaleric acid) na-eme mmeghachi omume na base dị mfe: $\mathrm{RCOOH + NaHCO_3 \to RCOONa + H_2O + CO_2}$.
c-056.example: Ọ bụrụ na itinye obere ngaji baking soda 1~2 n'otu akpụkpọ ụkwụ hapụ ya abalị, isi acid na-ebelata ma a na-amịkwa mmiri. Echi maa ya yi.
c-056.actionItem: Ọ bụrụ na ị wepụrụ akpụkpọ ụkwụ taa, fesaa otu ngaji baking soda n'ime ya hapụ ya abalị.

c-057.title: Nọmba ala plastik: enwere ike iji microwave ma ọ bụ mba
c-057.summary: Nọmba nrụgharị dị n'ala akpa na-egosi ma enwere ike iji ya na microwave na nri ọkụ.
c-057.principle: PP (nọmba 5) nwere melting point dị elu nke ihe dị ka 160℃, yabụ a na-eji ya na microwave, ma akpa PS (nọmba 6) foam na-agbanwe ọdịdị na ihe dị ka 80℃. Polymerization: $\mathrm{n\,CH_2{=}CHCH_3 \to [-CH_2{-}CH(CH_3)-]_n}$
c-057.example: Igbe nri ehihie PP na-agbanwe obere ọdịdị ọbụna ma etinye ofe karịa 100℃, mana ọ bụrụ na ị kpọọ nri nwere mmanụ n'akpa ramen PS nke otu ojiji, ọ nwere ike agbaze. Lelee akara 'enwere ike iji microwave' n'akara.
c-057.actionItem: Taa, lelee nọmba ala akpa 3 ị na-ejikarị, ma wepụ ndị na-abụghị nọmba 5 na microwave.

c-058.title: A na-eri vitamin A, D, E, K na mmanụ ka e were ha
c-058.summary: Fat-soluble vitamins anaghị agbaze na mmiri, yabụ ha chọrọ abụba ka e buru ha n'micelles n'obere eriri afọ ka e were ha. Iri karọt ma ọ bụ supplement n'afọ efu nwere ike ibelata mmịnye.
c-058.principle: Ụmụ non-polar na-agbaze n'ime micelles bile acid na-emepụta ma na-aga. Ọ bụrụ na abụba adịghị, ịmepụta micelles na-ebelata ma ọnụ ọgụgụ mmịnye dị ala.
c-058.example: A maara na n'karọt a gbara na otu obere ngaji mmanụ olive, mmịnye beta-carotene na-abawanye ọtụtụ ugboro karịa karọt raw. Supplement vitamin D ka mma ka e rie ya n'oge nri.
c-058.actionItem: Ọ bụrụ na ị na-aṅụ vitamin D ma ọ bụ fat-soluble supplement taa, were ya n'oge nri nwere abụba.

c-059.title: Ntụpọ iko tii: site na baking soda
c-059.summary: A na-ehicha ntụpọ tii na kọfị n'ime iko site na mado baking soda, ọ na-apụ site n'obere ịkpụ na mmetụta alkali.
c-059.principle: Tannin na polyphenol nke tii na-agbaze nke ọma n'ime alkali. $\mathrm{NaHCO_3 \rightleftharpoons Na^+ + HCO_3^-}$, alkali dị mfe pH ihe dị ka 8.3
c-059.example: Ọ bụrụ na ị gwakọta otu ngaji baking soda na otu obere ngaji mmiri kpụọ na sponge nkeji 1, ọtụtụ fim agba aja aja nke iko afọ 5 na-apụ. A naghị akwụ ụgwọ ịzụta ihe nhicha dị iche.
c-059.actionItem: Taa, hichaa otu mug nwere ntụpọ mmiri site na mado baking soda.

c-060.title: Ihe fọdụrụ kọfị abụghị nri ala ozugbo
c-060.summary: Ga-akpọnwụrịrị ihe fọdụrụ kọfị nke ọma gwakọta ntakịrị, ọ bụrụ na ị fesa ọtụtụ, mold na mgbochi uto na-apụta.
c-060.principle: Ịdị irè compost dị mma mgbe carbon:nitrogen ratio (C/N) bụ ihe dị ka 25~30:1. Ihe fọdụrụ kọfị bụ ihe dị ka 20:1, nwere nitrogen dị ukwuu, ma caffeine fọdụrụ nwere ike igbochi mkpụrụ ịmalite.
c-060.example: Ọ bụrụ na ịgwakọta naanị n'okpuru 10% nke olu ala ite (100mL nke ihe fọdụrụ n'otu lita ala) mgbe ọ kpọrọ nkụ, enwere ike iji ya n'enweghị nsogbu. Ọ bụrụ na gbasaa ya ọkpụrụkpụ mgbe ọ dị mmiri, mold na-etolite.
c-060.actionItem: Ihe fọdụrụ kọfị ị ṅụrụ taa, gbasaa ya n'akwụkwọ akụkọ kpoo ya nkụ.

c-061.title: Ọ bụrụ na aspirin na-esi isi vinegar
c-061.summary: Ọ bụrụ na karama aspirin na-esi isi vinegar, ọ gbajiri n'ihi mmiri, yabụ ṅụla ya, tụfuo ya.
c-061.principle: Acetylsalicylic acid na-agbaji mgbe ọ na-eme mmeghachi omume na mmiri: $\mathrm{C_9H_8O_4 + H_2O \to C_7H_6O_3 + CH_3COOH}$ (salicylic acid + acetic acid)
c-061.example: Ọ bụrụ na edebe ya n'ebe mmiri dị karịa 80% dị ka shelf ụlọ mposi, hydrolysis na-aga n'ihu n'ime ọnwa ole na ole. Debe ya n'ime drowa dị jụụ na kpọrọ nkụ nwere mkpuchi mechiri, ma itinye otu akpa silica gel n'otu ebe dị mma.
c-061.actionItem: Taa, kwaga ọgwụ na supplements dị n'ụlọ mposi n'ime drowa kpọrọ nkụ.

c-062.title: Jacket na-egbochi mmiri: ọkụ na-eweghachite coating ya
c-062.summary: Ọ bụrụ na mmiri anaghị aghọ bead n'elu jacket na-egbochi mmiri, ị nwere ike iweghachite coating na-egbochi mmiri site n'ịkpọ ya nkụ n'ọkụ dị ala mgbe ị saachara ya.
c-062.principle: DWR coating nwere usoro fluorine na hydrocarbon hydrophobic guzo n'elu eriri, ya mere nrụgide elu mmiri na-eme ka mmiri ghọọ bead. Contact angle $\theta>90^\circ$, akụkụ Young: $\cos\theta=\dfrac{\gamma_{SV}-\gamma_{SL}}{\gamma_{LV}}$
c-062.example: Ihe fọdụrụ nke detergent na unyi na-eme ka usoro dina, ya mere mgbe ị saachara ya na neutral detergent, ọ bụrụ na ị kpọọ ya nkụ nkeji 20 n'ime dryer na ọkụ etiti (ihe dịka 40~60℃) ma ọ bụ jiri iron na ọkụ dị nwayọ, usoro ndị ahụ na-guzo ọzọ ma mmiri na-aghọ bead. Ọ bụrụ na ọ dịghị arụ ọrụ, jiri water-repellent spray a na-ere n'ahịa.
c-062.actionItem: Taa, fesa mmiri n'elu jacket gị na-egbochi mmiri ma lelee ma ọ na-aghọ bead.

c-063.title: Kedu ihe 20-10-10 na akpa fertilizer pụtara
c-063.summary: Ọnụọgụgụ N-P-K dị n'akpa fertilizer bụ nitrogen, phosphorus, na potassium (%), ya mere ị ga-ahọrọ oke kwesịrị ihe ọkụkụ gị.
c-063.principle: Ihe ọkụkụ na-eji nitrogen (NO3−, NH4+) too akwụkwọ, phosphorus ($\mathrm{H_2PO_4^-}$) too mgbọrọgwụ na okooko osisi, potassium ($\mathrm{K^+}$) too ọkpụkpụ na mkpụrụ. Hydrolysis nke urea: $\mathrm{CO(NH_2)_2 + 2H_2O \to 2NH_4^+ + CO_3^{2-}}$
c-063.example: 1kg nke fertilizer 20-10-10 nwere nitrogen 200g, phosphoric acid 100g, na potassium 100g. Akwụkwọ nri na-achọ fertilizer nwere nitrogen karịa, okooko osisi na mkpụrụ na-achọ nke nwere phosphorus na potassium dị elu. Ọ bụrụ na ị karịa ọnụọgụgụ dị na akara, mgbọrọgwụ ga-ere ọkụ.
c-063.actionItem: Taa, chọọ ọnụ ọgụgụ N-P-K dabara n'ụdị ihe ọkụkụ ị na-akụ otu ugboro.

c-064.title: Alkaline na lithium AA: ebee ka ị ga-eji ha
c-064.summary: Maka remote, alkaline na-ezuru, maka oyi ma ọ bụ ngwa na-eji ọtụtụ current, lithium primary batrị na-adịgide ogologo oge.
c-064.principle: Alkaline: $\mathrm{Zn + 2MnO_2 + H_2O \to ZnO + 2MnO(OH)}$. Na okpomọkụ dị ala electrolyte mmiri na-adịghị ngwa ngwa, mana lithium primary batrị na-eji non-aqueous electrolyte ma na-arụ ọrụ ruo -40℃.
c-064.example: N'ime igwefoto dijitalụ, alkaline AA 2 na-ese ihe dịka foto 300, lithium AA na-ese foto 800 ma ọ bụ karịa. N'aka nke ọzọ, maka ngwa nwere obere current dịka remote na elekere mgbidi, alkaline dị ọnụ ala karịa ma dị mma.
c-064.actionItem: Taa, dee ngwa ọ bụla nke dabara na alkaline ma ọ bụ lithium.

c-065.title: Acidity nke ala na-ekpebi agba hydrangea
c-065.summary: Agba acha anụnụ anụnụ na pink nke hydrangea na-adabere na pH ala, ya mere ị nwere ike ịhazi ala iji nweta agba ị chọrọ.
c-065.principle: Na ala acidic (pH ihe dịka 5.5 ma ọ bụ ala), aluminium na-agbaze dị ka $\mathrm{Al^{3+}}$ ma jikọtara na anthocyanin ka ọ bụrụ acha anụnụ anụnụ, na ala neutral ruo alkaline ọ na-edozi dị ka $\mathrm{Al(OH)_3}$ ka ọ bụrụ pink: $\mathrm{Al^{3+} + 3OH^- \to Al(OH)_3\downarrow}$
c-065.example: Ọ bụrụ na ị nye hydrangea pink aluminium sulfate ihe dịka 3g kwa 1L mmiri n'oge otu ọnwa, ọ ga-abụ acha anụnụ anụnụ karịa mgbe ọnwa ole na ole gachara. N'aka nke ọzọ, ịbawanye pH ruo 6.5 ma ọ bụ karịa site na lime na-eme ka ọ bụrụ pink. Ọ bụrụ na ị nye ọtụtụ, mgbọrọgwụ ga-emebi.
c-065.actionItem: Taa, tinye pH test paper n'ala ite gị ma chọpụta agba hydrangea ị chọrọ.

c-066.title: Ihe mere ọ ga-eji chebe wool sweater
c-066.summary: Wool sweater na-ebelata n'ihe mmiri ọkụ na ịkpa ókè, ya mere jiri mmiri ọkụ ọkụ na neutral detergent saa ya n'aka.
c-066.principle: Wool bụ keratin protein, ma elu dị ka scale na-adọkọta site na ịkpa ókè (felting). Alkali na ọkụ na-eme hydrolysis nke peptide bond: $\mathrm{R{-}CO{-}NH{-}R' + H_2O \to RCOOH + R'NH_2}$
c-066.example: Ọ bụrụ na ị sachaa ya n'ime mmiri n'okpuru 30℃ na neutral detergent site na ịpịpịa nkeji 2~3, ị naghị ahụpụ ya, were akwa kpọọ mmiri, ma dina ya ka ọ kpọọ nkụ, ọ fọrọ nke nta ka ọ ghara ibelata. N'ime washer 40℃ na usoro nkịtị, ọ nwere ike ibelata otu nha n'otu oge, ma mebie sweater dị oke ọnụ.
c-066.actionItem: Taa, lelee akara nsacha nke uwe wool gị ma kwadoo neutral detergent iche.

c-067.title: Vitamin C na-adịghị ike n'ihu ìhè na ikuku
c-067.summary: Vitamin C supplement kwesịrị idebe ya n'ihu anwụ na mmiri mmiri, n'ime karama gbara ọchịchịrị nke mkpuchi ya mechiri nke ọma.
c-067.principle: Ascorbic acid na-eme oxidation mgbe ọ na-ezute oxygen: $\mathrm{C_6H_8O_6 \rightarrow C_6H_6O_6 + 2H^+ + 2e^-}$ (dehydroascorbic acid), ọkụ na ìhè na-eme ka ọsọ dịkwuo ngwa.
c-067.example: Ọ bụrụ na ị hapụ vitamin C ntụ ntụ n'ime karama meghere na 25℃ na iru mmiri 70%, ọ na-agbanwe ghọọ aja aja n'ime izu ole na ole ma ike na-ada. Ọ bụrụ na ị debe ya n'ebe oyi, ị nwere ike iji otu ngwaahịa ahụ ruo ụbọchị ọgwụgwụ ya.
c-067.actionItem: Taa, bugharịa supplements gị site n'akụkụ windo ma ọ bụ shelf kichin gaa na drawer dị jụụ.

c-068.title: Ịhọrọ ihe egbochi ụmụ ahụhụ DEET na icaridin
c-068.summary: Tupu ọrụ n'èzí, jiri ngwaahịa DEET 20~30% ma ọ bụ icaridin 10~20% iji nweta nchedo ruo awa ole na ole.
c-068.principle: DEET (N,N-diethyl-m-toluamide, $\mathrm{C_{12}H_{17}NO}$) na-akpaghasị ihe na-anabata isi nke ahụhụ, na-eme ka ọ sie ike ịchọta mmadụ. Ka ọnụọgụgụ dị elu, ka oge na-adịgide ogologo, mana mmetụta na-eru oke n'otu ọkwa.
c-068.example: DEET 30% na-echebe ihe dịka awa 6, 10% ihe dịka awa 2, ma 50% ma ọ bụ karịa na-agbakwunye obere mmetụta. Agbasala ya kpọmkwem n'ihu, kama wụsa ya n'aka gị wee fesa, ma ejila ya maka nwa na-erughị ọnwa 2.
c-068.actionItem: Taa, lelee ihe ndị dị n'ime na ọnụọgụgụ dị na akara ihe egbochi ụmụ ahụhụ gị ma tinye ya n'akpa maka ọrụ n'èzí.

c-069.title: Stainless 304 na 316: otu esi agụ akara
c-069.summary: Maka mmiri nnu ma ọ bụ ite nri nwere nnu, stainless 316 nke nwere molybdenum na-eguzogide corrosion karịa.
c-069.principle: Stainless nwere chromium ihe dịka 10.5% ma ọ bụ karịa, na-emepụta passive film $\mathrm{Cr_2O_3}$ n'elu: $\mathrm{4Cr + 3O_2 \to 2Cr_2O_3}$. 316 nwere molybdenum 2~3% agbakwunyere, ya mere ọ na-eguzogide corrosion chloride ion (Cl−).
c-069.example: 304 (18-8) zuru maka kichin nkịtị, mana n'ebe nwere nnu dị ukwuu, pitting corrosion (ọnụ ọnụ) na-apụta. Ọbụlagodi 316 dị ọnụ karịa 20~30% maka otu thermos, ndụ ya dị ogologo mgbe a na-eji ya n'akụkụ osimiri.
c-069.actionItem: Taa, chọọ akara 304 ma ọ bụ 316 n'okpuru ngwaahịa stainless ị na-eji.

c-070.title: Fluoride dị na toothpaste na-agbanwe elu eze ka ọ bụrụ kristal siri ike
c-070.summary: Fluoride ion na-agbanwe hydroxyapatite nke enamel eze ka ọ bụrụ fluorapatite nke na-eguzogide acid karịa. Ọ bụrụ na ị ghara ịwụpụ ọnụ gị n'ọtụtụ mmiri mgbe ị saachara eze, fluoride na-anọ ogologo oge.
c-070.principle: $\mathrm{Ca_{10}(PO_4)_6(OH)_2 + 2F^- \to Ca_{10}(PO_4)_6F_2 + 2OH^-}$. Fluorapatite na-amalite gbaze n'ihe dịka pH 4.5, ma na-eguzogide acid karịa hydroxyapatite (ihe dịka pH 5.5).
c-070.example: Jiri toothpaste nwere fluoride 1000~1500ppm n'ogo pea, ma mgbe ị saachara eze, were mmiri jiri nwayọ wụpụ ọnụ gị otu ugboro naanị, ị ga-echekwa mmetụta fluoride fọdụrụnụ.
c-070.actionItem: Abalị a mgbe ị saachara eze, ejila ọtụtụ mmiri wụpụ ọnụ gị ọtụtụ ugboro; wụpụ ya otu ugboro nwayọ.

c-071.title: Ihe mere ite aluminium ji agbanwe ghọọ oji
c-071.summary: Ọ bụrụ na ị hapụ nri acidic n'ime ite aluminium ogologo oge, ọ na-agbaa ọchịchịrị, ya mere jiri ihe ọzọ debe nri.
c-071.principle: Film $\mathrm{Al_2O_3}$ n'elu aluminium na-agbaze n'ime acid: $\mathrm{Al_2O_3 + 6H^+ \to 2Al^{3+} + 3H_2O}$, $\mathrm{2Al + 6H^+ \to 2Al^{3+} + 3H_2}$. Alkaline detergent na-emebikwa ya, ya mere kpachara anya.
c-071.example: Ọ bụrụ na ị hapụ tomato sauce (pH ihe dịka 4.5) n'ime ite aluminium otu ụbọchị, elu ya nwere ike ịgbanwe agba ma nwee isi ígwè. Ọtụtụ nke agba agbanweela na-apụ ma ọ bụrụ na ị tinye citric acid ma ọ bụ cream of tartar akwụkwọ nri 2 n'ime 1L mmiri ma sie ya nkeji 10.
c-071.actionItem: Taa, tụọ ofe na sauce fọdụrụ n'ime iko ma ọ bụ stainless container kama ịhapụ ha n'ime ite.

c-072.title: Ihe bụ ntụpọ edo edo n'okpuru ogwe aka
c-072.summary: Ntụpọ edo edo n'okpuru ogwe aka nke uwe elu ọcha bụ ihe sitere na mmiri ahụ nke ahụ na aluminium nke deodorant, ya mere oxygen bleach dị irè.
c-072.principle: Protein na fatty acid nke mmiri ahụ na-ejikọ na aluminium salt na-eme precipitate adịghị agbaze, ma oxygen bleach na-eme oxidation nke organic ihe: $\mathrm{H_2O_2 \to H_2O + [O]}$
c-072.example: Ọ bụrụ na ị gwakọta sodium percarbonate otu spoon buru ibu na mmiri 40℃ otu iko ka ọ bụrụ nke na-akpụ, tinye ya na ntụpọ ahụ nkeji 30, ma saa ya, agba na-ewepụ nke ukwuu. Chlorine bleach nwere ike ime ka ntụpọ protein bụrụ edo edo karịa.
c-072.actionItem: Taa, tinye ntụ oxygen bleach n'okpuru ogwe aka nke uwe elu ọcha ị yi tupu ị saa ya.

c-073.title: Isi ngwa ụlọ ọhụrụ bụ ihe ịrịba ama nke formaldehyde
c-073.summary: Isi ngwa ụlọ ọhụrụ ma ọ bụ wallpaper sitere na volatile organic compounds (VOC), ya mere meghee windo ruo ụbọchị ole na ole ka ha pụọ.
c-073.principle: Urea resin nke plywood adhesive na-agbaji ma formaldehyde na-apụ: $\mathrm{HCHO}$. Ọnụọgụgụ a na-ekpochapụ na-abawanye ka okpomọkụ na iru mmiri na-arị elu.
c-073.example: Mgbe ị webatara ngwa ụlọ ọhụrụ, n'ime izu 2 mbụ, ọ bụrụ na ị na-eme ka ikuku abanye nkeji 30 ugboro 3 kwa ụbọchị ma mee ka ụlọ ruo 25~30℃ (bake-out), ọnụọgụgụ na-ada nke ukwuu. Ntụziaka formaldehyde n'ime ụlọ bụ 0.1ppm ma ọ bụ ala.
c-073.actionItem: Taa, nye ikuku ọhụrụ site na ịmeghe windo abụọ dị n'ihu ibe ha ugboro 3 kwa ụbọchị, nkeji 10 ma ọ bụ karịa ugboro ọ bụla.

c-074.title: Mmiri n'ebe njem: sie ma ọ bụ jiri tablet na-ehicha mmiri
c-074.summary: Mmiri na-adịghị mma: ọ bụrụ na ị sie ya nkeji 1 ma ọ bụ karịa, ma ọ bụ jiri chlorine tablet na-ehicha ya, ị nwere ike ịgbu ọtụtụ ihe na-ebute ọrịa.
c-074.principle: Chlorine water tablet na-emepụta hypochlorous acid n'ime mmiri ma na-eme oxidation nke ụmụ ahụhụ: $\mathrm{NaDCC + H_2O \to HOCl + \cdots}$, $\mathrm{HOCl \rightleftharpoons H^+ + OCl^-}$
c-074.example: Tinye tablet 1 n'ime 1L mmiri doro anya ma hapụ ya nkeji 30 (ogologo oge maka Cryptosporidium). Ọ bụrụ na mmiri adịghị doro anya, buru ụzọ were akwa tụgbuo ya, ma ọ bụrụ na ị karịrị 2,000m n'elu mmiri oké osimiri, mụbaa oge isi ruo nkeji 3.
c-074.actionItem: Taa, tinye water purification tablet ma ọ bụ portable filter n'akpa njem gị.

c-075.title: Akpa nsacha fleece: ibelata microplastic
c-075.summary: Ọ bụrụ na ị tinye uwe synthetic n'ime akpa nsacha ma saa ya na mmiri oyi, ị nwere ike ibelata ọpụpụ microfiber nke ukwuu.
c-075.principle: Polyester bụ ester polymer nke na-adịghị agbaji, ma ọ na-agbaji n'ibe site na ịkpa ókè: $\mathrm{n\,HOOC{-}C_6H_4{-}COOH + n\,HOCH_2CH_2OH \to [-OC{-}C_6H_4{-}COO{-}CH_2CH_2O-]_n + 2n\,H_2O}$
c-075.example: Ịsacha jacket fleece 1 otu ugboro na-ewepụta ọtụtụ puku ruo ọtụtụ narị puku microfibers. Ọ bụrụ na ị jiri akpa nsacha na filter, ị na-ejide ọtụtụ ya, na-ebelata ọbụbà ha n'ime osimiri, ma nsacha na okpomọkụ dị ala na-azọpụtakwa ike.
c-075.actionItem: Taa, mechie zipper nke uwe fleece na polyester, tinye ha n'akpa nsacha ma saa ha na mmiri oyi.

c-076.title: Họrọ low self-discharge nickel-metal hydride maka batrị a na-eji ọzọ
c-076.summary: Batrị nickel-metal hydride nkịtị na-akpụ ihe dịka 20% kwa ọnwa n'onwe ha ọbụlagodi mgbe a naghị eji ha. Ụdị low self-discharge na-ejide 70~85% mgbe otu afọ gachara, ya mere ọ dị mma maka remote na elekere.
c-076.principle: Mmeghachi omume nickel-metal hydride batrị: $\mathrm{NiOOH + MH \rightleftharpoons Ni(OH)_2 + M}$. Self-discharge na-eme mgbe hydrogen na-ebugharị nwayọ nwayọ n'etiti electrolyte na electrode.
c-076.example: Ọ bụrụ na ị jiri low self-discharge AA rechargeable batrị otu (ihe dịka 2000 mAh) ma chaji ya ugboro 500, ọ nwere ike dochie ọtụtụ narị batrị alkaline a na-atụfu, ya mere ọnụ ahịa ogologo oge na-ebelata nke ukwuu.
c-076.actionItem: Taa, ọ bụrụ na ị nwere batrị maka remote ma ọ bụ elekere, tụlee ịgbanwe ha gaa na low self-discharge rechargeable.

c-077.title: Wepụ ntụpọ ink ballpoint site na mmanya alkọhọl, ọ bụghị mmiri
c-077.summary: Ink ballpoint bụ ink na-adabere na mmanụ nke nwere dye gbazere n'ime organic solvent, ya mere ọ naghị agbasa na mmiri. Ọ bụrụ na ị jiri akwa nwere disinfecting ethanol kpọpịa ya, dye na-agbaze pụta.
c-077.principle: Ihe nwere polarity yiri na-agwakọta nke ọma. Oil-based dye na-agbaze nke ọma na ethanol ($\varepsilon \approx 25$) karịa mmiri ($\varepsilon \approx 80$).
c-077.example: Tinye paper towel kpọrọ nkụ n'okpuru ntụpọ ahụ, jiri cotton swab nwere 70% ethanol kpọpịa site n'èzí gaa n'ime, ink anaghị agbasa ma na-aga n'ime towel. Buru ụzọ nwaa n'obere ebe.
