c-077.actionItem: Taa ọ bụrụ na ị nwere ntụpọ ballpoint n'uwe ma ọ bụ ngwa ụlọ, buru ụzọ nwaa alkọhọl n'ebe a naghị ahụ ahụ.

c-078.title: Akwụkwọ nri kpọrọ nkụ na-adị ọhụrụ ọzọ mgbe etinyere ya na mmiri oyi
c-078.summary: Lettuce na spinach kpọrọ nkụ nwere mmiri dị ntakịrị n'ime sel ma dị ka ndị ọdịdọ. Ọ bụrụ na ị tinye ha n'ime mmiri oyi nkeji 20~30, mmiri na-abanye ọzọ site na osmosis, ha na-aghọ ọhụrụ ma ị na-atụfu ntakịrị.
c-078.principle: Ọ bụrụ na ọnụọgụgụ solute dị n'ime sel dị elu karịa mmiri dị n'èzí, mmiri na-aga n'ime. Osmotic pressure $\Pi = iMRT$ na-emepụta turgor pressure na-akpụ sel.
c-078.example: Ọ bụrụ na ị tinye aka ndị lettuce kpọrọ nkụ n'ime mmiri oyi nkeji 30 mgbe otu ụbọchị gafere, ibu ya na-abawanye 5~10% ma ọ na-aghọ ọhụrụ ọzọ. Ma akwụkwọ nke dị nro ma ọ bụ dara ada abụghị nke a.
c-078.actionItem: Taa, tinye akwụkwọ nri kpọrọ nkụ dị na friji n'ime mmiri oyi nkeji 30, kpụchapụ mmiri, ma rie ya.

c-079.title: Allergen nke house dust mite na-ebelata naanị ma a saa ya na mmiri 60℃ ma ọ bụ karịa
c-079.summary: Mite na protein allergen dị n'akwa ume anaghị ebelata nke ọma site na nsacha mmiri oyi. Na mmiri ọkụ ihe dịka 60℃, protein na-agbanwe, mite na-anwụ, allergen na-ebelata.
c-079.principle: Ọkụ na-agbaghasị akụkụ nke atọ nke protein, na-eme ka enzyme na allergen tufuo ọrụ (thermal denaturation). N'ozuzu, mite na-anwụ n'ime nkeji ole na ole na 55~60℃.
c-079.example: Ọ bụrụ na ị sachaa bed sheet na pillowcase na 60℃, allergen na-ebelata nke ukwuu, mana nsacha 30℃ nwere obere mmetụta. Ọ bụrụ na akara eriri anaghị ekwe ya, ị nwere ike iji ịkpọ nkụ na dryer na ọkụ dị elu dochie ya.
c-079.actionItem: Taa, lelee akara nsacha, wee saa pillowcase ma ọ bụ bed sheet gị n'usoro kacha ọkụ nke ekwesịrị ekwesị.

c-080.title: Gas camping: butane anaghị apụta n'oge oyi
c-080.summary: Mmanya isobutane na-adịghị ike n'akụkụ okpomọkụ n'okpuru ziro, ya mere n'oge oyi, jiri gas gwakọtara na propane maka camping.
c-080.principle: Liquefied gas anaghị agbanwe ghọọ gas n'okpuru isi mmiri na-asa ya. Butane ihe dịka $-1^\circ\mathrm{C}$, isobutane $-12^\circ\mathrm{C}$, propane $-42^\circ\mathrm{C}$. Ọkụ: $\mathrm{C_4H_{10} + \tfrac{13}{2}O_2 \to 4CO_2 + 5H_2O}$
c-080.example: N'okpuru 0℃, nrụgide nke butane can dị ala, ire ọkụ na-adịghị ike ma oge iji sie mmiri nwere ike ịdị ogologo okpukpu abụọ. Debe can ahụ n'ime akpa ura ma ọ bụ nso ahụ gị ka ọ dị ọkụ, ma ọ bụrụ na ị na-eji ya n'ime tent, nwee ikuku n'ihi ihe egwu CO poisoning.
c-080.actionItem: Taa, lelee ihe ndị dị n'akara gas camping gị (oke butane na propane).

c-081.title: Ịgụ ihe ndị dị n'ime sunscreen
c-081.summary: Tupu UV opupu ihe ubi na-arị elu, mara ọdịiche dị n'etiti inorganic filter (zinc oxide) na organic filter ma họrọ ya.
c-081.principle: Zinc oxide ($\mathrm{ZnO}$) na-egosipụta ma na-agbasa UV, ebe organic filter dịka avobenzone na-ewere ya ma tọhapụ ya dị ka ọkụ: $h\nu + \text{filter} \to \text{filter}^* \to \text{ọkụ}$
c-081.example: SPF 50 na-egbochi UVB ihe dịka 98%, SPF 30 ihe dịka 97%, ya bụ ọdịiche dị ntakịrị. Maka ihu, a chọrọ ihe dịka 0.5g (eriri abụọ n'ogologo mkpịsị aka nke abụọ na nke atọ) ma ọ dị mkpa iji ya ọzọ n'ime awa 2~3 ọ bụla.
c-081.actionItem: Taa tupu ị pụọ, pịa sunscreen ogologo mkpịsị aka abụọ ma tee ya.

c-082.title: Ịpụnye mmiri n'ime ahịhịa nri na-ebelata isi na olu
c-082.summary: Isi ọjọọ nke ahịhịa nri sitere na gas dịka hydrogen sulfide nke microbes na-eme mgbe ha na-agbaji protein. Ọ bụrụ na ị buru ụzọ kpụpụ mmiri tupu itufu ya, uto microbe na-adị nwayọ, isi na-adị ntakịrị, ibu na-ebelatakwa.
c-082.principle: Nkewa nke sulfur amino acids nke protein: $\mathrm{R{-}SH \to H_2S}$. Ọsọ uto microbe na-adị nwayọ mgbe water activity $a_w$ dị ala.
c-082.example: 70~80% nke ahịhịa nri bụ mmiri. Ọbụlagodi ibelata mmiri naanị 20% site na ịpịpịa ya nke ọma, ibu na-ebelata ihe dịka 15%, ma ọnụ ahịa nkwatu na isi na-ebelatakwa.
c-082.actionItem: Taa tupu ị tụfuo ahịhịa nri, tinye ya na strainer ma pịpịa mmiri ahụ nke ọma.

c-083.title: A na-ekpebi ụbọchị ngwụcha nke nri site na ịdabere nke ọsọ mmeghachi omume n'okpomọkụ
c-083.summary: Maka nri, ọ bụrụ na okpomọkụ rịa elu 10℃, mmeghachi omume mebi emebi na-aga ihe dịka ugboro abụọ ngwa ngwa. Ya mere ị ga-agbaso okpomọkụ nchekwa e dere, ka ụbọchị ngwụcha na ụbọchị iri nri nwee nkọwa.
c-083.principle: Akụkụ Arrhenius: $k = A e^{-E_a/RT}$. Maka mmeghachi omume mebi emebi nwere activation energy nkịtị, ọsọ na-aghọ ihe dịka ugboro 2~3 maka 10℃ ọ bụla.
c-083.example: Ọ bụrụ na mmiri ara ehi n'ime friji 4℃ na-adịgide ụbọchị 7, na 14℃ ọ nwere ike ire ure n'ime ụbọchị ihe dịka 3~4. Ọ dị mma ịtụkwasị ya n'ime friji karịa n'ebe shelf ọnụ ụzọ (ebe okpomọkụ na-agbanwe nke ukwuu).
c-083.actionItem: Taa, lelee okpomọkụ friji gị ka ị hụ ma ọ dị n'ime 0~4℃.

c-084.title: Washing soda, ọ bụghị sodium percarbonate, maka unyi mmanụ
c-084.summary: Maka unyi mmanụ ochie n'ihe ikuku kichin na stove, washing soda (sodium carbonate) nke nwere alkali ka ike na-ehichapụ ya nke ọma karịa baking soda.
c-084.principle: Mmanụ (triglyceride) na-eme saponification n'ime alkali: $\mathrm{RCOOR' + OH^- \to RCOO^- + R'OH}$. Washing soda $\mathrm{Na_2CO_3}$ bụ pH ihe dịka 11.
c-084.example: Gwakọta otu spoon buru ibu washing soda n'ime 1L mmiri ọkụ, hapụ ya nkeji 10, ma hichaa, mmanụ ochie na-agbaze. Ọ na-akpa akpụkpọ ahụ ọkụ, ya mere yi rubber gloves, ma ejila ya na aluminium ma ọ bụ coated pan.
c-084.actionItem: Taa, tinye otu filter nke range hood n'ime ngwọta washing soda ka ọ jupụta.

c-085.title: Fine dust na-esi na nri a na-eghe
c-085.summary: Nri a na-eghe na a na-ere ọkụ na-eme ka PM2.5 n'ime ụlọ rịa elu nke ukwuu, ya mere mgbe ị na-esi nri, gbanye range hood ma meghee windo.
c-085.principle: Ọ bụrụ na mmanụ na-ekpo ihe dịka 180℃ ma ọ bụ karịa, ọ na-agbaji site na ọkụ ma na-emepụta particles na acrolein: $\mathrm{C_3H_5(OH)_3 \to CH_2{=}CHCHO + 2H_2O}$ (dehydration nke glycerol)
c-085.example: Mgbe ị na-ere azụ mackerel n'ime pan, e nwere nyocha na-egosi na PM2.5 n'ime ụlọ na-arị elu ruo ọtụtụ narị μg/m³, ma ọ na-ebelata nke ukwuu mgbe ị gbanyere hood. Hapụ hood ka ọ na-agba nkeji 10 ọzọ mgbe i sichara nri.
c-085.actionItem: Taa, buru ụzọ gbanye hood tupu ị malite isi nri, ma hapụ ya nkeji 10 ọzọ mgbe i sichara.

c-086.title: Mgbe ị si n'akụkụ osimiri laghachi, saa ugbọ na ịnyịnya ígwè
c-086.summary: Nnu dị n'ikuku osimiri na-eme ka ígwè corrode ngwa ngwa, ya mere mgbe njem n'akụkụ osimiri gasịrị, saa ụgbọala na ịnyịnya ígwè gị na mmiri nkịtị.
c-086.principle: Sodium chloride solution na-aghọ electrolyte ma na-eme corrosion cell nke ígwè: $\mathrm{Fe \to Fe^{2+} + 2e^-}$, $\mathrm{O_2 + 2H_2O + 4e^- \to 4OH^-}$
c-086.example: N'ebe nwere nnu na mmiri mmiri, ọsọ corrosion nke ígwè dị ọtụtụ ugboro karịa n'ebe kpọrọ nkụ. Ọ bụrụ na ị saa akụkụ n'okpuru na chain site na mmiri n'ime awa 24 mgbe ịkwọ n'akụkụ osimiri, ma tee chain oil, ị na-egbochi rust nke ukwuu.
c-086.actionItem: Ọ bụrụ na ị si n'akụkụ osimiri bịa taa, saa akụkụ n'okpuru nke ụgbọala na chain nke ịnyịnya ígwè site na mmiri.

c-087.title: Otu esi asa ọgwụ pesticide: mmiri buru ụzọ, baking soda mgbe nke ahụ gasịrị
c-087.summary: Maka mkpụrụ osisi na akwụkwọ nri, mmiri na-asọ bụ ihe bụ isi, ma ọmụmụ ihe na-egosi na itinye ha n'ime mmiri baking soda nkeji 12 nwere ike ibelata ụfọdụ pesticide n'elu karị.
c-087.principle: Ụfọdụ pesticide (thiabendazole wdg.) na-agbaji ngwa ngwa n'ime alkali dị nro. Ngwọta baking soda 1% ($\mathrm{NaHCO_3}$) bụ pH ihe dịka 8.1.
c-087.example: N'ime nnwale ebe e tinyere apple n'ime ngwọta baking soda 1% (10g n'ime 1L mmiri) nkeji 12, pesticide fọdụrụ n'elu belatara karịa nsacha mmiri. Maka mkpụrụ osisi a na-eri ya na akpụkpọ ya, saa ha ọzọ n'ime mmiri na-asọ mgbe ị tinyechara ha.
c-087.actionItem: Taa, nwaa itinye apple ma ọ bụ mkpụrụ vaịn n'ime mmiri baking soda 10g/L, wee saa ha.

c-088.title: Nsị nnụnụ na ihe ahụhụ bụ protein, ya mere ịkwesịrị ịmị ha ma hichaa ngwa ngwa
c-088.summary: Nsị nnụnụ na mmiri ahụhụ nwere acidic ihe na protein, ma mgbe ha kpọrọ nkụ, ha na-arapara n'elu agba ma gbasaa. Ọ bụrụ na ị buru ụzọ were akwa mmiri mịọ ha nke ọma, wee hichaa nwayọ, mmebi agba dị ntakịrị.
c-088.principle: Protein na-agbakọta ma sie ike mgbe ha kpọrọ nkụ ma na-eme hydrogen bond na elu. Mmiri na detergent dị nro alkaline (pH 8~9) na-agbaji njikọ ndị a.
c-088.example: Nsị nnụnụ a hapụrụ ihe karịrị otu ụbọchị nwere ike imebi elu agba n'ụzọ a na-ahụ n'ime ụbọchị 1~2, ya mere ọ dị mma ịtụkwasị akwa microfiber mmiri n'elu ya nkeji 5 tupu ị hichaa ya.
c-088.actionItem: Taa, ọ bụrụ na ị nwere nsị nnụnụ kpọrọ nkụ n'ụgbọala ma ọ bụ windo, tinye akwa mmiri n'elu ya nkeji 5 ka ọ dị nro, wee hichaa ya.

c-089.title: Baking powder na baking soda bụ ihe dị iche
c-089.summary: Baking soda bụ naanị sodium bicarbonate, ya mere ọ chọrọ acid ka ọ pụta, ebe baking powder nwere acidic ihe n'ime ya, ya mere ọ na-ebuli naanị ya na mmiri. Ọ bụrụ na ị gbanwee ha, uto nwere ike ịbụ ilu ma ọ ghara ibuli nke ọma.
c-089.principle: $\mathrm{NaHCO_3 + H^+ \to Na^+ + H_2O + CO_2\uparrow}$. Otu obere spoon baking soda (ihe dịka 5g) nwere ike ịmepụta carbon dioxide ihe dịka 1L.
c-089.example: Ọ bụrụ na usoro nri nwere baking soda 1/2 obere spoon na yogurt (acid), acid ahụ na-eme ka soda rụọ ọrụ. N'ime ntụ ntụ na-enweghị acid, ọ bụrụ na ị tinye naanị soda, soda na-emeghị ihe na-ahapụ uto ilu dị ka ncha.
c-089.actionItem: Taa, lelee akara baking soda na baking powder dị na shelf kichin gị, ma debe ha n'ime ite dị iche iche.

c-090.title: Apple na banana kwesịrị idebe ha iche
c-090.summary: Ethylene gas nke apple na-ewepụta na-eme ka banana mere ngwa ngwa, ya mere debe mkpụrụ osisi n'ebe dị iche iche.
c-090.principle: Ethylene $\mathrm{CH_2{=}CH_2}$ bụ hormone osisi nke na-eme ka enzyme na-agbaji mgbidi sel rụọ ọrụ, na-eme ka mmeri dị ngwa ngwa. Mmepụta: ntọhapụ $\mathrm{C_2H_4}$ na-abawanye nke ukwuu mgbe mkpụrụ osisi na-eme.
c-090.example: Banana na-ezughị ezu nke etinyere n'otu akpa na apple na-eme otu ụbọchị ma ọ bụ abụọ ngwa ngwa, ya mere ị nwere ike ime nke a n'ụzọ ezubere. N'aka nke ọzọ, iji debe ya ogologo oge, debe apple iche, nke na-eme ka oge nchekwa dịkwuo otu ụbọchị ma ọ bụ abụọ ma na-ebelata ahịhịa nri.
c-090.actionItem: Taa, tinye apple na banana n'ebe dị iche ma ọ bụ n'ime ite dị iche.

c-091.title: Tannin nke tii na kọfị na-egbochi nnabata iron supplement
c-091.summary: Tannin na polyphenol nke tii na kọfị na-ejikọ na iron ion ma na-emepụta complex nke na-esi ike ịnabata. Ọ dị mma ịhapụ oge awa 1~2 opekata mpe n'etiti iron supplement ma ọ bụ nri nwere ọtụtụ iron.
c-091.principle: Tannin na-eme chelate na iron: $\mathrm{Fe^{2+} + tannin \to Fe{-}tannin\ complex}$. Complex a na-esiri ike ịnabata n'eriri afọ.
c-091.example: A na-akọ na tii ị na-aṅụ na nri nwere ike ibelata nnabata non-heme iron ruo 40~60%. Ọ bụrụ na ị na-aṅụ ya otu awa mgbe nri gasịrị, mmetụta dị ntakịrị karịa.
c-091.actionItem: Taa ọ bụrụ na ị were iron supplement ma ọ bụ rie nri nwere spinach ma ọ bụ agwa, were tii na kọfị awa otu mgbe nke ahụ gasịrị.

c-092.title: Anya mmiri mgbe ị na-eghepịa yabasị nwere ike ibelata site na ịtinye ya na friji
c-092.summary: Mgbe ị na-eghepịa yabasị, sel na-agbawa, enzyme na-emepụta gas na-akpasu anya iwe. Ọ bụrụ na ị debe yabasị n'ime friji nkeji 30, mmeghachi omume enzyme na-adị nwayọ ma anya mmiri na-ebelata.
c-092.principle: Alliinase na-agbanwe sulfoxide ghọọ ihe na-akpasu iwe: propanethial S-oxide ($\mathrm{C_3H_6OS}$) na-akpali akwara nke anya ka ọ na-akwa mmiri. Ọsọ mmeghachi omume enzyme na-ebelata ka okpomọkụ na-ada.
c-092.example: Na yabasị oyi 4℃ nkeji 30 karịa yabasị na okpomọkụ ụlọ (25℃), ọsọ mmepụta ihe na-akpasu iwe na-ebelata ruo ọkara ma ọ bụ ala. Mgbọrọgwụ nwere ọtụtụ enzyme, ya mere gbutu ya n'ikpeazụ.
c-092.actionItem: Taa, tinye yabasị n'ime friji nkeji 30 tupu ị jiri ya.

c-093.title: Ntụpọ n'uwe bụ hydrogen bond ọhụrụ
c-093.summary: Eriri dịka owu, mgbe ha nwetara mmiri na ọkụ, hydrogen bond dị n'etiti molecular chains na-agbaze, wee sie ike n'ụdị ọhụrụ mgbe ha na-ajụ oyi. Ọ bụrụ na ị wepụ ya site na steam na ọkụ ma gbasaa ya tupu ọ jụọ oyi, ntụpọ na-apụ.
c-093.principle: Otu $\mathrm{{-}OH}$ nke cellulose chains na-eme hydrogen bond. Mmiri na ọkụ na-agbaji njikọ ndị a, ma mgbe ọ na-ajụ oyi ha na-ejikọ ọzọ n'ụdị agbasaa.
c-093.example: Okpomọkụ iron kwesịrị ekwesị bụ ihe dịka 200℃ maka owu na 110℃ ma ọ bụ ala maka synthetic. Ọ bụrụ na ị kwụọ uwe n'ime ụlọ mmiri mgbe ị saachara ahụ na mmiri ọkụ, ntụpọ dị ntakịrị nwere ike ịpụ n'onwe ha site na mmiri mmiri na ọkụ.
c-093.actionItem: Taa, lelee akara nsacha nke uwe elu ị ga-eyi, ma jiri steam wepụ ntụpọ n'okpomọkụ kwesịrị ekwesị.

c-094.title: N'ụbọchị yellow dust na fine dust, saa ihu ya nkeji 30 site na surfactant
c-094.summary: Fine dust na-arapara n'ihe mmanụ akpụkpọ ahụ (sebum), ya mere mmiri naanị anaghị ewepụ ya nke ọma. Isi ihe bụ ịsa mmanụ na ájá ọnụ site na ịsa ihu na ụfụfụ.
c-094.principle: Surfactant nwere ọdụ hydrophobic na isi hydrophilic, na ọnụọgụgụ dị elu karịa critical micelle concentration, ọ na-ejide sebum na ájá n'ime micelle ma na-asa ha site na mmiri. $c>\mathrm{CMC}\;\Rightarrow\;\text{micelle}\ (\text{sebum + dust trapped inside})$
c-094.example: Ọ bụrụ na ị were mmiri ọkụ ọkụ 30~35°C na foaming cleanser mịa ihu gị nkeji 30 wee saa ya, ọtụtụ ájá ihu na-apụ. pH nke elu akpụkpọ ahụ bụ ihe dịka 4.7~5.5, ya mere ngwaahịa weak acid (pH 5~6) dị mma.
c-094.actionItem: Taa mgbe ị si n'èzí bịa, mee ọtụtụ ụfụfụ site na mmiri ọkụ ọkụ ma saa ihu gị nwayọ nkeji 30 (zere mmiri ọkụ).

c-095.title: Ikuku kpọrọ nkụ n'ime ụgbọelu chọrọ moisturizer na ịṅụ mmiri
c-095.summary: Iru mmiri n'ime ụgbọelu na-abụkarị 10~20%, dị ka ọzara, ya mere mmiri akpụkpọ ahụ na mucous membrane imi na-apụ ngwa ngwa. Moisturizer na ịṅụ otu iko mmiri ugboro ugboro na-enye aka.
c-095.principle: Relative humidity $RH = \dfrac{p_{\mathrm{H_2O}}}{p^{*}_{\mathrm{H_2O}}} \times 100\%$. N'ime ụgbọelu, a na-ekpo ikuku si èzí, ya mere saturated vapor pressure dị elu ma actual vapor pressure dị ala, $RH$ dị ala.
c-095.example: Ma ọ bụ 40~60% bụ iru mmiri ụlọ nkịtị, n'ime ụgbọelu 10~20% mmiri na-efunahụ ugboro 2~3 ngwa ngwa. A na-atụ aro ịṅụ 100~200mL mmiri n'otu awa n'ime ụgbọelu ogologo.
c-095.actionItem: Na njem ụgbọelu na-esote, buru moisturizer cream n'ime akpa nwere 100mL ma ọ bụ ala.

c-096.title: Esi akwụkwọ nri opupu ihe ubi naanị sekọnd 30 n'ime mmiri na-esi
c-096.summary: Ịsi ha obere oge na-akwụsị enzyme, agba na-edo anya, ma ilu na isi akwụkwọ ndụ ndụ na-ebelata. Ọ bụrụ na ị sie ha ogologo oge, chlorophyll na-agbanwe ma ha na-aghọ olive edo edo.
c-096.principle: Ọkụ na-ewepụ ikuku n'ime anụ ahụ ma na-akwụsị enzyme na-eme ka agba gbanwee. Mgbe chlorophyll magnesium na-edochi hydrogen ion n'okpomọkụ na acid, ọ na-aghọ pheophytin aja aja. $\mathrm{Chl\text{-}Mg}+2\,\mathrm{H^+}\rightarrow \mathrm{Pheophytin}+\mathrm{Mg^{2+}}$
c-096.example: Ọ bụrụ na ị tinye nnu 10g (1%) n'ime 1L mmiri na-esi, sie spinach 100g sekọnd 30 wee saa ya na mmiri oyi, agba akwụkwọ ndụ ndụ na-adịgide. Ọ bụrụ na ị sie ya nkeji 5 ma ọ bụ karịa, ọ na-aghọ olive.
c-096.actionItem: Taa mgbe ị zụtara akwụkwọ nri opupu ihe ubi, sie ha sekọnd 30 n'ime mmiri na-esi nwere nnu 1%, wee jụọ ha oyi ozugbo n'ime mmiri oyi.

c-097.title: Nkụ nkụ kwesịrị ịkpọnwụ ruo mmiri 20% ma ọ bụ ala ka ọkụ ka mma
c-097.summary: Nkụ mmiri mmiri na-eji ọkụ buru ụzọ megharịa mmiri tupu ọ gbawa ọkụ, ya mere ọ na-emepụta ọtụtụ anwụrụ ma ọkụ dị ntakịrị. Nkụ nke e chebere site na mmiri ozuzo ma kpọọ nkụ ihe karịrị ọnwa 6 dị irè karịa.
c-097.principle: Latent heat of vaporization nke mmiri bụ $\Delta H_{vap} \approx 2.26\ \mathrm{MJ/kg}$. Site na ọkụ nke nkụ (ihe dịka $18\ \mathrm{MJ/kg}$ dry basis), ọkụ ahụ na-ewepụ dị ka mmiri dị.
c-097.example: Osisi ọhụrụ nwere mmiri 40% nwere ọkụ ị nwere ike iji karịa nkụ kpọrọ nkụ (15~20%) ihe dịka 30% ma ọ bụ karịa, ma ọ na-emepụta ọtụtụ soot. Gbaa nkụ ahụ ka ị lee ma etiti ya kpọrọ nkụ.
c-097.actionItem: Taa, ọ bụrụ na ị nwere nkụ maka iji n'èzí, kpọkọta ya n'ebe mmiri ozuzo na-adịghị erute ma ikuku na-agabiga.

c-098.title: Tii akwụkwọ ndụ ndụ: tinye ya n'ime mmiri 70~80℃ ka uto ilu ghara ịdị
c-098.summary: Catechin nke tii akwụkwọ ndụ ndụ na-agbaze ọtụtụ na okpomọkụ dị elu, na-eme ka ọ bụrụ ilu na ọ na-asa ọnụ, ebe theanine amino acid na-enye uto ụtọ na-apụta nke ọma na okpomọkụ dị ala. Mmiri a kpụrụ ruo 70~80℃ na-enye nhazi dị mma.
c-098.principle: Solubility na-abawanye na okpomọkụ n'ozuzu. Catechin epigallocatechin gallate (EGCG) na-apụta ngwa ngwa na 80℃ ma ọ bụ karịa, ya mere ọ na-ewere uto na-asa ọnụ.
c-098.example: Tii e tinyere n'ime mmiri 90℃ nkeji 3 nwere catechin a na-ewepụta karịa nke e tinyere na mmiri 70℃, ya mere a na-eche na ọ dị ilu karịa. Ịwụsa mmiri a sịrị n'iko otu ugboro na-ebelata okpomọkụ ihe dịka 10℃.
c-098.actionItem: Taa mgbe ị na-eme tii akwụkwọ ndụ ndụ, wụsa mmiri a sịrị n'iko otu ugboro ka ọ jụọ oyi, wee tinye ya nkeji 2.

c-099.title: Glacial acetic acid abụghị vinegar, ọ bụ acetic acid 99%
c-099.summary: Vinegar bụ ngwọta mmiri nke acetic acid 4~8%, mana glacial acetic acid bụ acetic acid dị ọcha ihe dịka 99% nke nwere ike ọkụ akpụkpọ ahụ na anya. Ọ bụrụ na ị ga-eji ya maka nri, lelee akara nri ma mee ka ọ dị mmiri nke ukwuu.
c-099.principle: Vinegar: $\mathrm{CH_3COOH}$ ihe dịka $0.7\ \mathrm{mol/L}$ (4~5%). Glacial acetic acid bụ ihe dịka $17\ \mathrm{mol/L}$, ya bụ ugboro 20 ma ọ bụ karịa dị ukwuu. Acetic acid dị ọcha na-akpọnwụ ka ice n'okpuru 16.6℃, ya mere a na-akpọ ya glacial acetic acid.
c-099.example: Ọ bụrụ na ị jiri 99% glacial acetic acid n'otu ọnụọgụgụ ahụ n'ime usoro nri nke na-eji vinegar 5%, ị na-etinye acid dị ukwuu ihe dịka ugboro 20. Ọ bụrụ na akara enweghị usoro iji mee ka ọ dị mmiri maka nri, ọ dị mma ịzụghị ya.
c-099.actionItem: Taa, lelee acid (%) na ihe ndị dị n'ime n'akara vinegar nke ụlọ gị.

c-100.title: Mmanya na-aghọ acetaldehyde n'imeju ma na-eme ka isi ọkụ ọgbụgbọ
c-100.summary: A na-agbaji alkọhọl ghọọ acetaldehyde n'imeju, nke na-akpata isi ọwụwa na ọgbụgbọ ruo mgbe ọ gbanwere ghọọ acetic acid. Ịṅụ mmiri anaghị eme ka ọsọ imeju na-agbaji ya dịkwuo ngwa.
c-100.principle: $\mathrm{CH_3CH_2OH \xrightarrow{ADH} CH_3CHO \xrightarrow{ALDH} CH_3COOH}$. N'ozuzu, imeju okenye na-agbaji naanị ihe dịka $7\ \mathrm{g}$ nke alkọhọl dị ọcha n'otu awa.
c-100.example: Imeju na-ewe karịa awa 7 iji gbaji otu karama soju (ihe dịka 360mL, alkọhọl ihe dịka 50g). Mmiri na-ebelata ịkpọnwụ naanị, ọ naghị eme ka ọsọ ịgbaji dịkwuo ngwa.
c-100.actionItem: Ọ bụrụ na ị ga-aga mmanya taa, tinye otu iko mmiri ma kpebie ọnụọgụgụ ị ga-aṅụ.

c-101.title: Gbanyụọ ọkụ campfire kpamkpam site na mmiri
c-101.summary: Ọkụ chọrọ ihe atọ: mmanụ, oxygen na ọkụ, ma iwepụ otu naanị na-agbanyụ ya. Wụsa mmiri zuru ezu n'elu nkụ, kpalie ya, ma lelee ruo mgbe ntụ na-ajụ oyi iji gbochie ịmalite ọzọ.
c-101.principle: N'ime ihe atọ nke ọkụ, mmiri na-agbanyụ ya site n'iwepụ ọkụ. Latent heat of vaporization nke mmiri $\approx 2.26\ \mathrm{MJ/kg}$ na-ewepụ ọkụ nke ọkụ nke ukwuu.
c-101.example: Otu iberibe uyi (ihe dịka 100g) na-ewepụta ọtụtụ MJ nke ọkụ, na 1L mmiri wụsara na-ewere ruo ihe dịka 2.3MJ dị ka evaporation heat. Wụsa ruo mgbe ị nweghị ọkụ mgbe ị tụkwasịrị azụ aka gị nso.
c-101.actionItem: Mgbe ị na-eji ọkụ n'èzí, buru ụzọ kpụọ otu bọkịt mmiri tupu ị malite ịhazi.

c-102.title: Sodium dị n'akwụkwọ nri x 2.54 = ọnụọgụgụ nnu
c-102.summary: Ọnụọgụgụ sodium abụghị nnu (sodium chloride), ọ bụ ibu nke sodium ion. Ọ bụrụ na ị gbanwee ya ghọọ nnu, ọnụọgụgụ ị na-eri kwa ụbọchị na-adị gị ọtụtụ ihe n'uche.
c-102.principle: Ọ bụrụ na ị kewaa molar mass nke NaCl 58.44g/mol site na nke Na 22.99g/mol, ọ bụ ihe dịka 2.54, ya mere ịbawanye sodium site na 2.54 na-enye ọnụọgụgụ nnu. $m_{\mathrm{NaCl}}=m_{\mathrm{Na}}\times\frac{58.44}{22.99}\approx 2.54\,m_{\mathrm{Na}}$
c-102.example: Otu akpa ramen nwere sodium 1,800mg bụ nnu ihe dịka 4.6g, nke na-ewe ọtụtụ n'ime nnu 5g (sodium 2,000mg) kwa ụbọchị a tụrụ aro site na WHO.
c-102.actionItem: Taa, were mg sodium nke otu nri a gwọrọ nọ n'ụlọ gị were 2.54mụbaa ya ka ị gbanwee ya ghọọ g nnu.

c-103.title: Ị nwere ike imechi ọkụ ma jiri ọkụ fọdụrụnụ sie noodles
c-103.summary: Mgbe ị sịrị mie nkeji 2~3 n'ime mmiri na-esi, ọ bụrụ na ị gbanyụọ ọkụ ma mechie ọnụ ite, starch na-aga n'ihu na-esi. Nke a bụ ụzọ iji belata iji gas.
c-103.principle: Starch gelatinization na-amalite site na ihe dịka 60~70℃ ma na-aga n'ihu ọ bụrụ na okpomọkụ mmiri anọgide na 90℃ ma ọ bụ karịa. Ọsọ mmeghachi omume dị ngwa ngwa ka okpomọkụ dị elu.
c-103.example: Mmiri n'ime ite nke mechiri emechi na-ada naanị ihe dịka 5~8℃ n'ime nkeji 5 mgbe a gbanyụrụ ọkụ, ya mere starch gelatinization na-aga n'ihu. Ị nwere ike belata oge iji gas nkeji 3~4.
c-103.actionItem: Taa mgbe ị na-esi pasta ma ọ bụ noodles, gbanyụọ ọkụ mgbe 2/3 nke oge dị na ngwugwu gasịrị, ma mechie ọnụ ite.

c-104.title: Tinye ntakịrị shuga na vinegar n'ime mmiri ahịhịa ka okooko osisi dịgide ogologo
c-104.summary: Okooko osisi e bipụrụ na-eku ume ma na-ere shuga. Ọ bụrụ na ị nye ya shuga dị nro na acidity, ị na-agbakwunye nri ma belata kokoro n'ime mmiri.
c-104.principle: Okooko osisi e bipụrụ na-eji glucose dị ka ike site na respiration, ma mmiri acidic dị nro (pH ihe dịka 3.5~4) na-egbu oge ịmechi ọkpọ mmiri site na uto kokoro. $\mathrm{C_6H_{12}O_6}+6\,\mathrm{O_2}\rightarrow 6\,\mathrm{CO_2}+6\,\mathrm{H_2O}$
c-104.example: Ọ bụrụ na ị gwakọta shuga 10g (1%) na vinegar 5mL n'ime 1L mmiri, pH bụ ihe dịka 3.7, ma ọ bụrụ na ị gbanwee mmiri n'ụbọchị abụọ ọ bụla, ọ na-adịgide ụbọchị ole na ole ọzọ n'ozuzu.
c-104.actionItem: Taa, gbanwee mmiri vase gị ghọọ mmiri dị ọcha 1L nwere shuga 10g na vinegar 5mL, ma bee ọnụ ọkpụkpụ n'akụkụ.

c-105.title: Hichaa mmanụ sticker na mmanụ nri
c-105.summary: Ihe a na-arapara fọdụrụnụ mgbe ị wepụrụ label anaghị apụ site na mmiri, mana mmanụ na-agbaze ya. Ọ na-edozi ọtụtụ n'enweghị solvent siri ike.
c-105.principle: Adhesive bụ nonpolar polymer, ya mere ọ naghị agbaze na mmiri polar, mana ọ na-agwakọta nke ọma na mmanụ nonpolar (ihe yiri na-agbaze ihe yiri). $\delta_{\text{oil}}\approx\delta_{\text{adhesive}}\;\Rightarrow\;\text{like dissolves like}$
c-105.example: Ọ bụrụ na ị tee ntakịrị mmanụ nri n'ebe ahụ, hapụ ya nkeji 5, hichaa ya, ma jiri detergent wepụ mmanụ, ọtụtụ ihe label dị n'iko na ceramic na-apụ.
c-105.actionItem: Taa, tee mmanụ nri n'ebe sticker rapara n'ite ma ọ bụ efere, chere nkeji 5, ma hichaa ya (acetone nwere ike imebi plastic).

c-106.title: Nuts na-ere ure ngwa ngwa n'ihi na unsaturated fat na-eme oxidation
c-106.summary: Unsaturated fatty acid nke nuts na sesame oil na-eme oxidation mgbe ha na-ezute ikuku, na-emepụta isi rancid. Mechie ha nke ọma ma debe ha n'ime friza iji gbuo oge rancid ọnwa ole na ole.
c-106.principle: Lipid autoxidation: na-amalite site na $\mathrm{RH + O_2 \to ROOH}$, aldehyde na-etolite, ma isi na-apụta. Ọsọ mmeghachi omume na-ebelata ihe dịka ọkara maka 10℃ ọ bụla okpomọkụ na-ada.
c-106.example: Na okpomọkụ ụlọ (25℃), walnuts na-amalite inwe uto rancid n'ime izu ole na ole ruo ọnwa ole na ole, mana na -18℃ n'ime friza emechiri nke ọma, ọ nwere ike ịdịgide ọnwa 6~12. Ọ bụrụ na ọ dị ilu ma ọ bụ nwee isi rancid, tụfuo ya.
c-106.actionItem: Taa, tinye nuts fọdụrụnụ n'ime zipper bag ma ọ bụ ite emechiri nke ọma ma tinye ya n'ime friza.

c-107.title: Ọkụ nwere ike ibelata ọkụ na-eme ya ebe anwụnta ruru
c-107.summary: Mgbe anwụnta si ọnụ ya banye n'ahụ, nzaghachi ahụ ike na-eme ka histamine pụta ma ọ na-abụba na ịkpụ ọkụ. Ọ bụrụ na ị tinye ọkụ ihe dịka 50℃ sekọnd ole na ole, protein dị n'ime mmiri ọnụ na-agbanwe, ma akara ọkụ na-ebelata.
c-107.principle: Histamine $\mathrm{C_5H_9N_3}$ na-akpali nerve endings, ma ọkụ na-agbaghasị akụkụ nke atọ nke protein nke mmiri ọnụ, na-ebelata nzaghachi (thermal denaturation).
c-107.example: A na-akọ na ịtinye ọkụ patch ihe dịka 50℃ ruo ihe dịka sekọnd 10 na-ebelata ọkụ ruo awa ole na ole. Iji gbochie ọkụ ọkụ, ejila ihe ọkụ ọkụ mụọ n'akpụkpọ ahụ ogologo oge.
c-107.actionItem: Na njem a, buru ọgwụ ọkụ ma ọ bụ cooling gel maka mgbe anwụnta ruru gị.

c-108.title: Potassium sorbate dị na akara nri bụ preservative na-egbochi mold
c-108.summary: Potassium sorbate bụ preservative nke na-egbochi mold na yeast n'ọnọdụ acidic, a na-eji ya na cheese, ihe ọṅụṅụ na achịcha. A na-eche na ọ dị mma n'ime oke e kwere, mana ndị na-enwe mmetụta nwere ike ịlele ihe ndị dị n'ime.
c-108.principle: Sorbic acid ($\mathrm{C_5H_7COOH}$, $pK_a = 4.76$) na-enwekwu undissociated form ka pH dị ala, ma na-agafe akpụkpọ sel ka ọ rụọ ọrụ.
c-108.example: Na pH 4.8, ihe dịka 50% nke sorbic acid bụ undissociated form dị irè, mana na pH 6.8 ọ bụ naanị ihe dịka 1%. Ya mere ọ na-arụ ọrụ nke ọma n'ime nri acidic.
c-108.actionItem: Taa, chọọ akara preservative n'ime ihe ndị dị n'ime nri abụọ ị na-erikarị.

c-109.title: Tụfuo batrị ejirila n'ime akpa mkpokọta, ọ bụghị ahịhịa nkịtị
c-109.summary: Batrị nwere ọla dịka zinc, manganese na nickel, ya mere ọ bụrụ na e wee wụsa ha dị ka ahịhịa nkịtị, ha nwere ike ịbanye n'ala. Ọ bụrụ na ị kpọkọta ha n'akpa mkpokọta batrị, a nwere ike ịweghachite ọla.
c-109.principle: Mmeghachi omume alkaline batrị: $\mathrm{Zn + 2MnO_2 + H_2O \to ZnO + 2MnOOH}$. Ọla ndị a na-aghọ akụ ọhụrụ mgbe a weghachiri ha.
c-109.example: Otu AA batrị dị ihe dịka 23g ma ihe dịka 20% ma ọ bụ karịa bụ ọla dịka zinc na manganese. Ọ bụrụ na ị kpọkọta 100, ị nwere ike iweghachite ọtụtụ ọla site na batrị ihe dịka 2.3kg.
c-109.actionItem: Taa, kpọkọta batrị ejirila n'ụlọ gị n'otu ite ma buga ha n'akpa mkpokọta dị n'agbata obi.

c-110.title: Weghachite shuga aja aja siri ike site na otu iberibe achịcha
c-110.summary: Shuga aja aja na-ewere siri ike n'ihi na mmiri dị na molasses na-apụ, kristal na-ejikọta. Ọ bụrụ na ị mechie ya na otu iberibe achịcha ma ọ bụ paper towel mmiri mmiri, mmiri na-alaghachi ma ọ na-adị nro.
c-110.principle: Shuga na-amịkọrọ mmiri ma na-adọta steam $\mathrm{H_2O(g)}$, ma ihe molasses dị n'elu na-adị nro ọzọ. Nguzozi na-adị n'etiti vapor pressure n'ime ikuku na elu shuga.
c-110.example: Ọ bụrụ na ị tinye otu iberibe achịcha n'ime shuga aja aja siri ike 500g ma mechie ya nke ọma, ọ na-adị nro n'ime otu ụbọchị n'ozuzu. Ọ bụrụ na ị na-ekwo ekwo, kpuchie ya na paper towel mmiri ma tinye ya n'ime microwave sekọnd 20.
c-110.actionItem: Taa, ọ bụrụ na ị nwere shuga siri ike, tinye ya n'ime ite emechiri nke ọma na otu iberibe achịcha.

c-111.title: Kelp na-enye uto umami nke ọma mgbe ị tinye ya n'ime mmiri oyi ogologo oge
c-111.summary: Glutamic acid nke kelp (dashima) na-apụta nwayọ na mmiri oyi, ma ọ bụrụ na ị sie ya ruo ọtụtụ, mucilage na-apụta ma ofe na-adị ntụ ntụ na-arapara. Ọ bụrụ na ị tinye ya n'ime mmiri oyi nkeji 30 ma ọ bụ karịa wee wepụ ya tupu ọ sie, ọ dị doro anya.
c-111.principle: Glutamic acid $\mathrm{HOOC{-}CH_2CH_2{-}CH(NH_2){-}COOH}$ na-agbaze na mmiri, ma mucilage polysaccharides dịka alginic acid na-apụta ọtụtụ mgbe a sie ya ogologo oge.
c-111.example: Ọ bụrụ na ị tinye kelp 10cm abụọ n'ime 1L mmiri nkeji 30 wee wepụ ya mgbe mmiri na-amalite isi (ihe dịka 90℃), umami na-apụta nke ọma. Kelp a wepụrụ nwere ike iji ya mee nri a na-eri dị ka jorim.
c-111.actionItem: Abalị a mgbe ị na-eme ofe, tinye kelp n'ime mmiri oyi nkeji 30 tupu ị sie ya.

c-112.title: Agba mmamịrị nwere ike igosi ma ị na-aṅụ mmiri zuru ezu
c-112.summary: Agba edo edo nke mmamịrị sitere na pigment a na-akpọ urochrome, ma ọ na-adị ọkụ ma ọ bụrụ na mmiri adịghị ezu. Ọ bụrụ na ọ bụ edo edo dị nro, n'ozuzu ịna-aṅụ ezuru.
c-112.principle: N'ime ọnụọgụgụ $c = \dfrac{n}{V}$, mgbe ịṅụ mmiri belatara ma $V$ dị obere, otu ọnụọgụgụ urochrome $n$ na-adị ọkụ karịa.
c-112.example: Ọ bụrụ na olu mmamịrị kwa ụbọchị bụ ihe dịka 1.5L ma agba bụ edo edo dị nro dị ka ahịhịa, n'ozuzu ọ zuru ezu. Ọ bụrụ na ọ bụ amber ọkụ, ọ bụ ihe ịrịba ama ịṅụ mmiri ọzọ, mana ọ bụrụ na ị na-eri vitamin B ma ọ bụ ọgwụ, agba nwere ike ịgbanwe.
c-112.actionItem: Taa, lelee agba mmamịrị gị otu ugboro, ma ọ bụrụ na ọ dị ọkụ, ṅụọ otu iko mmiri.

c-113.title: Ọkwa petrol bụ octane number, ma jiri nke dabara ụgbọala gị
c-113.summary: Octane number bụ ọnụọgụgụ na-egosi ka mmanụ si eguzogide knocking, ịgbawa n'onwe ya mgbe a na-akpakọta ya. Ọ bụrụ na ntuziaka ụgbọala nwere ọkwa a tụrụ aro, ịtinye mmanụ dị oke ọnụ nke dị elu karịa ya enweghị mmetụta.
c-113.principle: Octane number bụ uru e jiri tụnyere mmegide knocking, n'ọkwa nke e were isooctane ($\mathrm{C_8H_{18}}$) dị ka 100 na heptane dị ka 0.
c-113.example: Ọ bụrụ na ntuziaka ụgbọala na-atụ aro octane 91 (nkịtị), ma ị tinye 94 (premium), ọ na-adị ọnụ naanị ọtụtụ narị won kwa lita ma ịdị irè fọrọ nke nta ka ọ ghara ịbawanye. Jiri premium naanị ma ụgbọala dịka high-compression engine chọrọ ya.
c-113.actionItem: Taa, lelee octane number a tụrụ aro na ntuziaka ụgbọala gị ma ọ bụ akara dị n'ime ọnụ tank mmanụ.

c-114.title: A na-edepụta ihe niile dị na cosmetics site n'ọtụtụ ruo obere
c-114.summary: Ihe niile dị na akara cosmetics: 1% ma ọ bụ karịa a na-edepụta site n'ọtụtụ ruo obere, ma n'okpuru 1% a nwere ike ịdepụta ya n'usoro ọ bụla. Ihe ole na ole mbụ bụ ọtụtụ ngwaahịa, ya mere ọ bụrụ na ihe a gbara mgbasa ozi dị n'azụ, ọ dị ntakịrị.
c-114.principle: N'ọtụtụ ngwaahịa, mmiri ($\mathrm{H_2O}$) bụ nke mbụ. Ọ bụrụ na ọnụọgụgụ $w = \dfrac{m_{\text{ihe}}}{m_{\text{niile}}} \times 100\%$ dị n'okpuru 1%, a na-ekwe ka edepụta ya n'usoro ọ bụla.
c-114.example: Ọ bụrụ na ihe niile dị na toner bụ mmiri, glycerin, butylene glycol n'usoro ahụ, ihe atọ mbụ nwere ike ịbụ 90% ma ọ bụ karịa nke ngwaahịa. Ọ bụrụ na ihe a gbara mgbasa ozi dị n'ikpeazụ, ọ na-abụkarị n'okpuru 1%.
c-114.actionItem: Taa, gụọ ihe ise mbụ dị n'ime otu ngwaahịa cosmetics ị na-eji.

c-115.title: Mee ka nri camping gafee ọnụ ọgụgụ 4~60℃ ngwa ngwa
c-115.summary: Bacteria na-amụba ngwa ngwa na ihe dịka 4~60℃, nke a na-akpọ ebe okpomọkụ ize ndụ. N'ime camping, debe anụ na nri akwa n'okpuru 4℃ n'ime ice box, ma mgbe ị na-esi ya, kpoo ya nke ọma ruo n'etiti.
c-115.principle: Ọnụọgụgụ bacteria na-abawanye dị ka $N = N_0 \cdot 2^{t/t_d}$. E. coli nwere ike ịmụba okpukpu abụọ n'ihe dịka nkeji 20 ọ bụla n'ihe dịka 37℃.
c-115.example: Na nri a hapụrụ awa 2 n'okpomọkụ ụlọ (30℃) n'oge okpomọkụ, bacteria nwere ike ịbawanye ihe dịka $2^{6} = 64$ ugboro. Sie anụ ruo okpomọkụ etiti 75℃ ma ọ bụ karịa ruo nkeji 1 ma ọ bụ karịa.
c-115.actionItem: Na camping a, jupụta ice box na ice ma buru thermometer.

c-116.title: Ịtinye nnu n'ime mmiri noodles anaghị akwalite isi mmiri na-asa nke ukwuu
c-116.summary: Echiche na nnu na-eme ka mmiri dịkwuo ọkụ bụ nghọtahie. Iji chekwaa gas, ọnụ ite na ọkụ dị nwayọ dị irè karịa nnu.
c-116.principle: E nwere 'boiling point elevation' mgbe ọtụtụ particles agbazere, mana uru ya dị ntakịrị. $\Delta T_b=i\,K_b\,m=2\times0.512\times0.171\approx0.17\ \mathrm{K}$
c-116.example: Ọbụlagodi ma ị tinye nnu 10g n'ime 1L mmiri, isi mmiri na-asa naanị na-arị elu 0.17°C, ya mere oge isi nri anaghị agbanwe, naanị ụtọ na-ahazi.
c-116.actionItem: Taa mgbe ị na-esi noodles, jiri nnu naanị maka ụtọ, ma mgbe ọ na-esi, mechie ọnụ ite ma belata ọkụ ka ọ dị nwayọ.

c-117.title: Ntụpọ ahịhịa: alkọhọl buru ụzọ, wee enzyme detergent
c-117.summary: Ntụpọ ahịhịa nwere chlorophyll (ihe mmanụ) na protein agwakọta, ya mere mmiri naanị anaghị ewepụ ya. Ọ bụrụ na ị gbaso usoro, ọ na-ehicha nke ọma.
c-117.principle: Chlorophyll na-agbaze na ethanol, ma protease nke enzyme detergent na-agbaji ntụpọ protein ghọọ peptides. Mmiri ọkụ na-eme ka protein sie ike ma na-edozi ya. $\text{protein stain}+\mathrm{H_2O}\xrightarrow{\ \text{protease}\ }\text{peptides}$
c-117.example: Ọ bụrụ na ị mịa ntụpọ ahụ na 70% ethanol nkeji 5 wee saa ya n'ime mmiri 30~40°C na enzyme detergent, ntụpọ ahịhịa na-adị nro nke ukwuu.
c-117.actionItem: Taa, tee disinfecting ethanol n'ntụpọ ahịhịa nkeji 5 wee saa ya na 30~40°C (buru ụzọ lelee mgbanwe agba n'ebe a naghị ahụ).

c-118.title: Iron nke spinach na-abawanye nnabata mgbe ị riri ya na lemon
c-118.summary: Plant iron (non-heme iron) adịghị anabata nke ọma, mana vitamin C na-agbanwe ya ka ọ bụrụ ụdị enwere ike ịnabata. Tannin dị na tii na kọfị na-egbochi nnabata ya.
c-118.principle: Non-heme iron na-adị ka $\mathrm{Fe^{3+}}$ ọtụtụ oge, ma naanị $\mathrm{Fe^{2+}}$ ka a na-anabata n'eriri afọ, ma vitamin C na-ebelata ferric iron ghọọ ferrous iron ma na-eme chelate na iron. $\mathrm{Fe^{3+}}+\text{ascorbate}\rightarrow\mathrm{Fe^{2+}}+\text{dehydroascorbate}$
c-118.example: Ọ bụrụ na ị na-eri vitamin C ihe dịka 100mg (ọnụọgụgụ otu lemon) na nri, nnabata non-heme iron nwere ike ịbawanye ihe dịka ugboro 2~3.
c-118.actionItem: Taa, fesa lemon juice n'ime nri spinach ma ọ bụ agwa, ma ṅụọ tii ma ọ bụ kọfị awa otu mgbe nri gasịrị.

c-119.title: Jiri ice nnu jụọ ihe ọṅụṅụ oyi ngwa ngwa n'èzí
c-119.summary: Ọ bụrụ na ị gwakọta nnu na ice, okpomọkụ na-agbada n'okpuru 0°C nke ukwuu, ma ihe ọṅụṅụ na-ajụ oyi n'ime nkeji ole na ole. Ị nwere ike iji ya kama friji n'oge picnic.
c-119.principle: Site na freezing point depression, mmiri nnu na-atụ naanị n'okpuru 0°C, ya mere mgbe ice na-agbaze, ọ na-ewepụ ọkụ site n'ebe ọ na-agbadata, ma okpomọkụ na-ada (eutectic point -21°C). $\Delta T_f=i\,K_f\,m,\quad K_f=1.86\ \mathrm{K\,kg\,mol^{-1}}$
c-119.example: Ọ bụrụ na ị gwakọta ice na nnu n'ọnụọgụgụ 3:1 site na ibu, ọ na-agbada ruo ihe dịka -15~-20°C, ma ọ bụrụ na ị tinye can wee gharịa ya, ọ na-ajụ oyi ruo ihe dịka 5°C n'ime nkeji ole na ole.
c-119.actionItem: Taa n'oge picnic, gwakọta ice 3 : nnu 1 n'ime ice box ma gharịa can ihe ọṅụṅụ nkeji 3~5 (lelee ka can ghara ịtụ ma gbawa).

c-120.title: Anụ nwere agba aja aja anaghị apụta na ọ bụ ihe emebiri ozugbo
c-120.summary: Agba anụ na-adabere n'ọnọdụ iron nke myoglobin, ma ọ bụghị mgbe niile ka ọ dabara na ọhụrụ. Lelee ụbọchị na isi n'otu oge.
c-120.principle: Oxymyoglobin nke jikọtara na oxygen bụ nwa ọbara ọbara, ma mgbe iron na-eme oxidation, ọ na-aghọ metmyoglobin aja aja. N'ime vacuum ma ọ bụ nke e kpachapụrụ ọnụ, n'ime ya adịghị oxygen ezu, ọ bụ odo odo gbara ọchịchịrị. $\mathrm{Mb}(\mathrm{Fe^{2+}})+\mathrm{O_2}\rightleftharpoons\mathrm{MbO_2}$ (red),  $\mathrm{Mb}\rightarrow\mathrm{metMb}(\mathrm{Fe^{3+}})$ (brown)
c-120.example: Anụ ehi a gwọrọ agwọ na-aghọ nwa ọbara ọbara n'ime nkeji 15~30 mgbe ọ na-ezute ikuku, ma mgbe ụbọchị ole na ole n'ime friji gasịrị ọ nwere ike ịghọ aja aja, mana agba naanị adịghị ezu iji kpebie na o emebiela.
c-120.actionItem: Taa mgbe ị na-azụ anụ, lelee ọ bụghị agba naanị, kamakwa ụbọchị iri nri, ọnọdụ ngwugwu, na ma ọ nwere isi ilu ma ọ bụ ọ na-arapara.

c-121.title: Gbutu galik ma hapụ ya nkeji 10 tupu ị sie ya ka allicin dịrị ndụ
c-121.summary: Mgbe ị gbutu ma ọ bụ gbarie galik, enzyme alliinase na-agbanwe alliin ghọọ allicin, nke bụ ntọala nke antibacterial na ahụ ike nke galik. Ọ bụrụ na ị kpoo ya ozugbo, enzyme na-akwụsị ma allicin na-emepụta dị ntakịrị.
c-121.principle: Alliin $\xrightarrow{\text{alliinase}}$ allicin ($\mathrm{C_6H_{10}OS_2}$). Enzyme na-agbanwe ngwa ngwa na ihe dịka 60~70℃ ma ọ bụ karịa.
c-121.example: A na-akọ na galik gbutuo egbutu a hapụrụ nkeji 10 tupu e sie ya na-ahapụ ọtụtụ ugboro ihe sitere na allicin karịa nke a sịrị ozugbo. Ọnụọgụgụ ị ga-eri n'otu oge bụ 1~2 cloves.
c-121.actionItem: Taa ọ bụrụ na ị na-eji galik n'ime nri, gbutu ya, hapụ ya nkeji 10 tupu ị kpoo ya.

c-122.title: Mmanụ e jiri ghee nri: sachaa ya ma debe ya n'ebe gbara ọchịchịrị ka ọ dịgide
c-122.summary: Mmanụ na-ere ure mgbe ọ na-ezute ọkụ, ìhè na oxygen, na-emepụta isi ọjọọ. Naanị idebe ya nke ọma na-egbochi mmefu mmanụ.
c-122.principle: Unsaturated fatty acid na-eme oxidation site na radical chain reaction na-emepụta peroxides na aldehydes. Ọkụ na ihe nri fọdụrụnụ na-eme ka mmeghachi omume dịkwuo ngwa. $\mathrm{R}\cdot+\mathrm{O_2}\rightarrow\mathrm{ROO}\cdot,\ \ \mathrm{ROO}\cdot+\mathrm{RH}\rightarrow\mathrm{ROOH}+\mathrm{R}\cdot$
c-122.example: Jiri mmanụ nri nwere unsaturation dị elu n'ime ihe dịka ọnwa 3 mgbe emeghere ya, ma mmanụ ghee nri, sachaa ihe fọdụrụnụ ma jiri ya naanị ruo ugboro 2~3.
c-122.actionItem: Taa, sachaa mmanụ ghee nri i jiri site na coffee filter, tinye ya n'ime karama gbara ọchịchịrị, debe ya n'ebe jụụ, ma ọ bụrụ na ọ nwere isi dị ka paint, tụfuo ya.

c-123.title: Ọbụna stainless steel na-agba nchara ma ọ bụrụ na ị hapụ ofe nnu ogologo oge
c-123.summary: Stainless steel anaghị agba nchara n'ihi ụdị oxide chromium dị mkpa, ma ọ bụrụ na ion chloride abanye n'ime ya, obere oghere na ebe nchara na-apụta.
c-123.principle: Mgbe chromium karịrị 10.5%, a na-emepụta oyi akwa $\mathrm{Cr_2O_3}$ nke na-edozi onwe ya n'ihu oxygen, ma $\mathrm{Cl^-}$ na-ebibi oyi akwa ahụ n'ebe ụfọdụ ma na-ebute corrosion pitting. $\mathrm{Cr_2O_3}\ (1\text{-}5\ \mathrm{nm\ film})\ +\ \mathrm{Cl^-}\rightarrow\text{pitting}$
c-123.example: 316 nke nwere 2% molybdenum na-eguzogide nnu karịa 304 (ihe dị ka 18% chromium, 8% nickel). Ọ bụrụ na ị hapụ mmiri nnu ruo ọtụtụ awa, corrosion ebe nwere ike ịpụta.
c-123.actionItem: Taa saa ma kpoo ite stainless steel ị jiri mee ofe ma ọ bụ nri nnu ozugbo.

c-124.title: Kọfị ehihie ka dị ọkara n'abalị
c-124.summary: Caffeine na-apụ n'ahụ nwayọọ, ya mere kọfị ọgwụgwụ na-emetụta ụra abalị. Ibu oge kọfị ikpeazụ n'ihu na-enyere aka.
c-124.principle: Caffeine nwere ọkara ndụ ihe dị ka awa 5 (3~7) na-ebelata n'ụdị ọnụọgụ otu ihe dị ka mmeghachi omume ọkwa mbụ. $C(t)=C_0\left(\tfrac12\right)^{t/t_{1/2}},\quad t_{1/2}\approx5\ \mathrm{h}$
c-124.example: Ọ bụrụ na ị nụọ caffeine 150mg n'elekere 3 nke ehihie, awa 8 ka e mesịrị, n'elekere 11 nke abalị, ihe dị ka 50mg (1/3) ka fọdụrụ. A na-atụ aro ngụkọta kwa ụbọchị ka ọ bụrụ 400mg ma ọ bụ ihe pere mpe.
c-124.actionItem: Taa tọọ ihe ọṅụṅụ caffeine ikpeazụ gị n'awa 8 tupu ụra ma mgbe nke ahụ gasịrị ṅụọ decaf ma ọ bụ tii ọka bali.

c-125.title: N'ugwu dị elu mmiri na-esi na 95°C ma isi nri na-agbada nwayọọ
c-125.summary: Ka ịdị elu na-abawanye, nrụgide ikuku na-ebelata ma mmiri na-esi n'okpomọkụ dị ala. Nke a bụ ihe mere noodles ma ọ bụ osikapa ji adị ọkara esi.
c-125.principle: Mgbe nrụgide ikuku na-ebelata, ebe mmiri na-esi na-agbada (ihe dị ka 3.3°C maka 1,000m). Ọ bụrụ na ị tinye iwu ahụmahụ na ọnụọgụ mmeghachi omume na-abawanye okpukpu abụọ maka 10°C ọ bụla, oge isi nri na-abawanye. $\Delta T_b\approx -3.3\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}\ \text{per}\ 1000\ \mathrm{m};\quad \frac{t'}{t}\approx 2^{\Delta T/10}$
c-125.example: Na 1,500m ịdị elu, mmiri na-esi na ihe dị ka 95°C ma ọnụọgụ na-aghọ $2^{-0.5}\approx0.7$ ugboro, ya mere oge isi nri na-abawanye ihe dị ka 40%.
c-125.actionItem: Ọ bụrụ na ị na-eme atụmatụ ịrịgo ugwu taa, dee na dịka ịdị elu si dị, noodles chọrọ oge 1.4 ugboro, ma osikapa ka e sie ya ogologo oge n'okpuru mkpuchi.

c-126.title: Ejila ite nwere mkpuchi non-stick nke tụkwasịrị ọkụ siri ike ka ọ kpoo n'efu
c-126.summary: Mkpuchi Teflon (PTFE) nwere ike iguzosi ike ruo ihe dị ka 260°C, ma karịa nke ahụ ọ na-ebibi ma na-ewepụta anwụrụ ọkụ na-emerụ ahụ. N'ụlọ, ịkpoo ite efu na ọkụ siri ike bụ ihe kachasị akpata ya.
c-126.principle: PTFE na-adịgide n'ihi na njikọ C-F siri ike nke ukwuu, ma karịa ihe dị ka 300°C ọ na-ebibi ma na-ewepụta gas nwere fluorine nke na-egbu nnụnụ. $-(\mathrm{CF_2\text{-}CF_2})_n-,\quad E_{\mathrm{C\text{-}F}}\approx485\ \mathrm{kJ\,mol^{-1}}$
c-126.example: Ite efu n'ọkụ siri ike nwere ike iru karịa 300°C n'ime nkeji 2~5. Ọ bụrụ na i jiri ya n'ọkụ dị nro na mmanụ ma ọ bụ ihe dị n'ime, ọ na-anọkarị n'okpuru 200°C.
c-126.actionItem: Taa jiri ite nwere mkpuchi non-stick n'ọkụ dị nro ma ọ bụ nke dị ala, buru ụzọ tinye mmanụ, ejila kpoo ya n'efu, zere ngwa ígwè.

c-127.title: Ịṅụ ihe ọṅụṅụ vinegar na-adịghị agwakọta na-agbaze enamel eze
c-127.summary: pH vinegar bụ ihe dị ka 2.5, nke dị ala karịa pH 5.5 mgbe enamel eze na-amalite ịgbaze. Ọ bụrụ na ị ṅụọ ya, ọ ka mma ịgwakọta ya nke ọma ma saa ọnụ na mmiri mgbe nke ahụ gasịrị.
c-127.principle: Mgbaze enamel eze: $\mathrm{Ca_{10}(PO_4)_6(OH)_2 + 14H^+ \to 10Ca^{2+} + 6H_2PO_4^- + 2H_2O}$. Ka $\mathrm{pH} = -\log[\mathrm{H^+}]$ dị ala, ka ọ na-agbaze ngwa ngwa.
c-127.example: Vinegar nwere pH 2.5 nwere nchịkọta ion hydrogen 1000 ugboro karịa oke pH 5.5. Gwakọta otu ngaji vinegar na mmiri 200mL ma ọ bụ karịa, ṅụọ site na ntụtụ ma saa eze gị mgbe nkeji 30 gasịrị.
c-127.actionItem: Taa ọ bụrụ na ị ṅụọ vinegar ma ọ bụ ihe ọṅụṅụ dị gụọ, saa ọnụ otu ugboro na mmiri ma saa eze gị mgbe nkeji 30 gasịrị.

c-128.title: Tinye achịcha toast n'ime freezer, ọ bụghị friji
c-128.summary: Achịcha na-esi ike ọ bụghị n'ihi na ọ na-akpọnwụ, kama n'ihi na starch na-emegharị crystal, nke na-eme ngwa ngwa n'ime friji.
c-128.principle: Retrogradation, ebe amylose na amylopectin nke starch esiri esi na-ahazigharị n'usoro, na-eme ngwa ngwa na 0~5°C ma fọrọ nke nta ka ọ kwụsị n'okpuru -18°C. $\text{amylose/amylopectin recrystallization (retrogradation)},\ \text{fastest at }0\text{-}5\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$
c-128.example: Achịcha na okpomọkụ ụlọ na-esi ike n'ime ụbọchị 2~3, n'ime friji ọbụna ngwa ngwa, ma na freezer -18°C ọ nwere ike ịdịru ihe dị ka ọnwa 3, ma ọ bụrụ na ị kpoo ya karịa 60°C kristal na-agbaze ma ọ na-adị nro.
c-128.actionItem: Taa kewaa achịcha toast fọdụrụ n'ibe, kwụsị ya n'ime freezer, ma mgbe ị ga-eri ya, kpoo ya na toaster ma ọ bụ steamer.

c-129.title: Mkpọda tomato n'ime ihe plastik wepụ site n'anyanwụ na mmanụ
c-129.summary: Agba uhie nke ofe tomato na-agwakọta nke ọma na mmanụ ma na-abanye n'ime plastik. Mmanụ na ultraviolet na-arụ ọrụ nke ọma karịa mmiri.
c-129.principle: Lycopene bụ agba na-abụghị polar nke na-agbaze n'ime plastik, ma njikọ abụọ 11 ya na-etinye ọkụ ya na-ahụ ka uhie, ma ultraviolet na-agbaji njikọ ndị a ma na-eme ya enweghị agba. $\text{lycopene (11 conjugated C=C)}\xrightarrow{h\nu}\text{colourless fragments}$
c-129.example: Ọ bụrụ na ị were otu ntụpọ mmanụ bee ya, saa ya na ncha efere ma hapụ ya n'anyanwụ awa 2~3, ọtụtụ mkpọda na-adịghị.
c-129.actionItem: Taa tinye otu ntụpọ mmanụ nri n'ihe plastik nwere mkpọda, bee ya, saa ya na ncha ma hapụ ya n'anyanwụ n'akụkụ windo awa 2~3 (ịmalite iji iko site na mbụ na-egbochi ya).

c-130.title: Maka afọ ọsịsa na akpịrị ịkpọ nkụ, mmiri ọgwụ oral nke nnu na shuga
c-130.summary: Mgbe glucose na sodium na-abanye ọnụ, mmiri na-esochi ha. Ọ na-eme ka mmiri dị n'ahụ karịa ịṅụ mmiri naanị.
c-130.principle: Onye na-ebu SGLT1 nke sel eriri afọ na-ebu otu molecule glucose na ion sodium abụọ ma mmiri na-esochi site na osmosis. $\mathrm{SGLT1}:\ 1\ \text{glucose}+2\ \mathrm{Na^+}\rightarrow\text{water uptake}$
c-130.example: Usoro ụlọ WHO bụ 1L mmiri sie ma jụrụ oyi na ngaji obere shuga 6 (ihe dị ka 25g) na 1/2 ngaji obere nnu (ihe dị ka 3g). Ọ bụrụ na akpịrị ịkpọ nkụ siri ike, ọ bụ nwa ọhụrụ ma ọ bụ nwatakịrị, ma ọ bụ ahụ ọkụ dị elu, ị ga-aga ụlọ ọgwụ.
c-130.actionItem: Taa kwadebe otu ma ọ bụ abụọ nke ORS ahịa n'igbe ọgwụ mberede.

c-131.title: Ọkụ anya n'ime pool bụ chloramine, ọ bụghị chlorine
c-131.summary: Anya na-acha uhie uhie ọ bụghị n'ihi na ọgwụ pool siri ike nke ukwuu, kama n'ihi chloramine nke na-etolite mgbe ọ na-ezute mmiri ọsụsọ na mmamịrị. Ịsa ahụ bụ nzọpụta kacha mma.
c-131.principle: Chlorine na mmiri na-aghọ hypochlorous acid (HOCl) ma na-egbu nje, ma mgbe ọ na-ejikọ na nitrogen ammonia ọ na-etolite chloramine na-akpali akpali. Na pH 7.5 ihe dị ka 50% bụ HOCl. $\mathrm{Cl_2}+\mathrm{H_2O}\rightleftharpoons\mathrm{HOCl}+\mathrm{H^+}+\mathrm{Cl^-},\quad \mathrm{HOCl}\rightleftharpoons\mathrm{H^+}+\mathrm{OCl^-}\ (\mathrm{p}K_a\approx7.5)$
c-131.example: A na-atụ aro pH 7.2~7.8 maka pool na chlorine efu 1~3ppm. Ịsa ahụ nkeji 1 na ncha tupu ịmalite na-ebelata ihe ndị dị ndụ nke ukwuu.
c-131.actionItem: Taa tupu ị gaa pool, saa ahụ gị na ncha nkeji 1 ma ejikwala mmamịrị n'ime mmiri.

c-132.title: Gbakọọ ike mmiri site na calcium na magnesium dị na akara mmiri akpa
c-132.summary: Ọbụna n'ime mmiri akpa, ike mmiri dị iche ma na-agbanwe ụtọ kọfị na tii na nchịkọta nnu. Naanị site na nọmba akara ị nwere ike ịmara ma ọ dị nro ma ọ bụ siri ike.
c-132.principle: Ike bụ ngụkọta ion calcium na magnesium e mere ka ọ bụrụ ibu calcium carbonate. Maka mwepụta kọfị a na-atụ aro ihe dị ka 50~175mg/L. $H=2.497\,[\mathrm{Ca}]+4.118\,[\mathrm{Mg}]\ (\mathrm{mg\,L^{-1}}\text{ as }\mathrm{CaCO_3})$
c-132.example: Mmiri nwere calcium 80mg/L na magnesium 26mg/L na-enye $2.497\times80+4.118\times26\approx307$ mg/L, mmiri siri ike nke ukwuu (karịa 180), ya mere nchịkọta nnu na-etolite n'ime kettle eletrik.
c-132.actionItem: Taa gbakọọ ike mmiri nke ị na-aṅụ site na ụkpụrụ Ca na Mg dị na akara ya.

c-133.title: Calorie bụ okpomọkụ nkpo, na carbohydrate, protein na abụba bụ 4·4·9kcal/g
c-133.summary: A tụrụ ọnụ ọgụgụ calorie nri n'okpomọkụ a na-ewepụta mgbe a na-ere ya n'èzí ahụ. Ị nwere ike ịgbakọ calorie site na g dị na tebụl ntụziaka nri.
c-133.principle: Mgbe 1 mol glucose na-ere, 2,803kJ na-apụta (ihe dị ka 15.6kJ/g, 3.7kcal/g). Ọnụọgụ Atwater bụ 4kcal/g maka carbohydrate na protein na 9kcal/g maka abụba. $\mathrm{C_6H_{12}O_6}+6\,\mathrm{O_2}\rightarrow6\,\mathrm{CO_2}+6\,\mathrm{H_2O},\ \Delta H=-2803\ \mathrm{kJ\,mol^{-1}}\approx3.7\ \mathrm{kcal\,g^{-1}}$
c-133.example: Ihe oriri nwere carbohydrate 50g, abụba 20g na protein 10g bụ $50\times4+20\times9+10\times4=420$ kcal.
c-133.actionItem: Taa gbakọọ calorie nke otu ihe oriri site na g nke carbohydrate, protein na abụba dị na tebụl ntụziaka nri.

c-134.title: Ịkpọ akwa n'anyanwụ nwere mmetụta ịcha ọcha
c-134.summary: Ultraviolet nke anyanwụ na-eme ka ntụpọ agba dị n'ime eriri na-agbaji ma na-eme ka uwe ọcha dị ọcha karịa. Ọbụna n'enweghị sodium percarbonate, enwere ike ibelata obere ntụpọ site na anyanwụ.
c-134.principle: Photooxidation: photon ultraviolet na-agbaji njikọ $\pi$ nke agba ma na-emeghachi omume na oxygen na-eme ya ihe enweghị agba. Ume photon $E = h\nu$ ga-abụrịrị nke karịrị ume njikọ.
c-134.example: Ọ bụrụ na ị kpọọ ala T-shirt ọcha nwere ntụpọ mmiri n'anyanwụ ozugbo awa 4~6, ntụpọ dị mkpa na-ebelata nke ukwuu. Ma uwe nwere agba nwere ike ịmalite ịgba ọcha n'otu ụzọ ahụ, ya mere kpọọ ha n'ime.
c-134.actionItem: Taa kpọọ uwe ọcha nwere ntụpọ mmiri n'ebe anyanwụ dị.

c-135.title: Ọ bụrụ na gluu ngwa ngwa jide aka, tinye ya na mmiri ncha
c-135.summary: Gluu ngwa ngwa na-ata site na mmiri dị n'akpụkpọ, ma enwere ike ịgbaze ya nwayọọ na mmiri ncha dị ọkụ. Ọ bụrụ na ị dọpụta ya na ike, akpụkpọ na-adọwa.
c-135.principle: Cyanoacrylate na-etolite polymer n'usoro site na mmiri (OH⁻) n'ime sekọnd ole na ole ruo nkeji 1. Mmiri ncha na esemokwu na-emeso ma na-ebugharị oyi akwa gluu. $n\,\mathrm{CH_2{=}C(CN)COOR}\xrightarrow{\ \mathrm{OH^-}\ (\text{moisture})\ }\left[\mathrm{CH_2\text{-}C(CN)(COOR)}\right]_n$
c-135.example: Ọ bụrụ na ị tinye aka gị na mmiri ncha dị ọkụ nkeji 10~15 ma tụgharịa ya na isi mkpịsị aka, ọ na-agbaze ọtụtụ oge. Ọ bụrụ na ọ metụrụ anya ma ọ bụ egbugbere ọnụ, ekwula ya, gaa ụlọ ọgwụ.
c-135.actionItem: Taa mgbe ị na-eji gluu ngwa ngwa, mepee ikuku, ma ọ bụrụ na mkpịsị aka jidere, tinye ya na mmiri ncha dị ọkụ nkeji 15 ma tụgharịa ya wepụ ya.

c-136.title: Isi isi azụ na-ebelata ma ị gbakwunye acid
c-136.summary: Isi isi azụ bụ trimethylamine, ihe bụ isi. Ọ bụrụ na ị fesa acid dịka mmiri lemon ma ọ bụ vinegar, a na-emeso ya ma isi na-agbasa obere.
c-136.principle: $\mathrm{(CH_3)_3N + H^+ \to (CH_3)_3NH^+}$. Amine ghọrọ ion anaghị agbanwe ma isi na-ebelata.
c-136.example: Ọ bụrụ na ị fesa 1 ngaji obere (ihe dị ka 5mL) mmiri lemon n'azụ ma hapụ ya nkeji 5, isi na-ebelata n'ụzọ doro anya. Ụzọ ịtinye ya na mmiri ara ehi nkeji 20 dabere n'otu ụkpụrụ, ebe protein na-ejide ihe isi.
c-136.actionItem: Taa mgbe ị na-ere azụ, buru ụzọ fesa mmiri lemon ma ọ bụ vinegar otu ugboro.

c-137.title: Ka ịdị elu na-abawanye, nrụgide oxygen na-ebelata ma iku ume na-esiri ike
c-137.summary: Ọnụ ọgụgụ oxygen n'ikuku bụ ihe dị ka 21% ebe niile, ma ka ịdị elu na-abawanye, nrụgide na-ebelata ma nrụgide akụkụ oxygen na-ebelata. Na 3,000m ịdị elu ị nwere ike iku ume naanị ihe dị ka 70% nke ihe ọ bụ n'ọkwa oké osimiri.
c-137.principle: Iwu nrụgide akụkụ Dalton: $p_{\mathrm{O_2}} = x_{\mathrm{O_2}} \times P_{\mathrm{total}}$. $x_{\mathrm{O_2}} \approx 0.21$ bụ otu ma $P_{\mathrm{total}}$ na-ebelata.
c-137.example: Na ọkwa oké osimiri (101kPa) nrụgide akụkụ oxygen bụ ihe dị ka 21kPa, na 3,000m ịdị elu (ihe dị ka 70kPa) ihe dị ka 14.7kPa. Ịrịgo nwayọọ, ihe ruru 500m kwa ụbọchị, na-ebelata ihe ize ndụ ọrịa ugwu.
c-137.actionItem: Ọ bụrụ na ị na-eme atụmatụ njem n'ebe dị elu, hazie nhazi ka ịrịgo nwayọọ nwayọọ.

c-138.title: Ọ bụrụ na ngwa kọntena eruola ma ọ bụ gbagọrọ agbagọ, tụfuo ya
c-138.summary: Kọntena eruola bụ ihe ịrịba ama na ihe ndị dị ndụ emepụtara gas n'ime ya ma nwee ike ịbụ nje ndị dị ize ndụ dịka botulinum. Ejila meghee kọntena eruola, tụfuo ya.
c-138.principle: Gas mgbaze nke ndị ọrụ nta: site na mmeghachi omume dịka $\mathrm{C_6H_{12}O_6 \to 2C_2H_5OH + 2CO_2}$ a na-emepụta $\mathrm{CO_2}$ ma nrụgide n'ime kọntena na-ebili.
c-138.example: Kọntena nkịtị nwere fọrọ nke nta ka ọ bụrụ ntụpọ n'ime ya, ya mere mkpuchi ya dị larịị ma ọ bụ gbagọrọ obere. Ọ bụrụ na ọ ruru, ma ọ bụ mgbe ịmepe ya na-eme mkpọtụ dị ọkụ ma ọ bụ nwere ụfụfụ, erila ya.
c-138.actionItem: Taa wepụta kọntena dị n'ụlọ gị ma lelee ma enwere kọntena eruola ma ọ bụ nke nwere nchara.

c-139.title: Mmanụ n'ime sink drain na-ekpo ọkụ ma na-egbochi mgbe ọ na-ajụ oyi
c-139.summary: Mmanụ ọkụ bụ mmiri, ma mgbe ọ na-ajụ oyi abụba juputara na-adịkwa ike, na-arapara n'ọgbọ ọkpọkọ ma na-ejikọta na nsị. Ebufela mmanụ n'ime drain, kpochapụ ya na akwụkwọ ma tụfuo ya na mkpofu nkịtị.
c-139.principle: Ebe mgbaze nke abụba juputara bụ ihe dị ka 30~60℃ ma mgbe mmanụ nri na-ajụ oyi ọ na-eme mgbanwe usoro $\mathrm{liquid \to solid}$. Mgbe ọ na-ezute ion calcium ọ na-etolitekwa nnu calcium nke fatty acid (nsị ncha).
c-139.example: Ọ bụrụ na ị wụnye 200mL mmanụ fried n'ime drain, ọ na-adị ike n'ọgbọ ọkpọkọ n'ọkpụrụkpụ 1~2mm ma ọ bụrụ na ọ emegharịa ọtụtụ oge, ọ nwere ike igbochi. Tupu ịsa efere, buru ụzọ kpochapụ efere dị mmanụ na akwụkwọ kichin.
c-139.actionItem: Taa kpochapụ pan nwere mmanụ buru ụzọ na akwụkwọ kichin ma mgbe ahụ saa ya.

c-140.title: Mmiri n'ime karama PET n'ime ụgbọ ala n'oge ọkọchị, enwere ike ịṅụ ya?
c-140.summary: PET karama e hapụrụ ogologo oge n'ime ụgbọ ala dị ọkụ nwere ike ịgbaze ihe ndị dị ntakịrị dịka antimony ọtụtụ. Ụbọchị otu ma ọ bụ abụọ bụ ihe ize ndụ dị ala, ma ọ ka mma izere mmiri a hapụrụ ogologo oge.
c-140.principle: Mgbaze na-abawanye na okpomọkụ: $k = A\,e^{-E_a/RT}$ (nha Arrhenius, mgbe $T$ na-ebili $k$ na-abawanye)
c-140.example: N'ime ọkọchị n'ime ụgbọ ala a kwụsịrị okpomọkụ nwere ike iru 60~70°C, ma ọnụọgụ mgbaze dị ọtụtụ ugboro ngwa ngwa karịa na 20°C.
c-140.actionItem: Taa ṅụọla mmiri dị n'ime karama PET fọdụrụ n'ụgbọ ala, ma maka njem jiri tumbler stainless steel.

c-141.title: Uru nke R-32 refrigerant n'igwe oyi
c-141.summary: R-32 chọrọ obere refrigerant karịa R-410A maka otu ike oyi ma GWP ya bụ ihe dị ka otu ụzọ n'ụzọ atọ. Ọ bụ ihe kwesịrị ịlele mgbe ịzụrụ igwe oyi ọhụrụ.
c-141.principle: R-32: $\mathrm{CH_2F_2}$, mgbe okpomọkụ ịmịpụ $q = h_{\mathrm{g}} - h_{\mathrm{f}}$ buru ibu, ọnụ ọgụgụ refrigerant na-agagharị na-ebelata.
c-141.example: GWP bụ ihe dị ka 2088 maka R-410A, na 675 maka R-32. Nsinye refrigerant na-ebelatakwa ihe dị ka 20~30% ma arụmọrụ na-abawanye obere.
c-141.actionItem: Mgbe ị na-azụta ma ọ bụ na-elele igwe oyi, lelee n'akara ngwaahịa ụdị refrigerant (R-32 ma ọ bụ R-410A).

c-142.title: Ihe mere ihe ọṅụṅụ carbonated ji ejide ụtọ
c-142.summary: Carbon dioxide na-agbaze nke ọma na nrụgide na okpomọkụ dị ala ma na-apụ mgbe ọ kporo ma ọ bụ nrụgide ewepụrụ. Ịchekwa ya n'oyi ma mechie ọnụ ozugbo na-eme ka ụfụfụ dịgide.
c-142.principle: Iwu Henry: $C = k_{\mathrm{H}}\,P_{\mathrm{CO_2}}$, na $k_{\mathrm{H}}$ na-ebelata mgbe okpomọkụ na-ebili.
c-142.example: Nrụgide n'ime karama bụ ihe dị ka 3~4atm, ma na 25°C ịgbaze $\mathrm{CO_2}$ na-agbada ihe dị ka ọkara karịa na 4°C.
c-142.actionItem: Taa mechie ihe ọṅụṅụ carbonated ị na-aṅụ ozugbo ma tinye ya n'ọnọdụ kwụ ọtọ n'ime friji.

c-143.title: Baking soda maka iwepụ isi friji
c-143.summary: Baking soda bụ alkaline dị nro ma na-emeso ihe isi acid nke friji (dịka fatty acid). Ma ike mmịpụta ya dị obere, ya mere a ga-agbanwe ya kwa ọnwa 2~3.
c-143.example: Ọ bụrụ na ị tinye baking soda ihe dị ka 100g (1/2 iko) n'otu ihe, ọ zuru oke iji belata isi dị nro nke obere friji.
c-143.actionItem: Tinye otu iko baking soda n'otu efere dị ala n'ahịrị friji, dee ụbọchị ma gbanwee ya mgbe ọnwa 3 gasịrị.

c-144.title: Ọdụ nri a gbara na 70~75℃ n'ụzọ nwayọọ na-atọ ụtọ kacha
c-144.summary: Enzyme beta-amylase nke ọdụ nri na-agbaji starch ka ọ bụrụ maltose nwere ụtọ, ọ na-arụ ọrụ kacha na ihe dị ka 70~75℃ ma na-akwụsị karịa 90℃. Ka a na-ere ya nwayọọ, ka oge ụtọ na-ewe ogologo.
c-144.principle: $\mathrm{(C_6H_{10}O_5)_n + n/2\,H_2O \xrightarrow{\beta\text{-amylase}} n/2\,C_{12}H_{22}O_{11}}$. Ọrụ enzyme nwere okpomọkụ kacha mma.
c-144.example: Ọ bụrụ na ị gbaa karịa nkeji 50 n'okpuru 150℃, kama naanị nkeji 5 n'oven 180℃, okpomọkụ n'ime ọdụ nri na-anọ ogologo oge na mpaghara 70~75℃ ma a na-emepụta maltose karịa. Nke a bụ ihe mere ọdụ nri a gbara ji atọ ụtọ.
c-144.actionItem: Taa mgbe ị na-ere ọdụ nri, gbalịa ịgba ya nwayọọ n'okpomọkụ dị ala ogologo oge.

c-145.title: Ihe mere akwa ji aghọ ọkara esi na 62~65℃ bụ ịgbanwe protein
c-145.summary: Protein nke akwa ọcha na nke akwa ọchịchịrị na-eguzosi ike n'okpomọkụ dị iche iche. Akwa ọcha site na ihe dị ka 62~65℃, akwa ọchịchịrị na ihe dị ka 65~70℃, nke na-ekewa ọkara esi na nke esiri nke ọma.
c-145.principle: Ịgbanwe site n'okpomọkụ na-edozi usoro tertiary nke protein ma na-eme ka ha kpọkọta. Ovotransferrin na-agbanwe na ihe dị ka 62℃ na ovalbumin na ihe dị ka 80℃.
c-145.example: Ọ bụrụ na ị sie nkeji 6 n'ime mmiri na-esi, akwa ọcha na-eguzosi ike ma akwa ọchịchịrị fọrọ nke nta ka ọ bụrụ mmiri, ya bụ ọkara esi, ma ọ bụrụ na ị sie karịa nkeji 10 ọ na-aghọ nke esiri nke ọma. N'ihi ihe ize ndụ Salmonella, ndị agadi na ndị dị ime erie nke esiri nke ọma.
c-145.actionItem: Taa na akwa ị na-esi, tọọ ngwa nkeji 6 na 10 ma lelee ọdịiche.

c-146.title: Vitamin ndị na-agbaze na mmiri, ọbụna ọtụtụ, na-apụ site na mmamịrị
c-146.summary: Vitamin C na vitamin B na-agbaze na mmiri ma nke karịrị mkpa anaghị ekpokọta n'ahụ kama na-apụ site na mmamịrị. Ihe fọdụrụ nke ọgwụ ndị nwere ọgwụ dị elu nwere ike ịbụ ihe efu n'ọtụtụ ọnọdụ.
c-146.principle: Molecule ndị na-agbaze na mmiri bụ polar, ya mere ha na-agbaze n'ọbara na mmamịrị ma na-asị site na akụrụ. N'ụzọ megidere nke ahụ, vitamin ndị na-agbaze na abụba na-ekpokọta n'ahụ abụba.
c-146.example: Ihe achọrọ kwa ụbọchị nke vitamin C maka okenye bụ ihe dị ka 100mg, ma ọ bụrụ na ị nụọ 1000mg n'otu oge, ọnụ ọgụgụ iweta na-agbada n'okpuru 50%, ihe fọdụrụ na-apụ n'ọtụtụ. Otu mkpụrụ osisi na-ekpuchi ihe dị ka 50mg.
c-146.actionItem: Taa ọ bụrụ na ị na-anara vitamin, lelee na ya na ihe ị na-eri n'ime nri anaghị agafe oke a na-atụ aro.

c-147.title: Nnu oké osimiri na nnu a gbasoro dị iche n'ọnụọgụ sodium chloride na mineral
c-147.summary: Nnu a gbasoro nwere sodium chloride (NaCl) ihe dị ka 99% ma ọ bụ karịa, ma nnu oké osimiri ihe dị ka 80~90% na magnesium, calcium na mmiri. N'ụzọ ọ bụla ụtọ nnu na sodium yiri nke ọzọ, ya mere ọ dị mkpa iri obere.
c-147.principle: Ọnụọgụ sodium bụ $\dfrac{M_{\mathrm{Na}}}{M_{\mathrm{NaCl}}} = \dfrac{23}{58.5} \approx 0.39$. Maka otu ọnụ ọgụgụ nnu, ka ọnụọgụ NaCl dị elu, sodium na-abawanyekwa.
c-147.example: Na 5g nnu, ọ bụrụ na ọ bụ NaCl dị ọcha, enwere ihe dị ka 1.97g sodium, ma ọ bụrụ na nnu oké osimiri bụ 85% NaCl, ihe dị ka 1.67g. WHO na-atụ aro nnu ihe pere mpe karịa 5g kwa ụbọchị.
c-147.actionItem: Taa lelee n'ime tebụl ntụziaka nri nke nnu ụlọ gị ọdịnaya sodium (mg/100g).

c-148.title: Lens anya nke na-agbanwe agba site na ọkụ
c-148.summary: N'ime lens na-agbanwe agba, mgbe halide silver n'ime lens na-anata ultraviolet, ọ na-agbaji ghọọ ntụpọ silver ma na-eche ochie, ma mgbe ọkụ na-apụ ọ na-alaghachi. N'ime ụgbọ ala, ultraviolet na-egbochi site na iko ma na-eche ochie obere.
c-148.example: Lens na-agbanwe agba na-ebelata nnyefe site na ihe dị ka 85% rue 20% n'anyanwụ n'ime nkeji 1, ma ọ na-ewe nkeji 5~15 iji laghachi n'ime ụlọ.
c-148.actionItem: Mgbe ị na-ebugharị ụgbọ ala n'ụbọchị anyanwụ siri ike, nweta anya ọkụ nkịtị na-egbochi ultraviolet iche na lens na-agbanwe agba.

c-149.title: Ụgbọ ala eletrik na-efu ume pere mpe karịa ụgbọ ala petrol
c-149.summary: Injin petrol na-ebufe naanị ihe dị ka 20~30% nke ume mmanụ na wiil ma na-atụfu ndị ọzọ dịka okpomọkụ. Ụgbọ ala eletrik na-ebufe ihe dị ka 80~90% nke ume eletrik na wiil, ya mere ọ chọrọ obere ume maka otu ebe.
c-149.principle: 1L petrol nwere ihe dị ka $32\ \mathrm{MJ}$ ($\approx 8.9\ \mathrm{kWh}$) okpomọkụ ma, ọ bụrụ na arụmọrụ $\eta = \dfrac{W_{\text{out}}}{E_{\text{in}}}$ bụ ihe dị ka 25%, ọrụ bara uru bụ ihe dị ka 2.2kWh.
c-149.example: Ụgbọ ala na-aga ihe dị ka 12km na 1L petrol na-aga 12km na 2.2kWh, ma ụgbọ ala eletrik chọrọ maka 12km ihe dị ka 2kWh (arụmọrụ ihe dị ka 6km/kWh). Ọ bụrụ na ị tụlee mfu na mmepụta eletrik, ọdịiche na-ebelata.
c-149.actionItem: Taa maka njem dị nso, jee ije ma ọ bụ jiri njem ọha iji zọpụta mmanụ.

c-150.title: Ebe anwụrụ mmanụ nri na mmanụ fried
c-150.summary: Mgbe mmanụ gafere ebe anwụrụ, anwụrụ na acrolein na-apụta nke na-akpali anya na akpịrị. Maka isi nri n'ọkụ siri ike, ọ dị nchebe ịhọrọ mmanụ nwere ebe anwụrụ dị elu.
c-150.example: Ebe anwụrụ bụ ihe dị ka 190°C maka mmanụ olive (extra virgin), ihe dị ka 240°C maka mmanụ canola na ihe dị ka 230°C maka mmanụ sunflower a nụchara.
c-150.actionItem: Maka ịgba na ịre, họrọ mmanụ a nụchara nwere ebe anwụrụ dị elu, ma ọ bụrụ na anwụrụ pụta belata ọkụ ozugbo ma mepee ikuku.

c-151.title: Ihe mere tii ice ji adị nsị
c-151.summary: Mgbe tii ojii siri ike na-ajụ oyi, caffeine na tannin na-ejikọta ma na-ekpokọta n'ime ntụpọ, tii na-adị nsị. Ọ bụrụ na ị gbakwunye mmiri ọkụ, ọ na-eme ka ọ dị ọcha, ma ịrapara oyi na-eme ka ọ dị obere nsị.
c-151.principle: Caffeine + tannin (theaflavin) $\rightleftharpoons$ mkpọkọta: ka okpomọkụ dị ala, ka ịgbaze na-ebelata ma na-ada.
c-151.example: Ọ bụrụ na tii ojii a kwadebere na 100°C na-ajụ oyi rue 4°C, ọ na-adị nsị n'ime nkeji ole na ole, ma ịrapara oyi (4°C, awa 8) nwere nsị pere mpe.
c-151.actionItem: Taa maka tii ice, tinye akpa tii n'ime mmiri oyi 500mL ma hapụ ya n'ime friji awa 8 maka ịrapara oyi.

c-152.title: Amygdalin dị n'ime mkpụrụ ume bụ ihe ize ndụ ma ị rie ya ọcha
c-152.summary: Ume na-adịghị ere na mkpụrụ ya nwere amygdalin nke, mgbe ọ na-agbaji, nwere ike ịmepụta hydrogen cyanide. Mee ume sirop site na iwepụ mkpụrụ ma ọ bụ mgbe okpomọkụ karịrị ọnwa 6, kpochapụ ya ma erila mkpụrụ.
c-152.principle: $\mathrm{C_{20}H_{27}NO_{11} + 2H_2O \xrightarrow{\text{enzyme}} C_6H_5CHO + HCN + 2C_6H_{12}O_6}$. Mgbe enzyme metụrụ ya, hydrogen cyanide na-apụta.
c-152.example: Amygdalin dị n'otu mkpụrụ ume bụ nke dị obere, ma ọ bụrụ na ị na-ata ọtụtụ ọcha ọ nwere ike ịbụ ihe ize ndụ. Ume akwụkwọ ndụ akwụkwọ ndụ, mgbe iwepụ mkpụrụ, kpoo ya na shuga 1:1, hapụ ya ọnwa 6 ma wepụ anụ ahụ.
c-152.actionItem: Taa mgbe ị na-eme ume sirop, erila mkpụrụ ma dee n'akwụkwọ ụbọchị ị ga-ewepụ ya.

c-153.title: Ngwaahịa spray nwere ike ịgbawa ma ọ bụrụ na ị hapụ ya n'ebe ọkụ
c-153.summary: N'ime kọntena aerosol enwere gas nke a pịrị na propellant na-ere ọkụ, ya mere mgbe okpomọkụ na-ebili nrụgide na-ebilekwa. Ọ bụrụ na ị hapụ ya n'ụgbọ ala n'oge ọkọchị ma ọ bụ nso ọkụ, ọ nwere ike ịgbawa, ya mere debe akara ndebe n'okpuru 50℃.
c-153.principle: Nrụgide gas dabere na okpomọkụ: $\dfrac{P_1}{T_1} = \dfrac{P_2}{T_2}$ ($T$ na kelvin). Nrụgide gas nke propellant na-ebili ngwa ngwa na okpomọkụ.
c-153.example: Kọntena 5atm na 20℃ (293K), mgbe ọ na-eru 60℃ (333K), site na mgbakọ dị mfe ọ na-aghọ ihe dị ka 5.7atm, ma ọ bụrụ na ịgbakwunye mmụba nrụgide gas nke propellant ọ na-aghọ karịa nke ukwuu. N'ọkọchị ụgbọ ala nwere ike ịgafe 60℃.
c-153.actionItem: Taa chịkọta ngwaahịa spray dị n'ụlọ gị ma bugharịa ha gaa n'ebe dị jụụ ebe okpomọkụ anaghị eru.

c-154.title: Ihe mere jelii anaghị ekwe mgbe a tinyere pineapple ma ọ bụ kiwi
c-154.summary: N'ihi na enzyme na-agbaji protein nke pineapple na kiwi ọhụrụ na-egbutu gelatin ka ọ bụrụ obere. Ọ bụrụ na ị kpoo ya otu ugboro ma ọ bụ jiri nke e mere n'ime ite, enzyme na-akwụsị jelii na-ekwe.
c-154.principle: Bromelain na actinidin na-agbaji njikọ peptide: $\mathrm{R{-}CO{-}NH{-}R' + H_2O \to R{-}COOH + H_2N{-}R'}$. Enzyme na-agbanwe karịa ihe dị ka $70\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$.
c-154.example: 100mL gelatin nwere pineapple ọhụrụ anaghị ekwe ọbụna mgbe awa ole na ole gasịrị, ma pineapple a kpooro karịa 80℃ nkeji 1 ma ọ bụ nke e mere n'ite na-ekwe nke ọma. Otu enzyme a ka a na-eji eme ka anụ dị nro.
c-154.actionItem: Taa mgbe ị na-etinye mkpụrụ osisi ọhụrụ na jelii ma ọ bụ pudding, buru ụzọ gbaa pineapple na kiwi na mmiri na-esi nkeji 1 tupu iji ha.

c-155.title: Isi ndụ nke akwa a hapụrụ akọrọ n'ụzọ na-adịghị mma
c-155.summary: Isi nke ákwà na-ezughị ezu bụ n'ihi fatty acid dịka 4-methyl-3-hexenoic acid nke nje Moraxella na-emepụta. Isi ihe bụ ikpo ngwa ngwa tupu nje abawanye.
c-155.principle: Metabolism nje: abụba akpụkpọ $\rightarrow$ $\mathrm{C_7H_{12}O_2}$ (4-methyl-3-hexenoic acid) na fatty acid ndị ọzọ na-ekpo ọkụ.
c-155.example: Ọ bụrụ na akwa mmiri na-akọrọ n'ime ụlọ n'ime awa 5, isi na-amalite, ma igwe nkpo 60°C ma ọ bụ karịa na-ebelata nje nke ukwuu.
c-155.actionItem: Mgbe ịsachara kpọọ ya ozugbo ma gbanye fan ma ọ bụ dehumidifier ka ọ kọọ n'ime awa 5.

c-156.title: Gịnị bụ ntụpọ pink n'ụlọ ịsa ahụ
c-156.summary: Pink na ihe na-arapara abụghị ero kama oyi akwa agba uhie nke nje dịka Serratia na-emepụta. Mmiri na nsị ncha bụ nri, ya mere nkụ bụ ihe mgbochi kacha mma.
c-156.principle: Mmụba nje $N = N_0\,2^{t/t_d}$ (ọ bụrụ na oge nkewa $t_d$ bụ ihe dị ka nkeji 30, ọ na-abawanye ọtụtụ narị puku ugboro n'ime otu ụbọchị)
c-156.example: N'ime ụlọ ịsa ahụ mmiri 25~35°C, ọnụ ọgụgụ nje na-abawanye ihe dị ka puku 4 ugboro n'ime awa 6 ọ bụla. Mgbe ọ kọrọ, mmụba na-akwụsị.
c-156.actionItem: Mgbe ị sachara, jiri squeegee wepụ mmiri n'ogidi na n'ala ma hapụ fan ikuku na-arụ ọrụ nkeji 30.

c-157.title: Otu esi echekwa watermelon e bipụrụ
c-157.summary: Watermelon na-efu mmiri na shuga site n'akụkụ e bipụrụ ma nje na-ebawanye. Kpuchie akụkụ e bipụrụ na wrap, tinye ya na friji ma rie ya n'ime ụbọchị abụọ bụ nchekwa.
c-157.principle: Ịkpọchapụ dabere na mpaghara e kpughere na okpomọkụ. Na 4°C ọnụọgụ mmụba nje na-ebelata ihe dị ka 1/20 nke ọnụọgụ na 25°C.
c-157.example: Na okpomọkụ ụlọ (30°C), watermelon e bipụrụ na-enwe nje ọtụtụ iri ugboro karịa mgbe awa 2 gasịrị, ma na friji (4°C) ọ dị nchebe ihe dị ka ụbọchị 2.
c-157.actionItem: Hapụ watermelon fọdụrụ n'ime nnukwu ibe ya na ukpa ma tinye wrap n'akụkụ e bipụrụ ma tinye ya na friji.

c-158.title: N'oge ọkọchị, igbe nri na osikapa vinegar na nri jụrụ oyi dị nchebe
c-158.summary: N'ime gburugburu acid (pH n'okpuru 4.6) nje ndị na-akpata nri ndị ọzọ na-esi ike ito. Ọ bụrụ na ị tinye otu ngaji vinegar n'ime osikapa igbe nri ma ọ bụ tinye nri mgbe ha jụrụ oyi, ọ na-adị nchebe ogologo oge.
c-158.principle: Site na nhazi dissociation nke acid dị nro $\mathrm{CH_3COOH \rightleftharpoons CH_3COO^- + H^+}$ $[\mathrm{H^+}]$ na-abawanye, pH na-agbada ma ọsọ ito nje na-ebelata.
c-158.example: Ọ bụrụ na ị tinye 1 ngaji nri (15mL) vinegar n'osikapa iko 2 (ihe dị ka 300g), pH osikapa na-agbada ihe dị ka 5 ma mmụba nje na-ebelata. Mechie igbe mgbe ọ jụrụ oyi kpam kpam ma tinye ya na ice pack.
c-158.actionItem: Taa maka igbe nri, mechie ya mgbe osikapa jụrụ oyi nke ọma ma tinye ice pack.

c-159.title: Ihe mere ngwa ji agba nchara n'ụbọchị mmiri
c-159.summary: Ígwè, mgbe ọ nwere mmiri na oxygen, na-aghọ iron oxide (nchara) ma na-eme ngwa ngwa mgbe mmiri karịrị 60%. Mmanụ nkịtị ma ọ bụ desiccant na-egbu oge nchara.
c-159.example: Na mmiri ikuku 60% ma ọ bụ karịa, ígwè na-enweghị mkpuchi na-agba nchara n'ime ụbọchị ole na ole, ma n'okpuru 40% ọ fọrọ nke nta ka ọ gaghị aga n'ihu.
c-159.actionItem: Hichaa ngwa na akwa nwere mmanụ igwe ịkwa akwa ma tinye silica gel n'igbe ngwa.

c-160.title: Ịkpachara anya mgbe ị na-eji naphthalene n'igbe uwe
c-160.summary: Naphthalene na-agbanwe site na siri ike gaa na gas ozugbo (sublimation) ma na-achụ ụdụ. Ikuku ya na-emerụ ọkpụkpụ iku ume, ya mere ikuku na ebe dị anya dị mkpa.
c-160.principle: Sublimation: $\mathrm{C_{10}H_8(s) \rightarrow C_{10}H_8(g)}$, ma mgbe okpomọkụ na-ebili nrụgide ikuku na-abawanye.
c-160.example: Nrụgide ikuku nke naphthalene bụ ihe dị ka 11Pa na 25°C ma na 40°C ọ na-abawanye ihe dị ka ugboro 4. Ekwela ka ọ metụ uwe aka.
c-160.actionItem: Uwe e jiri naphthalene tinye, tupu ị yi ha, kpọọ ha n'ikuku n'èzí awa 2~3 ma debe ya n'ebe ụmụaka na-erubeghị.

c-161.title: Isi galiki na azụ na-ebelata ma ị kpụpụ aka na stainless steel
c-161.summary: A maara na isi sulfur nke galiki na yabasị na-ebelata ma ị kpụpụ aka na stainless steel. Ọ bụrụ na ị saa na ncha, a na-asachapụ sulfur compound fọdụrụ.
c-161.principle: Ihe nwere sulfur $\mathrm{R{-}SH}$ na-arapara n'oyi akwa oxide ($\mathrm{Cr_2O_3}$) nke elu ígwè ma ọnụọgụ ya na-ebelata.
c-161.example: Ọtụtụ mmadụ nwere ahụmahụ na isi na-ebelata ma ọ bụrụ na, mgbe ịkọrọ galiki, ị kpụpụ aka na ọpọpọ stainless sekọnd 30, ma ihe àmà sayensị maka nha mmetụta bụ nke mmachi. Ị nwekwara ike iji mmiri lemon na vinegar.
c-161.actionItem: Taa mgbe ị kọsịrị galiki, kpụpụ aka gị na sink stainless sekọnd 30 ma saa ya na ncha.

c-162.title: Ihe mere ero n'achịcha toast ji eto ngwa ngwa n'oge mmiri ozuzo
c-162.summary: Achịcha nwere mmiri dị elu ma ero na-eto ngwa ngwa mgbe mmiri ikuku karịrị 70%. Eriri ero na-agbasa rue n'ime achịcha, ya mere ọ dị ize ndụ ọbụna ịbepụ naanị akụkụ ọ pụtara.
c-162.principle: Mmiri nke ọrụ $a_w = \dfrac{p}{p_0}$ (achịcha toast ihe dị ka 0.95, ero na-eto site na ihe dị ka 0.80 ma ọ bụ karịa)
c-162.example: N'ụbọchị mmiri, achịcha toast na okpomọkụ ụlọ 25°C na-enwe ero n'ime ụbọchị 3~4, ma ọ bụrụ na e kwụsị ya (-18°C), ọ na-echekwa ọtụtụ izu.
c-162.actionItem: Taa kechie achịcha toast ị naghị eri n'otu n'otu na wrap, kwụsị ya ma mgbe ị ga-eri ya ree ya na toaster.

c-163.title: Ihe mere mmiri ozuzo ji dị acid ntakịrị
c-163.summary: Mmiri ozuzo bụ acid dị nro na pH ihe dị ka 5.6 n'ihi carbon dioxide ikuku agbaze, ma mmiri ozuzo acid bụ pH n'okpuru 5.6. Nke a anaghị emerụ akpụkpọ, ma ígwè na nkume na-aka nwayọọ.
c-163.example: Ọ bụrụ na $[\mathrm{H^+}] \approx 2.5\times10^{-6}\,\mathrm{mol/L}$, pH $= -\log[\mathrm{H^+}] \approx 5.6$. Mmiri dị ọcha nwere pH 7.
c-163.actionItem: Mgbe mmiri ozuzo gasịrị, hichaa mmiri n'eriri ịnyịnya igwe nke guzoro n'èzí ma tinye otu ntụpọ mmanụ.

c-164.title: Osikapa jụrụ oyi nwere starch na-eguzogide karịa ma shuga a na-anabata na-ebelata
c-164.summary: Mgbe osikapa na-ajụ oyi, akụkụ nke starch na-aghọ starch na-eguzogide nke na-esi ike ịgbari. Ọbụna ma ọ bụrụ na e kpoghachiri ya mgbe e mesịrị friji, akụkụ nke starch a na-eguzogide na-anọgide ma ọrịrị glucose ọbara nwere ike ịdị nwayọọ.
c-164.principle: Retrogradation nke starch bụ ihe omume nke amylose gelatinized na-etolitegharị ọdịdị kristal mgbe ọ na-ajụ oyi. Kristal a na-esi ike maka enzyme amylase ịgbaji.
c-164.example: A maara na osikapa kpooro mgbe awa 12~24 n'ime friji nwere starch na-eguzogide ọtụtụ ugboro karịa osikapa a gbasịrị ọhụrụ, ma ọnụ ọgụgụ na-abawanye bụ naanị ọnụ ọgụgụ ole na ole nke starch niile. Ejila osikapa hapụ n'okpomọkụ ụlọ, tinye ya na friji ngwa ngwa.
c-164.actionItem: Taa tinye osikapa fọdụrụ n'ime friji n'ime awa 1.

c-165.title: Mmetụta softener uwe na akwa ịsa ahụ mgbe ịsachara
c-165.summary: Softener uwe, nke nwere surfactant cationic na-ekpuchi eriri, na-eme ya dị nro ma na-ebelata ịnabata mmiri. Maka akwa ịsa ahụ ọ ka mma iji ya obere ugboro ma ọ bụ tinye vinegar kama ya.
c-165.principle: Surfactant cationic $\mathrm{R_2N^+(CH_3)_2}$ na-arapara n'eriri nwere ụgwọ adịghị mma $\mathrm{{-}COO^-}$ ma na-etolite oyi akwa hydrophobic.
c-165.example: Akwa ịsa ahụ nwere softener nwere ike ịnwe ịnabata mmiri na-ebelata ihe dị ka 20~30%. Mgbe ị na-asa akwa ịsa ahụ 10, belata ojiji softener rue otu n'ime ugboro 3.
c-165.actionItem: Taa saa akwa ịsa ahụ na-enweghị softener ma maa ya ka ọ kọọ nke ọma.

c-166.title: Ịmegharị otu ite aluminum chọrọ naanị ihe dị ka 5% nke ume emepụtara ọhụrụ
c-166.summary: Aluminum, mgbe a na-emepụta ya ọhụrụ site na ore, na-eri eletrik nke ukwuu, ma site n'ịgbaze na imegharị, enwere ike ịzọpụta ihe dị ka 95%. Ọ bụrụ na ị saa ite nke ọma ma kewaa ha maka imegharị, nsonaazụ buru ibu.
c-166.principle: Electrolysis nke bauxite: $\mathrm{2Al_2O_3 \to 4Al + 3O_2}$. Maka 1kg aluminum ọhụrụ chọrọ ihe dị ka $14\ \mathrm{kWh}$, ma maka aluminum emegharịrị ihe dị ka $0.7\ \mathrm{kWh}$.
c-166.example: Imegharị otu ite aluminum (ihe dị ka 14g) na-azọpụta ihe dị ka 0.2kWh. Maka ite 100 ọ bụ ihe dị ka 20kWh, nke yiri eletrik igwe oyi na-eji n'ime awa 5.
c-166.actionItem: Taa kpochapụ ite ị ṅụrụ, saa ya ma tinye ya n'ime ihe mkpọkọta aluminum.

c-167.title: Ọ bụghị nchekwa ibepụ naanị akụkụ a na-ahụ anya n'nri nwere ero
c-167.summary: Ero na-agbatị eriri ndị dị ka eriri n'okpuru akụkụ a na-ahụ anya ma ụfọdụ na-emepụta nsị. N'ihe oriri dị nro dịka achịcha, mkpụrụ osisi na jam, ọ bụrụ na ị hụ ero, nchekwa bụ ịtụfu ya niile.
c-167.principle: Aflatoxin $\mathrm{B_1}$ bụ $\mathrm{C_{17}H_{12}O_6}$ ma na-eguzogide okpomọkụ, na-agbaji naanị karịa ihe dị ka $270\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$. Ọ naghị apụ ọbụna site na isi nri ma ọ bụ ịre.
c-167.example: Enwere ntụziaka na maka nri siri ike dịka cheese siri ike ma ọ bụ carrot, ọ zuru ezu ibepụ 2.5cm gburugburu ebe ero dị, ma nri dị nro nwere mmiri ọtụtụ dịka achịcha toast, jam na tofu ga-atụfu niile.
c-167.actionItem: Taa lelee ma achịcha toast na jam dị n'ime friji nwere ero.

c-168.title: Isi gas obodo bụ ihe a tinyere n'ụzọ ezi uche
c-168.summary: Gas obodo (methane) enweghị isi site na okike, ya mere a na-agbakwunye obere ihe sitere na thioether na mercaptan nwere isi dị ka akwa rere ure ka a mata mgbapụ. Ọ bụrụ na ị nụ isi, ejila ọkụ ma ọ bụ switch eletrik, buru ụzọ mepee ikuku.
c-168.principle: Methane na-agbawa n'ihe dị ka 5~15% n'ikuku: $\mathrm{CH_4 + 2O_2 \to CO_2 + 2H_2O}$. Maka methane enweghị isi, ihe isi a na-agbakwunye gụnyere $\mathrm{CH_3SH}$.
c-168.example: Ọ bụrụ na methane 0.4~1.2m³ (5~15%) na-agbapụ n'ime ụlọ 8m³, ọ nọ n'ime oke mgbawa. Ọ bụrụ na ị nụ isi gas, mechie valvụ, mepee windo, ejila switch ọkụ ma ọ bụ ikuku ma kpọọ ka enyere gị aka site n'èzí.
c-168.actionItem: Taa mata ebe valvụ gas dị ma mee ọ bụ omenala imechi ya mgbe ojiji.

c-169.title: Onye na-ahụ ọcha n'ime ncha uwe ọcha na-eme ka ọcha pụta ka ọ dị ọcha karịa
c-169.summary: Onye na-ahụ ọcha na-anabata ultraviolet ma na-ewepụta ọkụ na-acha anụnụ anụnụ, na-ekpuchi ọcha odo ma na-eme ka uwe dị ka ọ dị ọcha karịa. Ọ naghị ewepụ unyi, ọ bụ mmetụta anya, ma a chọghị ya maka uwe nwere agba.
c-169.principle: Fluorescence bụ ịwepụta ultraviolet a nabatara (ihe dị ka 350nm) dịka ọkụ na-acha anụnụ anụnụ (ihe dị ka 430nm), na ume $E = \dfrac{hc}{\lambda}$ nke na-apụta n'ogologo mmiri dị ntakịrị ogologo.
c-169.example: T-shirt ọcha a sachara otu ugboro na onye na-ahụ ọcha nwere ike iwepụta ọkụ na-acha anụnụ anụnụ karịa n'okpuru anyanwụ ma pụta ihe dị ka 5~10% dị nchara. Maka uwe nwere agba, ịsa ya na ncha nkịtị n'enweghị akara a zuru ezu.
c-169.actionItem: Taa n'oge ịsa uwe, lelee akara onye na-ahụ ọcha n'ime ncha maka uwe ọcha na nke nwere agba.

c-170.title: Ọ bụrụ na ekwentị dabara na mmiri, itinye ya n'osikapa fọrọ nke nta ka ọ ghara inwe mmetụta
c-170.summary: Osikapa nwere ike dị ntakịrị iwere mmiri, ya mere ọsọ iwepụ mmiri n'ekwentị adịghị iche nke ukwuu na ịkụ ya n'ikuku. Ọ ka mma ịgbanyụọ ekwentị, ejila chaji ma hapụ ya ka ọ kọọ n'ebe ikuku na-abanye.
c-170.principle: Ọsọ ịkọ dabere na ọdịiche nrụgide ikuku. Ike iwere mmiri nke osikapa dị obere karịa silica gel, ma oge ọ na-ewe maka mmeghachi omume corrosion nke ọkụ ịkwụsị dị mkpa.
c-170.example: Silica gel na-anabata mmiri ruo ihe dị ka 40% nke ibu ya, ma osikapa dị obere. Gbanyụọ ya ma hapụ ya ka ọ kọọ karịa awa 24~48 tupu ị gbanye ya. Ọ bụrụ na ọ dabara na mmiri nnu, rịọ ụlọ ọrụ ọrụ buru ụzọ.
c-170.actionItem: Ọ bụrụ na ekwentị gị mmiri ruru ya, kama osikapa, gbanyụọ ya ma tinye ya n'ebe ikuku na-abanye.

c-171.title: Maka ọkụ ọkụ, buru ụzọ jụụ ya na mmiri oyi na-asọ nkeji 20
c-171.summary: Ozugbo ọkụ gasịrị, ịkwa mmiri oyi na-asọ (15~25℃) nkeji 10~20 na-ewepụ okpomọkụ na-agbasa miri emi n'akpụkpọ ma na-ebelata mmerụ. Ejila ice, nri eze ma ọ bụ doenjang.
c-171.principle: Okpomọkụ nke ihe ọkụ na-ebufe n'ahụ site na $q = mc\Delta T$ ma na-agbanwe protein. Mmiri na-asọ na-ewepụ okpomọkụ ngwa ngwa.
c-171.example: Mmiri 60℃ na-akpata ọkụ siri ike n'akpụkpọ n'ime sekọnd 5. Mmiri oyi nkeji 20 na-ebelata omimi ọkụ ma na-agwọ mgbu, ma ice dị oyi nke ukwuu na-egbochi ụbọchị ọbara ma na-emerụ ahụ.
c-171.actionItem: Taa cheta usoro: ọ bụrụ na ọkụ ọ bụla n'ime kichin, ozugbo jụụ ya na mmiri oyi na-asọ nkeji 20.

c-172.title: Gịnị bụ 'oxygen absorber' dị n'ime nri
c-172.summary: Obere akpa dị n'ime ngwaahịa seaweed ma ọ bụ jerky nwere ntụ ígwè nke na-emeghachi omume na oxygen ma na-ewepụ ya n'ime ngwaahịa. Mgbe oxygen na-ebelata, ịgbanwe abụba na ero na-egbu oge.
c-172.example: Otu akpa oxygen absorber (ihe dị ka 2g ígwè) na-anabata ihe dị ka 200mL oxygen ma ọ fọrọ nke nta ka ọ wepụ 21% oxygen n'ime ngwaahịa ikuku 1L.
c-172.actionItem: Erila oxygen absorber dị n'akpa ma n'ime nri e ji mkpọkọta ọhụrụ hapụ ya dịka ọ dị maka nchekwa.

c-173.title: Ọhụrụ nke akwa, lelee site na ịfe n'ime mmiri
c-173.summary: Akpụkpọ akwa nwere ntụpọ dị nro, ya mere n'oge, mmiri na carbon dioxide na-apụ ma ikuku n'ime na-abawanye. Ọ bụrụ na ọ banye n'okpuru, ọ bụ ọhụrụ, ọ bụrụ na ọ na-efe, ọ bụ ochie.
c-173.principle: Ike ịgbanye $F_{\mathrm{b}} = \rho_{\mathrm{water}}\,V g$, ọ bụrụ na ikuku n'ime na-abawanye ma njupụta nkezi $\rho < \rho_{\mathrm{water}}$, ọ na-efe.
c-173.example: Njupụta akwa ozugbo ọ tụrụ bụ ihe dị ka 1.09g/mL, ma mgbe izu 3~4 gasịrị ọ na-agbada rue ihe dị ka 1.02g/mL, ọ na-amalite ịfe na mmiri na-enweghị nnu.
c-173.actionItem: Maka akwa na-enye nkụ, tupu ị gbawaa ya, wụsa mmiri n'ime ihe ma tinye ya ka ọ fe. Ọ bụrụ na ọ na-efe n'elu, erila ya.

c-174.title: Ihe mere mmanụ aṅụ ji adịkwa ike ma na-acha ọcha
c-174.summary: Mgbe glucose dị n'ime mmanụ aṅụ gafere oke nke ọ nwere ike ịgbaze n'ime mmiri, ọ na-etolite kristal ma na-adị ike. Ọ bụghị mgbaji kama ọ bụ ihe omume nkịtị, ma enwere ike iweghachi ya site n'ịkpọ mmiri.
c-174.principle: Ịgbaze glucose: mgbe oke nnabata gafere $\mathrm{C_6H_{12}O_6(aq)} \rightarrow \mathrm{C_6H_{12}O_6(s)}$
c-174.example: Mmanụ aṅụ nwere ihe dị ka 31% glucose, ihe dị ka 38% fructose na ihe dị ka 17% mmiri, ma kristalization na-eme ngwa ngwa n'okpuru 14°C. Ọ bụrụ na ị tinye ya n'ime mmiri 40°C, ọ na-agbaze.
c-174.actionItem: Mmanụ aṅụ siri ike, kama microwave, tinye ya n'ime ite n'ime mmiri n'okpuru 40°C ma jiri ya.

c-175.title: Ihe mere a na-etinye mmanụ nri na ọgwụ n'ime karama agba aja aja
c-175.summary: Ọkụ, karịsịa ultraviolet na ọkụ na-acha anụnụ anụnụ, na-eme ka abụba na vitamin na-emepụta ma na-emebi ha. Iko agba aja aja na-egbochi ọkụ nke ogologo mmiri n'okpuru ihe dị ka 450nm n'ụzọ buru ibu.
c-175.principle: Photooxidation: $\mathrm{RH + O_2} \xrightarrow{h\nu} \mathrm{ROO\cdot}$ (oxidation n'usoro), ume photon $E = hc/\lambda$
c-175.example: Iko agba aja aja na-egbochi karịa 90% nke ọkụ dị nso na 400nm, ma mmanụ n'ime karama doro anya nwere ike ịmalite ịre ere n'ime izu ole na ole n'anyanwụ.
c-175.actionItem: Chekwaa mmanụ sesame na mmanụ perilla n'ime kabụọdụ ọchịchịrị, ọ bụghị n'akụkụ windo nwere ọkụ.

c-176.title: Ụkpụrụ nke ice pack ozugbo na-ajụ oyi
c-176.summary: Ammonium nitrate ma ọ bụ urea n'ime ngwugwu, mgbe ọ na-agbaze na mmiri, na-anabata okpomọkụ ma okpomọkụ na-agbada. Ọ bụ mmeghachi omume endothermic nke ị nwere ike iji ozugbo site na ịgbaji na ịma jijiji.
c-176.example: Mgbe 1 mol ammonium nitrate (80g) na-agbaze na mmiri, ọ na-anabata 25.7kJ ma nwee ike belata okpomọkụ nke 100mL mmiri ihe dị ka 15~20°C n'okpuru okpomọkụ ụlọ.
c-176.actionItem: N'ịga ịhụ ihe ndina ma ọ bụ mgbatị ahụ, buru ice pack ozugbo, ma ekwela ka ọ metụ akpụkpọ, kechie ya n'akwa ma jiri ya naanị nkeji 15.

c-177.title: Ihe mere batrị lithium-ion ji adịghị ike n'ọkụ
c-177.summary: Okpomọkụ dị elu na-eme ka mmebi electrolyte na ịtolite SEI layer ngwa ngwa ma na-ebelata ikike ruo mgbe ebighi ebi. Ejila hapụ ekwentị na powerbank n'ime ụgbọ ala n'oge ọkọchị.
c-177.principle: Ọnụọgụ mgbaji $k = A\,e^{-E_a/RT}$: mgbe okpomọkụ na-ebili ihe dị ka 10°C, ọnụọgụ na-abụ okpukpu abụọ (iwu ahụmahụ Arrhenius)
c-177.example: Ọ bụrụ na na 25°C ikike na-ebelata ihe dị ka 20% mgbe afọ 1 gasịrị, na 45°C n'otu oge ahụ ọ nwere ike ibelata ihe dị ka 35~40%.
c-177.actionItem: N'oge ọkọchị, ejila hapụ ngwa nwere batrị n'ime ụgbọ ala, kama buru ha n'akpa.

c-178.title: Ihe mere kimchi ji acid ngwa ngwa n'oge ọkọchị
c-178.summary: Nje lactic acid n'ime kimchi na-eto ngwa ngwa ka okpomọkụ dị elu ma na-emepụta ọtụtụ lactic acid. N'okpuru 10°C ọ na-eto nwayọọ ma ụtọ na-adịgide ogologo.
c-178.principle: Mgbaze lactic: $\mathrm{C_6H_{12}O_6 \rightarrow 2\,CH_3CH(OH)COOH}$ (pH na-agbada ma ụtọ acid na-abawanye)
c-178.example: Na 20°C n'ime ụbọchị 3~4 pH na-agbada rue ihe dị ka 4.2 ma na-adị acid, ma na friji 4°C ọ na-agbanwe nwayọọ n'ime ọtụtụ izu.
c-178.actionItem: Debe naanị oke ị ga-eri n'obere ihe ma chekwaa ndị ọzọ n'ebe kacha oyi nke friji.

c-179.title: Sunscreen bụ mmanụ ma anaghị ewepụ nke ọma site na mmiri naanị
c-179.summary: Ihe nchacha UV na mmanụ nke sunscreen fọrọ nke nta ka ha ghara ịgbaze na mmiri, ya mere ha na-anọgide ma ị saa naanị na mmiri. Ọ bụrụ na ị gbaze ihe mmanụ na mmanụ ịsachapụ ma ọ bụ balm ma mechie na foam cleanser, ọ na-apụ nke ọma.
c-179.principle: Iwu 'ihe yiri ya na-agbaze ihe yiri ya': ihe nwere otu polarity na-agwakọta. Mmanụ na-abụghị polar na-agbaze n'ime nchacha na-abụghị polar ma n'ime mmiri a chọrọ surfactant (micelle).
c-179.example: A na-ekpebi sunscreen na-adịghị emerụ mmiri ka ọ nọgide karịa 80% ọbụna mgbe e tinyere ya n'ime mmiri awa atọ. Ọ dị irè ịme massage na mmanụ ịsachapụ sekọnd 30, mee ka ọ bụrụ emulsion na mmiri ma saa ya.
c-179.actionItem: Ọ bụrụ na ị tee sunscreen taa, buru ụzọ jiri mmanụ ịsachapụ ma mgbe ahụ saa na foam cleanser.

c-180.title: Ntụ ọcha sitere na mmiri batrị bụ alkaline, yi aka ọma mgbe ị na-ehicha ya
c-180.summary: Ntụ ọcha na-awụsa mgbe batrị alkaline na-ewere agadi bụ potassium carbonate nke potassium hydroxide na carbon dioxide ikuku na-emeghachi omume. Ọ na-akpali akpụkpọ na anya, ya mere yi aka ọma ma jiri swab nwere vinegar ma ọ bụ lemon hichaa.
c-180.principle: Site na $\mathrm{2KOH + CO_2 \to K_2CO_3 + H_2O}$ kristal ọcha na-etolite, ma site na acid dị nro nke vinegar a na-emeso ya dịka $\mathrm{K_2CO_3 + 2CH_3COOH \to 2CH_3COOK + H_2O + CO_2}$.
c-180.example: Mmiri na-awụsa bụ alkaline siri ike na pH 13~14 ma na-akpali akpụkpọ ma ọ bụrụ na aka na-adịghị yi aka metụrụ ya. Hichaa ya na swab nwere vinegar ma mezue na akwa akọrọ. N'ime ngwa ị na-anaghị eji, ọ dị nchebe iwepụ batrị.
c-180.actionItem: Taa wepụ batrị n'ime ndụmọdụ ma ọ bụ ihe egwuregwu ị na-anaghị eji ogologo oge.

c-181.title: Ihe mere ice ji adịghị ọcha
c-181.summary: Ikuku na ihe ruru dị n'ime mmiri na-ejide n'etiti ice mgbe ọ na-eguzosi ike ma na-eme ka ọ pụta ọcha. Mmiri sie ma jụrụ oyi na-eme ka ọ doo anya karịa, ma ọ naghị adị ọcha kpam kpam.
c-181.principle: Ịgbaze gas $C = k_{\mathrm{H}}\,P$: mgbe mmiri na-ajụ oyi, ịgbaze na-abụ ihe dị ka 0 ma ụfụfụ na-ejide
c-181.example: Ice e mere site na mmiri sie ma jụrụ oyi nwere obere ụfụfụ ma doo anya n'ụzọ doro anya, ma ọ bụrụ na ị kwụsị ya site n'otu akụkụ (directional freezing) ọ na-aghọ ice doro anya.
c-181.actionItem: Taa maka ice ị ga-eji, wụsa mmiri sie ma jụrụ oyi n'ime ice tray ma kwụsị ya.

c-182.title: Otu esi echekwa hydrogen peroxide
c-182.summary: Hydrogen peroxide na-agbaji ghọọ oxygen na mmiri mgbe ọ na-ezute ọkụ, okpomọkụ ma ọ bụ ígwè. Chekwaa ya n'ime karama agba aja aja n'ebe dị jụụ ma karama ochie na-ebelata ịdị irè.
