c-270.actionItem: Taa, lelee na ebe batrị bọtịnị n'ime remote, igodo smart na ihe egwuregwu ka a kpọchiri na skru, ma debe batrị ọzọ n'ebe aka ụmụaka na-adịghị eru.

c-271.title: Tuna na swordfish: ọ bụ naanị otu ma ọ bụ abụọ n'izu n'ihi mercury
c-271.summary: Azụ buru ibu na-eri anụ dị ka tuna na swordfish nwere methylmercury kpọkọtara, ya mere ọ dị mma ịchịkwa ọnụọgụ ị na-eri ruo otu ma ọ bụ abụọ n'izu.
c-271.principle: Mercury na-aghọ methylmercury site na microbes ma na-agbakọta n'ụdọ nri. $\mathrm{Hg^{2+} \xrightarrow{\text{microbes}} CH_3Hg^+}$ Nnabata kwa izu nke European Food Safety Authority bụ 1.3 μg n'otu kg nke ibu ahụ.
c-271.example: Maka ibu ahụ 60kg, nnabata kwa izu bụ 78 μg. Swordfish nwere mercury 1.0ppm na 100g nwere ihe dị ka 100 μg, ya mere otu oge nwere ike ịgafe, ebe tuna dị mfe nwere ihe dị ka 0.1ppm na 100g bụ ihe dị ka 10 μg. Ụmụ nwanyị dị ime na ụmụaka kwesịrị ịkpachapụ anya karịa.
c-271.actionItem: Taa, rie tuna, swordfish ma ọ bụ shark naanị ihe dị ka 100g n'otu oge, ma tụọ atụmatụ iri otu azụ buru ibu ahụ ugboro 1-2 naanị n'izu a.

c-272.title: Shrimp na akwa mmiri na-acha ọbara ọbara mgbe e sichara ha
c-272.summary: Mgbe a na-esi shrimp na akwa mmiri, protein ha na-agbanwe ma agba ọbara ọbara kpọchiri na-apụta, nke bụ ezigbo ihe ngosi na ha sie nke ọma.
c-272.principle: Mgbe ha dị ndụ, astaxanthin na-arapara na protein (crustacyanin) ma na-acha ọcha na-acha anụnụ anụnụ, ma mgbe okpomọkụ na-agbanwe protein, astaxanthin ọbara ọbara na-apụta. $\text{astaxanthin-protein (ọcha anụnụ anụnụ)} \xrightarrow{\Delta} \text{astaxanthin (ọbara ọbara)} + \text{protein gbanwere}$
c-272.example: Shrimp na-aghọ pink na-adịghị ahụ site n'ime mgbe okpomọkụ n'ime ya ruru 63℃ (145℉) ma ọ bụ karịa, ma nkeji 2-3 n'mmiri na-esi zuru ezu. Ịsi ya ogologo oge na-eme ka anụ ya sie ike.
c-272.actionItem: Taa, mgbe ị na-esi shrimp, wepụ ya ozugbo ahụ ya ghọrọ pink na-adịghị ahụ ma gbagọọ n'ụdị C ka ọ ghara ịsi ike.

c-273.title: Brake fluid ochie na-eme ka ịkwụsị ụgbọ ala dị adịghị ike
c-273.summary: Brake fluid na-anata mmiri n'ikuku, nke na-ebelata ebe ọ na-esi, ma n'ịkwụsị na mberede dị ka n'ala ugwu ọ nwere ike ịsi ma ike ịkwụsị na-ada.
c-273.principle: Brake fluid glycol na-anata mmiri, ya mere mgbe mmiri gwakọtara ya, ebe ọ na-esi na-ada ma ikuku na-apụta, ikuku na-ewe mkpakọ ma anaghị ebufe ike ịkwụsị. $\ln\frac{P_2}{P_1} = -\frac{\Delta H_{vap}}{R}\left(\frac{1}{T_2} - \frac{1}{T_1}\right)$
c-273.example: Ebe DOT 4 kpọrọ nkụ na-esi bụ opekata mpe 230℃, ma mgbe ọ natara mmiri ọ na-ada ihe dị ka 75℃ ruo 155℃. Ọ na-anata ihe dị ka 2-3% mmiri n'afọ, ya mere a na-akwado ịgbanwe ya kwa afọ 2 ma ọ bụ kwa 40,000km.
c-273.actionItem: Taa, lelee ndekọ nhazi gị maka ụbọchị ikpeazụ a gbanwere brake fluid, ma ọ bụrụ na ọ gafeela afọ 2, depụta oge nyocha n'ebe a na-edozi ụgbọ ala.

c-274.title: Agba pink nke ham gift set bụ ihe nitrite na-akpata
c-274.summary: Ịnọgide na-acha pink nke ham ọbụna mgbe e sichara ya bụ agba nitrite mere, ma ọ ka mma ịghara iri anụ a hazigharịrị ọtụtụ.
c-274.principle: Nitrite na-aghọ nitric oxide (NO) n'acidic ma na-ejikọta na iron nke myoglobin, ihe nchacha anụ, na-emepụta nitrosomyoglobin pink. $\mathrm{NO + Mb(Fe^{2+}) \to Mb(Fe^{2+})\text{-}NO}$
c-274.example: Oke nnabata nitrite ion fọdụrụ n'ngwaahịa anụ na Korea bụ 70mg/kg ma ọ bụ ihe na-erughị nke ahụ. Òtù Ahụike Ụwa na-ekewa anụ a hazigharịrị dị ka ihe na-akpata ọrịa kansa Otu 1, ma na-eme atụmatụ na iri 50g kwa ụbọchị na-eme ka ihe ize ndụ kansa afọ ukwu bawanye ihe dị ka 18%.
c-274.actionItem: Taa, debe ham gift set ị natara n'ime friji, ma rie ya n'ụzọ nke ihe dị ka 50g n'otu oge ya na akwụkwọ nri.

c-275.title: Ntụ ọcha n'elu gotgam abụghị ero, kama ọ bụ kristal shuga
c-275.summary: Ntụ ọcha n'èzí gotgam (persimmon akọrọ) abụghị ero n'ọtụtụ ọnọdụ, kama ọ bụ kristal shuga (glucose na fructose) mere ka ọ siri ike n'elu. Ọ bụrụ na ọ nwere ntụpọ akwụkwọ ndụ ma ọ bụ ojii dị ka ajị anụ, ọ bụ ero, ya mere tụfuo ya.
c-275.principle: N'oge ịkpọnwụ, mmiri na-ebelata ma nkwụnye shuga na-arị elu, ma mgbe ọ gafere solubility saturation, shuga na-apụta dị ka kristal. Ọnọdụ saturation bụ $C > C_{\mathrm{sat}}(T)$, nke bụ nsonaazụ nke mmiri na-apụ ma n'ihi ya denominator nke $C=\frac{m_{\mathrm{shuga}}}{V_{\mathrm{mmiri}}}$ na-ebelata.
c-275.example: Persimmon ndụ nwere ihe dị ka 80% mmiri na ihe dị ka 15% shuga, mana gotgam na-ebelata ruo ihe dị ka 25-30% mmiri ma shuga na-agbakọta ruo ihe dị ka 60% ma ọ bụ karịa. Ya mere ntụ ọcha na-apụta n'elu.
c-275.actionItem: Taa, mgbe ị na-azụta gotgam, họrọ nke ntụ ya dị otu ọnụ, siri ike, ma elu ya kpọrọ nkụ, ma zere nke nwere ajị akwụkwọ ndụ ma ọ bụ ntụpọ na-arapara.

c-276.title: Isi ọkụ ọkụ mgbe a na-ebido ihe ọkụkụ okpomọkụ bụ unyi kpokọtara na-agbaji site n'okpomọkụ
c-276.summary: Mgbe ị na-agbanye igwe okpomọkụ nke zuru ike n'oge okpomọkụ nke mbụ, isi ọkụ ọkụ na-adịghị mma bụ ọtụtụ mgbe unyi kpokọtara n'ime ya na-agbaji. Ọ na-apụkarị mgbe ị hapụrụ ya ka ọ rụọ nkeji ole na ole ebe ikuku na-agafe, mana ọ bụrụ na ọ nọgide, ọ chọrọ nyocha.
c-276.principle: Ihe ndụ dị n'unyi (eriri, nkpụrụ akpụkpọ ahụ wdg) na-agbaji mgbe e kpoo ya, na-emepụta ihe na-agbaze na carbon. Ọ na-amalite n'ihe dị ka $T \approx 150\text{~}250\,^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$, ma elu akụkụ na-ekpo ọkụ dị ọkụ karịa nke a.
c-276.example: Elu akụkụ na-ekpo ọkụ nke igwe okpomọkụ eletrik na-eru 300-800°C, ya mere unyi na-ere ngwa ngwa. Igwe okpomọkụ 1-2kW nwere ike inye isi mgbe nkeji 30, ma mgbe a hichara ya isi ahụ na-apụ fọrọ nke nta ka ọ bụrụ nke zuru ezu.
c-276.actionItem: Taa, tupu ị gbanye igwe okpomọkụ, wepụ ya na ọkụ, were igwe nchacha wepụ unyi n'ọnụ ọbanye na n'ala, meghee windo ma nwalee ya nkeji 10. Ọ bụrụ na isi ọkụ nọgide ma ọ bụ anwụrụ ọkụ apụta, gbanyụọ ya ozugbo ma nyochaa ya.

c-277.title: Ịtinye kabeeji Napa n'nnu na-eme ka ọ dị nro ma na-eme ka ihe ntinye kimchi banye
c-277.summary: Ịtinye kabeeji n'nnu na-ewepụ mmiri site n'osmosis ma na-eme ka ọ dị nro, ihe ntinye na-abanye nke ọma ma nke ọ na-adị ọkụ ọkụ na-anọgide. Ọ bụrụ na ọ zughị ezu, kimchi na-adịghị ụtọ ma na-esi nro.
c-277.principle: Akpụkpọ mkpụrụ ndụ bụ semipermeable, ya mere mgbe nnu dị elu n'èzí, mmiri na-aga site n'ime ruo n'èzí. Osmotic pressure bụ $\Pi = iCRT$, ma calcium na-ejikọta pectin iji chekwaa nhazi anụ ahụ.
c-277.example: Ịtinye kabeeji otu isi (ihe dị ka 2.5kg) na ihe dị ka 200g nnu (ihe dị ka 8%) ruo awa 4-6 na-ebelata ibu ya ihe dị ka 20-25%, ya bụ mmiri ihe dị ka 0.5-0.6kg na-apụ. Nnu kwesịrị ekwesị nke kabeeji e tinyere n'nnu bụ ihe dị ka 2%.
c-277.actionItem: Taa, ọ bụrụ na ị na-eme kimchi, tụgharịa kabeeji otu ugboro n'etiti mgbe ị na-etinye ya n'nnu, ma saa ya mgbe ogwe ya na-agbagọ ma na-agbaghị, wee wụsa mmiri ya.

c-278.title: Persimmon na-akpọ ire na-adịghị ire mgbe tannin gbazere siri ike
c-278.summary: Ire ọkụ ọkụ nke persimmon sitere na tannin na-agbaze n'mmiri, ma mgbe ọ ghọrọ nke na-agbazeghị, ọ naghị akpọ ire ọzọ. Ịkpọnwụ gotgam ma ọ bụ ọgwụgwọ astringency bụ usoro a.
c-278.principle: Tannin na-agbaze na-ejikọta na protein nke ire ma na-akpata ọkụ ọkụ ire. Mgbe persimmon na-eto, na-akpọnwụ ma ọ bụ a kpuchiri ya ikuku, acetaldehyde ($\mathrm{CH_3CHO}$) nke e mepụtara na-eme ka tannin kpọkọta ghọọ nke na-agbazeghị, ma ọ naghịzi agbaze n'ọnụ mmiri.
c-278.example: Persimmon na-akpọ ire nwere ihe dị ka 1% tannin na-agbaze, nke na-eme ka ọnụ kọọ nkụ, mana n'ọnọdụ mechiri emechi na ihe dị ka 20-25°C ruo ụbọchị 3-5, ọtụtụ na-aghọ nke na-agbazeghị ma ire na-apụ fọrọ nke nta ka ọ bụrụ nke zuru ezu.
c-278.actionItem: Taa, ọ bụrụ na ị nwere persimmon na-akpọ ire, tinye ya n'ime akpa mechiri emechi ya na apụl ma ọ bụ banana ruo ụbọchị 2-3, ma ọ bụ bipụ akpụkpọ ya ma kpọnwụọ ya n'anyanwụ. Nwalee otu iberibe tupu iri ya ka ị lelee ire.

c-279.title: Mmiri grapefruit nwere ike ịgbanwe mmetụta ụfọdụ ọgwụ
c-279.summary: Grapefruit nwere ike igbochi mgbaji nke ụfọdụ ọgwụ ma mee ka ọnụọgụ ọgwụ n'ọbara dị elu. Ọ bụrụ na ị na-aṅụ ọgwụ, jụọ onye na-ere ọgwụ maka mmekọrịta ya na grapefruit.
c-279.principle: Furanocoumarin nke grapefruit na-egbochi enzyme na-agbaji ọgwụ CYP3A4 n'afọ. Mgbe mgbaji na-ebelata, ọgwụ e nwetara na-abawanye, $AUC=\int_0^\infty C(t)\,dt$ na-abawanye ma ihe ize ndụ mmetụta ọjọọ na-arị elu.
c-279.example: Maka ụfọdụ statin (ọgwụ cholesterol), iṅụ otu iko mmiri grapefruit (ihe dị ka 250mL) nwere ike ime ka ọnụọgụ n'ọbara (AUC) bawanye ọtụtụ ugboro, ma mmetụta ahụ nwere ike ịdị ihe karịrị otu ụbọchị. Mmetụta ọgwụ dị iche nke ukwuu.
c-279.actionItem: Taa, lelee akwụkwọ ntụziaka ọgwụ ị na-aṅụ ma ọ bụ jụọ onye na-ere ọgwụ ma ọ nwere ịdọ aka ná ntị grapefruit, ma ọ bụrụ na ọ dị, zere mmiri grapefruit na mkpụrụ osisi ndụ. Ewepụla ọgwụ n'onwe gị.

c-280.title: Ihe mere a ga-eji kewaa mmiri n'ime ụgbọelu ruo 100mL ma ọ bụ obere
c-280.summary: N'ụgbọelu mba ụwa, a na-ekwe ka e bubata mmiri na gel n'ime akpa zip doro anya, nke ọ bụla 100mL ma ọ bụ obere. Ụkpụrụ ọnụọgụ ahụ bụ iji mee ka o sie ike ịmepụta ọnụọgụ dị ize ndụ site n'otu akpa.
c-280.principle: A na-ede oke nha akpa n'ihi na mgbawa mmiri na-adị ize ndụ naanị mgbe ọ gafere otu ọnụọgụ. Ọnụọgụ niile a na-ebu bụ $V_{\mathrm{nchikota}}=\sum V_i$ ma $V_i \le 100\,\mathrm{mL}$ nke ọ bụla, ma ọtụtụ mgbe a na-ede ya n'otu akpa zip 1L.
c-280.example: Itinye akpa 100mL iri n'otu akpa zip 1L na-enye oke ọnụọgụ ihe dị ka 1L. Akpa 200mL ọbụna ma ọ bụrụ ọkara jupụtara na-adịghị agafe n'ọtụtụ ọnọdụ n'ihi ụkpụrụ ikike akpa.
c-280.actionItem: Taa, ọ bụrụ na ị na-akwado njem, kwaga shampoo, lotion na ọgwụ mmiri n'obere akpa 100mL ma ọ bụ obere, tinye ha n'otu akpa zip doro anya ma tinye ya n'elu akpa gị. Lelee ụkpụrụ ụgbọelu na mba nke ọ bụla otu ugboro ọzọ tupu ị pụọ.

c-281.title: Họrọ jeotgal site na oge ịgwụ na ụtọ amino acid, ọ bụghị naanị nnu
c-281.summary: Ụtọ umami nke jeotgal sitere na amino acid nke protein mebiri n'oge ịgwụ. Họrọ nke na-abụghị naanị nnu siri ike ma nwere ozi doro anya banyere nrụpụta na ịgwụ.
c-281.principle: Enzyme na-agbaji protein n'ime azụ na-eme hydrolysis nke protein ghọọ peptide na amino acid: $\text{protein} + n\,\mathrm{H_2O} \to n\,\text{amino acid}$. N'usoro a, glutamic acid na-enye ụtọ umami.
c-281.example: Saeujeot nwere nnu ọtụtụ mgbe ihe dị ka 20%, ma ịgwụ ọnwa 3-6 na-eme ka amino nitrogen bawanye ma ụtọ na-adị omimi. Ọbụna na nnu otu, ịgwụ dị mkpụmkpụ na-eme ka isi azụ na nnu pụta ìhè.
c-281.actionItem: Taa, mgbe ị na-azụta jeotgal, lelee ụbọchị nrụpụta, ihe ndị e ji mee ya na nnu a gosipụtara n'ime nkwakọ, ma ọ bụrụ na ị nwere ike nụ ya, họrọ nke na-ahapụ ụtọ na isi nri mgbe nnu gasịrị.

c-282.title: Lelee njikọ gas site n'ụfụfụ mmiri ncha, ọ bụghị isi
c-282.summary: Lelee njikọ ebe a na-enyo enyo na gas na-agba site n'ịhịa mmiri ncha ma lee ma ụfụfụ na-apụta. Ilele site n'ọkụ ma ọ bụ lighter dị ize ndụ nke mgbawa ma ọ bụ nke a na-agaghị eme.
c-282.principle: Gas na-agba na-akwali akpụkpọ surfactant nke mmiri ncha ma na-emepụta ụfụfụ. Nrụgide n'ime ụfụfụ bụ $\Delta P = \frac{4\gamma}{r}$ (maka ụfụfụ ncha), ya mere ọbụna obere ntapu na-aghọ ụfụfụ a na-ahụ anya.
c-282.example: Tinye ngwakọta nke mmiri 100mL na ihe nsa efere ihe dị ka 1mL n'njikọ hoosu nke stovu gas, ma ọ bụrụ na ụfụfụ na-ebili ma ọ bụ na-apụta ugboro ugboro, ọ bụ ntapu. Gas obodo dị ọkụ karịa ikuku ma na-ekpokọta n'elu, ma LPG dị arọ ma na-ekpokọta n'ala.
c-282.actionItem: Taa, mgbe valve gas mechiri, hịa mmiri ncha n'njikọ hoosu ma lee ma ụfụfụ na-apụta. Ọ bụrụ na ụfụfụ na-aga n'ihu na-ebili, mechie valve, hapụ ikuku bata ma kpọọ ọkachamara ka ọ nyochaa ya.

c-283.title: Chestnut e debere n'oyi na-aghọ starch ka ọ bụrụ shuga ma na-atọ ụtọ karịa
c-283.summary: Ịtụnye chestnut ndụ n'ime friji 0-4°C ruo izu ole na ole na-eme ka starch ghọọ shuga ma ọ na-atọ ụtọ karịa. Ịhapụ ya n'okpomọkụ ụlọ na-eme ka ọ rụọ ngwa ngwa, ya mere nchekwa friji bụ ụzọ dị mma.
c-283.principle: N'oyi, amylase na ndị ọzọ na-agbaji starch ghọọ maltose na glucose: $(\mathrm{C_6H_{10}O_5})_n + n\,\mathrm{H_2O}\to n\,\mathrm{C_6H_{12}O_6}$. Osisi na-ejikọta shuga iji gbochie ịmịnye mmiri site na osmosis.
c-283.example: Chestnut e nwetara ọhụrụ nwere shuga ihe dị ka 5-8%, mana ịchekwa ya na 0-2°C ruo izu 4-8 nwere ike ime ka ọdịnaya shuga bawanye ihe dị ka ugboro 1.5-2, ma ụtọ ya na-ebuli elu nke ukwuu. N'okpomọkụ ụlọ, ahụhụ na ero na-apụta n'ime ọkara ọnwa.
c-283.actionItem: Taa, kechie chestnut ndụ n'ime akwụkwọ kichin ya na akpụkpọ ya, tinye ya n'akpa zip n'ime friji (ihe dị ka 1-4°C), wee sie ma ọ bụ kpọọ ya n'ime izu 1-2.

c-284.title: Nchekwa nri n'ime karama dabere na pH 4.6 maka nchekwa
c-284.summary: Mgbe ị na-echekwa nri n'ụlọ, kewaa nri acid pH 4.6 ma ọ bụ obere na nri nwere acid dị ala nke dị elu karịa ya. Maka nri nwere acid dị ala, ịkpo naanị n'mmiri na-esi nwere ike ịhapụ ihe ize ndụ nsi botulinum.
c-284.principle: Spores nke Clostridium botulinum nwere ike ịmepụta nsi mgbe pH dị elu karịa 4.6 na n'ọnọdụ mechiri emechi na-enweghị oxygen. Acidity bụ $\mathrm{pH}=-\log_{10}[\mathrm{H^+}]$ ma pH 4.6 bụ $[\mathrm{H^+}]\approx 2.5\times10^{-5}\,\mathrm{mol/L}$.
c-284.example: Jam na mkpụrụ osisi e chekwara bụ acidic na pH ihe dị ka 3-4, ya mere ịkpo n'mmiri na-esi dị nchebe n'ụzọ ụfọdụ, mana akwụkwọ nri, anụ na agwa nwere acid dị ala na pH 5-7 ma chọrọ ịkpo n'nrụgide dị elu na ihe dị ka 116-121°C. Mmiri na-esi enweghị ike ịgafe 100°C.
c-284.actionItem: Taa, ọ bụrụ na ị na-echekwa nri n'ime karama, lelee acidity nke ihe (ma ọ bụ mkpụrụ osisi ma ọ bụ vinegar pickling), ma maka ihe nwere acid dị ala, chekwaa n'ime friji ma ọ bụ freezer kama karama n'ụlọ. Ọ bụrụ na mkpuchi pụta ìhè, ụfụfụ ma ọ bụ isi ọjọọ nọ, erila ya ma tụfuo ya.

c-285.title: Chocolate nwere ike ịbụ nsi maka nkịta
c-285.summary: Theobromine nke chocolate na-agbaji nwayọọ n'ime nkịta ma nwee ike ịkpata nsi. Ka cocoa dị elu, ka ihe ize ndụ na-abawanye, ya mere ọ bụrụ na nkịta gị rie ya, lelee ọnụọgụ na ụdị ma kpọọ dọkịta anụmanụ.
c-285.principle: Theobromine ($\mathrm{C_7H_8N_4O_2}$) nwere half-life ihe dị ka awa 17 n'ime nkịta, nke ka ogologo karịa nke mmadụ (ihe dị ka awa 6-10), ya mere ọ na-ekpokọta n'ahụ. A na-atụ ihe ize ndụ nsi site n'ọnụọgụ ejiri n'otu ibu ahụ $D=\frac{m_{\mathrm{theobromine}}}{m_{\mathrm{ibu}}}$.
c-285.example: Chocolate gbara ọchịchịrị (cocoa 70%) nwere ihe dị ka 5-8mg/g theobromine, ya mere nkịta 10kg nke riri ihe dị ka 50g (ihe dị ka ọkara otu mpempe chocolate) na-ewere ihe dị ka 250-400mg (ihe dị ka 25-40mg/kg), nke bụ oke mgbaàmà siri ike. Chocolate mmiri ara ehi nwere obere.
c-285.actionItem: Taa, debe chocolate na ngwaahịa cocoa n'ebe dị elu nke nkịta gị na-adịghị eru ma ọ bụ n'ime kọbọd mechiri emechi. Ọ bụrụ na ọ riri ya, ekwela ka ọ chere; dee ụdị, ọnụọgụ na oge, ma kpọọ dọkịta anụmanụ ozugbo.

c-286.title: Ihe mere nri ụgbọelu ji adị ka enweghị ụtọ bụ nrụgide ikuku na mmiri akọrọ
c-286.summary: N'ime ụgbọelu, nrụgide dị ala ma ikuku kọrọ nkụ nke ukwuu, nke na-eme ka isi na ire dị nro, ya mere nri na-adị ka enweghị nnu. Nke a mere e ji etinye nnu ọtụtụ n'ebumnuche n'nri ụgbọelu.
c-286.principle: Nrụgide n'ime ụlọ ụgbọelu bụ ihe dị ka ọkwa 2,000-2,400m n'elu oke osimiri (ihe dị ka 0.75-0.8atm) ma ọnọdụ mmiri bụ 10-20%. N'nrụgide dị ala na akọrọ, mmetụta nke ndị na-anata isi na ire na-ada nke ukwuu, a kọrọ na ụtọ na nnu na-adị nro ihe dị ka 30%. Ọnụọgụ nrụgide bụ $\frac{P_{\mathrm{ụlọ}}}{P_0}\approx0.8$.
c-286.example: Nri nke ị na-ahụ dị ka nkịtị n'ala nwere ike ịdị ụtọ na nnu ihe dị ka 20-30% pere mpe n'ịdị elu njem, ya mere nri ụgbọelu na-eji nnu na ihe ntinye ọtụtụ. Ihe mere mmiri tomato ji adị ụtọ karịsịa n'ụgbọelu a na-akọwa n'otu ụzọ ahụ.
c-286.actionItem: Taa, ọ bụrụ na ị na-aga n'ụgbọelu, ṅụọ mmiri ugboro ugboro ka ọnụ gị ghara ịkọ nkụ, ma ọbụna ma nri adịghị ụtọ, etinyela nnu ọzọ; kama họrọ nri nwere isi siri ike ma ọ bụ ihe ọṅụṅụ na-atọ ụtọ.

c-287.title: Họrọ ntụ wiit maka mmepụta site na protein: ike, etiti ma ọ bụ dị nro
c-287.summary: Ọdịiche dị n'etiti ntụ wiit siri ike, etiti na dị nro bụ ọdịiche protein. Họrọ ntụ siri ike nwere protein ọtụtụ maka achịcha, na ntụ dị nro nwere obere maka kek na kuki ka e nwee ezigbo ọdịdị.
c-287.principle: Gliadin na glutenin nke protein wiit na-ezute mmiri ma na-etolite netwọk gluten: $\text{gliadin}+\text{glutenin}+\mathrm{H_2O}\to\text{gluten}$. Ka protein dị ukwuu, netwọk na-adị siri ike ma na-eme ka ọ dị ike karịa.
c-287.example: Ntụ siri ike nwere protein ihe dị ka 11-13% dabara adaba maka achịcha na bagel, ntụ etiti ihe dị ka 9-10% maka noodle na jeon, ntụ dị nro ihe dị ka 7-9% maka kek na kuki. 100g ntụ dị nro nwere protein ihe dị ka 8g.
c-287.actionItem: Taa, mgbe ị na-azụta ntụ wiit, lelee ọdịnaya protein n'ozi nri dị n'azụ nkwakọ ma họrọ ntụ siri ike, etiti ma ọ bụ dị nro dabara n'ihe ị chọrọ ime.

c-288.title: Ịgwakọta batrị ọhụrụ na nke ochie na-ebuli ihe ize ndụ ịsọpụta mmiri
c-288.summary: Ịgwakọta batrị ọhụrụ na nke ochie, ma ọ bụ ụdị dị iche iche, nwere ike ime ka batrị adịghị ike gwụọ oke ma nwee ike ịsọpụta mmiri. Gbanwee batrị niile n'otu oge, otu ụdị na otu oge, n'ime ngwa.
c-288.principle: N'njikọ usoro, otu ọkụ na-asọ, mana mgbe voltaji nke batrị adịghị ike dara nso 0V buru ụzọ, ndị ọzọ na-akwụ ya ọkụ n'ụzọ ọzọ. N'oge ahụ, mmeghachi omume dị ka $2\,\mathrm{H_2O}+2e^-\to \mathrm{H_2}+2\,\mathrm{OH^-}$ na-emepụta hydrogen, nrụgide n'ime na-arị ma mmiri na-asọpụta.
c-288.example: Ọ bụrụ na batrị ọhụrụ 1.5V atọ nọ n'usoro (4.5V) ma otu ewepụla nke ọma ruo nso 0V, abụọ ndị ọzọ na-ebugharị ihe dị ka 3V ma na-akwụ batrị ahụ ọkụ n'ụzọ ọzọ. Potassium hydroxide na-asọpụta bụ alkali siri ike (pH ihe dị ka 14) nke na-emebi akpụkpọ ahụ na ngwa.
c-288.actionItem: Taa, lelee batrị dị n'ime remote, elekere na ihe egwuregwu, ma mgbe ị na-agbanwe ha, jiri batrị ọhụrụ otu ụdị na otu ụlọ ọrụ maka ngwa niile. Emetụla ntụ ọcha na-asọpụta n'aka efu.

c-289.title: Sie ofe ọkpụkpụ ehi n'otu oge ma kewaa ya
c-289.summary: Mgbe a na-esi ọkpụkpụ ehi ogologo oge, collagen na-agbaze ghọọ gelatin ma ofe na-adị ọkụ ọkụ, na mgbe ọ jụrụ oyi ọ na-agbanye ka jelii. Ịsi ya n'otu oge ma kewaa ya n'ime freezer na-echekwa ego gas na oge.
c-289.principle: Collagen na-agbaze mgbe a kpoo ya ma ghọọ gelatin, ma mgbe ọ jụrụ oyi, ọ na-agbanwe site na sol ruo gel. Hydrolysis nke okpomọkụ bụ $\text{collagen}\xrightarrow{\Delta,\ \mathrm{H_2O}}\text{gelatin}$, ma ọ na-agbanye n'okpuru ihe dị ka 35°C.
c-289.example: Ịsi 1kg ọkpụkpụ ehi na mmiri ihe dị ka 6L ruo awa 6-8 na-enye ofe ihe dị ka 4-5L. Kama ịgbanye stovu gas oge ọ bụla, ịsi otu ugboro ma kewaa ya n'akụkụ 15 nke 300mL na-ebelata iji gas nke ukwuu.
c-289.actionItem: Taa, ọ bụrụ na ị na-esi ofe ọkpụkpụ ehi, hapụ ya ka ọ jụrụ oyi kpamkpam, kewaa ya otu oge ọ bụla n'akpa zip ma ọ bụ akpa, tinye ya n'ime freezer, ma mgbe ị na-eri, mee ka naanị ọnụọgụ ị chọrọ gbazee ma kpoo ya.

c-290.title: Ntụ ọcha n'elu ala ite osisi nwere ike ịbụ nnu, ọ bụghị ero
c-290.summary: Ntụ ọcha n'elu ala ite osisi ma ọ bụ n'ọnụ ya nwere ike ịbụ nnu sitere na nri osisi na mmiri ọkpọ, ọ bụghị ero. Ịwụsa mmiri ọtụtụ iji saa ya na-ebelata ya.
c-290.principle: Mgbe mmiri na-apụ n'elu, nnu gbazere na-anọgide ma na-apụta dị ka kristal. Nkwụnye nnu na-abawanye mgbe $V_{\mathrm{mmiri}}$ na-ebelata na $C=\frac{m_{\mathrm{nnu}}}{V_{\mathrm{mmiri}}}$, ma mgbe ọ gafere saturation ọ na-aghọ kristal. Dịka ọmụmaatụ, ihe mmiri siri ike dị ka $\mathrm{CaCO_3}$ na-anọgide.
c-290.example: Ọ bụrụ na ike mmiri ọkpọ bụ ihe dị ka 100mg/L (dịka CaCO3), ịkpọnwụ 1L mmiri na-ahapụ ihe dị ka 100mg calcium carbonate. Ọbụna ịwụsa 200mL kwa izu, n'ime ọnwa ole na ole, akwa ọcha a na-ahụ anya na-apụta n'elu ala.
c-290.actionItem: Taa, ọ bụrụ na ị hụ ntụ ọcha, wepụ 1-2cm nke elu ala, kpuchie ya na ala ọhụrụ, wee wụsa mmiri nwayọọ n'ịdị n'ibu nke ite ka ọ si n'oghere mmiri pụọ nke ọma.

c-291.title: Chewing gum xylitol dị ize ndụ maka nkịta
c-291.summary: Xylitol dị nchebe maka mmadụ mana dị ize ndụ nke ukwuu maka nkịta, ọbụna n'obere ọnụọgụ ọ nwere ike ịkpata shuga ọbara dị ala na mmebi imeju. Debe chewing gum na-enweghị shuga, kandi na ụfọdụ peanut butter n'ebe nkịta anaghị eru.
c-291.principle: Pancreas nke nkịta na-eche xylitol dị ka glucose ma na-ewepụ insulin ngwa ngwa. Mgbe ahụ shuga ọbara na-ada nke ukwuu, ma a na-atụ ọnụọgụ xylitol ($\mathrm{C_5H_{12}O_5}$) dị ize ndụ site na $D=\frac{m}{m_{\mathrm{ibu}}}$.
c-291.example: Nkịta 10kg nwere ike inwe shuga ọbara dị ala site na naanị xylitol ihe dị ka 0.1g/kg (ihe dị ka 1g), ma na 0.5g/kg (ihe dị ka 5g) ma ọ bụ karịa, ihe ize ndụ mmebi imeju dị elu. Otu mpempe chewing gum na-enweghị shuga na-enwekarị xylitol ihe dị ka 0.2-1g, ya mere ole na ole nwere ike ịbụ ọnụọgụ dị ize ndụ.
c-291.actionItem: Taa, wepụ chewing gum na kandi na-enweghị shuga n'akpa gị, akpa uwe na drawers gaa n'ebe nkịta anaghị eru. Ọ bụrụ na ọ riri ya, were ndepụta ihe ndị dị n'ime ma kpọọ dọkịta anụmanụ ozugbo.

c-292.title: Ihe mere mmiri ọkụ alkaline na-adị nro
c-292.summary: Mgbe ị banye n'mmiri ọkụ alkaline, ọ na-adị nro n'ihi na ọ bụ lipid dị n'elu akpụkpọ ahụ na-aghọ ncha. Ọ bụrụ na akpụkpọ ahụ gị dị nro, ejila ya nọ ogologo oge ma tinye moisturizer mgbe ị pụtara.
c-292.principle: Alkali (pH 8.5 ma ọ bụ karịa) na-eme saponification nke mmanụ akpụkpọ ahụ (triglyceride) ma na-agbanwe ya ghọọ ncha na glycerol: $\text{abụba} + 3\,\mathrm{OH^-}\to 3\,\text{nnu fatty acid (ncha)}+\text{glycerol}$. Ncha a na-emulsify n'elu ma na-eme ka o dị nro.
c-292.example: Ịbanye n'mmiri ọkụ alkaline pH ihe dị ka 9-10 na ihe dị ka 40°C ruo nkeji 20 na-agbaze akpụkpọ nwụrụ anwụ na sebum, na-eme ka ọ dị nro. Ma pH 10 nwere $[\mathrm{OH^-}]$ dị elu okpukpu 1,000 karịa neutral (pH 7).
c-292.actionItem: Taa, ọ bụrụ na ị na-aga mmiri ọkụ ma ọ bụ ịsa ahụ, nọrọ n'mmiri ọkụ alkaline naanị ihe dị ka nkeji 10-20 n'otu oge, kpọọ ahụ gị nkụ mgbe ị pụtara ma tinye moisturizer ozugbo.

c-293.title: Mmanụ oliv 'extra virgin' bụ akara ọkwa nke acidity 0.8% ma ọ bụ obere
c-293.summary: Extra virgin bụ ọkwa mmanụ e nwetara site n'ịpị oliv nke free fatty acid acidity ya bụ 0.8% ma ọ bụ obere ma gafere nyocha ọnụ. Acidity dị ala adịghị pụtara mgbe niile na ụtọ ka mma, ya mere lelekwa ụbọchị owuwe ihe ubi na ụbọchị ịtinye n'karama.
c-293.principle: Acidity bụ ọnụọgụ free fatty acid n'ime mmanụ (dịka oleic acid) $\text{acidity (\%)}=\frac{m_{\mathrm{free\ fatty\ acid}}}{m_{\mathrm{mmanụ}}}\times100$. Ka oliv dị ọhụrụ, ka triglyceride na-agbaji obere ma acidity dị ala, ma polyphenol na-eme ka oxidation dịkwuo nwayọọ.
c-293.example: Acidity 0.8% ma ọ bụ obere bụ extra virgin, 2% ma ọ bụ obere bụ virgin. Maka karama 1L, free fatty acid bụ ihe dị ka 8g ma ọ bụ obere maka extra virgin. Ọ na-adịghị ike n'ọkụ na okpomọkụ, ya mere karama gbara ọchịchịrị dị mma.
c-293.actionItem: Taa, mgbe ị na-azụta mmanụ oliv, lelee akara 'extra virgin' na afọ owuwe ihe ubi na ụbọchị ịtinye n'karama, họrọ karama gbara ọchịchịrị kama nke doro anya, ma chekwaa ya n'ebe dị jụụ.

c-294.title: Kpuchie ọnụ batrị 9V na teepu mgbe ị na-echekwa ya
c-294.summary: Batrị 9V nwere ọnụ abụọ nso n'otu akụkụ, ya mere mgbe ha metụrụ ọla, ha nwere ike ịkwali ma kpoo ọkụ. Mgbe ị na-etinye ya n'ime drawer, kpuchie ọnụ ya na teepu ma ọ bụ kwakọọ ha n'otu n'otu.
c-294.principle: Mgbe ọnụ batrị metụrụ ọla dị ka igodo ma ọ bụ mkpụrụ ego wee kwali, nguzogide dị nta nke ukwuu ma ọkụ buru ibu $I=\frac{V}{R}$ na-asọ, na-emepụta okpomọkụ Joule $P=I^2R$. Dịka ọmụmaatụ, ọ bụrụ na $R=0.5\,\Omega$ mgbe ahụ $I=18\,\mathrm{A}$.
c-294.example: Ọ bụrụ na batrị 9V nwere nguzogide n'ime ihe dị ka 1.5Ω wee kwali, n'echiche ọ nwere ike ịrị ruo $I\approx6\,\mathrm{A}$ na okpomọkụ ihe dị ka 54W, na-ekpo ọkụ n'ime nkeji ole na ole. Batrị alkaline na-adị ala karịa nke a, mana ihe ize ndụ ọkụ na ọkụ ọkụ ka nọ.
c-294.actionItem: Taa, kpuchie ọnụ batrị 9V ọzọ dị n'ime drawer gị na teepu doro anya ma ọ bụ tinye ha n'nkwakọ mbụ ma ọ bụ n'igbe plastik. Ejikọtala ha na mkpụrụ ego ma ọ bụ igodo.

c-295.title: Tofu na-adịte aka mgbe etinyere ya n'mmiri ma gbanwee mmiri kwa ụbọchị
c-295.summary: Tofu meghere ga-anọgide dị ọhụrụ ụbọchị 2-3 ọzọ ma ọ bụrụ na etinyere ya n'mmiri dị ọcha n'ime friji ma gbanwee mmiri kwa ụbọchị. Tụfuo ya ma ọ bụrụ na ọ na-esi isi nke ukwuu ma ọ bụ na-arapara.
c-295.principle: Tofu bụ gel nke protein soya na coagulant mere, ma ọ nwere ihe dị ka 85% mmiri, ya mere nje na-eto ngwa ngwa. Mgbe e tinyere ya n'mmiri, mgbanwe mmiri na-arụ ọrụ nke elu $a_w=\frac{p}{p_0}$ na mmetụta oxygen na-ebelata, ma ịgbanwe mmiri oge ọ bụla na-asa nje na ihe ha mepụtara.
c-295.example: Tofu meghere n'ime friji 4°C nke etinyere n'mmiri ma gbanwee kwa ụbọchị na-adịte ụbọchị 3-5, ebe ọ bụrụ na ahapụ ya, elu ya na-arapara n'ime ụbọchị 1-2. Ịghara ịtụfu otu tofu (300g, ihe dị ka 2,000 won) bụ nnukwu nchekwa ego.
c-295.actionItem: Taa, tinye tofu fọdụrụ n'ime akpa mechiri emechi, wụsa mmiri dị ọcha (mmiri karama ma ọ bụ nke a sịrị ma jụọ oyi) ka ọ kpuchie ya, debe ya n'ime friji, ma malite echi, gbanwee mmiri otu ugboro kwa ụbọchị.

c-296.title: Saa jaket down site n'ihe nsa efere neutral ma kpọnwụọ ya kpamkpam
c-296.summary: Ọ bụrụ na ị na-eji ncha alkaline siri ike maka jaket down (nku okpoko ma ọ bụ nku gụọse), mmanụ okike nke nku na-apụ ma ike ya ịlọghachi dị adịghị ike. Saa ya na ncha neutral ma kpọnwụọ ya kpamkpam ruo n'ime iji gbochie isi na ero.
c-296.principle: Abụba nke nku (lipid) na-eme saponification n'ọnọdụ alkaline ma na-asachapụ: $\text{abụba}+3\,\mathrm{OH^-}\to\text{ncha}+\text{glycerol}$. Mgbe abụba pụọ, nku na-ejikọta ma ọkpụrụkpụ nke akwa ikuku na-eme ka okpomọkụ ghara ịpụ na-ebelata.
c-296.example: Ngwọta ncha ntụ nkịtị nwere pH ihe dị ka 10-11 (alkaline), ebe ncha neutral nwere pH ihe dị ka 7-8. Ọbụna ma ọ bụrụ na naanị 100g mmiri fọdụrụ n'ime jaket 500g nwere 800 fill power, isi mmiri na ero nwere ike ịpụta mgbe ịkọrọ nkụ.
c-296.actionItem: Taa, ọ bụrụ na ị na-asa jaket, jiri ncha neutral (nke akpọrọ wool ma ọ bụ down), saa ya nke ọma, wee kpọnwụọ ya kpamkpam n'ime igwe nkụ okpomọkụ dị ala ya na bọọlụ tennis 2-3, ma ọ bụ kpọnwụọ ya n'ndò ruo ụbọchị ole na ole ka ọ kpọọ nkụ ruo n'ime.

c-297.title: Were ọgwụ calcium na iron n'oge dị iche
c-297.summary: Ịṅụ calcium supplement na iron supplement ọnụ nwere ike igbochi nnabata ibe ha. Ọ bụrụ na ị na-aṅụ abụọ, hapụ oghere opekata mpe awa 2 ma ọ bụ karịa n'etiti ha.
c-297.principle: Divalent cation dị ka $\mathrm{Ca^{2+}}$ na $\mathrm{Fe^{2+}}$ na-asọ mpi maka otu ndị na-ebufe nnabata (DMT1 wdg) n'eriri afọ pere mpe. Mgbe nkwụnye otu dị elu, ọnụọgụ nnabata nke ọzọ na-ada, ma n'ihe karịrị calcium 500mg, nnabata iron nwere ike ibelata nke ọma.
c-297.example: A kọrọ na iṅụ calcium 600mg na iron 18mg ọnụ na-ebelata nnabata iron ruo ihe dị ka 40-50%. Ọ na-abụkarị iron n'afọ efu na vitamin C, na calcium na nri.
c-297.actionItem: Taa, ọ bụrụ na ị na-aṅụ ha abụọ, kewaa oge: iron n'ụtụtụ n'afọ efu ma ọ bụ n'ụtụtụ, calcium na nri abalị. Ọ bụrụ na ị nwere ọgwụ ndenye, buru ụzọ lelee na onye na-ere ọgwụ.

c-298.title: Ụkpụrụ dị maka ibuga lighter n'ụgbọelu
c-298.summary: Ụkpụrụ lighter dị iche site na mba na ụgbọelu, ma n'ozuzu ọtụtụ mgbe a na-ekwe otu naanị onye ọ bụla ibu n'ahụ ma ọ bụghị n'akpa a na-enyefe. A machibidoro ọtụtụ lighter ụdị torch (turbo). Lelee tupu ị pụọ.
c-298.principle: Butane ($\mathrm{C_4H_{10}}$), mmanụ lighter, dị n'ime dị ka mmiri a na-ahụ n'nrụgide, na-ere ọkụ nke ukwuu, ma ire ya bụ $2\,\mathrm{C_4H_{10}}+13\,\mathrm{O_2}\to8\,\mathrm{CO_2}+10\,\mathrm{H_2O}$. Mgbe nrụgide ụgbọelu na-ada, ọdịiche nrụgide n'ime na n'èzí akpa $\Delta P$ na-abawanye.
c-298.example: Butane nwere nrụgide ikuku ihe dị ka 2atm na 20°C. N'ụgbọelu (ihe dị ka 0.8atm), ọdịiche na n'èzí dị elu karịa n'ala, ya mere n'ụfọdụ lighter mmanụ nwere ike ịsọpụta ma ọ bụ ire ọkụ nwere ike ịbawanye. Lighter ejiri otu ugboro nkịtị na-ejide butane ole na ole g.
c-298.actionItem: Taa, ọ bụrụ na ị na-eme njem, lelee ụkpụrụ lighter nke ụgbọelu ahụ na mba ị na-aga, ma ọ bụrụ na ịchọghị ya, hapụ lighter n'ụlọ. Ọ bụrụ na ị ga-ebu ya, were naanị otu n'akpa uwe ka ị nwee ike ihapụta ya n'nyocha nchekwa.

c-299.title: Soy sauce a gbara ọkụ na nke acid-hydrolyzed nwere mmeghachi omume ọmụmụ dị iche
c-299.summary: A na-eme soy sauce a gbara ọkụ site n'ịgbapụta soya na wiit na microbes, ebe a na-eme acid-hydrolyzed soy sauce site n'ịgbaji protein soya ngwa ngwa na hydrochloric acid. Lelee akara 'a gbara ọkụ' na ihe ndị e ji mee ya iji ghọta ha.
c-299.principle: Abụọ na-eme hydrolysis nke protein ghọọ amino acid, mana ndị na-agba ha ọkụ dị iche. Fermentation bụ enzyme $\text{protein}\xrightarrow{\text{enzyme},\ \text{ọnwa ole na ole}}\text{amino acid}$, ebe acid hydrolysis bụ $\text{protein}\xrightarrow{\mathrm{HCl},\ \Delta}\text{amino acid}$ nke na-ejedebe n'awa ole na ole ruo ụbọchị.
c-299.example: Soy sauce a gbara ọkụ na-ewekarị ọnwa 6 ruo afọ ole na ole ịgwụ, ebe acid-hydrolyzed nwere ike ịrụpụta n'ụbọchị ole na ole, nke dị ọnụ ala mana isi ya dị otu ụdị. Soy sauce gwakọtara a na-ere bụ ngwakọta abụọ, ma a na-egosipụta ọnụọgụ n'akara.
c-299.actionItem: Taa, mgbe ị na-azụta soy sauce, lelee n'ihe ndị e ji mee ya ma ọ bụ '100% gbara ọkụ' ma ọ bụ 'gwakọtara acid-hydrolyzed', ma họrọ ya dabara n'ojiji: gbara ọkụ maka ofe na braise, gwakọtara maka fried na stew.

c-300.title: Mgbe oyi dị oke, wax paraffin nke diesel na-eme ka ọ sie ike ma ụgbọ ala anaghị amalite
c-300.summary: Wax paraffin n'ime diesel na-agbanwe ghọọ kristal mgbe okpomọkụ dara n'okpuru efu, na-egbochi ihe nzacha mmanụ ma ụgbọ ala anaghị amalite. Mgbe a na-atụ anya oyi, tinye diesel oge oyi ma jupụta mmanụ.
c-300.principle: n-paraffin nke diesel (dịka $\mathrm{C_{20}H_{42}}$) na-apụta dị ka kristal mgbe okpomọkụ dara n'okpuru cloud point $T_{\mathrm{cp}}$. Mgbe $T<T_{\mathrm{cp}}$, kristal wax na-abawanye, ma n'ọkwa dị ala karịa (cold filter plugging point), ihe nzacha na-egbochi.
c-300.example: Diesel oge okpomọkụ nwere cloud point ihe dị ka 0°C, ebe nke oge oyi na-edozi ya ala ruo ihe dị ka -15 ruo -20°C. N'ụtụtụ oyi -10°C, ihe ize ndụ ụgbọ ala amalitebeghị na-abawanye ma ọ bụrụ na diesel oge okpomọkụ fọdụrụ.
c-300.actionItem: Taa, ọ bụrụ na a na-atụ anya oyi, lelee ma ụgbọ ala gị nwere diesel oge oyi n'ebe a na-ere mmanụ ma jupụta ọkara tank ma ọ bụ karịa. Ọ bụrụ na ọ naghị amalite, ejila ya na-agbagharị ugboro ugboro; kpọọ ebe a na-edozi ụgbọ ala ma ọ bụ ọrụ inshọransị.

c-301.title: Osikapa ole na ole n'ime ite nnu na-egbochi ya ịrapara
c-301.summary: Mgbe nnu na-ejikọta n'ihi mmiri, itinye osikapa ole na ole na-eme ka osikapa buru ụzọ nata mmiri, ya mere nnu na-ejikọta obere. Ọ bụghị ihe zuru oke, ya mere nchekwa mechiri emechi bụ ihe mbụ.
c-301.principle: Sodium chloride na-anata mmiri n'ikuku ma na-agbaze mgbe ọnọdụ mmiri ruru ihe dị ka 75% ma ọ bụ karịa (deliquescence). Ọnọdụ mmiri dị mkpa a bụ $\mathrm{RH}_{\mathrm{c}}\approx75\%$, ma n'elu ya, mkpụrụ na-arapara ibe ha ma na-aghọ ihe.
c-301.example: Mgbe ọnọdụ mmiri n'oge mmiri ozuzo bụ 80% ma ọ bụ karịa, ite nnu meghere nwere ike ịrapara n'ime ụbọchị 1-2. Itinye osikapa ihe dị ka 10-20 na-anata ụfọdụ nke mmiri g ole na ole n'otu 100g nnu, na-egbu oge ịkpokọta.
c-301.actionItem: Taa, tinye osikapa 10-20 n'ite nnu, kechie mkpuchi nke ọma, ma debe ya n'ebe dị jụụ, kọrọ nkụ, ọ bụghị n'akụkụ stovu gas ma ọ bụ ebe mmiri dị.

c-302.title: Ejila ihe nsa efere enzyme maka uwe wool na silk
c-302.summary: Wool na silk bụ eriri protein, ya mere ihe nsa efere enzyme nwere protease na-agbaze eriri ma na-emebi ya. Jiri ncha neutral akpọrọ maka wool na silk.
c-302.principle: Protease nke ihe nsa efere enzyme na-eme hydrolysis nke njikọ peptide nke protein: $\mathrm{R{-}CO{-}NH{-}R'}+\mathrm{H_2O}\to\mathrm{R{-}COOH}+\mathrm{H_2N{-}R'}$. Keratin nke wool na fibroin nke silk bụ otu protein, ya mere ha na-adịghị ike site n'otu mmeghachi omume.
c-302.example: Enzyme protease na-arụ ọrụ kacha na 30-50°C, ya mere ọ na-arụ ọrụ n'okpomọkụ ịsa uwe nkịtị. Ịtinye sweta wool n'ihe nsa efere enzyme na 30°C naanị otu awa nwere ike ime ka eriri dị warara, nchapụta belata ma ọ bụ oghere pụta.
c-302.actionItem: Taa, lelee akara ịsa uwe wool ma ọ bụ silk, ma ọ bụrụ na ihe ndị e ji mee ncha nwere akara 'enzyme (protease)', ejila ya; kama jiri ncha neutral akpọrọ maka wool na silk saa ya n'aka na mmiri oyi nwayọọ.

c-303.title: Soro akara okpomọkụ nchekwa nke ngwaahịa lactic acid bacteria
c-303.summary: Ngwaahịa lactic acid bacteria bụ nje ndụ, ya mere ha adịghị ike n'okpomọkụ na mmiri, ma ị ga-eso akara okpomọkụ nchekwa. Ọ bụrụ na akara ha bụ friji, ekwela ya n'ime ụgbọ ala ma ọ bụ n'oge e zigara ya n'oge okpomọkụ.
c-303.principle: Nje ndụ na-anwụ ngwa ngwa mgbe okpomọkụ na-arị, na-ebelata dị ka $N(t)=N_0\,e^{-kt}$, ma ka okpomọkụ dị elu, $k$ na-abawanye. Ụdị na-etolite spore (dịka Bacillus) ma ọ bụ ngwaahịa e kpuchiri ma ọ bụ freeze-dried dị kwụsiri ike n'okpomọkụ ụlọ.
c-303.example: Ngwaahịa akara friji nke e debere na 25-30°C nwere ike ịhụ mbelata nje ndụ n'ime izu ole na ole, ma n'ime ụgbọ ala na 40°C ma ọ bụ karịa ọ na-eme ngwa ngwa karịa. Ọnụọgụ nje e kwere nkwa na-abụkarị nke dị ndụ ruo ụbọchị ngwụcha, ọ bụghị n'oge a rụpụtara ya.
c-303.actionItem: Taa, lelee akara ngwaahịa lactic acid bacteria gị ma ọ bụ 'chekwaa n'friji' ma ọ bụ 'chekwaa n'okpomọkụ ụlọ'; ọ bụrụ na ọ bụ friji, debe ya n'ime friji ma ekwela ya n'ime ụgbọ ala ma ọ bụ n'akụkụ windo n'oge okpomọkụ. Ọ bụrụ na ị nwere nsogbu ahụike, gwa dọkịta.

c-304.title: N'ụlọ ọgwụ mba ofesi, chọọ ọgwụ site n'aha ihe ndị dị n'ime
c-304.summary: Otu ọgwụ nwere aha azụmahịa dị iche n'obodo ọ bụla, ya mere n'ụlọ ọgwụ mba ofesi ọ kacha dị mma ịgwa ha aha ihe ndị dị n'ime ya (n'asụsụ Bekee). Dịka ọmụmaatụ, a na-akpọkwa acetaminophen paracetamol na mba ofesi.
c-304.principle: Aha ihe ndị dị n'ime ọgwụ (aha izugbe, INN) bụ otu n'ụwa niile, ma aha azụmahịa dị iche site na onye na-emepụta. Otu ihe $\mathrm{C_8H_9NO_2}$ ka a na-akpọ acetaminophen (US, Korea), paracetamol (Europe, Asia wdg).
c-304.example: Ngwaahịa acetaminophen 500mg na-ere dị ka 'Tylenol', 'Panadol', 'Paracetamol' wdg dabere na mba, mana ihe ndị dị n'ime bụ otu. Oke ọnụọgụ kwa ụbọchị maka okenye na-abụkarị 4g (mkpụrụ 500mg 8) ma ọ bụ obere.
c-304.actionItem: Taa, maka njem, dee ma ọ bụ chekwaa n'ekwentị aha ihe ndị dị n'ime ọgwụ ị na-aṅụkarị (n'asụsụ Bekee). N'ụlọ ọgwụ, kọọ mgbaàmà gị, ọgwụ ị na-aṅụ na allergies gị, ma buru akwụkwọ dọkịta maka ọgwụ ndenye.

c-305.title: Ọdịiche dị n'etiti tii oji, akwụkwọ ndụ na oolong bụ ogo oxidation nke akwụkwọ tii
c-305.summary: Tii oji, oolong na tii akwụkwọ ndụ sitere n'otu osisi tii mana ogo oxidation (fermentation) dị iche, nke na-eme ka ụtọ na agba dị iche. Tii akwụkwọ ndụ na-egbochi oxidation, ebe tii oji na-eme ka ọ zuo oke.
c-305.principle: Enzyme polyphenol oxidase (PPO) nke akwụkwọ tii na-eme ka catechin na oxygen na-emeghachi omume ma gbanwee ya ghọọ theaflavin na ndị ọzọ: $\text{catechin}+\mathrm{O_2}\xrightarrow{\mathrm{PPO}}\text{theaflavin}$. Tii akwụkwọ ndụ na-emebu enzyme n'okpomọkụ n'oge mbụ ka ọ ghara oxidation.
c-305.example: Tii akwụkwọ ndụ bụ oxidation ihe dị ka 0%, oolong ihe dị ka 10-80%, tii oji nso 100%. Ọ bụ ihe a na-ahụkarị ịsa tii akwụkwọ ndụ na mmiri ihe dị ka 70-80°C ruo nkeji 1-2, na tii oji na mmiri ihe dị ka 90-95°C ruo nkeji 3-5.
c-305.actionItem: Taa, mgbe ị na-azụta tii, lelee ozi nkwakọ 'enweghị oxidation (akwụkwọ ndụ) · oxidation ọkara (oolong) · oxidation zuru ezu (oji)', ma sie ya n'okpomọkụ mmiri na oge dabara n'ụdị.

c-306.title: N'oge oyi, hapụ mmanụ dị na tankị ka o juru ọkara ma ọ bụ karịa
c-306.summary: N'oge oyi, ọ bụrụ na tankị mmanụ ahụ tọgbọ chakoo, uzuoku mmiri dị n'ikuku na-agbakọta ghọọ mmiri ma gwakọta na mmanụ, ma n'okpomọkụ dị n'okpuru efu ọ nwere ike ịmịkọrọ kpọchie ọkpọ mmanụ. Ịhapụ mmanụ ka o juru ọkara ma ọ bụ karịa na-ebelata nsogbu a.
c-306.principle: Uzuoku mmiri dị n'oghere efu na-agbakọta n'ahụ tankị oyi. Mmiri na-agbakọta mgbe okpomọkụ gbadara n'okpuru ebe igirigi $T_d$, ma ikuku dị n'ime tankị ka nwere ka uzuoku mmiri na-agbakọta ka na-abawanye. Mmiri na-amịkọrọ n'okpomọkụ $0^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$ ma ọ bụ n'okpuru ya, ya na-egbochi nkwụsị mmanụ.
c-306.example: Mgbe tankị 50L tọgbọ chakoo, ikuku mmiri dị ka 50L dị n'ime ya, ma n'ihe dị ka 80% mmiri ikuku na 10°C, n'echiche, gram mmiri ole na ole nwere ike ịgbakọta. Ọ bụrụ na i juo ya, ikuku ahụ na-ebelata, mmiri na-adịkwa nta, ya mere ọ na-adịkarịghị ka ọkpọ mmanụ mịkọrọ n'ụtụtụ oyi -10°C ma ụgbọala ghara ịgba.
c-306.actionItem: Taa, lelee ihe fọdụrụ na tankị ụgbọala gị ma ọ bụ nke mmanụ ọkụ ụlọ, ma ọ bụrụ na ọ dị ọkara ma ọ bụ n'okpuru, tinye mmanụ. Ọ ka mma idebe ya ka o juru ọkara ma ọ bụ karịa kama ịtinye ya ugboro ugboro ka o juru kpam kpam n'oge oyi.

c-307.title: Ọ bụrụ na kọfị gị ilu ilu, ejila ọka kọfị ọzọ, belata oge ịmịpụta ya
c-307.summary: Ọ bụrụ na kọfị gị ilu ilu, kama itinye ọka kọfị ọzọ, belata oge ịmịpụta ma ọ bụ mee ka mkpọ ya buru ibu karịa. Ịmịpụta karịa oke bụ ihe kpatara ilu ilu, ya mere ị nwere ike ịhazi isi ụtọ na-enweghị mfu ọka kọfị.
c-307.principle: Ịmịpụta bụ $\text{mkpụrụ(\%)}=\frac{m_{\mathrm{ihe\ gbazere}}}{m_{\mathrm{ọka\ kọfị}}}\times100$, ma 18~22% bụ nke kwesịrị ekwesị. Ọ bụrụ na ọ karịa nke a, ihe ilu ilu (dị ka chlorogenic acid lactone na phenylindane) na-agbaze nke ukwuu.
c-307.example: Site na ọka kọfị 20g, ọ bụrụ na mkpụrụ ya gafere 22%, ihe karịrị 4.4g na-agbaze, kọfị ahụ na-eluwa ilu ma na-ekpo ọnụ n'ọnụ. Site na ọka kọfị 20g ahụ, ọ bụrụ na mkpụrụ ahụ bụ 20%, ihe dị ka 4g na-agbaze, kọfị ahụ na-atọ ụtọ ma kwụ ọtọ. Ọ bụrụ na 20g ọka kọfị dị ihe dị ka 1,000 won, ị na-ebelata mfu.
c-307.actionItem: Taa, ọ bụrụ na kọfị gị ilu ilu, ekwela ka ọka kọfị ọzọ gbanye, kama mee ka mkpọ ya buru ibu otu ogo ma ọ bụ belata oge ịmịpụta site na 20~30 sekọnd. Debe okpomọkụ mmiri na 90~94°C.

c-308.title: Yist na-anwụ ma ọ bụrụ na etinye ya n'ime mmiri karịrị 55℃
c-308.summary: Yist e ji eme achịcha na-anwụ ma ọ bụrụ na etinye ya n'ime mmiri na-ekpo oke ọkụ, ma ọ bụ ya mere ntụ ahụ anaghị afụli. Debe okpomọkụ mmiri na ihe dị ka 30~38°C, nke ị ga-ahụ ka ọ na-ekpo ntakịrị mgbe ị metụrụ ya aka.
c-308.principle: Yist (Saccharomyces) na-anwụ ngwa ngwa n'okpomọkụ dị ka 55°C ma ọ bụ karịa, bụ ebe protein na-agbanwe. Okpomọkụ kacha mma maka ọrụ ya bụ ihe dị ka 28~35°C, ma mgbe ọ na-eme fementeshọn, $\mathrm{C_6H_{12}O_6}\to2\,\mathrm{C_2H_5OH}+2\,\mathrm{CO_2}$, carbon dioxide na-eme ka ntụ ahụ fụlie.
c-308.example: Mgbe ị tinyere yist 7g n'ime ntụ ọka wiiti 500g, ọ bụrụ na mmiri bụ 35°C, ntụ ahụ na-afụli ihe dị ka okpukpu abụọ n'ime otu awa, mana ọ bụrụ na mmiri bụ 60°C, ọtụtụ yist na-anwụ ma ntụ ahụ fụlịghị fọrọ nke nta. Nke a bụ otu esi echekwa akpa yist (ihe dị ka 500 won).
c-308.actionItem: Ọ bụrụ na ị na-eme achịcha taa, lelee okpomọkụ mmiri site na tamomita ma ọ bụ n'ime aka gị, ka ọ bụrụ nke na-ekpo ntakịrị, 30~38°C, ọ bụghị nke na-ekpo oke ọkụ, ma gwakọta nnu na yist n'ebe dị iche ka ha ghara ịmetụta ibe ha ozugbo.

c-309.title: Ịṅụ ọtụtụ ọgwụ oyi n'otu oge nwere ike ime ka acetaminophen ugboro ugboro
c-309.summary: Ọ bụrụ na ị na-aṅụ ọgwụ oyi ngwakọta, ọgwụ ọkụ ahụ na ọgwụ mgbu, ma ọ bụ Tylenol iche iche, acetaminophen nwere ike ịdị ugboro ugboro ma gafee oke kachasị n'ụbọchị. Gbakwunye ọnụọgụgụ acetaminophen (paracetamol) dị na ntanetị ihe mejupụtara ọgwụ ahụ ma lelee ya.
c-309.principle: Ọtụtụ acetaminophen na-agbaze n'imeju, mana ọ bụrụ na ọ karịa oke, ihe na-egbu egbu NAPQI na-abawanye, glutathione na-agwụ ma mkpụrụ ndụ imeju na-emebi. Gbakwunye ngụkọta kwa ụbọchị dị ka $D_{\mathrm{ngụkọta}}=\sum D_i$ ma debe ya n'okpuru 4g maka okenye (a na-atụ aro 3g ma ọ bụ n'okpuru).
c-309.example: Ọ bụrụ na ị tinye Tylenol 500mg anọ (2g) na ngwakọta ọgwụ oyi atọ nke nwere acetaminophen 325mg (ihe dị ka 1g), ọ ga-abụ 3g n'ụbọchị. Ọ bụrụ na ị were Tylenol ọzọ, ị ga-agafe 4g, ya mere ịgbakwunye ha dị mkpa.
c-309.actionItem: Ọ bụrụ na ị na-aṅụ ọgwụ oyi taa, lelee ọnụọgụgụ acetaminophen n'ime ntanetị ihe mejupụtara ọgwụ niile, dee ngụkọta ụbọchị, ma gbalịa ka ị ghara ịgafe oke. Ọ bụrụ na ị amaghị, jụọ onye na-ere ọgwụ.

c-310.title: Maka njem, shampụ siri ike na bar nke na-ehicha isi na-ezere oke mmiri mmiri
c-310.summary: Shampụ siri ike na bar nke na-ehicha isi abụghị mmiri mmiri ma ọ bụ jel, ya mere oke 100mL n'ime ụgbọelu anaghị emetụta ha, ma ngwongwo njem gị na-adị mfe. N'ọtụtụ ụgbọelu na obodo, a naghị ewere ncha siri ike dị ka mmiri mmiri.
c-310.principle: A na-eme ha site n'ime ka ihe na-eme ka mmiri na-agbaze (dịka sodium cocoyl isethionate) sie ike na-enweghị mmiri, ya mere mmiri adịghị n'ime ha fọrọ nke nta. Oke mmiri mmiri bụ iwu maka olu $V\le100\,\mathrm{mL}$, ya mere ihe siri ike adịghị abata ya, mana ikpe ikpeazụ bụ nke onye nyocha nchekwa.
c-310.example: Shampụ mmiri mmiri 250mL enweghị ike ịbanye n'ime ụgbọelu n'ihi olu akpa ya, mana otu shampụ siri ike (ihe dị ka 50g) nwere ike iji ya mee 50~80 ugboro ma ịdị arọ ya bụ ihe dị ka otu ụzọ n'ụzọ ise nke otu karama mmiri mmiri.
c-310.actionItem: Ọ bụrụ na ị na-aga njem taa, debe shampụ siri ike na bar nke na-ehicha isi n'ime igbe nwere oghere maka mmiri ịgafe, ma ghara itinye ha mgbe ha na-agba mmiri; kpoo ha kpam kpam tupu ị kechie ha. Iwu dị iche site n'ụgbọelu na obodo, ya mere lelee tupu ị pụọ.

c-311.title: Lelee ọdịdị abụba na akara trans fat n'ime bọta na margarine
c-311.summary: Bọta na margarine nwere ụdị abụba dị iche, ya mere tụnyere abụba juputara na trans fat na ntanetị nri ma họrọ. Margarine abụghị nke ka mma ma ọ bụ nke ka njọ n'ụzọ niile, ọ na-adị iche site na ngwaahịa.
c-311.principle: Mgbe a gbakwunye hydrogen na abụba na-enweghị mmiri juputara n'mmanụ ahịhịa, ọ na-esi ike, ma ụfọdụ n'ime ya na-aghọ trans isomer: $\mathrm{C{=}C}+\mathrm{H_2}\xrightarrow{\mathrm{Ni}}\mathrm{C{-}C}$. N'usoro nke ịsị ike akụkụ a, trans fat nwere ike ịmalite.
c-311.example: Bọta nwere abụba ihe dị ka 80%, ọtụtụ ya bụ abụba juputara (ihe dị ka 50%) ma nwee obere trans fat sitere n'okike. Margarine ochie nke e ji mmanụ gbanwere akụkụ ya mee nwere trans fat dị elu, mana ọtụtụ ngwaahịa ugbu a nwere n'okpuru 0.5g, ma oke abụba juputara dị ala.
c-311.actionItem: Mgbe ị na-azụta bọta ma ọ bụ margarine taa, tụnyere abụba juputara na trans fat n'otu ọnụọgụgụ nri na ntanetị nri, ma lelee ma 'mmanụ e gbanwere akụkụ ya' dị n'ihe mejupụtara.

c-312.title: Gụọ ọrụ ihe mejupụtara tupu ị kwere mgbasa ozi ihe mgbakwunye mmanụ ọkụ
c-312.summary: Maka ihe mgbakwunye mmanụ ọkụ, lelee ihe mejupụtara na ihe ọ na-eme kama okwu mgbasa ozi. Ihe na-asacha na ntisa na-asa ihe e kpokọtara, mana enweghị nkwa na ọ ga-abawanye ojiji mmanụ nke ukwuu.
c-312.principle: Ihe na-asacha na ntisa bụ molekul surfactant nwere ihe abụọ n'ụdị ya, ha na-ekere ihe e kpokọtara (carbon) gburugburu ma na-esiwanye ya n'ime mmanụ. A na-atụ mgbanwe ojiji mmanụ site na $\eta=\frac{\text{ebe e gafere}}{\text{mmanụ}}$, ma n'injin dị ọcha, mmelite ahụ dị obere nke ukwuu.
c-312.example: Ọtụtụ ngwaahịa na-atụ aro itinye mL ole na ole n'ime 1L, mana mmelite ojiji mmanụ na-adịkarị nta, ihe dị ka 1~2%. Maka ụgbọala nwere 12km/L, 2% bụ 12.24km/L, ma ọnụ ahịa otu karama ihe mgbakwunye 5,000 won nwere ike ọ gaghị abụ nke a ga-akwụghachi site na nchekwa mmanụ.
c-312.actionItem: Ọ bụrụ na ị chọrọ ịzụta ihe mgbakwunye mmanụ ọkụ taa, lelee nkọwa ihe mejupụtara n'ọkpọkọ (ihe na-asacha na ntisa, ihe na-ebuli cetane, wdg.) na mmanụ na ụdị ụgbọala ọ kwesịrị ekwesị, ma lelee ma ọnụọgụgụ mmelite ojiji mmanụ nwere ọnọdụ.

c-313.title: Maka akpụkpọ ụkwụ akpụkpọ anụ, jiri ude mejupụta mmanụ kama ịchakwa ya ka o dị nchara
c-313.summary: Maka akpụkpọ ụkwụ akpụkpọ anụ, ịmejupụta mmanụ site n'ude dị mkpa karịa ime ka ọ na-egbu ọkụ, ka ọ ghara ịmịkọrọ ma gbawaa. Ndụ ya na-abawanye, ya mere ị nwere ike ịchekwa ọnụ ahịa akpụkpọ ụkwụ ọhụrụ.
c-313.principle: Lipid na-ejupụta n'etiti eriri collagen n'akpụkpọ anụ na-eme ka ọ dị nro. Ọ bụrụ na lipid a belata site n'ọkụ ma ọ bụ ịsa, eriri ndị ahụ na-esi n'ibe ha n'ihe, ọ na-agbazi ma gbawaa. Ude na-emejupụta oghere a site na mmanụ na wax.
c-313.example: Ọ bụrụ na otu ụzọ akpụkpọ ụkwụ akpụkpọ anụ dị ihe dị ka 150,000 won, ma ị na-etinye ude otu ugboro n'otu ọnwa, ndụ ya nwere ike ịbawanye site na afọ 2~3 ruo afọ 5 ma ọ bụ karịa. Ọ bụrụ na ị lelee ya kwa afọ, ọnụ ahịa akpụkpọ ụkwụ na-agbada ihe dị ka ọkara. Otu ite ude akpụkpọ ụkwụ (ihe dị ka 5,000 won) ezuru ọtụtụ iri ụzọ akpụkpọ ụkwụ.
c-313.actionItem: Taa, saa uzuzu n'akpụkpọ ụkwụ akpụkpọ anụ gị site n'akwa kpọrọ nkụ, tinye obere ude akpụkpọ ụkwụ n'ihe dị mkpa, ma mgbe nkeji 5 gasịrị, jiri brọshị dị nro ma ọ bụ akwa saa ya.

c-314.title: Ahịhịa akwụkwọ nri na-acha akwụkwọ ndụ na-agbanwe odo odo mgbe etinyere mmanya mmanya
c-314.summary: Mgbe ị na-esi ahịhịa akwụkwọ nri na-acha akwụkwọ ndụ dị ka spinach ma ọ bụ broccoli, ma tinye acid dị ka mmanya mmanya ma ọ bụ mmiri lemọn, agba akwụkwọ ndụ doro anya na-agbanwe n'agba oliv odo odo. Tinye acid ahụ ikpeazụ ma ọ bụ fesa ya n'oge ị na-eri.
c-314.principle: $\mathrm{H^+}$ nke acid na-anọchi $\mathrm{Mg^{2+}}$ dị n'etiti chlorophyll ma ghọọ pheophytin: $\text{chlorophyll}+2\,\mathrm{H^+}\to\text{pheophytin}+\mathrm{Mg^{2+}}$. Pheophytin na-acha odo odo aja aja, ya mere agba na-adị ntụ.
c-314.example: Ọ bụrụ na ị were mmiri nwere otu ngaji mmanya mmanya (15mL) sie spinach 100g, pH na-agbada site na ihe dị ka 7 ruo ihe dị ka 4, agba na-amalite ịgbanwe n'ime nkeji 5. Ma ọ bụrụ na ị tinye obere nnu ma sie ya nwa oge n'ime mmiri na-esi, agba akwụkwọ ndụ na-adịgide ogologo oge.
c-314.actionItem: Ọ bụrụ na ị na-esi ahịhịa akwụkwọ nri na-acha akwụkwọ ndụ taa, mepee mkpuchi ma sie ya naanị nkeji 1~2 n'ime mmiri na-esi, werekwa mmiri oyi saa ya, ma fesa mmanya mmanya ma ọ bụ mmiri lemọn n'oge ị na-eri.

c-315.title: Jiri ngwaahịa retinol n'abalị, ma n'ehihie jiri ihe na-egbochi ìhè anyanwụ
c-315.summary: Retinol adịghị ike n'ihu ìhè ma nwee ike ime ka akpụkpọ ahụ nwee mmetụta karịa n'ihu ìhè UV, ya mere jiri ya n'abalị ma n'ehihie tinye ihe na-egbochi anyanwụ. Ọ bụrụ na ị dị ime ma ọ bụ nwee ọrịa akpụkpọ ahụ, buru ụzọ gwa ọkachamara.
c-315.principle: Ìhè UV na-agbaji retinol: $\text{retinol}\xrightarrow{h\nu}\text{ihe e gbajiri}$. Ọzọkwa, akwa ọnụ akpụkpọ na-ata ata ma akpụkpọ ọhụrụ na-apụta, ya mere ọbara ọbara nwere ike ịdị mfe iweta n'otu ọnụọgụgụ UV.
c-315.example: A na-amalitekarị site na retinol dị ala (0.1~0.3%) ugboro 2~3 n'izu, ma n'ehihie itinye ihe na-egbochi anyanwụ SPF 30 ma ọ bụ karịa na ihe dị ka 2mg/cm². SPF 30 na-egbochi ihe dị ka 97% nke ìhè UVB.
c-315.actionItem: Abalị a, jiri retinol mgbe ị sachara ihu, ma echi n'ụtụtụ tinye ihe na-egbochi anyanwụ SPF 30 ma ọ bụ karịa. Ọ bụrụ na ọ na-ahụ ihe mgbu ma ọ bụ ọbara ọbara nke ukwuu, belata ojiji ma gwa dọkịta.

c-316.title: Ihe mere osikapa retort dị ngwa na-adịgide ogologo oge n'okpomọkụ ụlọ
c-316.summary: Osikapa dị ngwa na-adịgide ogologo oge n'okpomọkụ ụlọ n'ihi na, mgbe emechiri ya, a na-ebibi nje site n'okpomọkụ na nrụgide dị elu ma na-ebelata nje fọrọ nke nta. Tupu imepe ya, enwere ike ichekwa ya n'okpomọkụ ụlọ, ya mere ọ dị mma dị ka nri mberede njem.
c-316.principle: Nsị retort na-eji nrụgide n'okpomọkụ ihe dị ka 120°C egbu ọbụna spore nje na-anagide okpomọkụ. A na-agbakọ oge nsị dị ka $F=D_T\,\log\frac{N_0}{N}$, ma n'ihi na emechiri ya na-enweghị oxygen, nje na-achọ oxygen enweghị ike itolite.
c-316.example: A na-asị otu ngwugwu osikapa dị ngwa (210g) n'ihe dị ka 120°C maka ihe dị ka nkeji 20~30, ma a na-echekwa ya n'okpomọkụ ụlọ ọnwa 6~12. Tupu imepe ya, enwere ike ichekwa ya n'okpomọkụ ụlọ, mana mgbe emepechara ya, rie ya ozugbo ma ọ bụ debe ya n'ime friji.
c-316.actionItem: Mgbe ị na-ekpuchi akpa njem taa, were osikapa dị ngwa dị ka nri mberede, ma ọ bụrụ na mkpuchi ya fụrụ ma ọ bụ ngwugwu ahụ na-asọpụta, ekwula ya, tụfuo ya. Maka igwe microwave, kpoo ya dị ka akara dị n'ime akpa ahụ si dị.

c-317.title: Ihe ụtọ ndị ọzọ dị ka allulose na erythritol nwere isi ụtọ na àgwà dị iche iche
c-317.summary: Ihe ụtọ ndị ọzọ dị ka allulose, erythritol na xylitol nwere isi ụtọ, kalori na mmeghachi nke ọrịa afọ dị iche, ya mere họrọ ya dịka ojiji si dị. Ọ bụrụ na ị rie nke ukwuu, afọ nwere ike ịdị gị ọjọọ, ya mere malite site na obere.
c-317.principle: Ihe ụtọ ndị a nwere ọdịdị molekul dị iche, ya mere ọnụọgụgụ ntinye na kalori dị iche. Dịka ọmụmaatụ, erythritol ($\mathrm{C_4H_{10}O_4}$) na-etinye ọtụtụ ya n'ahụ ma na-apụ site n'mmamịrị, ya mere kalori ya dị nso na efu, ma ọ na-amịkọrọ okpomọkụ mgbe ọ na-agbaze ($\Delta H_{\mathrm{sol}}>0$), ya mere ọ na-eme ka ọ dị jụụ n'ọnụ.
c-317.example: Shuga 1g bụ ihe dị ka 4kcal, ma erythritol bụ ihe dị ka 0~0.2kcal/g, allulose bụ ihe dị ka 0.4kcal/g. Ọ bụrụ na shuga bụ 1, isi ụtọ erythritol bụ ihe dị ka 0.7 ma allulose bụ ihe dị ka 0.7. Mgbe ị na-eji ha dochie shuga, ị ga-ahazi ọnụọgụgụ.
c-317.actionItem: Mgbe ị na-azụta ihe ụtọ ndị ọzọ taa, lelee ụdị (allulose, erythritol, wdg.) na kalori n'otu ọnụọgụgụ nri na ntanetị ihe mejupụtara, ma malite site na ihe dị ka 10g n'ụbọchị ka ị hụ ka ahụ gị si emeghachi.

c-318.title: Mmiri ojii dị n'ọkpọkọ mmiri okpomọkụ bụ unyi ígwè mebiri emebi
c-318.summary: Ọ bụrụ na mmiri e wepụrụ n'ọkpọkọ mmiri okpomọkụ bụ ojii, ọ nwere ike ịbụ unyi (magnetite) sitere na ígwè ọkpọkọ na-agbaze, ma ọ bụrụ na ọ agbakọta, mgbasa okpomọkụ na-adị njọ. Tụlee ka ụlọ ọrụ boiler saa ọkpọkọ ma lelee ihe na-egbochi nchara.
c-318.principle: N'ime mmiri na-ekpo ọkụ nke fọrọ nke nta ka ọ nweghị oxygen, ígwè na-eme oxidation nwayọ nwayọ: $3\,\mathrm{Fe}+4\,\mathrm{H_2O}\to\mathrm{Fe_3O_4}+4\,\mathrm{H_2}$. Magnetite ($\mathrm{Fe_3O_4}$) e mepụtara na-agbakọta dị ka ntụ ojii ma na-eme ka nguzogide mgbasa okpomọkụ ka ukwuu.
c-318.example: Ọ bụrụ na unyi dị 1mm agbakọta n'ime ọkpọkọ na radieta, mgbasa okpomọkụ nwere ike ịda ọnụọgụgụ ole na ole pasent, boiler nwere ike ịgba ogologo oge ma ọnụ ahịa mmanụ ọkụ nwere ike ịbawanye 5~10%. Ọnụ ahịa ịsa ọkpọkọ na-abụkarị ọtụtụ narị puku won, mana a nwere ike ịkwụghachi ya site n'ịchekwa ọnụ ahịa okpomọkụ na ịgbatị ndụ.
c-318.actionItem: Taa, lelee akụkọ ịsa ọkpọkọ okpomọkụ, ma ọ bụrụ na ọ gafeela afọ ole na ole, jụọ ụlọ ọrụ boiler ka ha lelee ya. Ekwula ka ị nwaa wepụ ọkpọkọ n'onwe gị, ma ọ bụ metụ mmiri a na-apụpụta aka.

c-319.title: Freezer burn bụ ebe mmiri efunahụla n'ihu na-akpọtụrụ ikuku
c-319.summary: Akụkụ ọcha na kpọrọ nkụ nke na-apụta n'anụ ma ọ bụ akwụkwọ nri e debere ogologo oge n'ime friza bụ freezer burn; ọ bụ eziokwu na ọ adịghị emerụ ahụ ma ọ bụrụ na erie ya, mana ọ na-esi ike ma isi ụtọ ya na-ebelata. Ịpụpụ ikuku ma kechie ya nke ọma na-egbochi ya.
c-319.principle: N'oge e debere ya n'ime friza, ice dị n'elu na-agbanwe ozugbo ghọọ uzuoku mmiri na-adịghị agafe n'ụdị mmiri mmiri, ya mere mmiri na-efunahụ: $\mathrm{H_2O(s)}\to\mathrm{H_2O(g)}$. Ọ bụrụ na ihu kpọrọ nkụ na-akpọtụrụ ikuku, abụba na-eme oxidation ma isi ụtọ na-emebi.
c-319.example: Anụ e debere n'ime friza -18°C na-enweghị mkpuchi na-efunahụ ọnụọgụgụ pasent ole na ole nke mmiri n'elu n'ime izu ole na ole ma na-acha ọcha kpọọ nkụ. Ọ bụrụ na ị wepụ ikuku site na akpa vacuum ma ọ bụ zipper, ogo ya na-adịgide ihe karịrị ọnwa 3~6, ya mere ị na-ebelata nri ị na-atụfu (otu puku won ole na ole kwa ọnwa).
c-319.actionItem: Taa, tinye anụ na akwụkwọ nri ị chọrọ ịtọ n'ime friza n'ime akpa zipper otu oge nri, wepụ ikuku dị ka o kwere mee, kechie ya ma dee ụbọchị. Akụkụ nke freezer burn ebibiwo, bipụ ya ma jiri ya mee ofe.

c-320.title: Gwakọta ntụ curry na ntụ ihe ọ̀ṅụ̀ṅụ̀ mbụ n'ime mmiri oyi ka ha ghara ịghọ ntụ ntụ
c-320.summary: Ọ bụrụ na ị wụsa ntụ curry ma ọ bụ ntụ ihe ọ̀ṅụ̀ṅụ̀ ozugbo n'ime ofe na-ekpo ọkụ, naanị elu ya na-esi ma ọ na-aghọ mkpụrụ mkpụrụ. Gwakọta ya mbụ n'ime mmiri oyi ma ọ bụ mmiri dị ntakịrị ọkụ, ma ọ bụ gbanyụọ ọkụ ma gwakọta ya nke nta nke nta.
c-320.principle: Mgbe mmiri na-ekpo ọkụ metụrụ mkpụrụ starch, elu ya na-abụ ihe mbụ na-agbanwe ghọọ ihe na-arapara arapara, ma ihe ahụ na-egbochi mmiri ịbanye n'ntụ dị n'ime. Mgbanwe a na-amalite n'ihe dị ka 60~70°C ma na-eme nke mbụ n'elu ebe $T>T_{\mathrm{gel}}$.
c-320.example: Ọ bụrụ na ị wụsa ntụ curry 100g ozugbo n'ime ofe 90°C, elu ya na-agbanwe ma mkpụrụ mkpụrụ dị mm ole na ole n'obosara na-etolite, mana ọ bụrụ na ị gwakọta ya mbụ n'ime mmiri 20~30°C 200mL, mkpụrụ ya na-agbasa nke ọma ma fọrọ nke nta ka mkpụrụ mkpụrụ ghara ịdị.
c-320.actionItem: Ọ bụrụ na ị na-eme curry ma ọ bụ ofe taa, gwakọta ntụ ahụ mbụ n'ime mmiri oyi ma kọpụta ya, ma ọ bụ gbanyụọ ọkụ ma wụsa ya nke nta nke nta ka ị na-akpali, mgbe ahụ sie ya ọzọ n'ọkụ dị nwayọ.

c-321.title: Maka ihe na-ewepụ akpụkpọ ọnụ AHA na BHA, pH na ọnụọgụgụ bụ isi
c-321.summary: Maka acid na-ewepụ akpụkpọ ọnụ, pH na ọnụọgụgụ ngwaahịa na-ekpebi mmetụta na mkpasu iwe karịa aha ihe mejupụtara. Ọbụna ngwaahịa dị nro nwere ike ịkpasu iwe ma ọ bụrụ na pH ya dị ala.
c-321.principle: Acid na-eme ion dị ka $\mathrm{pH} = \mathrm{p}K_a + \log\frac{[\mathrm{A^-}]}{[\mathrm{HA}]}$, ma ihe na-arụ ọrụ n'akpụkpọ ahụ bụ acid efu na-agbazeghị ($\mathrm{HA}$). Ka pH dị ala karịa $\mathrm{p}K_a$, ka oke acid efu na-abawanye.
c-321.example: N'ihe ngwaahịa glycolic acid ($\mathrm{p}K_a$ ihe dị ka 3.83) 10%, acid efu bụ 50% na pH 3.83, ma na pH 3.0 ọ na-abawanye ruo ihe dị ka 87%, ya mere mkpasu iwe na-abawanye. A na-ejikarị salicylic acid ($\mathrm{p}K_a$ ihe dị ka 2.97) n'ihe dị ka pH 3~4.
c-321.actionItem: Ọ bụrụ na ị na-eji ihe na-ewepụ akpụkpọ ọnụ taa, lelee ụdị acid, ọnụọgụgụ na pH nke ngwaahịa ahụ, malite n'ime ugboro abụọ n'izu ma ọ bụ n'okpuru, ma echi tinye ihe na-egbochi anyanwụ.

c-322.title: E machibidoro durian n'ime ụlọ ọrụ nkwari akụ n'ihi isi ya
c-322.summary: E machibidoro durian n'ime ụlọ ọrụ nkwari akụ na n'ụgbọ ọha na eze, ọ bụghị n'ihi na ọ na-egbu egbu, kama n'ihi isi ya nke a na-anụ nke ukwuu ọbụna n'obere ọnụọgụgụ.
c-322.principle: Esters ($\mathrm{RCOOH + R'OH \rightleftharpoons RCOOR' + H_2O}$) na ihe jikọtara sọlfọ (thiol $\mathrm{R{-}SH}$) nwere ọnụ ụzọ isi n'ọkwa ppb, ya mere a na-anụ ọbụna obere ọnụọgụgụ.
c-322.example: 1ppb bụ otu n'ime otu ijeri site na olu, ya mere n'ime ụlọ 30m³ ọ bụ ihe dị ka 0.03mL nke gas. Ya mere, ọ bụrụ na ị hapụ ya na ogbo ya, isi na-anọgide n'ime ụlọ dum na ihe nzacha ikuku.
c-322.actionItem: Tupu njem gị na Southeast Asia, lelee ọkwa mmachibido ya n'ebe obibi gị, ma rie durian n'ụlọ ahịa ndị na-ekechi ya ma ọ bụ n'èzí.

c-323.title: Ihe na-eme ka akpụkpọ ahụ dị ọmịmị: ceramide, glycerin na mmanụ nwere ọrụ dị iche
c-323.summary: Ihe na-eme ka akpụkpọ ahụ dị ọmịmị dị mma nwere ihe na-adọta mmiri, ihe na-emejupụta oghere, na ihe na-egbochi ọmụmụ mmiri na-apụ n'ọnụ ya.
c-323.principle: Humectant (glycerin) na-adọta mmiri, emollient (ceramide wdg.) na-emejupụta oghere dị n'etiti mkpụrụ akpụkpọ, ma occlusive (Vaseline) na-egbochi mmiri ịpụ. A na-akọwa mmegharị mmiri site na $J = -D\frac{\Delta C}{\Delta x}$.
c-323.example: A na-ejikarị glycerin 5~10%, ma a maara na Vaseline na-ebelata mfu mmiri site n'akpụkpọ ahụ ihe karịrị 90%. Ọ bụrụ na ngwaahịa nwere ihe atọ ahụ niile, ọ na-adịgide ogologo oge n'oge oyi kpọrọ nkụ karịa nke nwere otu naanị.
c-323.actionItem: Taa, lelee ma glycerin, ceramide na mmanụ (ma ọ bụ Vaseline) dị na ntanetị ihe mejupụtara nke ihe na-eme ka akpụkpọ ahụ dị ọmịmị, ma tinye ya n'ime nkeji 3 mgbe ị sachara ahụ.

c-324.title: Lelee creosote n'ọkpọkọ ọkụ ụlọ na stovu kwa afọ
c-324.summary: Ọ bụrụ na tar dị n'anwụrụ ọkụ osisi na-agbakọta n'ọgbọ ọkpọkọ ma na-ejuputa, ọ na-eduga n'ọkụ ọkpọkọ, ya mere a ga-enyocha ya kwa afọ.
c-324.principle: Tar na uzuoku ntụ nke ọkụ na-ezughị oke mere na-agbakọta n'ọgbọ ọkpọkọ oyi ghọọ creosote. Mgbe oxygen adịghị zuru oke, dị ka $\mathrm{C_xH_y + O_2 \to C + CO + H_2O}$, ihe na-ere ọkụ na-ezughị oke na-abawanye.
c-324.example: NFPA 211 nke United States na-atụ aro ka a saa ya mgbe ihe e kpokọtara n'ime ọgbọ ọkpọkọ ruru ihe dị ka 3mm (1/8 inch). Ọkụ osisi dị mmiri nke nwere mmiri karịrị 20% na-ebelata okpomọkụ ọkụ ma na-eme ka ihe e kpokọtara dịkwuo ngwa.
c-324.actionItem: Taa, lelee ma mmiri dị n'ọkụ osisi dị n'okpuru 20% ma ọ kpọrọ nkụ nke ọma, ma kpọọ ọkachamara ka ọ nyochaa ma saa ọkpọkọ.

c-325.title: Ọ bụrụ na ị debe bọta n'akụkụ nri na-esi isi ike, isi ahụ na-abanye n'ime ya
c-325.summary: Bọta nwere abụba ihe dị ka 80%, ya mere ọ na-agbaze ma na-amịkọrọ molekul isi dị ka nke kimchi ma ọ bụ azụ nke ọma.
c-325.principle: Abụba abụghị polar, ya mere ọ na-agbaze molekul na-ala n'ikuku na-abụghị polar nke na-ekpuchi isi nke ọma. Ọnụọgụgụ nkesa bụ $K = \frac{C_{\mathrm{fat}}}{C_{\mathrm{water}}}$, ma ọ bụrụ na $\log K = 3$, ọnụọgụgụ dị n'abụba dị elu okpukpu 1,000.
c-325.example: N'ime bọta 200g, abụba bụ ihe dị ka 160g. Ọ bụrụ na ị hapụ ya n'akụkụ kimchi na-enweghị mkpuchi ụbọchị ole na ole, isi nwere ike ịbanye ma ị nwere ike ịtụfu bọta dị oke ọnụ.
c-325.actionItem: Taa, tinye bọta n'ime igbe emechiri emechi n'elu akwụkwọ mkpuchi mbụ ya, ma debe ya n'ebe dị anya site na nri na-esi isi ike.

c-326.title: Ihe mere iko glaasị na-acha ọcha n'ime igwe na-asa efere
c-326.summary: Ihe kpatara ya nwere ike ịbụ ihe e kpokọtara n'ihi mmiri siri ike ma ọ bụ elu glaasị e etchiri. Ị nwere ike ịmata dị iche site n'ibudo ya n'ime mmanya mmanya.
c-326.principle: Ọ bụrụ na ejiri mmiri dị nro na ncha alkaline n'okpomọkụ dị elu, netwọk silicate nke glaasị na-agbaze ma elu ya na-etched. $\mathrm{SiO_2 + 2OH^- \to SiO_3^{2-} + H_2O}$
c-326.example: A naghị ebugharị etching, mana mkpuchi lime sitere na mmiri siri ike na-apụ ma ọ bụrụ na ị dị ya n'ime mmanya mmanya ọcha nkeji 5. Ọ bụrụ na ị belata ọnụọgụgụ ncha ma jiri usoro nchekwa nke ihe dị ka 55℃, etching na-ebelata.
c-326.actionItem: Taa, dị iko na-acha ọcha n'ime mmanya mmanya ọcha nkeji 5 ka ị hụ ma ọ bụ ihe e kpokọtara, ma tinye naanị ọnụọgụgụ ncha a tụrụ aro n'akwụkwọ ntuziaka.

c-327.title: Gbanwee mascara n'ime ọnwa 3~6
c-327.summary: A na-eji mascara n'akụkụ anya, ma ikuku na-abanye mgbe ọ bụla ị na-emepe ya, nje na-amụbakwa ngwa ngwa, ya mere ọ ka mma ịgbanwe ya n'ime ọnwa 3~6 mgbe imepere ya.
c-327.principle: Mgbe emepere ya, ihe nchekwa na-akwụsị nke nta nke nta ma nje na-amụba dị ka $N = N_0\,2^{t/t_d}$. Mgbe ọ bụla ị na-etinye ma wepụ brọshị, ikuku na-abanye ma kpọkọta, ya mere ịkpọnwụ na mmetọ na-eme ọnụ.
c-327.example: N'ọnọdụ kacha mma, ọ bụrụ na nje na-abawanye okpukpu abụọ kwa nkeji 20, mgbe awa 6 gasịrị ọ ga-abụ $2^{18}$, ya bụ ihe dị ka okpukpu 260,000. Ọ bụrụ na anya gị na-akpọ ọkụ ma ọ bụ na-acha ọbara ọbara, buru ụzọ na-enyo mascara ochie enyo.
c-327.actionItem: Taa, dee ụbọchị imepe n'ime akpa mascara gị, ma ọ bụrụ na ọ gafeela ọnwa 3, gbanwee ya na nke ọhụrụ.

c-328.title: Osikapa si mba ofesi nwere amylose dị iche, ya mere isi ụtọ nri dị iche
c-328.summary: Nri osikapa ị na-eri na mba ofesi na-adị ntakịrị ma ọ bụ na-arapara arapara n'ihi na ọnụọgụgụ amylose na amylopectin dị iche n'ime osikapa ahụ.
c-328.principle: Ọ bụrụ na amylose (ọkpụrụkpụ ahịrị) dị ọtụtụ, mkpụrụ osikapa na-ekewa ma siere ike, ma ọ bụrụ na amylopectin (nke nwere alaka) dị ọtụtụ, ọ na-arapara nke ukwuu. $\text{amylose \%} = \frac{m_{\mathrm{amylose}}}{m_{\mathrm{amylose}}+m_{\mathrm{amylopectin}}}\times 100$
c-328.example: Osikapa mkpụrụ mkpụrụ nke Korea na Japan nwere amylose ihe dị ka 17~20%, indica mkpụrụ ogologo nwere ihe dị ka 22~28%, ma osikapa glutinous nwere fọrọ nke nta 0%. Osikapa mkpụrụ ogologo na-achọkarị mmiri okpukpu 1.5~2 nke olu osikapa.
c-328.actionItem: Taa, lelee akara mkpụrụ mkpụrụ, ọkara ma ọ bụ mkpụrụ ogologo n'ọkpọkọ osikapa, ma sie osikapa ahụ site na oke mmiri e dere n'ọkpọkọ.

c-329.title: Maka mmiri ịsa ọnụ, lelee ma ọ nweghị mmanya na ma ọ nwere CPC
c-329.summary: Họrọ mmiri ịsa ọnụ site n'ịlele ihe na-egbu nje (CPC) na ma ọ nwere mmanya. Mmanya nwere ike ime ka ọnụ kpọọ nkụ.
c-329.principle: CPC (cetylpyridinium chloride) bụ surfactant cationic nke na-arapara n'akpụkpọ nje nwere ụgbọ ọgụgụ na-adịghị mma ma na-ebibi ya. A na-akọwa mkpọtụ site na $F = k\frac{q_1 q_2}{r^2}$.
c-329.example: Ngwaahịa CPC na-enwekarị ọnụọgụgụ 0.05~0.07%, ma otu mgbapụ 20mL nwere ihe dị ka 10~14mg. Ụfọdụ ngwaahịa nwere ethanol karịrị 20%, ya mere ndị ọnụ ha na-akpọ nkụ ngwa ngwa ga-ahọrọ nke na-enweghị mmanya.
c-329.actionItem: Taa, lelee CPC na ethanol n'ime ntanetị ihe mejupụtara mmiri ịsa ọnụ, gargle sekọnd 30, ma gbuo ya, ejila ya.

c-330.title: Isi silicone caulk n'akụkụ windo bụ acetic acid na-apụta mgbe ọ na-eme ka ọ sie ike
c-330.summary: Isi dị ka mmanya mmanya sitere na caulk bụ n'ihi na acetic acid na-apụta mgbe silicone na-eme ka ọ sie ike, ma ọ na-ebelata mgbe ịsị ike gwụsịrị.
c-330.principle: Acetoxy silicone na-emeghachi omume na mmiri dị n'ikuku, ya na-ewepụta acetic acid ma na-ejikọta. $\mathrm{R{-}Si(OCOCH_3)_3 + 3H_2O \to R{-}Si(OH)_3 + 3CH_3COOH}$
c-330.example: Elu na-esi ike n'ime nkeji 10~30, ma ọ na-ewe ihe dị ka awa 24 ka ọkpụrụkpụ 3mm sie ike kpam kpam. Acetic acid nwere ike imebi ígwè na marble, ya mere silicone na-anọpụ iche kwesịrị ebe ndị ahụ.
c-330.actionItem: Ọ bụrụ na ị rụrụ ya taa, mepee windo ka ikuku banye awa 24, ma họrọ silicone na-anọpụ iche maka ígwè na nkume.

c-331.title: Ọ bụrụ na mmanụ olive na-agbaze ma na-acha ọcha n'ime friji, ọ rụrụghị arụ
c-331.summary: Mmanụ olive na-acha ọcha ma sie ike n'ime friji adịghị emebi; abụba ahụ na-eme crystal, ma ọ ga-adị ọcha ọzọ ma ọ bụrụ na ị hapụ ya n'okpomọkụ ụlọ.
c-331.principle: Ọbụna abụba na-enweghị mmiri na-eme crystal n'okpuru ebe mgbaze ya. A na-ekpebi okpomọkụ mgbaze site na $T_m = \frac{\Delta H}{\Delta S}$, ma mmanụ olive na-amalite ịcha ọcha n'okpuru ihe dị ka 5~10℃.
c-331.example: N'ime friji 4℃, ọ na-acha ọcha ma sie ike, mana ọ ga-adị ọcha ọzọ mgbe ọkara awa ruo otu awa n'okpomọkụ ụlọ 20~25℃. Maka oxidation, ichekwa mmanụ olive n'ebe gbara ọchịchịrị na dị jụụ n'okpomọkụ ụlọ ka mma karịa ichekwa ya n'ime friji.
c-331.actionItem: Taa, kama iji microwave, hapụ mmanụ olive na-acha ọcha na sie ike n'okpomọkụ ụlọ ọkara awa ka ọ gbazee, ma n'ọdịnihu debe ya n'ime kabọọd gbara ọchịchịrị.

c-332.title: Gbaze shuga na-akpali ya mgbe ị na-eme caramel agaghị adị mma
c-332.summary: Ihe kpatara na a naghị akpali shuga mgbe a na-eme caramel bụ ka a ghara ịmepụta crystal shuga ọzọ n'usoro.
c-332.principle: Ọ bụrụ na otu mkpụrụ shuga ghọọ mkpụrụ, ngwọta gbara ya gburugburu na-eme crystal n'usoro. Na 160℃ ma ọ bụ karịa, hydrolysis na dehydration na-eme ma ọ na-aghọ aja aja. $\mathrm{C_{12}H_{22}O_{11} + H_2O \to C_6H_{12}O_6 + C_6H_{12}O_6}$
c-332.example: Ọ bụrụ na ị tinye mmiri 50mL n'ime shuga 200g ma sie ya, ọ na-aghọ caramel na-acha ọlaedo mgbe nkeji 5~10 gasịrị n'ihe dị ka 170~180℃. Caramel n'okpomọkụ a nwere ike ime ka ị gbaa ọkụ ma ọ bụrụ na ọ fesa.
c-332.actionItem: Ọ bụrụ na ị na-eme caramel taa, ekpelaghị ya, kama tụgharịa nchara ahụ ka ịgwakọta, ma jiri brọshị a dara na mmiri saa crystal dị n'ọgbọ ite.

c-333.title: Ọ bụrụ na akpụkpọ ahụ na-acha ọbara ọbara n'ihi ihe ọdịmma ígwè, ọ nwere ike ịbụ nickel allergy
c-333.summary: Ọ bụrụ na akpụkpọ ahụ na-acha ọbara ọbara ma na-akpọ ọkụ n'ebe ọdụ ntị ma ọ bụ buckle elekere dị, ọ nwere ike ịbụ n'ihi nickel dị n'ígwè. Gaa n'ihu dọkịta akpụkpọ ahụ maka nchọpụta.
c-333.principle: Nickel dị n'ígwè na-eme oxidation site n'ọsụsọ ma na-agbaze dị ka ion. $\mathrm{Ni \to Ni^{2+} + 2e^-}$ Mgbe ion a na-ejikọta na protein akpụkpọ ahụ, contact dermatitis nwere ike ịmalite.
c-333.example: EU na-edobe oke nickel na-apụta maka ngwaahịa na-akpọtụrụ akpụkpọ ahụ ogologo oge na $0.5\ \mu\mathrm{g/cm^2}$ kwa izu. A maara na ihe dị ka otu n'ime mmadụ 10 nwere mmetụta nickel.
c-333.actionItem: Taa, lelee akara 'nickel free' n'ihe ọdịmma na-akpata ọkụ ọkụ ugboro ugboro, ma ọ bụrụ na mgbaàmà nọgidere, gaa n'ihu dọkịta akpụkpọ ahụ.

c-334.title: Ụtọ ọkụ nke wasabi na-apụta naanị mgbe a na-agbari ya ma na-apụ ngwa ngwa
c-334.summary: Ụtọ ọkụ nke wasabi n'ezie na-apụta mgbe a na-agbari ya ma mkpụrụ ndụ na-agbaji, ma ọ na-agbanwe ngwa ngwa n'ihi na ọ na-ala n'ikuku.
c-334.principle: Mgbe mkpụrụ ndụ gbajiri, enzyme myrosinase na-agbaji glycoside sinigrin ma na-eme allyl isothiocyanate na-ekpo ọkụ. $\mathrm{C_{10}H_{16}KNO_9S_2 + H_2O \to C_4H_5NS + C_6H_{12}O_6 + KHSO_4}$
c-334.example: Ụtọ ọkụ ahụ kacha ike n'ime nkeji ole na ole mgbe a gbarịrị ya ma na-ebelata nke ukwuu n'ime nkeji 15~30. Wasabi n'ime tube na-abụkarị horseradish dị ka isi ihe.
c-334.actionItem: Ọ bụrụ na ị na-eji wasabi dị ọhụrụ taa, gbaa ya n'ihe a na-agba ya tupu ị rie ya ma kpuchie ya, ma lelee aha ihe mejupụtara nke ngwaahịa tube.

c-335.title: Ụfụfụ ọtụtụ nke ncha efere apụtaghị ike ịsa ka mma
c-335.summary: Inwe ụfụfụ ọtụtụ na ịsa abụba nke ọma bụ ihe dị iche. Ụfụfụ nwere ike ịbụ n'ihi ihe na-eme ka o guzosie ike.
c-335.principle: Surfactant na-eme micelle n'ọnụọgụgụ dị n'elu critical micelle concentration (CMC) ma na-ekpuchi mmanụ. Nsogbu elu mmiri na-ada ruo CMC, mgbe ahụ ọ fọrọ nke nta ka ọ bụrụ otu.
c-335.example: CMC nke SDS bụ ihe dị ka 8.2 mM, ya bụ ihe dị ka 2.4g kwa 1L mmiri. Ọ bụrụ na ị gafee ọnụọgụgụ a ma tinye ncha ọzọ, ike ịsa anaghị abawanye nke ukwuu, naanị ịwụpụ na-esiwanye ike.
c-335.actionItem: Taa, jiri naanị ntakịrị ncha efere dị ka mkpụrụ agwa, ma kpebie site n'ịlele ma abụba apụọla, ọ bụghị site n'ọnụọgụgụ ụfụfụ.

c-336.title: Uwe ime na-ekpo ọkụ dị ka Heattech na-ewepụta okpomọkụ mgbe mmiri ọsụsọ na-arapara n'eriri
c-336.summary: Uwe ime na-ekpo ọkụ na-ekpo ọkụ n'ihi na okpomọkụ na-apụta mgbe uzuoku mmiri si n'ahụ na-arapara n'eriri, mana mmetụta ya adịghị ukwuu ma anaghị adịgide ogologo oge.
c-336.principle: Mgbe uzuoku mmiri na-arapara n'eriri, a na-ewepụta okpomọkụ dị ka mgbe condensation na-eme. $Q = m\,L$ ma okpomọkụ condensation $L$ nke mmiri bụ ihe dị ka $2.26\ \mathrm{MJ/kg}$.
c-336.example: Ọ bụrụ na a na-amịkọrọ mmiri 10g, a na-ewepụta okpomọkụ kachasị dị ka 23kJ, mana ọ na-akwụsị mgbe eriri jupụtara. Ọ bụrụ na ọsụsọ juru ma jupụta mmiri, ọ na-ewepụ okpomọkụ kama, ma oyi na-adịwanye.
c-336.actionItem: Taa, yi uwe dị gịrịgịrị n'elu uwe ime na-ekpo ọkụ, ma ọ bụrụ na ị na-agbu ọsụsọ, wepụ otu ogbo ka ọ ghara ịmịkọrọ mmiri.

c-337.title: A ga-ewepụ akara na mkpuchi karama PET ma ekewaa ha ka ha ghọọ ihe e jiri eme ọzọ
c-337.summary: Wepụ akara karama PET ma saa ya tupu ịtọpụ ya ka ọ ghara ịgwakọta na plastik ndị ọzọ ma ghọọ ihe dị mma maka ịmaliteghachi.
c-337.principle: Maka ịmaliteghachi, a na-ekewa PET nke na-ada n'ime mmiri na PP·PE nke na-ese n'elu site n'ọdịiche njupụta $\rho = \frac{m}{V}$, ma gbaze ha. PET na-agbaze n'ihe dị ka 250℃, PP n'ihe dị ka 165℃, ma PE n'ihe dị ka 110~130℃.
c-337.example: Njupụta PET bụ ihe dị ka 1.38g/cm³ ma PP·PE bụ ihe dị ka 0.9g/cm³, ya mere a na-ekewa ha n'ime mmiri. Ọ bụrụ na mkpuchi ihe dị ka 2g gwakọtara na karama 500mL ihe dị ka 20g, ihe mgbakwunye na-erute 10%.
c-337.actionItem: Taa, tụgbuo karama PET, saa ya, wepụ akara ma tinye ya n'ime igbe nchịkọta karama PET doro anya.

c-338.title: Ọbụna otu ntụpọ abụba na-egbochi meringue ịfụli
c-338.summary: Ihe kpatara kacha ewu ewu mere meringue anaghị afụli bụ abụba dị n'efere ma ọ bụ n'ọcha akwa.
c-338.principle: Protein ọcha akwa na-agbasa n'ókè dị n'etiti ikuku na mmiri ma na-eme akpụkpọ na-akwado ụfụfụ. Abụba na-ewere ebe n'akpụkpọ a mbụ ma na-egbochi nhazi akpụkpọ ahụ. Ọdịiche nrụgide n'ime na n'èzí ụfụfụ bụ $\Delta P = \frac{4\gamma}{r}$.
c-338.example: Ọcha akwa 3 (ihe dị ka 100g) bụ ihe dị ka 90% mmiri na protein ihe dị ka 10%, mana yolk bụ ihe dị ka 30% abụba, ya mere ọbụna otu ntụpọ gwakọtara na-ebelata olu nke ukwuu. Efere plastik na-ejide mmanụ ngwa ngwa.
c-338.actionItem: Ọ bụrụ na ị na-eme meringue taa, saa efere glaasị ma ọ bụ stainless steel site na mmanya mmanya ma ọ bụ mmiri lemọn, ma kewaa ọcha akwa otu otu n'ebe dị iche tupu itinye ya.

c-339.title: Tupu ịcha ntutu isi ọcha, mee nnwale patch ụbọchị abụọ tupu
c-339.summary: Mmetụta nke agba ntutu nwere ike ịpụta na mberede, ya mere ọ ka mma ime nnwale patch n'azụ ntị ma ọ bụ n'ime aka awa 48 tupu ịcha agba.
c-339.principle: Agba oxidation dị ka para-phenylenediamine (PPD) na-eme ihe jikọtara na-arụ ọrụ mgbe ha na hydrogen peroxide zutere, ma ha nwere ike ijikọta na protein akpụkpọ ahụ ma kpatara mmetụta. $\mathrm{C_6H_4(NH_2)_2 \xrightarrow{H_2O_2} \text{ihe jikọtara na-arụ ọrụ}}$
c-339.example: EU na-egbochi PPD nke a na-etinye n'isi ruo 2% kachasị mgbe agwakọtara. Lelee obere ọnụọgụgụ, nke ruru ma ọ bụ n'okpuru nha mkpụrụ ego 500 won, awa 48; ọ bụrụ na enwere ọbara ọbara, ọkụ ọkụ ma ọ bụ ọzịza, ejila agba ahụ.
c-339.actionItem: Ọ bụrụ na ị na-eme atụmatụ ịcha agba, tinye obere n'azụ ntị ụbọchị abụọ tupu ma mee nnwale patch; ọ bụrụ na enwere mgbaàmà, ejila ya, ma ọ bụrụ na ọ siri ike, chọọ ọgwụgwọ.

c-340.title: Proof n'ime karama mmanya mba ofesi bụ okpukpu abụọ nke ogo mmanya
c-340.summary: Proof nke karama mmanya America bụ okpukpu abụọ nke ọnụọgụgụ mmanya (ABV), ya mere 80 proof bụ 40%.
c-340.principle: Usoro America bụ $\text{proof} = 2 \times \text{ABV}$. Proof ochie nke Britain nwere ọkwa dị iche, 100 proof bụ ihe dị ka 57.15%, ya mere lelee dị ka obodo ọ bụla si dị.
c-340.example: Na whiskey 80 proof 45mL (1.5 oz), ethanol bụ $45 \times 0.40 = 18\ \mathrm{mL}$, ihe dị ka 14.2g, nke bụ otu iko dị ka ọkọlọtọ America. 100 proof (50%) nwere ihe dị ka 17.8g n'otu ọnụọgụgụ.
c-340.actionItem: Taa, kewaa proof nke karama mmanya mba ofesi site na 2 ka ịgbakọ ogo mmanya, ma dee ọnụọgụgụ ị mere ka ị ghara ịṅụ karịa oke.

c-341.title: Ihe nzacha ihe nzacha mmiri: activated carbon na akpụkpọ reverse osmosis na-ewepụ ihe dị iche
c-341.summary: Activated carbon na-ewepụkarị ihe ndị dị ka chlorine na isi, ma akpụkpọ reverse osmosis na-ewepụkarị ion gbazere n'ime mmiri. Tupu ịhọrọ, kpebie ihe ị chọrọ ewepụ.
c-341.principle: Activated carbon na-adọta n'elu, ma reverse osmosis na-etinye nrụgide karịrị nrụgide osmotic $\pi = iMRT$ ka naanị mmiri gafee akpụkpọ ahụ ọkara.
c-341.example: Nrụgide osmotic nke NaCl 500mg/L (ihe dị ka 8.6 mmol/L) bụ ihe dị ka 0.42atm na 25℃. Reverse osmosis ụlọ na-etinyekarị nrụgide 3~4bar ma na-ewepụ ọtụtụ ion.
c-341.actionItem: Taa, lelee oge ịgbanwe ihe nzacha ihe nzacha mmiri gị, ma lelee arụmọrụ ewepụ site n'akara asambodo gọọmenti.

c-342.title: Ihe mere gas mantle nke ọkụ ụlọ ntu na-egbu ìhè bụ rare earth oxide
c-342.summary: Ìhè pụtara ìhè nke ọkụ gas abụghị ọkụ ahụ, kama ọ bụ ìhè sitere na mantle rare earth oxide nke ọkụ kpụrụ ọkụ.
c-342.principle: Mgbe a kpụrụ mantle oxide ruo ihe dị ka 2,000K, ọ na-ewepụta radieshọn n'akụkụ ìhè a na-ahụ anya. Ogologo ebili mmiri kacha elu bụ $\lambda_{\max} T = 2898\ \mu\mathrm{m\cdot K}$.
c-342.example: Na 2,000K, $\lambda_{\max}$ bụ ihe dị ka 1.45μm. Mantle yttrium oxide na cerium nwere oke ìhè a na-ahụ anya, ya mere ha na-egbu ìhè karịa ọkụ efu site n'otu mmanụ. Mantle ochie jiri thorium oxide na-eme radio.
c-342.actionItem: Taa, kpoo mantle ọhụrụ n'èzí mbụ ka ọ sie ike, ejila aka metụ ntụ ọkụ, ma lelee akara thorium-free.

c-343.title: A naghị eji iko akwụkwọ eme akwụkwọ nkịtị ọzọ n'ihi mkpuchi polyethylene dị n'ime
c-343.summary: Iko akwụkwọ nwere ihe nkpuchi plastik maka igbochi mmiri, ya mere ọ siri ike iji ya mee ihe ọzọ ma ọ bụrụ na ị tinye ya n'ime igbe akwụkwọ nkịtị.
c-343.principle: Polyethylene (PE) dị n'ime iko akwụkwọ adịghị agbaze n'ime mmiri ma na-ese n'elu na njupụta $\rho \approx 0.92\ \mathrm{g/cm^3}$, ya mere ọ siri ike ikewapụ ya site n'eriri n'usoro pulping.
c-343.example: Otu iko akwụkwọ dị ihe dị ka 10g, ma mkpuchi PE bụ ihe dị ka 5%. Ọ bụrụ na ọ bụghị usoro pụrụ iche, mkpuchi a nwere ike ime ka akwụkwọ dum tụfuo ogo maka ịmaliteghachi.
c-343.actionItem: Taa, were tumbler nke gị, ma ọ bụrụ na ị na-eji iko akwụkwọ, lelee ụkpụrụ nkewa ebe ị bi ma chịkọta ha iche.

c-344.title: A ga-eme ka cream dị oyi ka ọ pụọ ike mgbe a na-akụ ya
c-344.summary: Fresh cream na-ewe ụfụfụ siri ike mgbe ọ dị oyi nke ukwuu, ma ọ bụrụ na ọ dị ntakịrị ọkụ, ọ naghị afụli n'agbanyeghị ka ị na-akpali ya.
c-344.principle: Mgbe ọ dị oyi, abụba dị n'ime globules abụba na-eme crystal, ya mere n'oge ịkụ, globules na-agbakọta akụkụ ma na-eme netwọk na-ekpuchi ụfụfụ ikuku. Ọ bụrụ na abụba agbazewo, a naghị eme netwọk a.
c-344.example: Ọ bụrụ na ị kụọ cream abụba mmiri ara 35% ma ọ bụ karịa 200mL na 4℃, olu na-aghọ okpukpu abụọ n'ime nkeji 3~5. Na 20℃ ma ọ bụ karịa, ọ naghị afụli nke ọma, ma ọ bụrụ na ị na-akpali ya ogologo oge, ọ na-ekewa n'ime bọta na whey.
c-344.actionItem: Taa, mee ka cream na efere dị oyi nkeji 10 ma ọ bụ karịa tupu ịkụ ya, ma kwụsị ozugbo ọ ga-ewere ọnụ nkọ.

c-345.title: Ejila peroxide dị n'ime ọgwụ eze na-eme ka eze ọcha n'ọnụ ogologo oge
c-345.summary: Peroxide dị n'ọgwụ eze ma ọ bụ strip na-eme ka eze ọcha nwere ike ịkpasu ọnụ iwe, ya mere jiri ya naanị oge a kọwara.
c-345.principle: Hydrogen peroxide na-eme oxidation ma na-agbaji molekul agba, ma na-ewepụta oxygen. $2\mathrm{H_2O_2} \to 2\mathrm{H_2O} + \mathrm{O_2}$ Ọrụ a na-eme ka ọ na-akpasu iwe ọbụna n'akpụkpọ ọnụ.
c-345.example: EU na-ede hydrogen peroxide n'ime ọgwụ eze nkịtị n'okpuru 0.1%, ma ngwaahịa na-eme ka eze ọcha nke 0.1~6% a ga-eji n'okpuru nlekọta dọkịta eze. Ọ bụrụ na ịghara ichebe oge ma debe ya ogologo oge, mkpasu iwe ọnụ na mmetụta ọkụ eze na-abawanye.
c-345.actionItem: Taa, jiri ngwaahịa na-eme ka eze ọcha naanị oge e dere n'akwụkwọ ntuziaka, ma ọ bụrụ na ọnụ na-akpọ ọkụ, kwụsị ma gwa dọkịta eze.

c-346.title: Ṅụọla mmiri sitere n'ice snow gbazere n'enweghị ịsie ya
c-346.summary: Ọbụna ma ice snow na-adị ọcha, ọ na-akpọkọta ihe mmetọ na nje dị n'ikuku, ya mere a ga-esi mmiri gbazere tupu ị ṅụọ ya.
c-346.principle: Crystal snow na-ejide uzuzu na obere mkpụrụ mgbe ọ na-etolite ma na-ada. Ịsị na-egbu nje, mana ọ naghị ewepụ ígwè dị arọ na mmetọ kemịkalụ. A na-ekpebi olu mmiri site na njupụta snow, $V_{\mathrm{water}} \approx \frac{V_{\mathrm{snow}}}{10}$.
c-346.example: Ọ bụrụ na ị gbazee snow ọhụrụ 10L, mmiri bụ ihe dị ka 1L, ma ụkpụrụ nkịtị maka ịsị bụ nkeji 1 ma ọ bụ karịa (nkeji 3 n'ebe dị elu karịa 2,000m). Ejila snow dị n'akụkụ okporo ụzọ ma ọ bụ nke agbanweela agba.
c-346.actionItem: Taa, n'oge mberede, chịkọta naanị snow ọhụrụ dị ọcha, tinye obere mmiri n'ime ite mbụ tupu ịgbazee ya, sie ya tupu ịṅụ ya, ma n'oge nkịtị were mmiri e mere n'karama.

c-347.title: Mmiri ara ehi lactose-free bụ mmiri ara ehi nke a gbajiri lactose ya tupu
c-347.summary: Mmiri ara ehi lactose-free bụ mmiri ara ehi nke a gbajiri lactose ya tupu, ya mere ọ dabara maka ndị na-enweghị ike iri lactose, mana protein mmiri ara ehi ka dị, ya mere ọ dabaghị maka ndị nwere allergy mmiri ara ehi.
c-347.principle: Enzyme lactase na-agbaji lactose site na hydrolysis ghọọ glucose na galactose. $\mathrm{C_{12}H_{22}O_{11} + H_2O \xrightarrow{\text{lactase}} C_6H_{12}O_6 + C_6H_{12}O_6}$
c-347.example: Lactose n'ime mmiri ara ehi nkịtị bụ ihe dị ka 4.7~5g kwa 100mL, ya mere 200mL bụ ihe dị ka 9.5g. Akara lactose-free dị ka ụkpụrụ EU bụ 0.01g/100g ma ọ bụ n'okpuru, ma ọ na-atọkwu ụtọ ntakịrị n'ihi monosaccharide a gbajiri.
c-347.actionItem: Taa, ọ bụrụ na afọ na-adịghị gị mma n'ihi na ị anaghị anagide lactose, họrọ ngwaahịa lactose-free, mana ọ bụrụ na ị nwere allergy mmiri ara ehi, zere ma nkịtị ma lactose-free.

c-348.title: Nitrogen dioxide na-apụta mgbe a na-esi nri na stovu gas, ya mere gbanye hood
c-348.summary: Ọkụ gas na-eme nitrogen dioxide nke nwere ike ime ka ikuku dị n'ime kichin dị warara dị njọ, ya mere ọ ka mma ịgbanye hood mgbe ị na-esi nri.
c-348.principle: N'ọkụ dị elu, nitrogen na oxygen dị n'ikuku na-emeghachi omume ($\mathrm{N_2 + O_2 \to 2NO}$) ma mgbe ahụ na-eme oxidation. $2\mathrm{NO} + \mathrm{O_2} \to 2\mathrm{NO_2}$
c-348.example: N'ihe a tụrụ n'obere kichin na-enweghị ikuku, a kọrọ ọnọdụ ebe ọnụọgụgụ nitrogen dioxide gafere ntụziaka awa 1 nke WHO $200\ \mu\mathrm{g/m^3}$. Hood nke na-ezipụ n'èzí na-ebelata ọnụọgụgụ a nke ukwuu.
c-348.actionItem: Taa, gbanye hood tupu ịmalite ịsi nri, ma mgbe ị gbanyụrụ ọkụ, hapụ ya ka ọ na-agba ihe dị ka nkeji 10 ọzọ.

c-349.title: Ị nwere ike iji mmanụ nri fọdụrụ mee ncha ịsa uwe
c-349.summary: Ọ bụrụ na ị chịkọta mmanụ nri fọdụrụ kama ịwụsa ya n'ime ọwa mmiri, ị nwere ike imeghachi ya na caustic soda ka ịme ncha.
c-349.principle: Mmeghachi omume saponification bụ triglyceride na NaOH na-eme ncha na glycerol. $\mathrm{C_3H_5(OOCR)_3 + 3NaOH \to C_3H_5(OH)_3 + 3RCOONa}$
c-349.example: Maka mmanụ soybean, a chọrọ NaOH ihe dị ka 0.135g kwa 1g mmanụ, ya mere maka mmanụ 500g ọ bụ ihe dị ka 68g. Caustic soda bụ alkali siri ike, ya mere anya nchekwa na aka mkpa dị mkpa, ma jiri ncha ahụ mgbe ọ sie ike ihe dị ka izu 4.
c-349.actionItem: Taa, nyochaa mmanụ fọdụrụ site na nzacha kọfị ma chịkọta ya n'ime karama emechiri emechi, ma ewela ya wụsa n'ime ọwa mmiri.

c-350.title: Ọbụna otu ntụpọ mmiri na-eme ka chocolate gbazere sie ike
c-350.summary: Ọbụna obere mmiri ma ọ bụrụ na ọ banye n'ime chocolate gbazere, ihe dị nro na mbụ na-aghọ mberede ọkpụrụkpụ siri ike.
c-350.principle: Mkpụrụ shuga na cocoa na-amịkọrọ mmiri ma na-eme akpụkpọ syrup na-arapara arapara, mkpụrụ na-ejikọta ibe ha ma viscosity na-abawanye ngwa ngwa. A na-akpọ nke a seizing.
c-350.example: Ọbụna mmiri gram ole na ole, ihe dị ka 1~2%, n'ime chocolate 200g na-eme ka ọ sie ike. Ọ bụrụ na ị tinye mmiri ọzọ ruo ihe dị ka 20% ma ọ bụ karịa, ọ nwere ike ịdị nro ọzọ dị ka ganache dị ọkụ.
c-350.actionItem: Taa, mgbe ị na-agbaze chocolate, hichaa mmiri n'efere na spatula, ma gbochie mmiri ịsa ahụ ịmetụ efere ma ọ bụ uzuoku ịbanye.

c-351.title: Saa bọọdụ iberibe ozugbo mgbe ojiji ma kpoo ya kpam kpam
c-351.summary: Nje chọrọ mmiri iji mụba, ya mere isi ihe bụ ịsa bọọdụ iberibe ozugbo mgbe ojiji ma kpoo ya kpam kpam.
c-351.principle: Ọrụ mmiri, nke na-egosi ka mmiri si dị n'ọnọdụ iji, bụ $a_w = \frac{p}{p_0}$, ma ọtụtụ ihe na-akpata ọrịa na-amụba ngwa ngwa mgbe $a_w$ dị ihe dị ka 0.9 ma ọ bụ karịa.
c-351.example: $a_w$ nke elu anụ ọhụrụ bụ ihe dị ka 0.99, nke dị mfe ka nje tolite. Ọ bụrụ na ị anaghị ewere ya na-adị mmiri, kama kpoo ya n'ebe ikuku na-agafe, mmiri elu na-ebelata ma ọmụmụ na-egbochi.
c-351.actionItem: Taa, saa bọọdụ iberibe ozugbo mgbe ojiji site na mmiri ọkụ na ncha, kpoo ya kpam kpam ka ọ guzoro. Jiri nke anụ ọhụrụ na nke akwụkwọ nri iche.

c-352.title: Ọ bụrụ na ị sie Glühwein nke ahịa Christmas, isi ụtọ na-apụ
c-352.summary: Ekwela ka Glühwein (vin chaud) sie, kama kpoo ya naanị ruo mgbe uzuoku na-ebili, ka isi ụtọ na mmanya ghara ịpụ nke ukwuu.
c-352.principle: Ethanol nwere ebe esi dị ka 78℃, nke dị ala karịa mmiri, ya mere ọ na-ala mbụ mgbe a kpoo ya. A na-egosi nrụgide uzuoku nke ngwakọta site na $P = x_{\mathrm{EtOH}}\,P^{\circ}_{\mathrm{EtOH}}$ (iwu Raoult).
c-352.example: Na mmanya wine 750mL nwere ogo 12%, ethanol bụ ihe dị ka 90mL. A na-ejikarị ya na-ekpo ọkụ ruo 60~70℃, ma ọ bụrụ na ị sie ya karịa 78℃, mmanya na isi ụtọ na-apụ ngwa ngwa.
c-352.actionItem: Taa, kpoo wine ahụ n'ọkụ dị nwayọ ka ọ ghara ịgafe 70℃, ma wepụ ngwa nri tupu ọ sie.

c-353.title: Akara ABC nke ihe na-emenyụ ọkụ pụtara ụdị ọkụ
c-353.summary: A, B na C nke ihe na-emenyụ ọkụ na-egosi ụdị ọkụ ọ nwere ike ịrụ ọrụ na ya, ma maka ụlọ, ihe na-emenyụ ọkụ ntụ ABC bụ nke a na-ejikarị.
c-353.principle: N'ime ndekọ Korea na America, A bụ ọkụ nkịtị, B bụ ọkụ mmanụ, ma C bụ ọkụ ọkụ eletrik. Ammonium dihydrogen phosphate na-agbaji mgbe a kpoo ya ma na-egbochi mmeghachi omume ọkụ. $\mathrm{NH_4H_2PO_4 \to NH_3 + H_3PO_4}$
c-353.example: Ihe na-emenyụ ọkụ ntụ 3.3kg maka ụlọ na-ewepụta n'ime sekọnd 10~20, ya mere ị ga-ama otu esi eji ya tupu. Na Europe, ndekọ dị iche, dị ka C pụtara ọkụ gas, ya mere lelee ụkpụrụ mpaghara.
c-353.actionItem: Taa, lelee ma ihe nrụgide nke ihe na-emenyụ ọkụ dị n'ókè akwụkwọ ndụ, ma debe ya n'ebe aka ga-eru.

c-354.title: Ihe na-ekpo ọkụ enwere ike iji ọzọ na-eji okpomọkụ crystallization nke sodium acetate
c-354.summary: Ihe na-ekpo ọkụ enwere ike iji ọzọ na-eji okpomọkụ na-apụta mgbe ngwọta supersaturated na-aghọ crystal n'otu oge, ma ị nwere ike iji ya ọzọ site n'igbaze ya n'ime mmiri na-esi.
c-354.principle: Sodium acetate trihydrate na-agbaze n'ihe dị ka 58℃, ma mgbe mmiri mmiri jụrụ oyi dị ka supersaturated na-eme crystal, ọ na-ewepụta okpomọkụ nke njikọ. $Q = m\,\Delta H_{\mathrm{fus}}$, $\Delta H_{\mathrm{fus}}$ bụ ihe dị ka 265J/g.
c-354.example: Mgbe ihe na-ekpo ọkụ 100g na-eme crystal, a na-ewepụta okpomọkụ dị ka 26kJ, ma elu ya na-eru ihe dị ka 50℃. Ọ bụrụ na ị hapụ otu ihe ahụ n'ime mmiri na-esi ihe dị ka nkeji 10, ọ na-aghọ mmiri mmiri doro anya ọzọ.
