20261121-physics-g07-2.title: Nhazi ike ndọda, ikpuru na buoyancy
20261121-physics-g07-2.summary: E debere ibe osisi n'elu akwụkwọ nkọ na iko ma dọpụta ya site na spring scale iji tụọ ike ikpuru kwụsiri ike kacha ukwuu. Kedu n'ime ndị a abụghị ọnọdụ a ga-achịkwa?
20261121-physics-g07-2.principle: Ebe nnwale a bụ ịtụ mgbanwe ikpuru dị ka ịdị gbagọrọ agbagọ nke ala si dị, 'ịdị gbagọrọ agbagọ nke ala' ga-abụ ọnọdụ a na-agbanwe, a gaghị edebe ya otu.
20261121-physics-g07-2.example: Ebumnuche nnwale a bụ ịmata ọdịiche ikpuru dị ka 'ụdị ala (ịdị gbagọrọ agbagọ)' si dị.
20261121-physics-g07-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261121-physics-g08-1.title: Iwu Ohm na ikike ọkụ
20261121-physics-g08-1.summary: E tinyere voltage 30 V n'ọnụ waya nichrome nke nguzogide ya bụ 10 Ω. Kedu ike ọkụ eletrik na-agafe waya ahụ?
20261121-physics-g08-1.principle: Dị ka iwu Ohm si dị, ike ọkụ eletrik bụ $I = \frac{V}{R} = \frac{30\text{ V}}{10\,\Omega} = 3\text{ A}$.
20261121-physics-g08-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261121-physics-g08-2.title: Iwu Ohm na ikike ọkụ
20261121-physics-g08-2.summary: Ọkụ eletrik na-agafe waya kwụ ọtọ site n'ala gaa n'elu. N'ụzọ kedu ka okpuru N nke kompas dị nso n'ugwu waya ahụ ga-atụgharị dị ka iwu aka nri Ampère si dị?
20261121-physics-g08-2.principle: Mgbe isi mkpịsị aka nri na-atụ aka n'ụzọ ọkụ eletrik (n'elu), ngalaba magnet gburugburu nke mkpịsị aka anọ na-eme na-atụ aka n'ọdịda anyanwụ n'ugwu waya, ya mere okpuru N nke kompas na-atụgharị n'ọdịda anyanwụ.
20261121-physics-g08-2.example: Bulie isi mkpịsị aka nri n'ụzọ ọkụ eletrik (n'elu) ma kechie waya site na mkpịsị aka anọ ndị ọzọ.
20261121-physics-g08-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261121-physics-g09-1.title: Ọrụ na mgbanwe ume mechanical
20261121-physics-g09-1.summary: N'ihe gbasara physics, kedu ọnọdụ ka 'ọrụ sayensị' e rụrụ bụ efu?
20261121-physics-g09-1.principle: Mgbe ị na-eje ije n'ụzọ dị larịị na-ebu igbe, ike ị na-eji (ike elu na-ejide ibu) na ntụziaka mmegharị (dị larịị) na-eme akụkụ ziri ezi nke $90^\circ$, yabụ ọ dịghị akụkụ nke ike na-arụ ọrụ n'ntụziaka mmegharị, ọrụ e rụrụ bụkwa $0$.
20261121-physics-g09-1.example: Ọrụ sayensị bụ W = F × s × cos(θ).
20261121-physics-g09-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261121-physics-g09-2.title: Ọrụ na mgbanwe ume mechanical
20261121-physics-g09-2.summary: A tụrụ ebe a kwọpụrụ otu mpempe osisi mgbe ụgbọ ịkwọ nwere ibu na ọsọ dị iche iche kụrụ ya. Kedu nkwubi okwu ziri ezi gbasara ume mmegharị (kinetic energy)?
20261121-physics-g09-2.principle: Ebe ume mmegharị bụ $E_k = \frac{1}{2}mv^2$, ọ kwesịrị ibu ihe ma kwesịkwa square nke ọsọ ya.
20261121-physics-g09-2.example: Usoro ume mmegharị: E<sub>k</sub> = (1/2) m v²
20261121-physics-g09-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261121-physics-g10-1.title: Ọgbaghara na nchekwa, mmepụta kwụ ọtọ na ike ndọda
20261121-physics-g10-1.summary: Nso n'elu ụwa, n'ime bọọlụ ígwè abụọ A na B n'otu ịdị elu, a hapụrụ A site n'izu ike ka ọ daa n'efu, a gbapụrụ B n'ike n'akụkụ larịị. Kedu nkọwa ziri ezi gbasara mmegharị ha? (Ghara ileghara ọgbụgba ikuku.)
20261121-physics-g10-1.principle: Mmegharị larịị na-adịgide adịgide na mmegharị ọdịda n'efu kwụ ọtọ adabereghị n'ibe ibe. Bọọlụ abụọ ahụ na-ada kwụ ọtọ n'otu ọsọ ike ndọda $g$, yabụ ha na-eru n'ala n'otu oge.
20261121-physics-g10-1.example: Chee banyere nnwere onwe nke mmegharị.
20261121-physics-g10-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261121-physics-g10-2.title: Ọgbaghara na nchekwa, mmepụta kwụ ọtọ na ike ndọda
20261121-physics-g10-2.summary: A hapụrụ àkwá abụọ nwere otu ibu site n'otu ịdị elu, otu n'elu ala sịmenti, nke ọzọ n'elu ọdụ dị nro. Kedu ntụnyere nke ọnụ ọgụgụ physics ziri ezi site n'oge ọ bụla àkwá metụrụ n'elu ruo mgbe ọ kwụsịrị?
20261121-physics-g10-2.principle: Ebe mgbanwe momentum ($\Delta p$) nke àkwá abụọ bụ otu, impulse ($I = F\Delta t$) bụ otu. Ọdụ na-agbatị oge mgbagwoju anya $\Delta t$, na-ebelata ike ọkpọkọ nkezi $F = \frac{I}{\Delta t}$, yabụ àkwá anaghị agbaji.
20261121-physics-g10-2.example: Ebe ha si n'otu ịdị elu daa, ọsọ tupu mgbagwoju anya na mgbanwe ọsọ ruo izu ike (mgbanwe momentum = impulse) bụ otu.
20261121-physics-g10-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261121-physics-g11-1.title: Iwu mmegharị Newton na tiori mmekọrịta pụrụ iche
20261121-physics-g11-1.summary: Kedu ihe bụ ọdịiche physics bụ isi kachasị ziri ezi n'etiti 'mmekọrịta mmeghachi omume (action-reaction)' na 'nhaịlịgide ike abụọ'?
20261121-physics-g11-1.principle: Mmeghachi omume na-arụ ọrụ n'ihe abụọ dị iche na-emekọrịta, yabụ enweghị ike ijikọta ike abụọ ahụ, mana ike nhaịlịgide abụọ na-arụ ọrụ n'otu ihe, yabụ enwere ike ijikọta ha, ike niile ghọọkwa 0.
20261121-physics-g11-1.example: Mmeghachi omume: ike A na-etinye na B na ike B na-etinye na A
20261121-physics-g11-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261121-physics-g11-2.title: Iwu mmegharị Newton na tiori mmekọrịta pụrụ iche
20261121-physics-g11-2.summary: E tinyere ihe A dị 3 kg na ihe B dị 2 kg ka ha na-emetụ onwe ha n'elu larịị na-enweghị esemokwu, a tinyekwara ike larịị 20 N ịkwọ n'akụkụ A. Kedu ọsọ nke ihe abụọ na ịdị ukwuu nke ike A na-akwọ B, n'usoro?
20261121-physics-g11-2.principle: Ọsọ niile bụ $a = \frac{F}{m_A + m_B} = \frac{20\text{ N}}{5\text{ kg}} = 4\text{ m/s}^2$. Naanị ike niile na-eme ka ihe B mee ọsọ bụ ike mmetụ nke A na-akwọ B, yabụ $F_{AB} = m_B \cdot a = 2\text{ kg} \times 4\text{ m/s}^2 = 8\text{ N}$.
20261121-physics-g11-2.example: Maka usoro niile (A + B): F = (m<sub>A</sub> + m<sub>B</sub>) a → 20 = (3 + 2) a
20261121-physics-g11-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261121-physics-g12-1.title: Mmetụta photoelectric, ụdị abụọ nke ìhè na ụwa nta
20261121-physics-g12-1.summary: Kedu nsonaazụ nke nnwale photoelectric effect nke Einstein enweghị ike ikwu site na 'echiche ebili mmiri nke ìhè' ma 'echiche photon (akụkụ) nke ìhè' naanị na-akọwa ya kpamkpam?
20261121-physics-g12-1.principle: Echiche ebili mmiri na-ahụ ọdịnihu na ume na-achịkọta n'oge, mana na photoelectric effect otu photon dị n'elu threshold frequency na-agbagwo electron ozugbo ma na-ebufe ume ya, yabụ a na-ewepụta electron ozugbo na-enweghị igbu oge.
20261121-physics-g12-1.example: Dabere n'echiche ebili mmiri, ọbụna ìhè adịghị ike ma e tinye ya ogologo oge kwesịrị ịchịkọta ume wee wepụta electron, mana n'eziokwu a na-ewepụta ya ozugbo.
20261121-physics-g12-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261121-physics-g12-2.title: Mmetụta photoelectric, ụdị abụọ nke ìhè na ụwa nta
20261121-physics-g12-2.summary: Akụkụ nwere ụgwọ nwere ibu m na ụgwọ q na-abata n'ụzọ kwụ ọtọ n'ime ikpo magnet edoro anya B n'ọsọ v ma na-eme mmegharị gburugburu edoro anya. Kedu nhọrọ na-egosi nke ọma radius r na period T nke ụzọ gburugburu ya?
20261121-physics-g12-2.principle: Site na nha ike centripetal, $\frac{mv^2}{r} = qvB \implies r = \frac{mv}{qB}$. Period bụ $T = \frac{2\pi r}{v} = \frac{2\pi m}{qB}$, ma n'ụzọ na-eju anya, cyclotron period a adabereghị na radius ụzọ ma ọ bụ ọsọ.
20261121-physics-g12-2.example: Ike Lorentz na-arụ ọrụ dị ka ike centripetal nke mmegharị gburugburu: q v B = m v² / r
20261121-physics-g12-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261122-physics-g01-1.title: Ihe ndị magnet na-adọta na ike magnet
20261122-physics-g01-1.summary: Gịnị na-eme mgbe e weta okpuru N na S nke magnet nso ibe ha?
20261122-physics-g01-1.principle: Okpuru magnet dị iche (N na S) na-adọta ibe ha site n'ike mkpali (attraction), ebe okpuru ndị yiri ibe ha na-ezipụ ibe ha site n'ike mgbapụ (repulsion).
20261122-physics-g01-1.example: Chee echiche banyere ihe na-eme mgbe okpuru magnet dị iche na-ezute.
20261122-physics-g01-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261122-physics-g01-2.title: Ihe ndị magnet na-adọta na ike magnet
20261122-physics-g01-2.summary: E tinyere ihe mkpịsị ígwè n'ime iko plastik doro anya ma were magnet tụgharịa n'èzí iko ahụ. Gịnị ga-eme ihe mkpịsị ígwè ahụ mgbe a na-ebuli magnet nwayọọ gaa n'elu?
20261122-physics-g01-2.principle: Ike magnet (magnetic force) nwere ike ịgafe ihe dị gịrịgịrị dị ka plastik, akwụkwọ ma ọ bụ iko ma rụọ ọrụ n'ihe e ji ígwè mee.
20261122-physics-g01-2.example: Ike magnet nwere ike ịgafe plastik ma ọ bụ akwụkwọ dị gịrịgịrị.
20261122-physics-g01-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261122-physics-g02-1.title: Mkpọtụ na mbufe ụda
20261122-physics-g02-1.summary: A tụrụ ihe ụda (tuning fork) site na hama rabba ma kpọkọta ya nwayọọ n'elu mmiri n'ime ihe ọnụ mmiri. Gịnị na-eme?
20261122-physics-g02-1.principle: Ihe ụda na-ekwu ụda na-ama jijiji, ya mere mgbe ọ metụrụ mmiri, ọ na-efesa mmiri n'akụkụ niile ma na-eme ebili mmiri.
20261122-physics-g02-1.example: Ihe ụda na-ekwu ụda na-ama jijiji ngwa ngwa.
20261122-physics-g02-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261122-physics-g02-2.title: Mkpọtụ na mbufe ụda
20261122-physics-g02-2.summary: Mgbe a na-ekwurịta okwu site na 'ekwentị eriri' e mere site n'iko akwụkwọ abụọ na eriri silk, kedu ka olu onye ọzọ si anụ nke ọma karịa?
20261122-physics-g02-2.principle: N'ekwentị eriri, a na-ebufe mkpọtụ nke ala iko akwụkwọ site n'eriri, ya mere eriri ga-adị ọtọ ka mkpọtụ nwee ike ịga nke ọma n'akụkụ ọzọ.
20261122-physics-g02-2.example: A na-ebufe ụda site na mkpọtụ eriri.
20261122-physics-g02-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261122-physics-g03-1.title: Mgbasa ìhè n'ahịrị kwụ ọtọ na mgbanwe onyinyo
20261122-physics-g03-1.summary: E debere akwụkwọ atọ nwere oghere n'usoro n'ihu ọkụ ọkụ ọkụ. Kedu ka e kwesịrị ịhazi oghere ahụ ka a hụ ìhè n'akụkụ nke ọzọ?
20261122-physics-g03-1.principle: Ìhè na-agbasa n'ahịrị kwụ ọtọ, ya mere ọ nwere ike ịgafe oghere niile naanị mgbe oghere atọ ahụ dị n'otu ahịrị.
20261122-physics-g03-1.example: Ìhè enweghị ike gafere n'ụzọ gbagọrọ agbagọ.
20261122-physics-g03-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261122-physics-g03-2.title: Mgbasa ìhè n'ahịrị kwụ ọtọ na mgbanwe onyinyo
20261122-physics-g03-2.summary: Anyị chọrọ ka onyinyo nke teddy bear n'ihuenyo bụrụ nke ka ukwuu karịa ugbu a. Kedu ụzọ kwesịrị ekwesị?
20261122-physics-g03-2.principle: Ka isi iyi ìhè (ọkụ ọkụ ọkụ) na ihe dị nso, ka ihe na-ekpuchi akụkụ ìhè ka ukwuu, ya mere onyinyo n'ihuenyo na-abawanye.
20261122-physics-g03-2.example: Ka ihe dị nso n'isi iyi ìhè, ka ọ na-ekpuchi mpaghara ìhè ka ukwuu.
20261122-physics-g03-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261122-physics-g04-1.title: Ihe nha abụọ na ụkpụrụ nhazi
20261122-physics-g04-1.summary: E kwụrụ ibu 20 g n'ebe dị n'ogo 4 sistemụ n'aka ekpe site n'ebe mkpọchi nke ihe nha abụọ. Kedu ibu e kwesịrị ịkwụ n'aka nri n'ogo 2 sistemụ ka ihe nha ahụ dị n'ahụ nhazi?
20261122-physics-g04-1.principle: Dị ka ụkpụrụ nhazi si dị, oge aka ekpe ($4\text{ nkeji} \times 20\text{ g} = 80$) na oge aka nri ($2\text{ nkeji} \times ? = 80$) ga-abụ otu, ya mere a ga-akwụ ibu $40\text{ g}$.
20261122-physics-g04-1.example: Gbakọọ (anya aka ekpe × ibu) = (anya aka nri × ibu).
20261122-physics-g04-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261122-physics-g04-2.title: Ihe nha abụọ na ụkpụrụ nhazi
20261122-physics-g04-2.summary: Mgbe nwanna nwoke dị 40 kg na nwa nta dị 20 kg na-egwu n'elu seesaw, kedu ka ha kwesịrị ịnọdụ ka seesaw dị n'ahụ nhazi?
20261122-physics-g04-2.principle: Ka seesaw dị n'ahụ nhazi, nwanna nwoke dị arọ ($40\text{ kg}$) ga-anọdụ ọkara anya nso n'ebe mkpọchi karịa nwa nta dị mfe ($20\text{ kg}$).
20261122-physics-g04-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261122-physics-g05-1.title: Nkọwa ọsọ na ntụnyere
20261122-physics-g05-1.summary: Kedu n'ime nkọwa sayensị ndị a gbasara ntụnyere ọsọ nke ihe ziri ezi?
20261122-physics-g05-1.principle: Mgbe e gafere otu ụzọ, ka oge dị mkpụmkpụ, ka ọ na-adị ngwa, ma mgbe e ji otu oge gaa, ka ụzọ e gafere dị ogologo, ka ọsọ dị ukwuu.
20261122-physics-g05-1.example: N'asọmpi ọsọ, onye mbụ na-eru ebe njedebe n'oge kacha nta.
20261122-physics-g05-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261122-physics-g05-2.title: Nkọwa ọsọ na ntụnyere
20261122-physics-g05-2.summary: Mgbe a na-ekpebi nnwale iji tụnyere ọsọ bọl ígwè na-agbagharị n'ala mkpọka dị iche iche n'ụzọ ziri ezi, kedu n'ime ndị a abụghị 'ọnọdụ a ga-edebe otu (control variable)'?
20261122-physics-g05-2.principle: N'ihi na anyị na-enyocha ọsọ dị ka akụkụ mkpọka si dị, akụkụ mkpọka bụ 'ọnọdụ a na-agbanwe', ma ọnọdụ ndị ọzọ ga-edebe otu.
20261122-physics-g05-2.example: Chọta ọnọdụ anyị na-agbanwe n'ụzọ na-agbanwe (independent variable).
20261122-physics-g05-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261122-physics-g06-1.title: Njikọ circuit na onyinyo convex lens
20261122-physics-g06-1.summary: A chọrọ iji batrị otu, bọlb abụọ na switch jikọọ ya site na waya ka bọlb nwee ike enwu. Kedu ọnọdụ 'circuit mechiri emechi' nke ọkụ na-enwu bụ nke ziri ezi?
20261122-physics-g06-1.principle: Ka ọkụ eletrik gafee, a ga-eme circuit mechiri emechi nke jikọtara na-agbaghị agba site n'otu okpuru batrị gafee akụrụngwa eletrik ruo n'okpuru nke ọzọ.
20261122-physics-g06-1.example: Ọkụ eletrik nwere ike ịgafe naanị mgbe waya jikọtara ma ọ dịghị agbaji.
20261122-physics-g06-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261122-physics-g06-2.title: Njikọ circuit na onyinyo convex lens
20261122-physics-g06-2.summary: Kedu n'ime nkọwa ndị a gbasara ntụnyere circuit nwere bọlb abụọ yiri ibe ha jikọtara n'usoro (series) na nke jikọtara n'otu ụzọ (parallel) ziri ezi?
20261122-physics-g06-2.principle: Mgbe e jikọtara bọlb parallel, voltage zuru ezu nke batrị na-agbado bọlb ọ bụla, ya mere ha na-enwu karịa, ọbụlagodi ma otu bọlb gbajiri, circuit nke bọlb ndị ọzọ na-anọgide.
20261122-physics-g06-2.example: Chee echiche banyere ụlọ ebe ọ bụrụ na e gbanyụọ ọkụ n'otu ụlọ, ọkụ n'ime ụlọ nzuko na-anọgide na-enwu.
20261122-physics-g06-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261122-physics-g07-1.title: Nhazi ike ndọda, ikpuru na buoyancy
20261122-physics-g07-1.summary: Onye mbara igwe nke ibu ya bụ 60 kg n'Ụwa rutere n'elu Ọnwa. Kedu nkọwa gbasara 'ibu (mass)' na 'ịdị arọ (weight)' ya n'ọnwa ziri ezi? (Ike ndọda Ọnwa bụ 1/6 nke Ụwa.)
20261122-physics-g07-1.principle: Ibu bụ ọnụọgụ ihe nke ahụ, ya mere ọ na-adị otu (60 kg) n'agbanyeghị ebe, mana ịdị arọ bụ ike ndọda, ya mere n'Ọnwa ọ na-ebelata ruo 1/6 nke Ụwa, ihe dị ka 98 N.
20261122-physics-g07-1.example: Ibu bụ ọnụọgụ ihe ahụ nwere, ya mere ọ naghị agbanwe site n'ebe.
20261122-physics-g07-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261122-physics-g07-2.title: Nhazi ike ndọda, ikpuru na buoyancy
20261122-physics-g07-2.summary: E debere ibe osisi n'elu akwụkwọ nkọ na iko ma dọpụta ya site na spring scale iji tụọ ike ikpuru kwụsiri ike kacha ukwuu. Kedu n'ime ndị a abụghị ọnọdụ a ga-achịkwa?
20261122-physics-g07-2.principle: Ebe nnwale a bụ ịtụ mgbanwe ikpuru dị ka ịdị gbagọrọ agbagọ nke ala si dị, 'ịdị gbagọrọ agbagọ nke ala' ga-abụ ọnọdụ a na-agbanwe, a gaghị edebe ya otu.
20261122-physics-g07-2.example: Ebumnuche nnwale a bụ ịmata ọdịiche ikpuru dị ka 'ụdị ala (ịdị gbagọrọ agbagọ)' si dị.
20261122-physics-g07-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261122-physics-g08-1.title: Iwu Ohm na ikike ọkụ
20261122-physics-g08-1.summary: E tinyere voltage 30 V n'ọnụ waya nichrome nke nguzogide ya bụ 10 Ω. Kedu ike ọkụ eletrik na-agafe waya ahụ?
20261122-physics-g08-1.principle: Dị ka iwu Ohm si dị, ike ọkụ eletrik bụ $I = \frac{V}{R} = \frac{30\text{ V}}{10\,\Omega} = 3\text{ A}$.
20261122-physics-g08-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261122-physics-g08-2.title: Iwu Ohm na ikike ọkụ
20261122-physics-g08-2.summary: Ọkụ eletrik na-agafe waya kwụ ọtọ site n'ala gaa n'elu. N'ụzọ kedu ka okpuru N nke kompas dị nso n'ugwu waya ahụ ga-atụgharị dị ka iwu aka nri Ampère si dị?
20261122-physics-g08-2.principle: Mgbe isi mkpịsị aka nri na-atụ aka n'ụzọ ọkụ eletrik (n'elu), ngalaba magnet gburugburu nke mkpịsị aka anọ na-eme na-atụ aka n'ọdịda anyanwụ n'ugwu waya, ya mere okpuru N nke kompas na-atụgharị n'ọdịda anyanwụ.
20261122-physics-g08-2.example: Bulie isi mkpịsị aka nri n'ụzọ ọkụ eletrik (n'elu) ma kechie waya site na mkpịsị aka anọ ndị ọzọ.
20261122-physics-g08-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261122-physics-g09-1.title: Ọrụ na mgbanwe ume mechanical
20261122-physics-g09-1.summary: N'ihe gbasara physics, kedu ọnọdụ ka 'ọrụ sayensị' e rụrụ bụ efu?
20261122-physics-g09-1.principle: Mgbe ị na-eje ije n'ụzọ dị larịị na-ebu igbe, ike ị na-eji (ike elu na-ejide ibu) na ntụziaka mmegharị (dị larịị) na-eme akụkụ ziri ezi nke $90^\circ$, yabụ ọ dịghị akụkụ nke ike na-arụ ọrụ n'ntụziaka mmegharị, ọrụ e rụrụ bụkwa $0$.
20261122-physics-g09-1.example: Ọrụ sayensị bụ W = F × s × cos(θ).
20261122-physics-g09-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261122-physics-g09-2.title: Ọrụ na mgbanwe ume mechanical
20261122-physics-g09-2.summary: A tụrụ ebe a kwọpụrụ otu mpempe osisi mgbe ụgbọ ịkwọ nwere ibu na ọsọ dị iche iche kụrụ ya. Kedu nkwubi okwu ziri ezi gbasara ume mmegharị (kinetic energy)?
20261122-physics-g09-2.principle: Ebe ume mmegharị bụ $E_k = \frac{1}{2}mv^2$, ọ kwesịrị ibu ihe ma kwesịkwa square nke ọsọ ya.
20261122-physics-g09-2.example: Usoro ume mmegharị: E<sub>k</sub> = (1/2) m v²
20261122-physics-g09-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261122-physics-g10-1.title: Ọgbaghara na nchekwa, mmepụta kwụ ọtọ na ike ndọda
20261122-physics-g10-1.summary: Nso n'elu ụwa, n'ime bọọlụ ígwè abụọ A na B n'otu ịdị elu, a hapụrụ A site n'izu ike ka ọ daa n'efu, a gbapụrụ B n'ike n'akụkụ larịị. Kedu nkọwa ziri ezi gbasara mmegharị ha? (Ghara ileghara ọgbụgba ikuku.)
20261122-physics-g10-1.principle: Mmegharị larịị na-adịgide adịgide na mmegharị ọdịda n'efu kwụ ọtọ adabereghị n'ibe ibe. Bọọlụ abụọ ahụ na-ada kwụ ọtọ n'otu ọsọ ike ndọda $g$, yabụ ha na-eru n'ala n'otu oge.
20261122-physics-g10-1.example: Chee banyere nnwere onwe nke mmegharị.
20261122-physics-g10-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261122-physics-g10-2.title: Ọgbaghara na nchekwa, mmepụta kwụ ọtọ na ike ndọda
20261122-physics-g10-2.summary: A hapụrụ àkwá abụọ nwere otu ibu site n'otu ịdị elu, otu n'elu ala sịmenti, nke ọzọ n'elu ọdụ dị nro. Kedu ntụnyere nke ọnụ ọgụgụ physics ziri ezi site n'oge ọ bụla àkwá metụrụ n'elu ruo mgbe ọ kwụsịrị?
20261122-physics-g10-2.principle: Ebe mgbanwe momentum ($\Delta p$) nke àkwá abụọ bụ otu, impulse ($I = F\Delta t$) bụ otu. Ọdụ na-agbatị oge mgbagwoju anya $\Delta t$, na-ebelata ike ọkpọkọ nkezi $F = \frac{I}{\Delta t}$, yabụ àkwá anaghị agbaji.
20261122-physics-g10-2.example: Ebe ha si n'otu ịdị elu daa, ọsọ tupu mgbagwoju anya na mgbanwe ọsọ ruo izu ike (mgbanwe momentum = impulse) bụ otu.
20261122-physics-g10-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261122-physics-g11-1.title: Iwu mmegharị Newton na tiori mmekọrịta pụrụ iche
20261122-physics-g11-1.summary: Kedu ihe bụ ọdịiche physics bụ isi kachasị ziri ezi n'etiti 'mmekọrịta mmeghachi omume (action-reaction)' na 'nhaịlịgide ike abụọ'?
20261122-physics-g11-1.principle: Mmeghachi omume na-arụ ọrụ n'ihe abụọ dị iche na-emekọrịta, yabụ enweghị ike ijikọta ike abụọ ahụ, mana ike nhaịlịgide abụọ na-arụ ọrụ n'otu ihe, yabụ enwere ike ijikọta ha, ike niile ghọọkwa 0.
20261122-physics-g11-1.example: Mmeghachi omume: ike A na-etinye na B na ike B na-etinye na A
20261122-physics-g11-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261122-physics-g11-2.title: Iwu mmegharị Newton na tiori mmekọrịta pụrụ iche
20261122-physics-g11-2.summary: E tinyere ihe A dị 3 kg na ihe B dị 2 kg ka ha na-emetụ onwe ha n'elu larịị na-enweghị esemokwu, a tinyekwara ike larịị 20 N ịkwọ n'akụkụ A. Kedu ọsọ nke ihe abụọ na ịdị ukwuu nke ike A na-akwọ B, n'usoro?
20261122-physics-g11-2.principle: Ọsọ niile bụ $a = \frac{F}{m_A + m_B} = \frac{20\text{ N}}{5\text{ kg}} = 4\text{ m/s}^2$. Naanị ike niile na-eme ka ihe B mee ọsọ bụ ike mmetụ nke A na-akwọ B, yabụ $F_{AB} = m_B \cdot a = 2\text{ kg} \times 4\text{ m/s}^2 = 8\text{ N}$.
20261122-physics-g11-2.example: Maka usoro niile (A + B): F = (m<sub>A</sub> + m<sub>B</sub>) a → 20 = (3 + 2) a
20261122-physics-g11-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261122-physics-g12-1.title: Mmetụta photoelectric, ụdị abụọ nke ìhè na ụwa nta
20261122-physics-g12-1.summary: Kedu nsonaazụ nke nnwale photoelectric effect nke Einstein enweghị ike ikwu site na 'echiche ebili mmiri nke ìhè' ma 'echiche photon (akụkụ) nke ìhè' naanị na-akọwa ya kpamkpam?
20261122-physics-g12-1.principle: Echiche ebili mmiri na-ahụ ọdịnihu na ume na-achịkọta n'oge, mana na photoelectric effect otu photon dị n'elu threshold frequency na-agbagwo electron ozugbo ma na-ebufe ume ya, yabụ a na-ewepụta electron ozugbo na-enweghị igbu oge.
20261122-physics-g12-1.example: Dabere n'echiche ebili mmiri, ọbụna ìhè adịghị ike ma e tinye ya ogologo oge kwesịrị ịchịkọta ume wee wepụta electron, mana n'eziokwu a na-ewepụta ya ozugbo.
20261122-physics-g12-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261122-physics-g12-2.title: Mmetụta photoelectric, ụdị abụọ nke ìhè na ụwa nta
20261122-physics-g12-2.summary: Akụkụ nwere ụgwọ nwere ibu m na ụgwọ q na-abata n'ụzọ kwụ ọtọ n'ime ikpo magnet edoro anya B n'ọsọ v ma na-eme mmegharị gburugburu edoro anya. Kedu nhọrọ na-egosi nke ọma radius r na period T nke ụzọ gburugburu ya?
20261122-physics-g12-2.principle: Site na nha ike centripetal, $\frac{mv^2}{r} = qvB \implies r = \frac{mv}{qB}$. Period bụ $T = \frac{2\pi r}{v} = \frac{2\pi m}{qB}$, ma n'ụzọ na-eju anya, cyclotron period a adabereghị na radius ụzọ ma ọ bụ ọsọ.
20261122-physics-g12-2.example: Ike Lorentz na-arụ ọrụ dị ka ike centripetal nke mmegharị gburugburu: q v B = m v² / r
20261122-physics-g12-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261123-physics-g01-1.title: Ihe ndị magnet na-adọta na ike magnet
20261123-physics-g01-1.summary: Gịnị na-eme mgbe e weta okpuru N na S nke magnet nso ibe ha?
20261123-physics-g01-1.principle: Okpuru magnet dị iche (N na S) na-adọta ibe ha site n'ike mkpali (attraction), ebe okpuru ndị yiri ibe ha na-ezipụ ibe ha site n'ike mgbapụ (repulsion).
20261123-physics-g01-1.example: Chee echiche banyere ihe na-eme mgbe okpuru magnet dị iche na-ezute.
20261123-physics-g01-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261123-physics-g01-2.title: Ihe ndị magnet na-adọta na ike magnet
20261123-physics-g01-2.summary: E tinyere ihe mkpịsị ígwè n'ime iko plastik doro anya ma were magnet tụgharịa n'èzí iko ahụ. Gịnị ga-eme ihe mkpịsị ígwè ahụ mgbe a na-ebuli magnet nwayọọ gaa n'elu?
20261123-physics-g01-2.principle: Ike magnet (magnetic force) nwere ike ịgafe ihe dị gịrịgịrị dị ka plastik, akwụkwọ ma ọ bụ iko ma rụọ ọrụ n'ihe e ji ígwè mee.
20261123-physics-g01-2.example: Ike magnet nwere ike ịgafe plastik ma ọ bụ akwụkwọ dị gịrịgịrị.
20261123-physics-g01-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261123-physics-g02-1.title: Mkpọtụ na mbufe ụda
20261123-physics-g02-1.summary: A tụrụ ihe ụda (tuning fork) site na hama rabba ma kpọkọta ya nwayọọ n'elu mmiri n'ime ihe ọnụ mmiri. Gịnị na-eme?
20261123-physics-g02-1.principle: Ihe ụda na-ekwu ụda na-ama jijiji, ya mere mgbe ọ metụrụ mmiri, ọ na-efesa mmiri n'akụkụ niile ma na-eme ebili mmiri.
20261123-physics-g02-1.example: Ihe ụda na-ekwu ụda na-ama jijiji ngwa ngwa.
20261123-physics-g02-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261123-physics-g02-2.title: Mkpọtụ na mbufe ụda
20261123-physics-g02-2.summary: Mgbe a na-ekwurịta okwu site na 'ekwentị eriri' e mere site n'iko akwụkwọ abụọ na eriri silk, kedu ka olu onye ọzọ si anụ nke ọma karịa?
20261123-physics-g02-2.principle: N'ekwentị eriri, a na-ebufe mkpọtụ nke ala iko akwụkwọ site n'eriri, ya mere eriri ga-adị ọtọ ka mkpọtụ nwee ike ịga nke ọma n'akụkụ ọzọ.
20261123-physics-g02-2.example: A na-ebufe ụda site na mkpọtụ eriri.
20261123-physics-g02-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261123-physics-g03-1.title: Mgbasa ìhè n'ahịrị kwụ ọtọ na mgbanwe onyinyo
20261123-physics-g03-1.summary: E debere akwụkwọ atọ nwere oghere n'usoro n'ihu ọkụ ọkụ ọkụ. Kedu ka e kwesịrị ịhazi oghere ahụ ka a hụ ìhè n'akụkụ nke ọzọ?
20261123-physics-g03-1.principle: Ìhè na-agbasa n'ahịrị kwụ ọtọ, ya mere ọ nwere ike ịgafe oghere niile naanị mgbe oghere atọ ahụ dị n'otu ahịrị.
20261123-physics-g03-1.example: Ìhè enweghị ike gafere n'ụzọ gbagọrọ agbagọ.
20261123-physics-g03-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261123-physics-g03-2.title: Mgbasa ìhè n'ahịrị kwụ ọtọ na mgbanwe onyinyo
20261123-physics-g03-2.summary: Anyị chọrọ ka onyinyo nke teddy bear n'ihuenyo bụrụ nke ka ukwuu karịa ugbu a. Kedu ụzọ kwesịrị ekwesị?
20261123-physics-g03-2.principle: Ka isi iyi ìhè (ọkụ ọkụ ọkụ) na ihe dị nso, ka ihe na-ekpuchi akụkụ ìhè ka ukwuu, ya mere onyinyo n'ihuenyo na-abawanye.
20261123-physics-g03-2.example: Ka ihe dị nso n'isi iyi ìhè, ka ọ na-ekpuchi mpaghara ìhè ka ukwuu.
20261123-physics-g03-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261123-physics-g04-1.title: Ihe nha abụọ na ụkpụrụ nhazi
20261123-physics-g04-1.summary: E kwụrụ ibu 20 g n'ebe dị n'ogo 4 sistemụ n'aka ekpe site n'ebe mkpọchi nke ihe nha abụọ. Kedu ibu e kwesịrị ịkwụ n'aka nri n'ogo 2 sistemụ ka ihe nha ahụ dị n'ahụ nhazi?
20261123-physics-g04-1.principle: Dị ka ụkpụrụ nhazi si dị, oge aka ekpe ($4\text{ nkeji} \times 20\text{ g} = 80$) na oge aka nri ($2\text{ nkeji} \times ? = 80$) ga-abụ otu, ya mere a ga-akwụ ibu $40\text{ g}$.
20261123-physics-g04-1.example: Gbakọọ (anya aka ekpe × ibu) = (anya aka nri × ibu).
20261123-physics-g04-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261123-physics-g04-2.title: Ihe nha abụọ na ụkpụrụ nhazi
20261123-physics-g04-2.summary: Mgbe nwanna nwoke dị 40 kg na nwa nta dị 20 kg na-egwu n'elu seesaw, kedu ka ha kwesịrị ịnọdụ ka seesaw dị n'ahụ nhazi?
20261123-physics-g04-2.principle: Ka seesaw dị n'ahụ nhazi, nwanna nwoke dị arọ ($40\text{ kg}$) ga-anọdụ ọkara anya nso n'ebe mkpọchi karịa nwa nta dị mfe ($20\text{ kg}$).
20261123-physics-g04-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261123-physics-g05-1.title: Nkọwa ọsọ na ntụnyere
20261123-physics-g05-1.summary: Kedu n'ime nkọwa sayensị ndị a gbasara ntụnyere ọsọ nke ihe ziri ezi?
20261123-physics-g05-1.principle: Mgbe e gafere otu ụzọ, ka oge dị mkpụmkpụ, ka ọ na-adị ngwa, ma mgbe e ji otu oge gaa, ka ụzọ e gafere dị ogologo, ka ọsọ dị ukwuu.
20261123-physics-g05-1.example: N'asọmpi ọsọ, onye mbụ na-eru ebe njedebe n'oge kacha nta.
20261123-physics-g05-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261123-physics-g05-2.title: Nkọwa ọsọ na ntụnyere
20261123-physics-g05-2.summary: Mgbe a na-ekpebi nnwale iji tụnyere ọsọ bọl ígwè na-agbagharị n'ala mkpọka dị iche iche n'ụzọ ziri ezi, kedu n'ime ndị a abụghị 'ọnọdụ a ga-edebe otu (control variable)'?
20261123-physics-g05-2.principle: N'ihi na anyị na-enyocha ọsọ dị ka akụkụ mkpọka si dị, akụkụ mkpọka bụ 'ọnọdụ a na-agbanwe', ma ọnọdụ ndị ọzọ ga-edebe otu.
20261123-physics-g05-2.example: Chọta ọnọdụ anyị na-agbanwe n'ụzọ na-agbanwe (independent variable).
20261123-physics-g05-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261123-physics-g06-1.title: Njikọ circuit na onyinyo convex lens
20261123-physics-g06-1.summary: A chọrọ iji batrị otu, bọlb abụọ na switch jikọọ ya site na waya ka bọlb nwee ike enwu. Kedu ọnọdụ 'circuit mechiri emechi' nke ọkụ na-enwu bụ nke ziri ezi?
20261123-physics-g06-1.principle: Ka ọkụ eletrik gafee, a ga-eme circuit mechiri emechi nke jikọtara na-agbaghị agba site n'otu okpuru batrị gafee akụrụngwa eletrik ruo n'okpuru nke ọzọ.
20261123-physics-g06-1.example: Ọkụ eletrik nwere ike ịgafe naanị mgbe waya jikọtara ma ọ dịghị agbaji.
20261123-physics-g06-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261123-physics-g06-2.title: Njikọ circuit na onyinyo convex lens
20261123-physics-g06-2.summary: Kedu n'ime nkọwa ndị a gbasara ntụnyere circuit nwere bọlb abụọ yiri ibe ha jikọtara n'usoro (series) na nke jikọtara n'otu ụzọ (parallel) ziri ezi?
20261123-physics-g06-2.principle: Mgbe e jikọtara bọlb parallel, voltage zuru ezu nke batrị na-agbado bọlb ọ bụla, ya mere ha na-enwu karịa, ọbụlagodi ma otu bọlb gbajiri, circuit nke bọlb ndị ọzọ na-anọgide.
20261123-physics-g06-2.example: Chee echiche banyere ụlọ ebe ọ bụrụ na e gbanyụọ ọkụ n'otu ụlọ, ọkụ n'ime ụlọ nzuko na-anọgide na-enwu.
20261123-physics-g06-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261123-physics-g07-1.title: Nhazi ike ndọda, ikpuru na buoyancy
20261123-physics-g07-1.summary: Onye mbara igwe nke ibu ya bụ 60 kg n'Ụwa rutere n'elu Ọnwa. Kedu nkọwa gbasara 'ibu (mass)' na 'ịdị arọ (weight)' ya n'ọnwa ziri ezi? (Ike ndọda Ọnwa bụ 1/6 nke Ụwa.)
20261123-physics-g07-1.principle: Ibu bụ ọnụọgụ ihe nke ahụ, ya mere ọ na-adị otu (60 kg) n'agbanyeghị ebe, mana ịdị arọ bụ ike ndọda, ya mere n'Ọnwa ọ na-ebelata ruo 1/6 nke Ụwa, ihe dị ka 98 N.
20261123-physics-g07-1.example: Ibu bụ ọnụọgụ ihe ahụ nwere, ya mere ọ naghị agbanwe site n'ebe.
20261123-physics-g07-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261123-physics-g07-2.title: Nhazi ike ndọda, ikpuru na buoyancy
20261123-physics-g07-2.summary: E debere ibe osisi n'elu akwụkwọ nkọ na iko ma dọpụta ya site na spring scale iji tụọ ike ikpuru kwụsiri ike kacha ukwuu. Kedu n'ime ndị a abụghị ọnọdụ a ga-achịkwa?
20261123-physics-g07-2.principle: Ebe nnwale a bụ ịtụ mgbanwe ikpuru dị ka ịdị gbagọrọ agbagọ nke ala si dị, 'ịdị gbagọrọ agbagọ nke ala' ga-abụ ọnọdụ a na-agbanwe, a gaghị edebe ya otu.
20261123-physics-g07-2.example: Ebumnuche nnwale a bụ ịmata ọdịiche ikpuru dị ka 'ụdị ala (ịdị gbagọrọ agbagọ)' si dị.
20261123-physics-g07-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261123-physics-g08-1.title: Iwu Ohm na ikike ọkụ
20261123-physics-g08-1.summary: E tinyere voltage 30 V n'ọnụ waya nichrome nke nguzogide ya bụ 10 Ω. Kedu ike ọkụ eletrik na-agafe waya ahụ?
20261123-physics-g08-1.principle: Dị ka iwu Ohm si dị, ike ọkụ eletrik bụ $I = \frac{V}{R} = \frac{30\text{ V}}{10\,\Omega} = 3\text{ A}$.
20261123-physics-g08-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261123-physics-g08-2.title: Iwu Ohm na ikike ọkụ
20261123-physics-g08-2.summary: Ọkụ eletrik na-agafe waya kwụ ọtọ site n'ala gaa n'elu. N'ụzọ kedu ka okpuru N nke kompas dị nso n'ugwu waya ahụ ga-atụgharị dị ka iwu aka nri Ampère si dị?
20261123-physics-g08-2.principle: Mgbe isi mkpịsị aka nri na-atụ aka n'ụzọ ọkụ eletrik (n'elu), ngalaba magnet gburugburu nke mkpịsị aka anọ na-eme na-atụ aka n'ọdịda anyanwụ n'ugwu waya, ya mere okpuru N nke kompas na-atụgharị n'ọdịda anyanwụ.
20261123-physics-g08-2.example: Bulie isi mkpịsị aka nri n'ụzọ ọkụ eletrik (n'elu) ma kechie waya site na mkpịsị aka anọ ndị ọzọ.
20261123-physics-g08-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261123-physics-g09-1.title: Ọrụ na mgbanwe ume mechanical
20261123-physics-g09-1.summary: N'ihe gbasara physics, kedu ọnọdụ ka 'ọrụ sayensị' e rụrụ bụ efu?
20261123-physics-g09-1.principle: Mgbe ị na-eje ije n'ụzọ dị larịị na-ebu igbe, ike ị na-eji (ike elu na-ejide ibu) na ntụziaka mmegharị (dị larịị) na-eme akụkụ ziri ezi nke $90^\circ$, yabụ ọ dịghị akụkụ nke ike na-arụ ọrụ n'ntụziaka mmegharị, ọrụ e rụrụ bụkwa $0$.
20261123-physics-g09-1.example: Ọrụ sayensị bụ W = F × s × cos(θ).
20261123-physics-g09-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261123-physics-g09-2.title: Ọrụ na mgbanwe ume mechanical
20261123-physics-g09-2.summary: A tụrụ ebe a kwọpụrụ otu mpempe osisi mgbe ụgbọ ịkwọ nwere ibu na ọsọ dị iche iche kụrụ ya. Kedu nkwubi okwu ziri ezi gbasara ume mmegharị (kinetic energy)?
20261123-physics-g09-2.principle: Ebe ume mmegharị bụ $E_k = \frac{1}{2}mv^2$, ọ kwesịrị ibu ihe ma kwesịkwa square nke ọsọ ya.
20261123-physics-g09-2.example: Usoro ume mmegharị: E<sub>k</sub> = (1/2) m v²
20261123-physics-g09-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261123-physics-g10-1.title: Ọgbaghara na nchekwa, mmepụta kwụ ọtọ na ike ndọda
20261123-physics-g10-1.summary: Nso n'elu ụwa, n'ime bọọlụ ígwè abụọ A na B n'otu ịdị elu, a hapụrụ A site n'izu ike ka ọ daa n'efu, a gbapụrụ B n'ike n'akụkụ larịị. Kedu nkọwa ziri ezi gbasara mmegharị ha? (Ghara ileghara ọgbụgba ikuku.)
20261123-physics-g10-1.principle: Mmegharị larịị na-adịgide adịgide na mmegharị ọdịda n'efu kwụ ọtọ adabereghị n'ibe ibe. Bọọlụ abụọ ahụ na-ada kwụ ọtọ n'otu ọsọ ike ndọda $g$, yabụ ha na-eru n'ala n'otu oge.
20261123-physics-g10-1.example: Chee banyere nnwere onwe nke mmegharị.
20261123-physics-g10-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261123-physics-g10-2.title: Ọgbaghara na nchekwa, mmepụta kwụ ọtọ na ike ndọda
20261123-physics-g10-2.summary: A hapụrụ àkwá abụọ nwere otu ibu site n'otu ịdị elu, otu n'elu ala sịmenti, nke ọzọ n'elu ọdụ dị nro. Kedu ntụnyere nke ọnụ ọgụgụ physics ziri ezi site n'oge ọ bụla àkwá metụrụ n'elu ruo mgbe ọ kwụsịrị?
20261123-physics-g10-2.principle: Ebe mgbanwe momentum ($\Delta p$) nke àkwá abụọ bụ otu, impulse ($I = F\Delta t$) bụ otu. Ọdụ na-agbatị oge mgbagwoju anya $\Delta t$, na-ebelata ike ọkpọkọ nkezi $F = \frac{I}{\Delta t}$, yabụ àkwá anaghị agbaji.
20261123-physics-g10-2.example: Ebe ha si n'otu ịdị elu daa, ọsọ tupu mgbagwoju anya na mgbanwe ọsọ ruo izu ike (mgbanwe momentum = impulse) bụ otu.
20261123-physics-g10-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261123-physics-g11-1.title: Iwu mmegharị Newton na tiori mmekọrịta pụrụ iche
20261123-physics-g11-1.summary: Kedu ihe bụ ọdịiche physics bụ isi kachasị ziri ezi n'etiti 'mmekọrịta mmeghachi omume (action-reaction)' na 'nhaịlịgide ike abụọ'?
20261123-physics-g11-1.principle: Mmeghachi omume na-arụ ọrụ n'ihe abụọ dị iche na-emekọrịta, yabụ enweghị ike ijikọta ike abụọ ahụ, mana ike nhaịlịgide abụọ na-arụ ọrụ n'otu ihe, yabụ enwere ike ijikọta ha, ike niile ghọọkwa 0.
20261123-physics-g11-1.example: Mmeghachi omume: ike A na-etinye na B na ike B na-etinye na A
20261123-physics-g11-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261123-physics-g11-2.title: Iwu mmegharị Newton na tiori mmekọrịta pụrụ iche
20261123-physics-g11-2.summary: E tinyere ihe A dị 3 kg na ihe B dị 2 kg ka ha na-emetụ onwe ha n'elu larịị na-enweghị esemokwu, a tinyekwara ike larịị 20 N ịkwọ n'akụkụ A. Kedu ọsọ nke ihe abụọ na ịdị ukwuu nke ike A na-akwọ B, n'usoro?
20261123-physics-g11-2.principle: Ọsọ niile bụ $a = \frac{F}{m_A + m_B} = \frac{20\text{ N}}{5\text{ kg}} = 4\text{ m/s}^2$. Naanị ike niile na-eme ka ihe B mee ọsọ bụ ike mmetụ nke A na-akwọ B, yabụ $F_{AB} = m_B \cdot a = 2\text{ kg} \times 4\text{ m/s}^2 = 8\text{ N}$.
20261123-physics-g11-2.example: Maka usoro niile (A + B): F = (m<sub>A</sub> + m<sub>B</sub>) a → 20 = (3 + 2) a
20261123-physics-g11-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261123-physics-g12-1.title: Mmetụta photoelectric, ụdị abụọ nke ìhè na ụwa nta
20261123-physics-g12-1.summary: Kedu nsonaazụ nke nnwale photoelectric effect nke Einstein enweghị ike ikwu site na 'echiche ebili mmiri nke ìhè' ma 'echiche photon (akụkụ) nke ìhè' naanị na-akọwa ya kpamkpam?
20261123-physics-g12-1.principle: Echiche ebili mmiri na-ahụ ọdịnihu na ume na-achịkọta n'oge, mana na photoelectric effect otu photon dị n'elu threshold frequency na-agbagwo electron ozugbo ma na-ebufe ume ya, yabụ a na-ewepụta electron ozugbo na-enweghị igbu oge.
20261123-physics-g12-1.example: Dabere n'echiche ebili mmiri, ọbụna ìhè adịghị ike ma e tinye ya ogologo oge kwesịrị ịchịkọta ume wee wepụta electron, mana n'eziokwu a na-ewepụta ya ozugbo.
20261123-physics-g12-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261123-physics-g12-2.title: Mmetụta photoelectric, ụdị abụọ nke ìhè na ụwa nta
20261123-physics-g12-2.summary: Akụkụ nwere ụgwọ nwere ibu m na ụgwọ q na-abata n'ụzọ kwụ ọtọ n'ime ikpo magnet edoro anya B n'ọsọ v ma na-eme mmegharị gburugburu edoro anya. Kedu nhọrọ na-egosi nke ọma radius r na period T nke ụzọ gburugburu ya?
20261123-physics-g12-2.principle: Site na nha ike centripetal, $\frac{mv^2}{r} = qvB \implies r = \frac{mv}{qB}$. Period bụ $T = \frac{2\pi r}{v} = \frac{2\pi m}{qB}$, ma n'ụzọ na-eju anya, cyclotron period a adabereghị na radius ụzọ ma ọ bụ ọsọ.
20261123-physics-g12-2.example: Ike Lorentz na-arụ ọrụ dị ka ike centripetal nke mmegharị gburugburu: q v B = m v² / r
20261123-physics-g12-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261124-physics-g01-1.title: Ihe ndị magnet na-adọta na ike magnet
20261124-physics-g01-1.summary: Gịnị na-eme mgbe e weta okpuru N na S nke magnet nso ibe ha?
20261124-physics-g01-1.principle: Okpuru magnet dị iche (N na S) na-adọta ibe ha site n'ike mkpali (attraction), ebe okpuru ndị yiri ibe ha na-ezipụ ibe ha site n'ike mgbapụ (repulsion).
20261124-physics-g01-1.example: Chee echiche banyere ihe na-eme mgbe okpuru magnet dị iche na-ezute.
20261124-physics-g01-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261124-physics-g01-2.title: Ihe ndị magnet na-adọta na ike magnet
20261124-physics-g01-2.summary: E tinyere ihe mkpịsị ígwè n'ime iko plastik doro anya ma were magnet tụgharịa n'èzí iko ahụ. Gịnị ga-eme ihe mkpịsị ígwè ahụ mgbe a na-ebuli magnet nwayọọ gaa n'elu?
20261124-physics-g01-2.principle: Ike magnet (magnetic force) nwere ike ịgafe ihe dị gịrịgịrị dị ka plastik, akwụkwọ ma ọ bụ iko ma rụọ ọrụ n'ihe e ji ígwè mee.
20261124-physics-g01-2.example: Ike magnet nwere ike ịgafe plastik ma ọ bụ akwụkwọ dị gịrịgịrị.
20261124-physics-g01-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261124-physics-g02-1.title: Mkpọtụ na mbufe ụda
20261124-physics-g02-1.summary: A tụrụ ihe ụda (tuning fork) site na hama rabba ma kpọkọta ya nwayọọ n'elu mmiri n'ime ihe ọnụ mmiri. Gịnị na-eme?
20261124-physics-g02-1.principle: Ihe ụda na-ekwu ụda na-ama jijiji, ya mere mgbe ọ metụrụ mmiri, ọ na-efesa mmiri n'akụkụ niile ma na-eme ebili mmiri.
20261124-physics-g02-1.example: Ihe ụda na-ekwu ụda na-ama jijiji ngwa ngwa.
20261124-physics-g02-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261124-physics-g02-2.title: Mkpọtụ na mbufe ụda
20261124-physics-g02-2.summary: Mgbe a na-ekwurịta okwu site na 'ekwentị eriri' e mere site n'iko akwụkwọ abụọ na eriri silk, kedu ka olu onye ọzọ si anụ nke ọma karịa?
20261124-physics-g02-2.principle: N'ekwentị eriri, a na-ebufe mkpọtụ nke ala iko akwụkwọ site n'eriri, ya mere eriri ga-adị ọtọ ka mkpọtụ nwee ike ịga nke ọma n'akụkụ ọzọ.
20261124-physics-g02-2.example: A na-ebufe ụda site na mkpọtụ eriri.
20261124-physics-g02-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261124-physics-g03-1.title: Mgbasa ìhè n'ahịrị kwụ ọtọ na mgbanwe onyinyo
20261124-physics-g03-1.summary: E debere akwụkwọ atọ nwere oghere n'usoro n'ihu ọkụ ọkụ ọkụ. Kedu ka e kwesịrị ịhazi oghere ahụ ka a hụ ìhè n'akụkụ nke ọzọ?
20261124-physics-g03-1.principle: Ìhè na-agbasa n'ahịrị kwụ ọtọ, ya mere ọ nwere ike ịgafe oghere niile naanị mgbe oghere atọ ahụ dị n'otu ahịrị.
20261124-physics-g03-1.example: Ìhè enweghị ike gafere n'ụzọ gbagọrọ agbagọ.
20261124-physics-g03-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261124-physics-g03-2.title: Mgbasa ìhè n'ahịrị kwụ ọtọ na mgbanwe onyinyo
20261124-physics-g03-2.summary: Anyị chọrọ ka onyinyo nke teddy bear n'ihuenyo bụrụ nke ka ukwuu karịa ugbu a. Kedu ụzọ kwesịrị ekwesị?
20261124-physics-g03-2.principle: Ka isi iyi ìhè (ọkụ ọkụ ọkụ) na ihe dị nso, ka ihe na-ekpuchi akụkụ ìhè ka ukwuu, ya mere onyinyo n'ihuenyo na-abawanye.
20261124-physics-g03-2.example: Ka ihe dị nso n'isi iyi ìhè, ka ọ na-ekpuchi mpaghara ìhè ka ukwuu.
20261124-physics-g03-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261124-physics-g04-1.title: Ihe nha abụọ na ụkpụrụ nhazi
20261124-physics-g04-1.summary: E kwụrụ ibu 20 g n'ebe dị n'ogo 4 sistemụ n'aka ekpe site n'ebe mkpọchi nke ihe nha abụọ. Kedu ibu e kwesịrị ịkwụ n'aka nri n'ogo 2 sistemụ ka ihe nha ahụ dị n'ahụ nhazi?
20261124-physics-g04-1.principle: Dị ka ụkpụrụ nhazi si dị, oge aka ekpe ($4\text{ nkeji} \times 20\text{ g} = 80$) na oge aka nri ($2\text{ nkeji} \times ? = 80$) ga-abụ otu, ya mere a ga-akwụ ibu $40\text{ g}$.
20261124-physics-g04-1.example: Gbakọọ (anya aka ekpe × ibu) = (anya aka nri × ibu).
20261124-physics-g04-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261124-physics-g04-2.title: Ihe nha abụọ na ụkpụrụ nhazi
20261124-physics-g04-2.summary: Mgbe nwanna nwoke dị 40 kg na nwa nta dị 20 kg na-egwu n'elu seesaw, kedu ka ha kwesịrị ịnọdụ ka seesaw dị n'ahụ nhazi?
20261124-physics-g04-2.principle: Ka seesaw dị n'ahụ nhazi, nwanna nwoke dị arọ ($40\text{ kg}$) ga-anọdụ ọkara anya nso n'ebe mkpọchi karịa nwa nta dị mfe ($20\text{ kg}$).
20261124-physics-g04-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261124-physics-g05-1.title: Nkọwa ọsọ na ntụnyere
20261124-physics-g05-1.summary: Kedu n'ime nkọwa sayensị ndị a gbasara ntụnyere ọsọ nke ihe ziri ezi?
20261124-physics-g05-1.principle: Mgbe e gafere otu ụzọ, ka oge dị mkpụmkpụ, ka ọ na-adị ngwa, ma mgbe e ji otu oge gaa, ka ụzọ e gafere dị ogologo, ka ọsọ dị ukwuu.
20261124-physics-g05-1.example: N'asọmpi ọsọ, onye mbụ na-eru ebe njedebe n'oge kacha nta.
20261124-physics-g05-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261124-physics-g05-2.title: Nkọwa ọsọ na ntụnyere
20261124-physics-g05-2.summary: Mgbe a na-ekpebi nnwale iji tụnyere ọsọ bọl ígwè na-agbagharị n'ala mkpọka dị iche iche n'ụzọ ziri ezi, kedu n'ime ndị a abụghị 'ọnọdụ a ga-edebe otu (control variable)'?
20261124-physics-g05-2.principle: N'ihi na anyị na-enyocha ọsọ dị ka akụkụ mkpọka si dị, akụkụ mkpọka bụ 'ọnọdụ a na-agbanwe', ma ọnọdụ ndị ọzọ ga-edebe otu.
20261124-physics-g05-2.example: Chọta ọnọdụ anyị na-agbanwe n'ụzọ na-agbanwe (independent variable).
20261124-physics-g05-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261124-physics-g06-1.title: Njikọ circuit na onyinyo convex lens
20261124-physics-g06-1.summary: A chọrọ iji batrị otu, bọlb abụọ na switch jikọọ ya site na waya ka bọlb nwee ike enwu. Kedu ọnọdụ 'circuit mechiri emechi' nke ọkụ na-enwu bụ nke ziri ezi?
20261124-physics-g06-1.principle: Ka ọkụ eletrik gafee, a ga-eme circuit mechiri emechi nke jikọtara na-agbaghị agba site n'otu okpuru batrị gafee akụrụngwa eletrik ruo n'okpuru nke ọzọ.
20261124-physics-g06-1.example: Ọkụ eletrik nwere ike ịgafe naanị mgbe waya jikọtara ma ọ dịghị agbaji.
20261124-physics-g06-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261124-physics-g06-2.title: Njikọ circuit na onyinyo convex lens
20261124-physics-g06-2.summary: Kedu n'ime nkọwa ndị a gbasara ntụnyere circuit nwere bọlb abụọ yiri ibe ha jikọtara n'usoro (series) na nke jikọtara n'otu ụzọ (parallel) ziri ezi?
20261124-physics-g06-2.principle: Mgbe e jikọtara bọlb parallel, voltage zuru ezu nke batrị na-agbado bọlb ọ bụla, ya mere ha na-enwu karịa, ọbụlagodi ma otu bọlb gbajiri, circuit nke bọlb ndị ọzọ na-anọgide.
20261124-physics-g06-2.example: Chee echiche banyere ụlọ ebe ọ bụrụ na e gbanyụọ ọkụ n'otu ụlọ, ọkụ n'ime ụlọ nzuko na-anọgide na-enwu.
20261124-physics-g06-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261124-physics-g07-1.title: Nhazi ike ndọda, ikpuru na buoyancy
20261124-physics-g07-1.summary: Onye mbara igwe nke ibu ya bụ 60 kg n'Ụwa rutere n'elu Ọnwa. Kedu nkọwa gbasara 'ibu (mass)' na 'ịdị arọ (weight)' ya n'ọnwa ziri ezi? (Ike ndọda Ọnwa bụ 1/6 nke Ụwa.)
20261124-physics-g07-1.principle: Ibu bụ ọnụọgụ ihe nke ahụ, ya mere ọ na-adị otu (60 kg) n'agbanyeghị ebe, mana ịdị arọ bụ ike ndọda, ya mere n'Ọnwa ọ na-ebelata ruo 1/6 nke Ụwa, ihe dị ka 98 N.
20261124-physics-g07-1.example: Ibu bụ ọnụọgụ ihe ahụ nwere, ya mere ọ naghị agbanwe site n'ebe.
20261124-physics-g07-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261124-physics-g07-2.title: Nhazi ike ndọda, ikpuru na buoyancy
20261124-physics-g07-2.summary: E debere ibe osisi n'elu akwụkwọ nkọ na iko ma dọpụta ya site na spring scale iji tụọ ike ikpuru kwụsiri ike kacha ukwuu. Kedu n'ime ndị a abụghị ọnọdụ a ga-achịkwa?
20261124-physics-g07-2.principle: Ebe nnwale a bụ ịtụ mgbanwe ikpuru dị ka ịdị gbagọrọ agbagọ nke ala si dị, 'ịdị gbagọrọ agbagọ nke ala' ga-abụ ọnọdụ a na-agbanwe, a gaghị edebe ya otu.
20261124-physics-g07-2.example: Ebumnuche nnwale a bụ ịmata ọdịiche ikpuru dị ka 'ụdị ala (ịdị gbagọrọ agbagọ)' si dị.
20261124-physics-g07-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261124-physics-g08-1.title: Iwu Ohm na ikike ọkụ
20261124-physics-g08-1.summary: E tinyere voltage 30 V n'ọnụ waya nichrome nke nguzogide ya bụ 10 Ω. Kedu ike ọkụ eletrik na-agafe waya ahụ?
20261124-physics-g08-1.principle: Dị ka iwu Ohm si dị, ike ọkụ eletrik bụ $I = \frac{V}{R} = \frac{30\text{ V}}{10\,\Omega} = 3\text{ A}$.
20261124-physics-g08-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261124-physics-g08-2.title: Iwu Ohm na ikike ọkụ
20261124-physics-g08-2.summary: Ọkụ eletrik na-agafe waya kwụ ọtọ site n'ala gaa n'elu. N'ụzọ kedu ka okpuru N nke kompas dị nso n'ugwu waya ahụ ga-atụgharị dị ka iwu aka nri Ampère si dị?
20261124-physics-g08-2.principle: Mgbe isi mkpịsị aka nri na-atụ aka n'ụzọ ọkụ eletrik (n'elu), ngalaba magnet gburugburu nke mkpịsị aka anọ na-eme na-atụ aka n'ọdịda anyanwụ n'ugwu waya, ya mere okpuru N nke kompas na-atụgharị n'ọdịda anyanwụ.
20261124-physics-g08-2.example: Bulie isi mkpịsị aka nri n'ụzọ ọkụ eletrik (n'elu) ma kechie waya site na mkpịsị aka anọ ndị ọzọ.
20261124-physics-g08-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261124-physics-g09-1.title: Ọrụ na mgbanwe ume mechanical
20261124-physics-g09-1.summary: N'ihe gbasara physics, kedu ọnọdụ ka 'ọrụ sayensị' e rụrụ bụ efu?
20261124-physics-g09-1.principle: Mgbe ị na-eje ije n'ụzọ dị larịị na-ebu igbe, ike ị na-eji (ike elu na-ejide ibu) na ntụziaka mmegharị (dị larịị) na-eme akụkụ ziri ezi nke $90^\circ$, yabụ ọ dịghị akụkụ nke ike na-arụ ọrụ n'ntụziaka mmegharị, ọrụ e rụrụ bụkwa $0$.
20261124-physics-g09-1.example: Ọrụ sayensị bụ W = F × s × cos(θ).
20261124-physics-g09-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261124-physics-g09-2.title: Ọrụ na mgbanwe ume mechanical
20261124-physics-g09-2.summary: A tụrụ ebe a kwọpụrụ otu mpempe osisi mgbe ụgbọ ịkwọ nwere ibu na ọsọ dị iche iche kụrụ ya. Kedu nkwubi okwu ziri ezi gbasara ume mmegharị (kinetic energy)?
20261124-physics-g09-2.principle: Ebe ume mmegharị bụ $E_k = \frac{1}{2}mv^2$, ọ kwesịrị ibu ihe ma kwesịkwa square nke ọsọ ya.
20261124-physics-g09-2.example: Usoro ume mmegharị: E<sub>k</sub> = (1/2) m v²
20261124-physics-g09-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261124-physics-g10-1.title: Ọgbaghara na nchekwa, mmepụta kwụ ọtọ na ike ndọda
20261124-physics-g10-1.summary: Nso n'elu ụwa, n'ime bọọlụ ígwè abụọ A na B n'otu ịdị elu, a hapụrụ A site n'izu ike ka ọ daa n'efu, a gbapụrụ B n'ike n'akụkụ larịị. Kedu nkọwa ziri ezi gbasara mmegharị ha? (Ghara ileghara ọgbụgba ikuku.)
20261124-physics-g10-1.principle: Mmegharị larịị na-adịgide adịgide na mmegharị ọdịda n'efu kwụ ọtọ adabereghị n'ibe ibe. Bọọlụ abụọ ahụ na-ada kwụ ọtọ n'otu ọsọ ike ndọda $g$, yabụ ha na-eru n'ala n'otu oge.
20261124-physics-g10-1.example: Chee banyere nnwere onwe nke mmegharị.
20261124-physics-g10-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261124-physics-g10-2.title: Ọgbaghara na nchekwa, mmepụta kwụ ọtọ na ike ndọda
20261124-physics-g10-2.summary: A hapụrụ àkwá abụọ nwere otu ibu site n'otu ịdị elu, otu n'elu ala sịmenti, nke ọzọ n'elu ọdụ dị nro. Kedu ntụnyere nke ọnụ ọgụgụ physics ziri ezi site n'oge ọ bụla àkwá metụrụ n'elu ruo mgbe ọ kwụsịrị?
20261124-physics-g10-2.principle: Ebe mgbanwe momentum ($\Delta p$) nke àkwá abụọ bụ otu, impulse ($I = F\Delta t$) bụ otu. Ọdụ na-agbatị oge mgbagwoju anya $\Delta t$, na-ebelata ike ọkpọkọ nkezi $F = \frac{I}{\Delta t}$, yabụ àkwá anaghị agbaji.
20261124-physics-g10-2.example: Ebe ha si n'otu ịdị elu daa, ọsọ tupu mgbagwoju anya na mgbanwe ọsọ ruo izu ike (mgbanwe momentum = impulse) bụ otu.
20261124-physics-g10-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261124-physics-g11-1.title: Iwu mmegharị Newton na tiori mmekọrịta pụrụ iche
20261124-physics-g11-1.summary: Kedu ihe bụ ọdịiche physics bụ isi kachasị ziri ezi n'etiti 'mmekọrịta mmeghachi omume (action-reaction)' na 'nhaịlịgide ike abụọ'?
20261124-physics-g11-1.principle: Mmeghachi omume na-arụ ọrụ n'ihe abụọ dị iche na-emekọrịta, yabụ enweghị ike ijikọta ike abụọ ahụ, mana ike nhaịlịgide abụọ na-arụ ọrụ n'otu ihe, yabụ enwere ike ijikọta ha, ike niile ghọọkwa 0.
20261124-physics-g11-1.example: Mmeghachi omume: ike A na-etinye na B na ike B na-etinye na A
20261124-physics-g11-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261124-physics-g11-2.title: Iwu mmegharị Newton na tiori mmekọrịta pụrụ iche
20261124-physics-g11-2.summary: E tinyere ihe A dị 3 kg na ihe B dị 2 kg ka ha na-emetụ onwe ha n'elu larịị na-enweghị esemokwu, a tinyekwara ike larịị 20 N ịkwọ n'akụkụ A. Kedu ọsọ nke ihe abụọ na ịdị ukwuu nke ike A na-akwọ B, n'usoro?
20261124-physics-g11-2.principle: Ọsọ niile bụ $a = \frac{F}{m_A + m_B} = \frac{20\text{ N}}{5\text{ kg}} = 4\text{ m/s}^2$. Naanị ike niile na-eme ka ihe B mee ọsọ bụ ike mmetụ nke A na-akwọ B, yabụ $F_{AB} = m_B \cdot a = 2\text{ kg} \times 4\text{ m/s}^2 = 8\text{ N}$.
20261124-physics-g11-2.example: Maka usoro niile (A + B): F = (m<sub>A</sub> + m<sub>B</sub>) a → 20 = (3 + 2) a
20261124-physics-g11-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261124-physics-g12-1.title: Mmetụta photoelectric, ụdị abụọ nke ìhè na ụwa nta
20261124-physics-g12-1.summary: Kedu nsonaazụ nke nnwale photoelectric effect nke Einstein enweghị ike ikwu site na 'echiche ebili mmiri nke ìhè' ma 'echiche photon (akụkụ) nke ìhè' naanị na-akọwa ya kpamkpam?
20261124-physics-g12-1.principle: Echiche ebili mmiri na-ahụ ọdịnihu na ume na-achịkọta n'oge, mana na photoelectric effect otu photon dị n'elu threshold frequency na-agbagwo electron ozugbo ma na-ebufe ume ya, yabụ a na-ewepụta electron ozugbo na-enweghị igbu oge.
20261124-physics-g12-1.example: Dabere n'echiche ebili mmiri, ọbụna ìhè adịghị ike ma e tinye ya ogologo oge kwesịrị ịchịkọta ume wee wepụta electron, mana n'eziokwu a na-ewepụta ya ozugbo.
20261124-physics-g12-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261124-physics-g12-2.title: Mmetụta photoelectric, ụdị abụọ nke ìhè na ụwa nta
20261124-physics-g12-2.summary: Akụkụ nwere ụgwọ nwere ibu m na ụgwọ q na-abata n'ụzọ kwụ ọtọ n'ime ikpo magnet edoro anya B n'ọsọ v ma na-eme mmegharị gburugburu edoro anya. Kedu nhọrọ na-egosi nke ọma radius r na period T nke ụzọ gburugburu ya?
20261124-physics-g12-2.principle: Site na nha ike centripetal, $\frac{mv^2}{r} = qvB \implies r = \frac{mv}{qB}$. Period bụ $T = \frac{2\pi r}{v} = \frac{2\pi m}{qB}$, ma n'ụzọ na-eju anya, cyclotron period a adabereghị na radius ụzọ ma ọ bụ ọsọ.
20261124-physics-g12-2.example: Ike Lorentz na-arụ ọrụ dị ka ike centripetal nke mmegharị gburugburu: q v B = m v² / r
20261124-physics-g12-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261125-physics-g01-1.title: Ihe ndị magnet na-adọta na ike magnet
20261125-physics-g01-1.summary: Gịnị na-eme mgbe e weta okpuru N na S nke magnet nso ibe ha?
20261125-physics-g01-1.principle: Okpuru magnet dị iche (N na S) na-adọta ibe ha site n'ike mkpali (attraction), ebe okpuru ndị yiri ibe ha na-ezipụ ibe ha site n'ike mgbapụ (repulsion).
20261125-physics-g01-1.example: Chee echiche banyere ihe na-eme mgbe okpuru magnet dị iche na-ezute.
20261125-physics-g01-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261125-physics-g01-2.title: Ihe ndị magnet na-adọta na ike magnet
20261125-physics-g01-2.summary: E tinyere ihe mkpịsị ígwè n'ime iko plastik doro anya ma were magnet tụgharịa n'èzí iko ahụ. Gịnị ga-eme ihe mkpịsị ígwè ahụ mgbe a na-ebuli magnet nwayọọ gaa n'elu?
20261125-physics-g01-2.principle: Ike magnet (magnetic force) nwere ike ịgafe ihe dị gịrịgịrị dị ka plastik, akwụkwọ ma ọ bụ iko ma rụọ ọrụ n'ihe e ji ígwè mee.
20261125-physics-g01-2.example: Ike magnet nwere ike ịgafe plastik ma ọ bụ akwụkwọ dị gịrịgịrị.
20261125-physics-g01-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261125-physics-g02-1.title: Mkpọtụ na mbufe ụda
20261125-physics-g02-1.summary: A tụrụ ihe ụda (tuning fork) site na hama rabba ma kpọkọta ya nwayọọ n'elu mmiri n'ime ihe ọnụ mmiri. Gịnị na-eme?
20261125-physics-g02-1.principle: Ihe ụda na-ekwu ụda na-ama jijiji, ya mere mgbe ọ metụrụ mmiri, ọ na-efesa mmiri n'akụkụ niile ma na-eme ebili mmiri.
20261125-physics-g02-1.example: Ihe ụda na-ekwu ụda na-ama jijiji ngwa ngwa.
20261125-physics-g02-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261125-physics-g02-2.title: Mkpọtụ na mbufe ụda
20261125-physics-g02-2.summary: Mgbe a na-ekwurịta okwu site na 'ekwentị eriri' e mere site n'iko akwụkwọ abụọ na eriri silk, kedu ka olu onye ọzọ si anụ nke ọma karịa?
20261125-physics-g02-2.principle: N'ekwentị eriri, a na-ebufe mkpọtụ nke ala iko akwụkwọ site n'eriri, ya mere eriri ga-adị ọtọ ka mkpọtụ nwee ike ịga nke ọma n'akụkụ ọzọ.
20261125-physics-g02-2.example: A na-ebufe ụda site na mkpọtụ eriri.
20261125-physics-g02-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261125-physics-g03-1.title: Mgbasa ìhè n'ahịrị kwụ ọtọ na mgbanwe onyinyo
20261125-physics-g03-1.summary: E debere akwụkwọ atọ nwere oghere n'usoro n'ihu ọkụ ọkụ ọkụ. Kedu ka e kwesịrị ịhazi oghere ahụ ka a hụ ìhè n'akụkụ nke ọzọ?
20261125-physics-g03-1.principle: Ìhè na-agbasa n'ahịrị kwụ ọtọ, ya mere ọ nwere ike ịgafe oghere niile naanị mgbe oghere atọ ahụ dị n'otu ahịrị.
20261125-physics-g03-1.example: Ìhè enweghị ike gafere n'ụzọ gbagọrọ agbagọ.
20261125-physics-g03-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261125-physics-g03-2.title: Mgbasa ìhè n'ahịrị kwụ ọtọ na mgbanwe onyinyo
20261125-physics-g03-2.summary: Anyị chọrọ ka onyinyo nke teddy bear n'ihuenyo bụrụ nke ka ukwuu karịa ugbu a. Kedu ụzọ kwesịrị ekwesị?
20261125-physics-g03-2.principle: Ka isi iyi ìhè (ọkụ ọkụ ọkụ) na ihe dị nso, ka ihe na-ekpuchi akụkụ ìhè ka ukwuu, ya mere onyinyo n'ihuenyo na-abawanye.
20261125-physics-g03-2.example: Ka ihe dị nso n'isi iyi ìhè, ka ọ na-ekpuchi mpaghara ìhè ka ukwuu.
20261125-physics-g03-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261125-physics-g04-1.title: Ihe nha abụọ na ụkpụrụ nhazi
20261125-physics-g04-1.summary: E kwụrụ ibu 20 g n'ebe dị n'ogo 4 sistemụ n'aka ekpe site n'ebe mkpọchi nke ihe nha abụọ. Kedu ibu e kwesịrị ịkwụ n'aka nri n'ogo 2 sistemụ ka ihe nha ahụ dị n'ahụ nhazi?
20261125-physics-g04-1.principle: Dị ka ụkpụrụ nhazi si dị, oge aka ekpe ($4\text{ nkeji} \times 20\text{ g} = 80$) na oge aka nri ($2\text{ nkeji} \times ? = 80$) ga-abụ otu, ya mere a ga-akwụ ibu $40\text{ g}$.
20261125-physics-g04-1.example: Gbakọọ (anya aka ekpe × ibu) = (anya aka nri × ibu).
20261125-physics-g04-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261125-physics-g04-2.title: Ihe nha abụọ na ụkpụrụ nhazi
20261125-physics-g04-2.summary: Mgbe nwanna nwoke dị 40 kg na nwa nta dị 20 kg na-egwu n'elu seesaw, kedu ka ha kwesịrị ịnọdụ ka seesaw dị n'ahụ nhazi?
20261125-physics-g04-2.principle: Ka seesaw dị n'ahụ nhazi, nwanna nwoke dị arọ ($40\text{ kg}$) ga-anọdụ ọkara anya nso n'ebe mkpọchi karịa nwa nta dị mfe ($20\text{ kg}$).
20261125-physics-g04-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261125-physics-g05-1.title: Nkọwa ọsọ na ntụnyere
20261125-physics-g05-1.summary: Kedu n'ime nkọwa sayensị ndị a gbasara ntụnyere ọsọ nke ihe ziri ezi?
20261125-physics-g05-1.principle: Mgbe e gafere otu ụzọ, ka oge dị mkpụmkpụ, ka ọ na-adị ngwa, ma mgbe e ji otu oge gaa, ka ụzọ e gafere dị ogologo, ka ọsọ dị ukwuu.
20261125-physics-g05-1.example: N'asọmpi ọsọ, onye mbụ na-eru ebe njedebe n'oge kacha nta.
20261125-physics-g05-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261125-physics-g05-2.title: Nkọwa ọsọ na ntụnyere
20261125-physics-g05-2.summary: Mgbe a na-ekpebi nnwale iji tụnyere ọsọ bọl ígwè na-agbagharị n'ala mkpọka dị iche iche n'ụzọ ziri ezi, kedu n'ime ndị a abụghị 'ọnọdụ a ga-edebe otu (control variable)'?
20261125-physics-g05-2.principle: N'ihi na anyị na-enyocha ọsọ dị ka akụkụ mkpọka si dị, akụkụ mkpọka bụ 'ọnọdụ a na-agbanwe', ma ọnọdụ ndị ọzọ ga-edebe otu.
20261125-physics-g05-2.example: Chọta ọnọdụ anyị na-agbanwe n'ụzọ na-agbanwe (independent variable).
20261125-physics-g05-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261125-physics-g06-1.title: Njikọ circuit na onyinyo convex lens
20261125-physics-g06-1.summary: A chọrọ iji batrị otu, bọlb abụọ na switch jikọọ ya site na waya ka bọlb nwee ike enwu. Kedu ọnọdụ 'circuit mechiri emechi' nke ọkụ na-enwu bụ nke ziri ezi?
20261125-physics-g06-1.principle: Ka ọkụ eletrik gafee, a ga-eme circuit mechiri emechi nke jikọtara na-agbaghị agba site n'otu okpuru batrị gafee akụrụngwa eletrik ruo n'okpuru nke ọzọ.
20261125-physics-g06-1.example: Ọkụ eletrik nwere ike ịgafe naanị mgbe waya jikọtara ma ọ dịghị agbaji.
20261125-physics-g06-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261125-physics-g06-2.title: Njikọ circuit na onyinyo convex lens
20261125-physics-g06-2.summary: Kedu n'ime nkọwa ndị a gbasara ntụnyere circuit nwere bọlb abụọ yiri ibe ha jikọtara n'usoro (series) na nke jikọtara n'otu ụzọ (parallel) ziri ezi?
20261125-physics-g06-2.principle: Mgbe e jikọtara bọlb parallel, voltage zuru ezu nke batrị na-agbado bọlb ọ bụla, ya mere ha na-enwu karịa, ọbụlagodi ma otu bọlb gbajiri, circuit nke bọlb ndị ọzọ na-anọgide.
20261125-physics-g06-2.example: Chee echiche banyere ụlọ ebe ọ bụrụ na e gbanyụọ ọkụ n'otu ụlọ, ọkụ n'ime ụlọ nzuko na-anọgide na-enwu.

20261125-physics-g07-1.title: Nhazi ike ndọda, ikpuru na buoyancy
20261125-physics-g07-1.summary: Onye mbara igwe nke ibu ya bụ 60 kg n'Ụwa rutere n'elu Ọnwa. Kedu nkọwa gbasara 'ibu (mass)' na 'ịdị arọ (weight)' ya n'ọnwa ziri ezi? (Ike ndọda Ọnwa bụ 1/6 nke Ụwa.)
20261125-physics-g07-1.principle: Ibu bụ ọnụọgụ ihe nke ahụ, ya mere ọ na-adị otu (60 kg) n'agbanyeghị ebe, mana ịdị arọ bụ ike ndọda, ya mere n'Ọnwa ọ na-ebelata ruo 1/6 nke Ụwa, ihe dị ka 98 N.

20261125-physics-g07-2.title: Nhazi ike ndọda, ikpuru na buoyancy

20261125-physics-g07-2.principle: Ebe nnwale a bụ ịtụ mgbanwe ikpuru dị ka ịdị gbagọrọ agbagọ nke ala si dị, 'ịdị gbagọrọ agbagọ nke ala' ga-abụ ọnọdụ a na-agbanwe, a gaghị edebe ya otu.

20261125-physics-g08-1.title: Iwu Ohm na ikike ọkụ
20261125-physics-g08-1.summary: E tinyere voltage 30 V n'ọnụ waya nichrome nke nguzogide ya bụ 10 Ω. Kedu ike ọkụ eletrik na-agafe waya ahụ?
20261125-physics-g08-1.principle: Dị ka iwu Ohm si dị, ike ọkụ eletrik bụ $I = \frac{V}{R} = \frac{30\text{ V}}{10\,\Omega} = 3\text{ A}$.
20261125-physics-g08-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261125-physics-g08-2.title: Iwu Ohm na ikike ọkụ
20261125-physics-g08-2.summary: Ọkụ eletrik na-agafe waya kwụ ọtọ site n'ala gaa n'elu. N'ụzọ kedu ka okpuru N nke kompas dị nso n'ugwu waya ahụ ga-atụgharị dị ka iwu aka nri Ampère si dị?
20261125-physics-g08-2.principle: Mgbe isi mkpịsị aka nri na-atụ aka n'ụzọ ọkụ eletrik (n'elu), ngalaba magnet gburugburu nke mkpịsị aka anọ na-eme na-atụ aka n'ọdịda anyanwụ n'ugwu waya, ya mere okpuru N nke kompas na-atụgharị n'ọdịda anyanwụ.
20261125-physics-g08-2.example: Bulie isi mkpịsị aka nri n'ụzọ ọkụ eletrik (n'elu) ma kechie waya site na mkpịsị aka anọ ndị ọzọ.

20261125-physics-g09-1.title: Ọrụ na mgbanwe ume mechanical
20261125-physics-g09-1.summary: N'ihe gbasara physics, kedu ọnọdụ ka 'ọrụ sayensị' e rụrụ bụ efu?
20261125-physics-g09-1.principle: Mgbe ị na-eje ije n'ụzọ dị larịị na-ebu igbe, ike ị na-eji (ike elu na-ejide ibu) na ntụziaka mmegharị (dị larịị) na-eme akụkụ ziri ezi nke $90^\circ$, yabụ ọ dịghị akụkụ nke ike na-arụ ọrụ n'ntụziaka mmegharị, ọrụ e rụrụ bụkwa $0$.
20261125-physics-g09-1.example: Ọrụ sayensị bụ W = F × s × cos(θ).

20261125-physics-g09-2.title: Ọrụ na mgbanwe ume mechanical
20261125-physics-g09-2.summary: A tụrụ ebe a kwọpụrụ otu mpempe osisi mgbe ụgbọ ịkwọ nwere ibu na ọsọ dị iche iche kụrụ ya. Kedu nkwubi okwu ziri ezi gbasara ume mmegharị (kinetic energy)?
20261125-physics-g09-2.principle: Ebe ume mmegharị bụ $E_k = \frac{1}{2}mv^2$, ọ kwesịrị ibu ihe ma kwesịkwa square nke ọsọ ya.

20261125-physics-g10-1.title: Ọgbaghara na nchekwa, mmepụta kwụ ọtọ na ike ndọda
20261125-physics-g10-1.summary: Nso n'elu ụwa, n'ime bọọlụ ígwè abụọ A na B n'otu ịdị elu, a hapụrụ A site n'izu ike ka ọ daa n'efu, a gbapụrụ B n'ike n'akụkụ larịị. Kedu nkọwa ziri ezi gbasara mmegharị ha? (Ghara ileghara ọgbụgba ikuku.)
20261125-physics-g10-1.principle: Mmegharị larịị na-adịgide adịgide na mmegharị ọdịda n'efu kwụ ọtọ adabereghị n'ibe ibe. Bọọlụ abụọ ahụ na-ada kwụ ọtọ n'otu ọsọ ike ndọda $g$, yabụ ha na-eru n'ala n'otu oge.
20261125-physics-g10-1.example: Chee banyere nnwere onwe nke mmegharị.
20261125-physics-g10-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261125-physics-g10-2.title: Ọgbaghara na nchekwa, mmepụta kwụ ọtọ na ike ndọda
20261125-physics-g10-2.summary: A hapụrụ àkwá abụọ nwere otu ibu site n'otu ịdị elu, otu n'elu ala sịmenti, nke ọzọ n'elu ọdụ dị nro. Kedu ntụnyere nke ọnụ ọgụgụ physics ziri ezi site n'oge ọ bụla àkwá metụrụ n'elu ruo mgbe ọ kwụsịrị?
20261125-physics-g10-2.principle: Ebe mgbanwe momentum ($\Delta p$) nke àkwá abụọ bụ otu, impulse ($I = F\Delta t$) bụ otu. Ọdụ na-agbatị oge mgbagwoju anya $\Delta t$, na-ebelata ike ọkpọkọ nkezi $F = \frac{I}{\Delta t}$, yabụ àkwá anaghị agbaji.
20261125-physics-g10-2.example: Ebe ha si n'otu ịdị elu daa, ọsọ tupu mgbagwoju anya na mgbanwe ọsọ ruo izu ike (mgbanwe momentum = impulse) bụ otu.
20261125-physics-g10-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261125-physics-g11-1.title: Iwu mmegharị Newton na tiori mmekọrịta pụrụ iche
20261125-physics-g11-1.summary: Kedu ihe bụ ọdịiche physics bụ isi kachasị ziri ezi n'etiti 'mmekọrịta mmeghachi omume (action-reaction)' na 'nhaịlịgide ike abụọ'?
20261125-physics-g11-1.principle: Mmeghachi omume na-arụ ọrụ n'ihe abụọ dị iche na-emekọrịta, yabụ enweghị ike ijikọta ike abụọ ahụ, mana ike nhaịlịgide abụọ na-arụ ọrụ n'otu ihe, yabụ enwere ike ijikọta ha, ike niile ghọọkwa 0.
20261125-physics-g11-1.example: Mmeghachi omume: ike A na-etinye na B na ike B na-etinye na A
20261125-physics-g11-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261125-physics-g11-2.title: Iwu mmegharị Newton na tiori mmekọrịta pụrụ iche
20261125-physics-g11-2.summary: E tinyere ihe A dị 3 kg na ihe B dị 2 kg ka ha na-emetụ onwe ha n'elu larịị na-enweghị esemokwu, a tinyekwara ike larịị 20 N ịkwọ n'akụkụ A. Kedu ọsọ nke ihe abụọ na ịdị ukwuu nke ike A na-akwọ B, n'usoro?
20261125-physics-g11-2.principle: Ọsọ niile bụ $a = \frac{F}{m_A + m_B} = \frac{20\text{ N}}{5\text{ kg}} = 4\text{ m/s}^2$. Naanị ike niile na-eme ka ihe B mee ọsọ bụ ike mmetụ nke A na-akwọ B, yabụ $F_{AB} = m_B \cdot a = 2\text{ kg} \times 4\text{ m/s}^2 = 8\text{ N}$.
20261125-physics-g11-2.example: Maka usoro niile (A + B): F = (m<sub>A</sub> + m<sub>B</sub>) a → 20 = (3 + 2) a
20261125-physics-g11-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261125-physics-g12-1.title: Mmetụta photoelectric, ụdị abụọ nke ìhè na ụwa nta
20261125-physics-g12-1.summary: Kedu nsonaazụ nke nnwale photoelectric effect nke Einstein enweghị ike ikwu site na 'echiche ebili mmiri nke ìhè' ma 'echiche photon (akụkụ) nke ìhè' naanị na-akọwa ya kpamkpam?
20261125-physics-g12-1.principle: Echiche ebili mmiri na-ahụ ọdịnihu na ume na-achịkọta n'oge, mana na photoelectric effect otu photon dị n'elu threshold frequency na-agbagwo electron ozugbo ma na-ebufe ume ya, yabụ a na-ewepụta electron ozugbo na-enweghị igbu oge.
20261125-physics-g12-1.example: Dabere n'echiche ebili mmiri, ọbụna ìhè adịghị ike ma e tinye ya ogologo oge kwesịrị ịchịkọta ume wee wepụta electron, mana n'eziokwu a na-ewepụta ya ozugbo.
20261125-physics-g12-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261125-physics-g12-2.title: Mmetụta photoelectric, ụdị abụọ nke ìhè na ụwa nta
20261125-physics-g12-2.summary: Akụkụ nwere ụgwọ nwere ibu m na ụgwọ q na-abata n'ụzọ kwụ ọtọ n'ime ikpo magnet edoro anya B n'ọsọ v ma na-eme mmegharị gburugburu edoro anya. Kedu nhọrọ na-egosi nke ọma radius r na period T nke ụzọ gburugburu ya?
20261125-physics-g12-2.principle: Site na nha ike centripetal, $\frac{mv^2}{r} = qvB \implies r = \frac{mv}{qB}$. Period bụ $T = \frac{2\pi r}{v} = \frac{2\pi m}{qB}$, ma n'ụzọ na-eju anya, cyclotron period a adabereghị na radius ụzọ ma ọ bụ ọsọ.
20261125-physics-g12-2.example: Ike Lorentz na-arụ ọrụ dị ka ike centripetal nke mmegharị gburugburu: q v B = m v² / r
20261125-physics-g12-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261119-chemistry-g04-1.title: Evaporation, ịsị, condensation na mgbanwe oke nke ice

Kedu iwu ọsọ na usoro mmeghachi omume zuru oke nke mmeghachi omume a?

20261121-chemistry-g01-1.title: Àgwà dị iche iche nke ihe na ngwa
20261121-chemistry-g01-1.summary: N'ime ndị a, kedu nke jikọtara 'ihe (ọkpụrụkpụ)' nwere ụdị doro anya na ojiji pụrụ iche na 'ihe e ji mee ya (ngwa)' ziri ezi?
20261121-chemistry-g01-1.principle: Ihe nwere ụdị na ojiji bụ 'ihe', ma ihe bụ isi e ji mee ihe ahụ bụ 'ngwa'.
20261121-chemistry-g01-1.example: 'Ihe' bụ aha ihe e mechara a na-eji, 'ngwa' bụ aha ihe e ji mee ya.

20261121-chemistry-g01-2.title: Àgwà dị iche iche nke ihe na ngwa
20261121-chemistry-g01-2.summary: Kedu àgwà pụrụ iche nke ihe dị ka rọba ma ọ bụ bọlụn, nke na-agbatị mgbe e dọrọ ya ma laghachi n'ụdị mbụ ya mgbe e hapụrụ ya?

20261121-chemistry-g02-1.title: Ihe na-agbaze n'ime mmiri na ngwakọta
20261121-chemistry-g02-1.summary: Mgbe e tinyere otu ngaji shuga n'ime beaker nwere mmiri ọkụ ma were osisi gilaasị kpoo ya, kedu nkọwa ziri ezi banyere ihe na-eme?
20261121-chemistry-g02-1.principle: Mgbe shuga gbaze n'ime mmiri, ụmụ shuga na-agbasa n'etiti ụmụ mmiri nke ọma, ya mere a naghị ahụ ha, ma mmiri shuga na-adị doro anya.

20261121-chemistry-g02-2.title: Ihe na-agbaze n'ime mmiri na ngwakọta

20261121-chemistry-g03-1.title: Ọnọdụ atọ nke ihe: ihe siri ike, mmiri na gas
20261121-chemistry-g03-1.summary: Kedu ọnọdụ ihe nke ụdị ya na-agbanwe n'efu dabere n'ihe e debere ya n'ime, ma oke ya (volume) anaghị agbanwe ma na-anọgide n'otu?
20261121-chemistry-g03-1.principle: Mmiri nwere njikọ n'etiti molekul na-agbanwe agbanwe karịa nke ihe siri ike, ya mere ụdị ya na-agbanwe dabere n'ihe e debere ya, ma n'ihi na mkpali dọtara n'etiti molekul na-anọgide, oke ya na-adị otu.

20261121-chemistry-g03-2.title: Ọnọdụ atọ nke ihe: ihe siri ike, mmiri na gas
20261121-chemistry-g03-2.summary: E tinyere mmiri n'otu syringe ma tinye ikuku n'ọzọ, wee kwụsị ọnụ ya na mkpịsị aka ma pịa piston ike. Kedu ihe na-eme?
20261121-chemistry-g03-2.principle: Gas (ikuku) nwere ebe dị anya nke ukwuu n'etiti molekul, ya mere mgbe a pịrị ya, ọ na-apịkọta ngwa ngwa ma oke ya belata, ma mmiri (liquid) nwere molekul ndị kpọkọtara ma ọ fọrọ nke nta ka ọ pịkọta.

20261121-chemistry-g04-1.title: Evaporation, ịsị, condensation na mgbanwe oke nke ice

20261121-chemistry-g04-2.title: Evaporation, ịsị, condensation na mgbanwe oke nke ice

20261121-chemistry-g04-2.principle: Mgbe mmiri na-aghọ ice, a na-echekwa oke (arọ), ma n'ihi na molekul mmiri na-etolite kristal hexagon nwere oghere ọtụtụ site na njikọ hydrogen, oke na-abawanye ihe dị ka 10%.

20261121-chemistry-g05-1.title: Solute, solvent, solution na nchịkọta

20261121-chemistry-g05-1.principle: Mmiri nke na-agbaze bụ 'solvent', shuga nke na-agbaze bụ 'solute', ma ngwakọta doro anya ebe ha abụọ jikọtara nke ọma bụ 'solution'.
20261121-chemistry-g05-1.example: Mmiri na-agbaze = solvent, ihe na-agbaze = solute, ngwakọta zuru ezu = solution.

20261121-chemistry-g05-2.title: Solute, solvent, solution na nchịkọta
20261121-chemistry-g05-2.summary: A chọrọ ịmụ àgwà nke ngwọta mmiri nnu dị n'ime beaker. Kedu nkọwa ziri ezi banyere àgwà nke ngwọta (ngwakọta otu ụdị)?
20261121-chemistry-g05-2.principle: Ezigbo ngwọta (ngwakọta otu ụdị) nwere ụmụ solute ndị gbasasịrị n'otu n'etiti molekul solvent, ya mere ọ naghị ada n'ala ọbụlagodi ogologo oge, ma nchịkọta ya dị otu n'ebe ọ bụla.

20261121-chemistry-g06-1.title: Acid, base na ihe atọ nke ọkụ
20261121-chemistry-g06-1.summary: Mgbe e wụsara ngwọta dị iche iche n'ime red cabbage indicator, ngwọta A gbanwere ka ọ bụrụ uhie, ma ngwọta B gbanwere ka ọ bụrụ acha anụnụ anụnụ wee bụrụ odo odo. Kedu àgwà nke ngwọta abụọ ahụ ziri ezi?
20261121-chemistry-g06-1.principle: Red cabbage indicator na-agbanwe ka ọ bụrụ uhie n'acid, ma ọ na-agbanwe ka ọ bụrụ acha anụnụ anụnụ, akwụkwọ ndụ akwụkwọ ndụ, na odo odo n'ime base.

20261121-chemistry-g06-2.title: Acid, base na ihe atọ nke ọkụ
20261121-chemistry-g06-2.summary: Mgbe e wụsara hydrochloric acid dị ala ma ọ bụ mmanya (vinegar) n'ime akpị akwa ma ọ bụ marble (nke nwere calcium carbonate), ọkpụkpụ ikuku pụtara. Gịnị na-eme mgbe e kpọkọtara gas a ma gafere ya n'ime mmiri lime?
20261121-chemistry-g06-2.principle: Mgbe calcium carbonate ($\text{CaCO}_3$) na acid na-eme ihe, a na-emepụta carbon dioxide ($\text{CO}_2$) gas, ma carbon dioxide na-eme ihe na mmiri lime ($\text{Ca(OH)}_2$) iji mepụta precipitate calcium carbonate na-acha ọcha, na-eme ka ọ dị ọcha ọcha.

20261121-chemistry-g07-1.title: Iwu Boyle, iwu Charles na mgbanwe ọnọdụ
20261121-chemistry-g07-1.summary: Gịnị bụ isi ihe kpatara 'nrụgide gas' a na-enwe n'akụkụ mgbidi nke akpa mechiri emechi nwere gas?
20261121-chemistry-g07-1.principle: Nrụgide gas na-apụta site n'ike n'otu mpaghara nke ụmụ gas na-agba mgbidi n'ime akpa ahụ mgbe ha na-eme mmegharị n'efu n'agaghị kwụsị.

20261121-chemistry-g07-2.title: Iwu Boyle, iwu Charles na mgbanwe ọnọdụ
20261121-chemistry-g07-2.summary: N'okpomọkụ edoziri, a mụbara nrụgide nke gas nke oke ya bụ 60 mL na 1 atm ruo 3 atm. Kedu oke gas a dị dịka iwu Boyle?
20261121-chemistry-g07-2.principle: Dịka iwu Boyle, mgbe okpomọkụ dị otu, $P_1 V_1 = P_2 V_2$ na-adị. $1\text{ atm} \times 60\text{ mL} = 3\text{ atm} \times V_2 \implies V_2 = 20\text{ mL}$.

20261121-chemistry-g08-1.title: Element, atom, ion na mmeghachi omume precipitate

20261121-chemistry-g08-2.title: Element, atom, ion na mmeghachi omume precipitate

20261121-chemistry-g09-2.principle: Oke oxygen meghachiri bụ $5\text{ g} - 4\text{ g} = 1\text{ g}$. Dịka iwu nke ọnụọgụ edoro si dị, oke ọla kọpa na oxygen n'ime copper(II) oxide bụ mgbe niile $4 : 1$.

20261121-chemistry-g10-1.title: Njikọ ionic, njikọ covalent na oxidation-reduction
20261121-chemistry-g10-1.summary: Kedu nsonaazụ nnwale kacha ziri ezi na-eji tụnyere ike nkwụ ọkụ eletrik nke ihe A (sodium chloride) na ihe B (sugar)?
20261121-chemistry-g10-1.principle: Sodium chloride, ihe jikọtara ionic, na-agbaze n'ime mmiri ma kewaa ka ọ bụrụ cations na anions, ya mere ọkụ eletrik na-aga n'ime ngwọta mmiri, mana sugar, ihe jikọtara covalent, na-agbaze dị ka molecule, enweghị ihe na-ebu ụgwọ eletrik, ya mere ọkụ eletrik anaghị agafe.
20261121-chemistry-g10-1.example: Ihe jikọtara ionic (NaCl) na-agbaze n'ime mmiri ka ọ bụrụ ions nwere ike ịkwaga n'onwe ha.

20261121-chemistry-g10-2.title: Njikọ ionic, njikọ covalent na oxidation-reduction
20261121-chemistry-g10-2.summary: Mgbe a na-etinye ngwọta mmiri sodium hydroxide (NaOH) nke nta nke nta n'ime hydrochloric acid (HCl) dị n'ọnụọgụ ụfọdụ, kedu nsonaazụ ziri ezi nke ịlele mgbanwe ọnụọgụ ions n'ime ngwọta na okpomọkụ?
20261121-chemistry-g10-2.principle: Ebe a na-ahapụ okpomọkụ neutralization n'oge neutralization, okpomọkụ nke ngwọta na-eru n'ebe kachasị elu mgbe ọ ruru ebe neutralization ebe mmeghachi omume zuru ezu. Chloride ion ($\text{Cl}^-$) bụ spectator ion na-anaghị emeghachi omume, ya mere ọnụọgụ ya na-adịgide otu.
20261121-chemistry-g10-2.example: Mgbe mmeghachi omume neutralization (H⁺ + OH⁻ → H₂O) na-eme, a na-ahapụ okpomọkụ neutralization.

20261121-chemistry-g11-1.title: Mole
20261121-chemistry-g11-1.summary: N'ime 11.2 L nke methane gas (CH₄, oke molecule 16) n'ime 0℃ na 1 atm, kedu ọnụọgụ mole nke methane na ngụkọta ọnụọgụ mole nke atọm hydrogen (H)?
20261121-chemistry-g11-1.principle: Ọnụọgụ mole nke methane bụ $n = \frac{11.2\text{ L}}{22.4\text{ L/mol}} = 0.5\text{ mol}$. Ebe $1$ molecule nke methane nwere atọm hydrogen $4$, ngụkọta mole nke atọm hydrogen bụ $0.5 \times 4 = 2.0\text{ mol}$.
20261121-chemistry-g11-1.example: N'ime 0℃ na 1 atm, 1 mol nke gas = 22.4 L.

20261121-chemistry-g11-2.title: Mole
20261121-chemistry-g11-2.summary: Kedu oke nke NaOH siri ike zuru ezu achọrọ iji kwadebe 500 mL nke ngwọta mmiri sodium hydroxide (NaOH, oke formula 40) 0.1 M?
20261121-chemistry-g11-2.principle: Ọnụọgụ mole nke $\text{NaOH}$ achọrọ bụ $n = M \times V = 0.1\text{ mol/L} \times 0.5\text{ L} = 0.05\text{ mol}$. Oke achọrọ bụ $w = n \times M_w = 0.05\text{ mol} \times 40\text{ g/mol} = 2.0\text{ g}$.
20261121-chemistry-g11-2.example: Molarity M = ọnụọgụ mole (mol) / olu ngwọta (L)

20261121-chemistry-g12-1.title: Ọsọ mmeghachi omume, ụkpụrụ Le Chatelier na batrị kemịkal
20261121-chemistry-g12-1.summary: Kedu nkọwa ziri ezi banyere mgbanwe na-eme mgbe a na-agbakwunye 'positive catalyst' n'ime mmeghachi omume kemịkalụ?
20261121-chemistry-g12-1.principle: Positive catalyst na-enye ụzọ mmeghachi omume ọhụrụ nwere activation energy dị ala, na-eme ka rate constants nke mmeghachi omume n'ihu na nke azụ dịkwuo elu n'otu ọnụọgụ. Ọ naghị agbanwe reaction enthalpy ($\Delta H$) na equilibrium constant ($K$) ma ọlị.
20261121-chemistry-g12-1.example: Catalyst anaghị agbanwe ọdịiche ume n'etiti ihe mmalite na ngwaahịa ikpeazụ (ΔH) ma ọlị.

20261121-chemistry-g12-2.title: Ọsọ mmeghachi omume, ụkpụrụ Le Chatelier na batrị kemịkal
20261121-chemistry-g12-2.summary: Maka mmeghachi omume 2NO(g) + O₂(g) → 2NO₂(g), site na usoro ọsọ mmalite, mgbe a debere [O₂] otu ma mee [NO] okpukpu abụọ, ọsọ ghọrọ okpukpu anọ, ma mgbe a debere [NO] otu ma mee [O₂] okpukpu abụọ, ọsọ ghọrọ okpukpu abụọ. Kedu iwu ọsọ na usoro mmeghachi omume zuru oke nke mmeghachi omume a?
20261121-chemistry-g12-2.principle: Ebe ọsọ bụ okpukpu $4$ mgbe $[\text{NO}]$ bụ okpukpu $2$, $m=2$, ma ebe ọsọ bụ okpukpu $2$ mgbe $[\text{O}_2]$ bụ okpukpu $2$, $n=1$. Iwu ọsọ bụ $v = k[\text{NO}]^2[\text{O}_2]$, ma usoro mmeghachi omume zuru oke bụ $2 + 1 = 3$.

20261122-chemistry-g01-1.title: Àgwà dị iche iche nke ihe na ngwa
20261122-chemistry-g01-1.summary: N'ime ndị a, kedu nke jikọtara 'ihe (ọkpụrụkpụ)' nwere ụdị doro anya na ojiji pụrụ iche na 'ihe e ji mee ya (ngwa)' ziri ezi?
20261122-chemistry-g01-1.principle: Ihe nwere ụdị na ojiji bụ 'ihe', ma ihe bụ isi e ji mee ihe ahụ bụ 'ngwa'.
20261122-chemistry-g01-1.example: 'Ihe' bụ aha ihe e mechara a na-eji, 'ngwa' bụ aha ihe e ji mee ya.

20261122-chemistry-g01-2.title: Àgwà dị iche iche nke ihe na ngwa
20261122-chemistry-g01-2.summary: Kedu àgwà pụrụ iche nke ihe dị ka rọba ma ọ bụ bọlụn, nke na-agbatị mgbe e dọrọ ya ma laghachi n'ụdị mbụ ya mgbe e hapụrụ ya?

20261122-chemistry-g02-1.title: Ihe na-agbaze n'ime mmiri na ngwakọta
20261122-chemistry-g02-1.summary: Mgbe e tinyere otu ngaji shuga n'ime beaker nwere mmiri ọkụ ma were osisi gilaasị kpoo ya, kedu nkọwa ziri ezi banyere ihe na-eme?
20261122-chemistry-g02-1.principle: Mgbe shuga gbaze n'ime mmiri, ụmụ shuga na-agbasa n'etiti ụmụ mmiri nke ọma, ya mere a naghị ahụ ha, ma mmiri shuga na-adị doro anya.
