20261122-chemistry-g02-2.title: Ihe na-agbaze n'ime mmiri na ngwakọta
20261122-chemistry-g02-2.summary: Gịnị mere shuga ji agbaze ngwa ngwa karịa n'iko nwere mmiri ọkụ ma e jiri ya tụnyere iko nwere mmiri oyi?
20261122-chemistry-g02-2.principle: Ka okpomọkụ mmiri dị elu, ụmụ mmiri na-eme mmegharị ọkụ nke ọma ma na-agbaje ụmụ shuga ugboro ugboro na ike karịa, ya mere ọsọ mgbaze na-abawanye.
20261122-chemistry-g02-2.example: Ka okpomọkụ dị elu, ụmụ mmiri na-aga ngwa ngwa.

20261122-chemistry-g03-1.title: Ọnọdụ atọ nke ihe: ihe siri ike, mmiri na gas
20261122-chemistry-g03-1.summary: Kedu ọnọdụ ihe nke ụdị ya na-agbanwe n'efu dabere n'ihe e debere ya n'ime, ma oke ya (volume) anaghị agbanwe ma na-anọgide n'otu?
20261122-chemistry-g03-1.principle: Mmiri nwere njikọ n'etiti molekul na-agbanwe agbanwe karịa nke ihe siri ike, ya mere ụdị ya na-agbanwe dabere n'ihe e debere ya, ma n'ihi na mkpali dọtara n'etiti molekul na-anọgide, oke ya na-adị otu.

20261122-chemistry-g03-2.title: Ọnọdụ atọ nke ihe: ihe siri ike, mmiri na gas
20261122-chemistry-g03-2.summary: E tinyere mmiri n'otu syringe ma tinye ikuku n'ọzọ, wee kwụsị ọnụ ya na mkpịsị aka ma pịa piston ike. Kedu ihe na-eme?
20261122-chemistry-g03-2.principle: Gas (ikuku) nwere ebe dị anya nke ukwuu n'etiti molekul, ya mere mgbe a pịrị ya, ọ na-apịkọta ngwa ngwa ma oke ya belata, ma mmiri (liquid) nwere molekul ndị kpọkọtara ma ọ fọrọ nke nta ka ọ pịkọta.

20261122-chemistry-g04-1.title: Evaporation, ịsị, condensation na mgbanwe oke nke ice
20261122-chemistry-g04-1.summary: Mgbe e wepụrụ kan ihe ọṅụṅụ oyi n'ime friji wee hapụ ya nwa oge n'elu tebụl, ntanye mmiri pụtara n'elu kan ahụ. Ebee ka mmiri ndị a si bia?
20261122-chemistry-g04-1.principle: Ikuku mmiri dị n'ime ikuku na-ezute elu kan oyi, na-efunahụ okpomọkụ, wee gbanwee ka ọ bụrụ mmiri mmiri, nke a bụ 'condensation (liquefaction)'.

20261122-chemistry-g04-2.title: Evaporation, ịsị, condensation na mgbanwe oke nke ice
20261122-chemistry-g04-2.summary: Mgbe mmiri mmiri na-ejikọta ka ọ bụrụ ice siri ike, kedu nkọwa ziri ezi banyere mgbanwe arọ na oke?
20261122-chemistry-g04-2.principle: Mgbe mmiri na-aghọ ice, a na-echekwa oke (arọ), ma n'ihi na molekul mmiri na-etolite kristal hexagon nwere oghere ọtụtụ site na njikọ hydrogen, oke na-abawanye ihe dị ka 10%.

20261122-chemistry-g05-1.title: Solute, solvent, solution na nchịkọta
20261122-chemistry-g05-1.summary: E gbazere gram 50 shuga kpamkpam n'ime gram 200 mmiri. Kedu nke jikọtara 'solvent', 'solute', na 'solution' n'ime mmiri shuga a ziri ezi?
20261122-chemistry-g05-1.principle: Mmiri nke na-agbaze bụ 'solvent', shuga nke na-agbaze bụ 'solute', ma ngwakọta doro anya ebe ha abụọ jikọtara nke ọma bụ 'solution'.
20261122-chemistry-g05-1.example: Mmiri na-agbaze = solvent, ihe na-agbaze = solute, ngwakọta zuru ezu = solution.

20261122-chemistry-g05-2.title: Solute, solvent, solution na nchịkọta
20261122-chemistry-g05-2.summary: A chọrọ ịmụ àgwà nke ngwọta mmiri nnu dị n'ime beaker. Kedu nkọwa ziri ezi banyere àgwà nke ngwọta (ngwakọta otu ụdị)?
20261122-chemistry-g05-2.principle: Ezigbo ngwọta (ngwakọta otu ụdị) nwere ụmụ solute ndị gbasasịrị n'otu n'etiti molekul solvent, ya mere ọ naghị ada n'ala ọbụlagodi ogologo oge, ma nchịkọta ya dị otu n'ebe ọ bụla.

20261122-chemistry-g06-1.title: Acid, base na ihe atọ nke ọkụ
20261122-chemistry-g06-1.summary: Mgbe e wụsara ngwọta dị iche iche n'ime red cabbage indicator, ngwọta A gbanwere ka ọ bụrụ uhie, ma ngwọta B gbanwere ka ọ bụrụ acha anụnụ anụnụ wee bụrụ odo odo. Kedu àgwà nke ngwọta abụọ ahụ ziri ezi?
20261122-chemistry-g06-1.principle: Red cabbage indicator na-agbanwe ka ọ bụrụ uhie n'acid, ma ọ na-agbanwe ka ọ bụrụ acha anụnụ anụnụ, akwụkwọ ndụ akwụkwọ ndụ, na odo odo n'ime base.

20261122-chemistry-g06-2.title: Acid, base na ihe atọ nke ọkụ
20261122-chemistry-g06-2.summary: Mgbe e wụsara hydrochloric acid dị ala ma ọ bụ mmanya (vinegar) n'ime akpị akwa ma ọ bụ marble (nke nwere calcium carbonate), ọkpụkpụ ikuku pụtara. Gịnị na-eme mgbe e kpọkọtara gas a ma gafere ya n'ime mmiri lime?
20261122-chemistry-g06-2.principle: Mgbe calcium carbonate ($\text{CaCO}_3$) na acid na-eme ihe, a na-emepụta carbon dioxide ($\text{CO}_2$) gas, ma carbon dioxide na-eme ihe na mmiri lime ($\text{Ca(OH)}_2$) iji mepụta precipitate calcium carbonate na-acha ọcha, na-eme ka ọ dị ọcha ọcha.

20261122-chemistry-g07-1.title: Iwu Boyle, iwu Charles na mgbanwe ọnọdụ
20261122-chemistry-g07-1.summary: Gịnị bụ isi ihe kpatara 'nrụgide gas' a na-enwe n'akụkụ mgbidi nke akpa mechiri emechi nwere gas?
20261122-chemistry-g07-1.principle: Nrụgide gas na-apụta site n'ike n'otu mpaghara nke ụmụ gas na-agba mgbidi n'ime akpa ahụ mgbe ha na-eme mmegharị n'efu n'agaghị kwụsị.

20261122-chemistry-g07-2.title: Iwu Boyle, iwu Charles na mgbanwe ọnọdụ
20261122-chemistry-g07-2.summary: N'okpomọkụ edoziri, a mụbara nrụgide nke gas nke oke ya bụ 60 mL na 1 atm ruo 3 atm. Kedu oke gas a dị dịka iwu Boyle?
20261122-chemistry-g07-2.principle: Dịka iwu Boyle, mgbe okpomọkụ dị otu, $P_1 V_1 = P_2 V_2$ na-adị. $1\text{ atm} \times 60\text{ mL} = 3\text{ atm} \times V_2 \implies V_2 = 20\text{ mL}$.

20261122-chemistry-g08-2.principle: Atom na-efunahụ electron nke ọkpụkpụ ọdụ iji bụrụ cation (ọkachasị metal), ma ọ bụ na-enweta electron iji mepụta anion nke na-eso octet rule (ọkachasị non-metal).

20261122-chemistry-g09-1.title: Nchekwa oke, ịdị mgbe niile nke oke, exothermic na endothermic

20261122-chemistry-g10-1.title: Njikọ ionic, njikọ covalent na oxidation-reduction
20261122-chemistry-g10-1.summary: Kedu nsonaazụ nnwale kacha ziri ezi na-eji tụnyere ike nkwụ ọkụ eletrik nke ihe A (sodium chloride) na ihe B (sugar)?
20261122-chemistry-g10-1.principle: Sodium chloride, ihe jikọtara ionic, na-agbaze n'ime mmiri ma kewaa ka ọ bụrụ cations na anions, ya mere ọkụ eletrik na-aga n'ime ngwọta mmiri, mana sugar, ihe jikọtara covalent, na-agbaze dị ka molecule, enweghị ihe na-ebu ụgwọ eletrik, ya mere ọkụ eletrik anaghị agafe.
20261122-chemistry-g10-1.example: Ihe jikọtara ionic (NaCl) na-agbaze n'ime mmiri ka ọ bụrụ ions nwere ike ịkwaga n'onwe ha.
20261122-chemistry-g10-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261122-chemistry-g10-2.title: Njikọ ionic, njikọ covalent na oxidation-reduction
20261122-chemistry-g10-2.summary: Mgbe a na-etinye ngwọta mmiri sodium hydroxide (NaOH) nke nta nke nta n'ime hydrochloric acid (HCl) dị n'ọnụọgụ ụfọdụ, kedu nsonaazụ ziri ezi nke ịlele mgbanwe ọnụọgụ ions n'ime ngwọta na okpomọkụ?
20261122-chemistry-g10-2.principle: Ebe a na-ahapụ okpomọkụ neutralization n'oge neutralization, okpomọkụ nke ngwọta na-eru n'ebe kachasị elu mgbe ọ ruru ebe neutralization ebe mmeghachi omume zuru ezu. Chloride ion ($\text{Cl}^-$) bụ spectator ion na-anaghị emeghachi omume, ya mere ọnụọgụ ya na-adịgide otu.
20261122-chemistry-g10-2.example: Mgbe mmeghachi omume neutralization (H⁺ + OH⁻ → H₂O) na-eme, a na-ahapụ okpomọkụ neutralization.
20261122-chemistry-g10-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261122-chemistry-g11-1.title: Mole
20261122-chemistry-g11-1.summary: N'ime 11.2 L nke methane gas (CH₄, oke molecule 16) n'ime 0℃ na 1 atm, kedu ọnụọgụ mole nke methane na ngụkọta ọnụọgụ mole nke atọm hydrogen (H)?
20261122-chemistry-g11-1.principle: Ọnụọgụ mole nke methane bụ $n = \frac{11.2\text{ L}}{22.4\text{ L/mol}} = 0.5\text{ mol}$. Ebe $1$ molecule nke methane nwere atọm hydrogen $4$, ngụkọta mole nke atọm hydrogen bụ $0.5 \times 4 = 2.0\text{ mol}$.
20261122-chemistry-g11-1.example: N'ime 0℃ na 1 atm, 1 mol nke gas = 22.4 L.
20261122-chemistry-g11-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261122-chemistry-g11-2.title: Mole
20261122-chemistry-g11-2.summary: Kedu oke nke NaOH siri ike zuru ezu achọrọ iji kwadebe 500 mL nke ngwọta mmiri sodium hydroxide (NaOH, oke formula 40) 0.1 M?
20261122-chemistry-g11-2.principle: Ọnụọgụ mole nke $\text{NaOH}$ achọrọ bụ $n = M \times V = 0.1\text{ mol/L} \times 0.5\text{ L} = 0.05\text{ mol}$. Oke achọrọ bụ $w = n \times M_w = 0.05\text{ mol} \times 40\text{ g/mol} = 2.0\text{ g}$.
20261122-chemistry-g11-2.example: Molarity M = ọnụọgụ mole (mol) / olu ngwọta (L)
20261122-chemistry-g11-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261122-chemistry-g12-1.title: Ọsọ mmeghachi omume, ụkpụrụ Le Chatelier na batrị kemịkal
20261122-chemistry-g12-1.summary: Kedu nkọwa ziri ezi banyere mgbanwe na-eme mgbe a na-agbakwunye 'positive catalyst' n'ime mmeghachi omume kemịkalụ?
20261122-chemistry-g12-1.principle: Positive catalyst na-enye ụzọ mmeghachi omume ọhụrụ nwere activation energy dị ala, na-eme ka rate constants nke mmeghachi omume n'ihu na nke azụ dịkwuo elu n'otu ọnụọgụ. Ọ naghị agbanwe reaction enthalpy ($\Delta H$) na equilibrium constant ($K$) ma ọlị.
20261122-chemistry-g12-1.example: Catalyst anaghị agbanwe ọdịiche ume n'etiti ihe mmalite na ngwaahịa ikpeazụ (ΔH) ma ọlị.
20261122-chemistry-g12-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261122-chemistry-g12-2.title: Ọsọ mmeghachi omume, ụkpụrụ Le Chatelier na batrị kemịkal
20261122-chemistry-g12-2.summary: Maka mmeghachi omume 2NO(g) + O₂(g) → 2NO₂(g), site na usoro ọsọ mmalite, mgbe a debere [O₂] otu ma mee [NO] okpukpu abụọ, ọsọ ghọrọ okpukpu anọ, ma mgbe a debere [NO] otu ma mee [O₂] okpukpu abụọ, ọsọ ghọrọ okpukpu abụọ. Kedu iwu ọsọ na usoro mmeghachi omume zuru oke nke mmeghachi omume a?
20261122-chemistry-g12-2.principle: Ebe ọsọ bụ okpukpu $4$ mgbe $[\text{NO}]$ bụ okpukpu $2$, $m=2$, ma ebe ọsọ bụ okpukpu $2$ mgbe $[\text{O}_2]$ bụ okpukpu $2$, $n=1$. Iwu ọsọ bụ $v = k[\text{NO}]^2[\text{O}_2]$, ma usoro mmeghachi omume zuru oke bụ $2 + 1 = 3$.
20261122-chemistry-g12-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261123-chemistry-g01-1.title: Àgwà dị iche iche nke ihe na ngwa
20261123-chemistry-g01-1.summary: N'ime ndị a, kedu nke jikọtara 'ihe (ọkpụrụkpụ)' nwere ụdị doro anya na ojiji pụrụ iche na 'ihe e ji mee ya (ngwa)' ziri ezi?
20261123-chemistry-g01-1.principle: Ihe nwere ụdị na ojiji bụ 'ihe', ma ihe bụ isi e ji mee ihe ahụ bụ 'ngwa'.
20261123-chemistry-g01-1.example: 'Ihe' bụ aha ihe e mechara a na-eji, 'ngwa' bụ aha ihe e ji mee ya.
20261123-chemistry-g01-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261123-chemistry-g01-2.title: Àgwà dị iche iche nke ihe na ngwa
20261123-chemistry-g01-2.summary: Kedu àgwà pụrụ iche nke ihe dị ka rọba ma ọ bụ bọlụn, nke na-agbatị mgbe e dọrọ ya ma laghachi n'ụdị mbụ ya mgbe e hapụrụ ya?
20261123-chemistry-g01-2.principle: Àgwà nke ihe e gbanwere site n'ike ma laghachi n'ụdị mbụ ya mgbe ike ahụ kwụsịrị bụ 'ịgbatị na ịlaghachi (elasticity)'.
20261123-chemistry-g01-2.example: Ọ bụ àgwà ịlaghachi n'ụdị mbụ.
20261123-chemistry-g01-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261123-chemistry-g02-1.title: Ihe na-agbaze n'ime mmiri na ngwakọta
20261123-chemistry-g02-1.summary: Mgbe e tinyere otu ngaji shuga n'ime beaker nwere mmiri ọkụ ma were osisi gilaasị kpoo ya, kedu nkọwa ziri ezi banyere ihe na-eme?
20261123-chemistry-g02-1.principle: Mgbe shuga gbaze n'ime mmiri, ụmụ shuga na-agbasa n'etiti ụmụ mmiri nke ọma, ya mere a naghị ahụ ha, ma mmiri shuga na-adị doro anya.
20261123-chemistry-g02-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261123-chemistry-g02-2.title: Ihe na-agbaze n'ime mmiri na ngwakọta
20261123-chemistry-g02-2.summary: Gịnị mere shuga ji agbaze ngwa ngwa karịa n'iko nwere mmiri ọkụ ma e jiri ya tụnyere iko nwere mmiri oyi?
20261123-chemistry-g02-2.principle: Ka okpomọkụ mmiri dị elu, ụmụ mmiri na-eme mmegharị ọkụ nke ọma ma na-agbaje ụmụ shuga ugboro ugboro na ike karịa, ya mere ọsọ mgbaze na-abawanye.
20261123-chemistry-g02-2.example: Ka okpomọkụ dị elu, ụmụ mmiri na-aga ngwa ngwa.
20261123-chemistry-g02-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261123-chemistry-g03-1.title: Ọnọdụ atọ nke ihe: ihe siri ike, mmiri na gas
20261123-chemistry-g03-1.summary: Kedu ọnọdụ ihe nke ụdị ya na-agbanwe n'efu dabere n'ihe e debere ya n'ime, ma oke ya (volume) anaghị agbanwe ma na-anọgide n'otu?
20261123-chemistry-g03-1.principle: Mmiri nwere njikọ n'etiti molekul na-agbanwe agbanwe karịa nke ihe siri ike, ya mere ụdị ya na-agbanwe dabere n'ihe e debere ya, ma n'ihi na mkpali dọtara n'etiti molekul na-anọgide, oke ya na-adị otu.
20261123-chemistry-g03-1.example: Chee echiche mgbe i na-awụsa mmiri ma ọ bụ mmiri ara ehi n'iko ọzọ.
20261123-chemistry-g03-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261123-chemistry-g03-2.title: Ọnọdụ atọ nke ihe: ihe siri ike, mmiri na gas
20261123-chemistry-g03-2.summary: E tinyere mmiri n'otu syringe ma tinye ikuku n'ọzọ, wee kwụsị ọnụ ya na mkpịsị aka ma pịa piston ike. Kedu ihe na-eme?
20261123-chemistry-g03-2.principle: Gas (ikuku) nwere ebe dị anya nke ukwuu n'etiti molekul, ya mere mgbe a pịrị ya, ọ na-apịkọta ngwa ngwa ma oke ya belata, ma mmiri (liquid) nwere molekul ndị kpọkọtara ma ọ fọrọ nke nta ka ọ pịkọta.
20261123-chemistry-g03-2.example: Molekul gas dị anya nke ukwuu n'ebe ibe ha nọ, ya mere oghere dị ọtụtụ.
20261123-chemistry-g03-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261123-chemistry-g04-1.title: Evaporation, ịsị, condensation na mgbanwe oke nke ice
20261123-chemistry-g04-1.summary: Mgbe e wepụrụ kan ihe ọṅụṅụ oyi n'ime friji wee hapụ ya nwa oge n'elu tebụl, ntanye mmiri pụtara n'elu kan ahụ. Ebee ka mmiri ndị a si bia?
20261123-chemistry-g04-1.principle: Ikuku mmiri dị n'ime ikuku na-ezute elu kan oyi, na-efunahụ okpomọkụ, wee gbanwee ka ọ bụrụ mmiri mmiri, nke a bụ 'condensation (liquefaction)'.
20261123-chemistry-g04-1.example: Ikuku mmiri anaghị ahụ anya na-adị n'ikuku mgbe niile.
20261123-chemistry-g04-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261123-chemistry-g04-2.title: Evaporation, ịsị, condensation na mgbanwe oke nke ice
20261123-chemistry-g04-2.summary: Mgbe mmiri mmiri na-ejikọta ka ọ bụrụ ice siri ike, kedu nkọwa ziri ezi banyere mgbanwe arọ na oke?
20261123-chemistry-g04-2.principle: Mgbe mmiri na-aghọ ice, a na-echekwa oke (arọ), ma n'ihi na molekul mmiri na-etolite kristal hexagon nwere oghere ọtụtụ site na njikọ hydrogen, oke na-abawanye ihe dị ka 10%.
20261123-chemistry-g04-2.example: Ọbụlagodi mmiri jikọtara, ọnụ ọgụgụ niile nke molekul anaghị agbanwe.
20261123-chemistry-g04-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261123-chemistry-g05-1.title: Solute, solvent, solution na nchịkọta
20261123-chemistry-g05-1.summary: E gbazere gram 50 shuga kpamkpam n'ime gram 200 mmiri. Kedu nke jikọtara 'solvent', 'solute', na 'solution' n'ime mmiri shuga a ziri ezi?
20261123-chemistry-g05-1.principle: Mmiri nke na-agbaze bụ 'solvent', shuga nke na-agbaze bụ 'solute', ma ngwakọta doro anya ebe ha abụọ jikọtara nke ọma bụ 'solution'.
20261123-chemistry-g05-1.example: Mmiri na-agbaze = solvent, ihe na-agbaze = solute, ngwakọta zuru ezu = solution.
20261123-chemistry-g05-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261123-chemistry-g05-2.title: Solute, solvent, solution na nchịkọta
20261123-chemistry-g05-2.summary: A chọrọ ịmụ àgwà nke ngwọta mmiri nnu dị n'ime beaker. Kedu nkọwa ziri ezi banyere àgwà nke ngwọta (ngwakọta otu ụdị)?
20261123-chemistry-g05-2.principle: Ezigbo ngwọta (ngwakọta otu ụdị) nwere ụmụ solute ndị gbasasịrị n'otu n'etiti molekul solvent, ya mere ọ naghị ada n'ala ọbụlagodi ogologo oge, ma nchịkọta ya dị otu n'ebe ọ bụla.
20261123-chemistry-g05-2.example: Ngwọta bụ 'ngwakọta otu ụdị' ebe ụmụ ya jikọtara n'ọkwa molekul.
20261123-chemistry-g05-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261123-chemistry-g06-1.title: Acid, base na ihe atọ nke ọkụ
20261123-chemistry-g06-1.summary: Mgbe e wụsara ngwọta dị iche iche n'ime red cabbage indicator, ngwọta A gbanwere ka ọ bụrụ uhie, ma ngwọta B gbanwere ka ọ bụrụ acha anụnụ anụnụ wee bụrụ odo odo. Kedu àgwà nke ngwọta abụọ ahụ ziri ezi?
20261123-chemistry-g06-1.principle: Red cabbage indicator na-agbanwe ka ọ bụrụ uhie n'acid, ma ọ na-agbanwe ka ọ bụrụ acha anụnụ anụnụ, akwụkwọ ndụ akwụkwọ ndụ, na odo odo n'ime base.
20261123-chemistry-g06-1.example: Mmiri ahụ red cabbage, nke bụ indicator okike, nwere pigment anthocyanin.
20261123-chemistry-g06-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261123-chemistry-g06-2.title: Acid, base na ihe atọ nke ọkụ
20261123-chemistry-g06-2.summary: Mgbe e wụsara hydrochloric acid dị ala ma ọ bụ mmanya (vinegar) n'ime akpị akwa ma ọ bụ marble (nke nwere calcium carbonate), ọkpụkpụ ikuku pụtara. Gịnị na-eme mgbe e kpọkọtara gas a ma gafere ya n'ime mmiri lime?
20261123-chemistry-g06-2.principle: Mgbe calcium carbonate ($\text{CaCO}_3$) na acid na-eme ihe, a na-emepụta carbon dioxide ($\text{CO}_2$) gas, ma carbon dioxide na-eme ihe na mmiri lime ($\text{Ca(OH)}_2$) iji mepụta precipitate calcium carbonate na-acha ọcha, na-eme ka ọ dị ọcha ọcha.
20261123-chemistry-g06-2.example: Mgbe carbonate na acid na-eme ihe, a na-emepụta carbon dioxide (CO₂) gas.
20261123-chemistry-g06-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261123-chemistry-g07-1.title: Iwu Boyle, iwu Charles na mgbanwe ọnọdụ
20261123-chemistry-g07-1.summary: Gịnị bụ isi ihe kpatara 'nrụgide gas' a na-enwe n'akụkụ mgbidi nke akpa mechiri emechi nwere gas?
20261123-chemistry-g07-1.principle: Nrụgide gas na-apụta site n'ike n'otu mpaghara nke ụmụ gas na-agba mgbidi n'ime akpa ahụ mgbe ha na-eme mmegharị n'efu n'agaghị kwụsị.
20261123-chemistry-g07-1.example: Molekul gas na-efe n'ọsọ ọsọ dị ukwuu.
20261123-chemistry-g07-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261123-chemistry-g07-2.title: Iwu Boyle, iwu Charles na mgbanwe ọnọdụ
20261123-chemistry-g07-2.summary: N'okpomọkụ edoziri, a mụbara nrụgide nke gas nke oke ya bụ 60 mL na 1 atm ruo 3 atm. Kedu oke gas a dị dịka iwu Boyle?
20261123-chemistry-g07-2.principle: Dịka iwu Boyle, mgbe okpomọkụ dị otu, $P_1 V_1 = P_2 V_2$ na-adị. $1\text{ atm} \times 60\text{ mL} = 3\text{ atm} \times V_2 \implies V_2 = 20\text{ mL}$.
20261123-chemistry-g07-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261123-chemistry-g08-1.title: Element, atom, ion na mmeghachi omume precipitate
20261123-chemistry-g08-1.summary: Gịnị bụ ihe kpatara atom, nke nwere nucleus na electron, na-abụ ihe na-anọghị n'akụkụ eletrik (neutral)?
20261123-chemistry-g08-1.principle: Atom bụ ihe neutral n'akụkụ eletrik n'ihi na nchikota (+) charge nke proton dị n'etiti nucleus na nchikota (-) charge nke electron ndị na-agagharị n'orbit bụ otu kpamkpam.
20261123-chemistry-g08-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261123-chemistry-g08-2.title: Element, atom, ion na mmeghachi omume precipitate
20261123-chemistry-g08-2.summary: Kedu nkọwa banyere nhazi 'ion', ebe atom neutral na-efunahụ ma ọ bụ nweta electron wee nwee charge, ziri ezi?
20261123-chemistry-g08-2.principle: Atom na-efunahụ electron nke ọkpụkpụ ọdụ iji bụrụ cation (ọkachasị metal), ma ọ bụ na-enweta electron iji mepụta anion nke na-eso octet rule (ọkachasị non-metal).
20261123-chemistry-g08-2.example: Sodium (Na) na-efunahụ otu electron ma ghọọ Na⁺.

20261123-chemistry-g09-1.title: Nchekwa oke, ịdị mgbe niile nke oke, exothermic na endothermic
20261123-chemistry-g09-1.summary: Gịnị bụ isi ihe kpatara iwu nchekwa nke oke ji eme mgbe mgbanwe kemịkalụ na-eme?
20261123-chemistry-g09-1.principle: Mgbe mmeghachi omume kemịkalụ na-eme, ụzọ atọm si ejikọta na-agbanwe ka ihe ọhụrụ pụta, mana ụdị na ọnụọgụ atọm adịghị apụta ma ọ bụ furu efu, a na-echekwa ha, ya mere ngụkọta oke adịghị agbanwe.
20261123-chemistry-g09-1.example: Cheta iwu nchekwa nke oke nke Lavoisier.
20261123-chemistry-g09-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261123-chemistry-g09-2.title: Nchekwa oke, ịdị mgbe niile nke oke, exothermic na endothermic
20261123-chemistry-g09-2.summary: Etinyere ntụ ọla kọpa n'ime crucible ma kpoo ya n'ikuku iji mepụta copper(II) oxide. Mgbe 4 g nke ọla kọpa meghachiri nke ọma, a mepụtara 5 g nke copper(II) oxide. Kedu oke oxygen jikọtara na oke ọla kọpa na oxygen?
20261123-chemistry-g09-2.principle: Oke oxygen meghachiri bụ $5\text{ g} - 4\text{ g} = 1\text{ g}$. Dịka iwu nke ọnụọgụ edoro si dị, oke ọla kọpa na oxygen n'ime copper(II) oxide bụ mgbe niile $4 : 1$.
20261123-chemistry-g09-2.example: Iwu nchekwa nke oke: (ọla kọpa 4 g) + (oxygen ? g) = copper oxide 5 g

20261123-chemistry-g10-1.title: Njikọ ionic, njikọ covalent na oxidation-reduction
20261123-chemistry-g10-1.summary: Kedu nsonaazụ nnwale kacha ziri ezi na-eji tụnyere ike nkwụ ọkụ eletrik nke ihe A (sodium chloride) na ihe B (sugar)?
20261123-chemistry-g10-1.principle: Sodium chloride, ihe jikọtara ionic, na-agbaze n'ime mmiri ma kewaa ka ọ bụrụ cations na anions, ya mere ọkụ eletrik na-aga n'ime ngwọta mmiri, mana sugar, ihe jikọtara covalent, na-agbaze dị ka molecule, enweghị ihe na-ebu ụgwọ eletrik, ya mere ọkụ eletrik anaghị agafe.

20261123-chemistry-g10-2.title: Njikọ ionic, njikọ covalent na oxidation-reduction
20261123-chemistry-g10-2.summary: Mgbe a na-etinye ngwọta mmiri sodium hydroxide (NaOH) nke nta nke nta n'ime hydrochloric acid (HCl) dị n'ọnụọgụ ụfọdụ, kedu nsonaazụ ziri ezi nke ịlele mgbanwe ọnụọgụ ions n'ime ngwọta na okpomọkụ?
20261123-chemistry-g10-2.principle: Ebe a na-ahapụ okpomọkụ neutralization n'oge neutralization, okpomọkụ nke ngwọta na-eru n'ebe kachasị elu mgbe ọ ruru ebe neutralization ebe mmeghachi omume zuru ezu. Chloride ion ($\text{Cl}^-$) bụ spectator ion na-anaghị emeghachi omume, ya mere ọnụọgụ ya na-adịgide otu.
20261123-chemistry-g10-2.example: Mgbe mmeghachi omume neutralization (H⁺ + OH⁻ → H₂O) na-eme, a na-ahapụ okpomọkụ neutralization.
20261123-chemistry-g10-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261123-chemistry-g11-1.title: Mole
20261123-chemistry-g11-1.summary: N'ime 11.2 L nke methane gas (CH₄, oke molecule 16) n'ime 0℃ na 1 atm, kedu ọnụọgụ mole nke methane na ngụkọta ọnụọgụ mole nke atọm hydrogen (H)?
20261123-chemistry-g11-1.principle: Ọnụọgụ mole nke methane bụ $n = \frac{11.2\text{ L}}{22.4\text{ L/mol}} = 0.5\text{ mol}$. Ebe $1$ molecule nke methane nwere atọm hydrogen $4$, ngụkọta mole nke atọm hydrogen bụ $0.5 \times 4 = 2.0\text{ mol}$.
20261123-chemistry-g11-1.example: N'ime 0℃ na 1 atm, 1 mol nke gas = 22.4 L.
20261123-chemistry-g11-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261123-chemistry-g11-2.title: Mole
20261123-chemistry-g11-2.summary: Kedu oke nke NaOH siri ike zuru ezu achọrọ iji kwadebe 500 mL nke ngwọta mmiri sodium hydroxide (NaOH, oke formula 40) 0.1 M?
20261123-chemistry-g11-2.principle: Ọnụọgụ mole nke $\text{NaOH}$ achọrọ bụ $n = M \times V = 0.1\text{ mol/L} \times 0.5\text{ L} = 0.05\text{ mol}$. Oke achọrọ bụ $w = n \times M_w = 0.05\text{ mol} \times 40\text{ g/mol} = 2.0\text{ g}$.
20261123-chemistry-g11-2.example: Molarity M = ọnụọgụ mole (mol) / olu ngwọta (L)
20261123-chemistry-g11-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261123-chemistry-g12-1.title: Ọsọ mmeghachi omume, ụkpụrụ Le Chatelier na batrị kemịkal
20261123-chemistry-g12-1.summary: Kedu nkọwa ziri ezi banyere mgbanwe na-eme mgbe a na-agbakwunye 'positive catalyst' n'ime mmeghachi omume kemịkalụ?
20261123-chemistry-g12-1.principle: Positive catalyst na-enye ụzọ mmeghachi omume ọhụrụ nwere activation energy dị ala, na-eme ka rate constants nke mmeghachi omume n'ihu na nke azụ dịkwuo elu n'otu ọnụọgụ. Ọ naghị agbanwe reaction enthalpy ($\Delta H$) na equilibrium constant ($K$) ma ọlị.
20261123-chemistry-g12-1.example: Catalyst anaghị agbanwe ọdịiche ume n'etiti ihe mmalite na ngwaahịa ikpeazụ (ΔH) ma ọlị.
20261123-chemistry-g12-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261123-chemistry-g12-2.title: Ọsọ mmeghachi omume, ụkpụrụ Le Chatelier na batrị kemịkal
20261123-chemistry-g12-2.summary: Maka mmeghachi omume 2NO(g) + O₂(g) → 2NO₂(g), site na usoro ọsọ mmalite, mgbe a debere [O₂] otu ma mee [NO] okpukpu abụọ, ọsọ ghọrọ okpukpu anọ, ma mgbe a debere [NO] otu ma mee [O₂] okpukpu abụọ, ọsọ ghọrọ okpukpu abụọ. Kedu iwu ọsọ na usoro mmeghachi omume zuru oke nke mmeghachi omume a?
20261123-chemistry-g12-2.principle: Ebe ọsọ bụ okpukpu $4$ mgbe $[\text{NO}]$ bụ okpukpu $2$, $m=2$, ma ebe ọsọ bụ okpukpu $2$ mgbe $[\text{O}_2]$ bụ okpukpu $2$, $n=1$. Iwu ọsọ bụ $v = k[\text{NO}]^2[\text{O}_2]$, ma usoro mmeghachi omume zuru oke bụ $2 + 1 = 3$.
20261123-chemistry-g12-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261124-chemistry-g01-1.title: Àgwà dị iche iche nke ihe na ngwa
20261124-chemistry-g01-1.summary: N'ime ndị a, kedu nke jikọtara 'ihe (ọkpụrụkpụ)' nwere ụdị doro anya na ojiji pụrụ iche na 'ihe e ji mee ya (ngwa)' ziri ezi?
20261124-chemistry-g01-1.principle: Ihe nwere ụdị na ojiji bụ 'ihe', ma ihe bụ isi e ji mee ihe ahụ bụ 'ngwa'.
20261124-chemistry-g01-1.example: 'Ihe' bụ aha ihe e mechara a na-eji, 'ngwa' bụ aha ihe e ji mee ya.
20261124-chemistry-g01-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261124-chemistry-g01-2.title: Àgwà dị iche iche nke ihe na ngwa
20261124-chemistry-g01-2.summary: Kedu àgwà pụrụ iche nke ihe dị ka rọba ma ọ bụ bọlụn, nke na-agbatị mgbe e dọrọ ya ma laghachi n'ụdị mbụ ya mgbe e hapụrụ ya?
20261124-chemistry-g01-2.principle: Àgwà nke ihe e gbanwere site n'ike ma laghachi n'ụdị mbụ ya mgbe ike ahụ kwụsịrị bụ 'ịgbatị na ịlaghachi (elasticity)'.
20261124-chemistry-g01-2.example: Ọ bụ àgwà ịlaghachi n'ụdị mbụ.
20261124-chemistry-g01-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261124-chemistry-g02-1.title: Ihe na-agbaze n'ime mmiri na ngwakọta
20261124-chemistry-g02-1.summary: Mgbe e tinyere otu ngaji shuga n'ime beaker nwere mmiri ọkụ ma were osisi gilaasị kpoo ya, kedu nkọwa ziri ezi banyere ihe na-eme?
20261124-chemistry-g02-1.principle: Mgbe shuga gbaze n'ime mmiri, ụmụ shuga na-agbasa n'etiti ụmụ mmiri nke ọma, ya mere a naghị ahụ ha, ma mmiri shuga na-adị doro anya.
20261124-chemistry-g02-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261124-chemistry-g02-2.title: Ihe na-agbaze n'ime mmiri na ngwakọta
20261124-chemistry-g02-2.summary: Gịnị mere shuga ji agbaze ngwa ngwa karịa n'iko nwere mmiri ọkụ ma e jiri ya tụnyere iko nwere mmiri oyi?
20261124-chemistry-g02-2.principle: Ka okpomọkụ mmiri dị elu, ụmụ mmiri na-eme mmegharị ọkụ nke ọma ma na-agbaje ụmụ shuga ugboro ugboro na ike karịa, ya mere ọsọ mgbaze na-abawanye.
20261124-chemistry-g02-2.example: Ka okpomọkụ dị elu, ụmụ mmiri na-aga ngwa ngwa.
20261124-chemistry-g02-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261124-chemistry-g03-1.title: Ọnọdụ atọ nke ihe: ihe siri ike, mmiri na gas
20261124-chemistry-g03-1.summary: Kedu ọnọdụ ihe nke ụdị ya na-agbanwe n'efu dabere n'ihe e debere ya n'ime, ma oke ya (volume) anaghị agbanwe ma na-anọgide n'otu?
20261124-chemistry-g03-1.principle: Mmiri nwere njikọ n'etiti molekul na-agbanwe agbanwe karịa nke ihe siri ike, ya mere ụdị ya na-agbanwe dabere n'ihe e debere ya, ma n'ihi na mkpali dọtara n'etiti molekul na-anọgide, oke ya na-adị otu.
20261124-chemistry-g03-1.example: Chee echiche mgbe i na-awụsa mmiri ma ọ bụ mmiri ara ehi n'iko ọzọ.
20261124-chemistry-g03-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261124-chemistry-g03-2.title: Ọnọdụ atọ nke ihe: ihe siri ike, mmiri na gas
20261124-chemistry-g03-2.summary: E tinyere mmiri n'otu syringe ma tinye ikuku n'ọzọ, wee kwụsị ọnụ ya na mkpịsị aka ma pịa piston ike. Kedu ihe na-eme?
20261124-chemistry-g03-2.principle: Gas (ikuku) nwere ebe dị anya nke ukwuu n'etiti molekul, ya mere mgbe a pịrị ya, ọ na-apịkọta ngwa ngwa ma oke ya belata, ma mmiri (liquid) nwere molekul ndị kpọkọtara ma ọ fọrọ nke nta ka ọ pịkọta.
20261124-chemistry-g03-2.example: Molekul gas dị anya nke ukwuu n'ebe ibe ha nọ, ya mere oghere dị ọtụtụ.
20261124-chemistry-g03-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261124-chemistry-g04-1.title: Evaporation, ịsị, condensation na mgbanwe oke nke ice
20261124-chemistry-g04-1.summary: Mgbe e wepụrụ kan ihe ọṅụṅụ oyi n'ime friji wee hapụ ya nwa oge n'elu tebụl, ntanye mmiri pụtara n'elu kan ahụ. Ebee ka mmiri ndị a si bia?
20261124-chemistry-g04-1.principle: Ikuku mmiri dị n'ime ikuku na-ezute elu kan oyi, na-efunahụ okpomọkụ, wee gbanwee ka ọ bụrụ mmiri mmiri, nke a bụ 'condensation (liquefaction)'.
20261124-chemistry-g04-1.example: Ikuku mmiri anaghị ahụ anya na-adị n'ikuku mgbe niile.
20261124-chemistry-g04-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261124-chemistry-g04-2.title: Evaporation, ịsị, condensation na mgbanwe oke nke ice
20261124-chemistry-g04-2.summary: Mgbe mmiri mmiri na-ejikọta ka ọ bụrụ ice siri ike, kedu nkọwa ziri ezi banyere mgbanwe arọ na oke?
20261124-chemistry-g04-2.principle: Mgbe mmiri na-aghọ ice, a na-echekwa oke (arọ), ma n'ihi na molekul mmiri na-etolite kristal hexagon nwere oghere ọtụtụ site na njikọ hydrogen, oke na-abawanye ihe dị ka 10%.
20261124-chemistry-g04-2.example: Ọbụlagodi mmiri jikọtara, ọnụ ọgụgụ niile nke molekul anaghị agbanwe.
20261124-chemistry-g04-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261124-chemistry-g05-1.title: Solute, solvent, solution na nchịkọta
20261124-chemistry-g05-1.summary: E gbazere gram 50 shuga kpamkpam n'ime gram 200 mmiri. Kedu nke jikọtara 'solvent', 'solute', na 'solution' n'ime mmiri shuga a ziri ezi?
20261124-chemistry-g05-1.principle: Mmiri nke na-agbaze bụ 'solvent', shuga nke na-agbaze bụ 'solute', ma ngwakọta doro anya ebe ha abụọ jikọtara nke ọma bụ 'solution'.
20261124-chemistry-g05-1.example: Mmiri na-agbaze = solvent, ihe na-agbaze = solute, ngwakọta zuru ezu = solution.
20261124-chemistry-g05-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261124-chemistry-g05-2.title: Solute, solvent, solution na nchịkọta
20261124-chemistry-g05-2.summary: A chọrọ ịmụ àgwà nke ngwọta mmiri nnu dị n'ime beaker. Kedu nkọwa ziri ezi banyere àgwà nke ngwọta (ngwakọta otu ụdị)?
20261124-chemistry-g05-2.principle: Ezigbo ngwọta (ngwakọta otu ụdị) nwere ụmụ solute ndị gbasasịrị n'otu n'etiti molekul solvent, ya mere ọ naghị ada n'ala ọbụlagodi ogologo oge, ma nchịkọta ya dị otu n'ebe ọ bụla.
20261124-chemistry-g05-2.example: Ngwọta bụ 'ngwakọta otu ụdị' ebe ụmụ ya jikọtara n'ọkwa molekul.
20261124-chemistry-g05-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261124-chemistry-g06-1.title: Acid, base na ihe atọ nke ọkụ
20261124-chemistry-g06-1.summary: Mgbe e wụsara ngwọta dị iche iche n'ime red cabbage indicator, ngwọta A gbanwere ka ọ bụrụ uhie, ma ngwọta B gbanwere ka ọ bụrụ acha anụnụ anụnụ wee bụrụ odo odo. Kedu àgwà nke ngwọta abụọ ahụ ziri ezi?
20261124-chemistry-g06-1.principle: Red cabbage indicator na-agbanwe ka ọ bụrụ uhie n'acid, ma ọ na-agbanwe ka ọ bụrụ acha anụnụ anụnụ, akwụkwọ ndụ akwụkwọ ndụ, na odo odo n'ime base.
20261124-chemistry-g06-1.example: Mmiri ahụ red cabbage, nke bụ indicator okike, nwere pigment anthocyanin.
20261124-chemistry-g06-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261124-chemistry-g06-2.title: Acid, base na ihe atọ nke ọkụ
20261124-chemistry-g06-2.summary: Mgbe e wụsara hydrochloric acid dị ala ma ọ bụ mmanya (vinegar) n'ime akpị akwa ma ọ bụ marble (nke nwere calcium carbonate), ọkpụkpụ ikuku pụtara. Gịnị na-eme mgbe e kpọkọtara gas a ma gafere ya n'ime mmiri lime?
20261124-chemistry-g06-2.principle: Mgbe calcium carbonate ($\text{CaCO}_3$) na acid na-eme ihe, a na-emepụta carbon dioxide ($\text{CO}_2$) gas, ma carbon dioxide na-eme ihe na mmiri lime ($\text{Ca(OH)}_2$) iji mepụta precipitate calcium carbonate na-acha ọcha, na-eme ka ọ dị ọcha ọcha.
20261124-chemistry-g06-2.example: Mgbe carbonate na acid na-eme ihe, a na-emepụta carbon dioxide (CO₂) gas.
20261124-chemistry-g06-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261124-chemistry-g07-1.title: Iwu Boyle, iwu Charles na mgbanwe ọnọdụ
20261124-chemistry-g07-1.summary: Gịnị bụ isi ihe kpatara 'nrụgide gas' a na-enwe n'akụkụ mgbidi nke akpa mechiri emechi nwere gas?
20261124-chemistry-g07-1.principle: Nrụgide gas na-apụta site n'ike n'otu mpaghara nke ụmụ gas na-agba mgbidi n'ime akpa ahụ mgbe ha na-eme mmegharị n'efu n'agaghị kwụsị.
20261124-chemistry-g07-1.example: Molekul gas na-efe n'ọsọ ọsọ dị ukwuu.
20261124-chemistry-g07-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261124-chemistry-g07-2.title: Iwu Boyle, iwu Charles na mgbanwe ọnọdụ
20261124-chemistry-g07-2.summary: N'okpomọkụ edoziri, a mụbara nrụgide nke gas nke oke ya bụ 60 mL na 1 atm ruo 3 atm. Kedu oke gas a dị dịka iwu Boyle?
20261124-chemistry-g07-2.principle: Dịka iwu Boyle, mgbe okpomọkụ dị otu, $P_1 V_1 = P_2 V_2$ na-adị. $1\text{ atm} \times 60\text{ mL} = 3\text{ atm} \times V_2 \implies V_2 = 20\text{ mL}$.
20261124-chemistry-g07-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261124-chemistry-g08-1.title: Element, atom, ion na mmeghachi omume precipitate
20261124-chemistry-g08-1.summary: Gịnị bụ ihe kpatara atom, nke nwere nucleus na electron, na-abụ ihe na-anọghị n'akụkụ eletrik (neutral)?
20261124-chemistry-g08-1.principle: Atom bụ ihe neutral n'akụkụ eletrik n'ihi na nchikota (+) charge nke proton dị n'etiti nucleus na nchikota (-) charge nke electron ndị na-agagharị n'orbit bụ otu kpamkpam.
20261124-chemistry-g08-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261124-chemistry-g08-2.title: Element, atom, ion na mmeghachi omume precipitate
20261124-chemistry-g08-2.summary: Kedu nkọwa banyere nhazi 'ion', ebe atom neutral na-efunahụ ma ọ bụ nweta electron wee nwee charge, ziri ezi?
20261124-chemistry-g08-2.principle: Atom na-efunahụ electron nke ọkpụkpụ ọdụ iji bụrụ cation (ọkachasị metal), ma ọ bụ na-enweta electron iji mepụta anion nke na-eso octet rule (ọkachasị non-metal).
20261124-chemistry-g08-2.example: Sodium (Na) na-efunahụ otu electron ma ghọọ Na⁺.
20261124-chemistry-g08-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261124-chemistry-g09-1.title: Nchekwa oke, ịdị mgbe niile nke oke, exothermic na endothermic
20261124-chemistry-g09-1.summary: Gịnị bụ isi ihe kpatara iwu nchekwa nke oke ji eme mgbe mgbanwe kemịkalụ na-eme?
20261124-chemistry-g09-1.principle: Mgbe mmeghachi omume kemịkalụ na-eme, ụzọ atọm si ejikọta na-agbanwe ka ihe ọhụrụ pụta, mana ụdị na ọnụọgụ atọm adịghị apụta ma ọ bụ furu efu, a na-echekwa ha, ya mere ngụkọta oke adịghị agbanwe.
20261124-chemistry-g09-1.example: Cheta iwu nchekwa nke oke nke Lavoisier.
20261124-chemistry-g09-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261124-chemistry-g09-2.title: Nchekwa oke, ịdị mgbe niile nke oke, exothermic na endothermic
20261124-chemistry-g09-2.summary: Etinyere ntụ ọla kọpa n'ime crucible ma kpoo ya n'ikuku iji mepụta copper(II) oxide. Mgbe 4 g nke ọla kọpa meghachiri nke ọma, a mepụtara 5 g nke copper(II) oxide. Kedu oke oxygen jikọtara na oke ọla kọpa na oxygen?
20261124-chemistry-g09-2.principle: Oke oxygen meghachiri bụ $5\text{ g} - 4\text{ g} = 1\text{ g}$. Dịka iwu nke ọnụọgụ edoro si dị, oke ọla kọpa na oxygen n'ime copper(II) oxide bụ mgbe niile $4 : 1$.
20261124-chemistry-g09-2.example: Iwu nchekwa nke oke: (ọla kọpa 4 g) + (oxygen ? g) = copper oxide 5 g
20261124-chemistry-g09-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261124-chemistry-g10-1.title: Njikọ ionic, njikọ covalent na oxidation-reduction
20261124-chemistry-g10-1.summary: Kedu nsonaazụ nnwale kacha ziri ezi na-eji tụnyere ike nkwụ ọkụ eletrik nke ihe A (sodium chloride) na ihe B (sugar)?
20261124-chemistry-g10-1.principle: Sodium chloride, ihe jikọtara ionic, na-agbaze n'ime mmiri ma kewaa ka ọ bụrụ cations na anions, ya mere ọkụ eletrik na-aga n'ime ngwọta mmiri, mana sugar, ihe jikọtara covalent, na-agbaze dị ka molecule, enweghị ihe na-ebu ụgwọ eletrik, ya mere ọkụ eletrik anaghị agafe.
20261124-chemistry-g10-1.example: Ihe jikọtara ionic (NaCl) na-agbaze n'ime mmiri ka ọ bụrụ ions nwere ike ịkwaga n'onwe ha.
20261124-chemistry-g10-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261124-chemistry-g10-2.title: Njikọ ionic, njikọ covalent na oxidation-reduction
20261124-chemistry-g10-2.summary: Mgbe a na-etinye ngwọta mmiri sodium hydroxide (NaOH) nke nta nke nta n'ime hydrochloric acid (HCl) dị n'ọnụọgụ ụfọdụ, kedu nsonaazụ ziri ezi nke ịlele mgbanwe ọnụọgụ ions n'ime ngwọta na okpomọkụ?
20261124-chemistry-g10-2.principle: Ebe a na-ahapụ okpomọkụ neutralization n'oge neutralization, okpomọkụ nke ngwọta na-eru n'ebe kachasị elu mgbe ọ ruru ebe neutralization ebe mmeghachi omume zuru ezu. Chloride ion ($\text{Cl}^-$) bụ spectator ion na-anaghị emeghachi omume, ya mere ọnụọgụ ya na-adịgide otu.
20261124-chemistry-g10-2.example: Mgbe mmeghachi omume neutralization (H⁺ + OH⁻ → H₂O) na-eme, a na-ahapụ okpomọkụ neutralization.
20261124-chemistry-g10-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261124-chemistry-g11-1.title: Mole
20261124-chemistry-g11-1.summary: N'ime 11.2 L nke methane gas (CH₄, oke molecule 16) n'ime 0℃ na 1 atm, kedu ọnụọgụ mole nke methane na ngụkọta ọnụọgụ mole nke atọm hydrogen (H)?
20261124-chemistry-g11-1.principle: Ọnụọgụ mole nke methane bụ $n = \frac{11.2\text{ L}}{22.4\text{ L/mol}} = 0.5\text{ mol}$. Ebe $1$ molecule nke methane nwere atọm hydrogen $4$, ngụkọta mole nke atọm hydrogen bụ $0.5 \times 4 = 2.0\text{ mol}$.
20261124-chemistry-g11-1.example: N'ime 0℃ na 1 atm, 1 mol nke gas = 22.4 L.
20261124-chemistry-g11-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261124-chemistry-g11-2.title: Mole
20261124-chemistry-g11-2.summary: Kedu oke nke NaOH siri ike zuru ezu achọrọ iji kwadebe 500 mL nke ngwọta mmiri sodium hydroxide (NaOH, oke formula 40) 0.1 M?
20261124-chemistry-g11-2.principle: Ọnụọgụ mole nke $\text{NaOH}$ achọrọ bụ $n = M \times V = 0.1\text{ mol/L} \times 0.5\text{ L} = 0.05\text{ mol}$. Oke achọrọ bụ $w = n \times M_w = 0.05\text{ mol} \times 40\text{ g/mol} = 2.0\text{ g}$.
20261124-chemistry-g11-2.example: Molarity M = ọnụọgụ mole (mol) / olu ngwọta (L)
20261124-chemistry-g11-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261124-chemistry-g12-1.title: Ọsọ mmeghachi omume, ụkpụrụ Le Chatelier na batrị kemịkal
20261124-chemistry-g12-1.summary: Kedu nkọwa ziri ezi banyere mgbanwe na-eme mgbe a na-agbakwunye 'positive catalyst' n'ime mmeghachi omume kemịkalụ?
20261124-chemistry-g12-1.principle: Positive catalyst na-enye ụzọ mmeghachi omume ọhụrụ nwere activation energy dị ala, na-eme ka rate constants nke mmeghachi omume n'ihu na nke azụ dịkwuo elu n'otu ọnụọgụ. Ọ naghị agbanwe reaction enthalpy ($\Delta H$) na equilibrium constant ($K$) ma ọlị.
20261124-chemistry-g12-1.example: Catalyst anaghị agbanwe ọdịiche ume n'etiti ihe mmalite na ngwaahịa ikpeazụ (ΔH) ma ọlị.
20261124-chemistry-g12-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261124-chemistry-g12-2.title: Ọsọ mmeghachi omume, ụkpụrụ Le Chatelier na batrị kemịkal
20261124-chemistry-g12-2.summary: Maka mmeghachi omume 2NO(g) + O₂(g) → 2NO₂(g), site na usoro ọsọ mmalite, mgbe a debere [O₂] otu ma mee [NO] okpukpu abụọ, ọsọ ghọrọ okpukpu anọ, ma mgbe a debere [NO] otu ma mee [O₂] okpukpu abụọ, ọsọ ghọrọ okpukpu abụọ. Kedu iwu ọsọ na usoro mmeghachi omume zuru oke nke mmeghachi omume a?
20261124-chemistry-g12-2.principle: Ebe ọsọ bụ okpukpu $4$ mgbe $[\text{NO}]$ bụ okpukpu $2$, $m=2$, ma ebe ọsọ bụ okpukpu $2$ mgbe $[\text{O}_2]$ bụ okpukpu $2$, $n=1$. Iwu ọsọ bụ $v = k[\text{NO}]^2[\text{O}_2]$, ma usoro mmeghachi omume zuru oke bụ $2 + 1 = 3$.
20261124-chemistry-g12-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261125-chemistry-g01-1.title: Àgwà dị iche iche nke ihe na ngwa
20261125-chemistry-g01-1.summary: N'ime ndị a, kedu nke jikọtara 'ihe (ọkpụrụkpụ)' nwere ụdị doro anya na ojiji pụrụ iche na 'ihe e ji mee ya (ngwa)' ziri ezi?
20261125-chemistry-g01-1.principle: Ihe nwere ụdị na ojiji bụ 'ihe', ma ihe bụ isi e ji mee ihe ahụ bụ 'ngwa'.
20261125-chemistry-g01-1.example: 'Ihe' bụ aha ihe e mechara a na-eji, 'ngwa' bụ aha ihe e ji mee ya.
20261125-chemistry-g01-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261125-chemistry-g01-2.title: Àgwà dị iche iche nke ihe na ngwa
20261125-chemistry-g01-2.summary: Kedu àgwà pụrụ iche nke ihe dị ka rọba ma ọ bụ bọlụn, nke na-agbatị mgbe e dọrọ ya ma laghachi n'ụdị mbụ ya mgbe e hapụrụ ya?
20261125-chemistry-g01-2.principle: Àgwà nke ihe e gbanwere site n'ike ma laghachi n'ụdị mbụ ya mgbe ike ahụ kwụsịrị bụ 'ịgbatị na ịlaghachi (elasticity)'.
20261125-chemistry-g01-2.example: Ọ bụ àgwà ịlaghachi n'ụdị mbụ.
20261125-chemistry-g01-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261125-chemistry-g02-1.title: Ihe na-agbaze n'ime mmiri na ngwakọta
20261125-chemistry-g02-1.summary: Mgbe e tinyere otu ngaji shuga n'ime beaker nwere mmiri ọkụ ma were osisi gilaasị kpoo ya, kedu nkọwa ziri ezi banyere ihe na-eme?
20261125-chemistry-g02-1.principle: Mgbe shuga gbaze n'ime mmiri, ụmụ shuga na-agbasa n'etiti ụmụ mmiri nke ọma, ya mere a naghị ahụ ha, ma mmiri shuga na-adị doro anya.
20261125-chemistry-g02-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261125-chemistry-g02-2.title: Ihe na-agbaze n'ime mmiri na ngwakọta
20261125-chemistry-g02-2.summary: Gịnị mere shuga ji agbaze ngwa ngwa karịa n'iko nwere mmiri ọkụ ma e jiri ya tụnyere iko nwere mmiri oyi?
20261125-chemistry-g02-2.principle: Ka okpomọkụ mmiri dị elu, ụmụ mmiri na-eme mmegharị ọkụ nke ọma ma na-agbaje ụmụ shuga ugboro ugboro na ike karịa, ya mere ọsọ mgbaze na-abawanye.
20261125-chemistry-g02-2.example: Ka okpomọkụ dị elu, ụmụ mmiri na-aga ngwa ngwa.
20261125-chemistry-g02-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261125-chemistry-g03-1.title: Ọnọdụ atọ nke ihe: ihe siri ike, mmiri na gas
20261125-chemistry-g03-1.summary: Kedu ọnọdụ ihe nke ụdị ya na-agbanwe n'efu dabere n'ihe e debere ya n'ime, ma oke ya (volume) anaghị agbanwe ma na-anọgide n'otu?
20261125-chemistry-g03-1.principle: Mmiri nwere njikọ n'etiti molekul na-agbanwe agbanwe karịa nke ihe siri ike, ya mere ụdị ya na-agbanwe dabere n'ihe e debere ya, ma n'ihi na mkpali dọtara n'etiti molekul na-anọgide, oke ya na-adị otu.
20261125-chemistry-g03-1.example: Chee echiche mgbe i na-awụsa mmiri ma ọ bụ mmiri ara ehi n'iko ọzọ.
20261125-chemistry-g03-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261125-chemistry-g03-2.title: Ọnọdụ atọ nke ihe: ihe siri ike, mmiri na gas
20261125-chemistry-g03-2.summary: E tinyere mmiri n'otu syringe ma tinye ikuku n'ọzọ, wee kwụsị ọnụ ya na mkpịsị aka ma pịa piston ike. Kedu ihe na-eme?
20261125-chemistry-g03-2.principle: Gas (ikuku) nwere ebe dị anya nke ukwuu n'etiti molekul, ya mere mgbe a pịrị ya, ọ na-apịkọta ngwa ngwa ma oke ya belata, ma mmiri (liquid) nwere molekul ndị kpọkọtara ma ọ fọrọ nke nta ka ọ pịkọta.
20261125-chemistry-g03-2.example: Molekul gas dị anya nke ukwuu n'ebe ibe ha nọ, ya mere oghere dị ọtụtụ.
20261125-chemistry-g03-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261125-chemistry-g04-1.title: Evaporation, ịsị, condensation na mgbanwe oke nke ice
20261125-chemistry-g04-1.summary: Mgbe e wepụrụ kan ihe ọṅụṅụ oyi n'ime friji wee hapụ ya nwa oge n'elu tebụl, ntanye mmiri pụtara n'elu kan ahụ. Ebee ka mmiri ndị a si bia?
20261125-chemistry-g04-1.principle: Ikuku mmiri dị n'ime ikuku na-ezute elu kan oyi, na-efunahụ okpomọkụ, wee gbanwee ka ọ bụrụ mmiri mmiri, nke a bụ 'condensation (liquefaction)'.
20261125-chemistry-g04-1.example: Ikuku mmiri anaghị ahụ anya na-adị n'ikuku mgbe niile.
20261125-chemistry-g04-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261125-chemistry-g04-2.title: Evaporation, ịsị, condensation na mgbanwe oke nke ice
20261125-chemistry-g04-2.summary: Mgbe mmiri mmiri na-ejikọta ka ọ bụrụ ice siri ike, kedu nkọwa ziri ezi banyere mgbanwe arọ na oke?
20261125-chemistry-g04-2.principle: Mgbe mmiri na-aghọ ice, a na-echekwa oke (arọ), ma n'ihi na molekul mmiri na-etolite kristal hexagon nwere oghere ọtụtụ site na njikọ hydrogen, oke na-abawanye ihe dị ka 10%.
20261125-chemistry-g04-2.example: Ọbụlagodi mmiri jikọtara, ọnụ ọgụgụ niile nke molekul anaghị agbanwe.
20261125-chemistry-g04-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261125-chemistry-g05-1.title: Solute, solvent, solution na nchịkọta
20261125-chemistry-g05-1.summary: E gbazere gram 50 shuga kpamkpam n'ime gram 200 mmiri. Kedu nke jikọtara 'solvent', 'solute', na 'solution' n'ime mmiri shuga a ziri ezi?
20261125-chemistry-g05-1.principle: Mmiri nke na-agbaze bụ 'solvent', shuga nke na-agbaze bụ 'solute', ma ngwakọta doro anya ebe ha abụọ jikọtara nke ọma bụ 'solution'.
20261125-chemistry-g05-1.example: Mmiri na-agbaze = solvent, ihe na-agbaze = solute, ngwakọta zuru ezu = solution.
20261125-chemistry-g05-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261125-chemistry-g05-2.title: Solute, solvent, solution na nchịkọta
20261125-chemistry-g05-2.summary: A chọrọ ịmụ àgwà nke ngwọta mmiri nnu dị n'ime beaker. Kedu nkọwa ziri ezi banyere àgwà nke ngwọta (ngwakọta otu ụdị)?
20261125-chemistry-g05-2.principle: Ezigbo ngwọta (ngwakọta otu ụdị) nwere ụmụ solute ndị gbasasịrị n'otu n'etiti molekul solvent, ya mere ọ naghị ada n'ala ọbụlagodi ogologo oge, ma nchịkọta ya dị otu n'ebe ọ bụla.
20261125-chemistry-g05-2.example: Ngwọta bụ 'ngwakọta otu ụdị' ebe ụmụ ya jikọtara n'ọkwa molekul.
20261125-chemistry-g05-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261125-chemistry-g06-1.title: Acid, base na ihe atọ nke ọkụ
20261125-chemistry-g06-1.summary: Mgbe e wụsara ngwọta dị iche iche n'ime red cabbage indicator, ngwọta A gbanwere ka ọ bụrụ uhie, ma ngwọta B gbanwere ka ọ bụrụ acha anụnụ anụnụ wee bụrụ odo odo. Kedu àgwà nke ngwọta abụọ ahụ ziri ezi?
20261125-chemistry-g06-1.principle: Red cabbage indicator na-agbanwe ka ọ bụrụ uhie n'acid, ma ọ na-agbanwe ka ọ bụrụ acha anụnụ anụnụ, akwụkwọ ndụ akwụkwọ ndụ, na odo odo n'ime base.
20261125-chemistry-g06-1.example: Mmiri ahụ red cabbage, nke bụ indicator okike, nwere pigment anthocyanin.
20261125-chemistry-g06-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261125-chemistry-g06-2.title: Acid, base na ihe atọ nke ọkụ
20261125-chemistry-g06-2.summary: Mgbe e wụsara hydrochloric acid dị ala ma ọ bụ mmanya (vinegar) n'ime akpị akwa ma ọ bụ marble (nke nwere calcium carbonate), ọkpụkpụ ikuku pụtara. Gịnị na-eme mgbe e kpọkọtara gas a ma gafere ya n'ime mmiri lime?
20261125-chemistry-g06-2.principle: Mgbe calcium carbonate ($\text{CaCO}_3$) na acid na-eme ihe, a na-emepụta carbon dioxide ($\text{CO}_2$) gas, ma carbon dioxide na-eme ihe na mmiri lime ($\text{Ca(OH)}_2$) iji mepụta precipitate calcium carbonate na-acha ọcha, na-eme ka ọ dị ọcha ọcha.
20261125-chemistry-g06-2.example: Mgbe carbonate na acid na-eme ihe, a na-emepụta carbon dioxide (CO₂) gas.
20261125-chemistry-g06-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261125-chemistry-g07-1.title: Iwu Boyle, iwu Charles na mgbanwe ọnọdụ
20261125-chemistry-g07-1.summary: Gịnị bụ isi ihe kpatara 'nrụgide gas' a na-enwe n'akụkụ mgbidi nke akpa mechiri emechi nwere gas?
20261125-chemistry-g07-1.principle: Nrụgide gas na-apụta site n'ike n'otu mpaghara nke ụmụ gas na-agba mgbidi n'ime akpa ahụ mgbe ha na-eme mmegharị n'efu n'agaghị kwụsị.
20261125-chemistry-g07-1.example: Molekul gas na-efe n'ọsọ ọsọ dị ukwuu.
20261125-chemistry-g07-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261125-chemistry-g07-2.title: Iwu Boyle, iwu Charles na mgbanwe ọnọdụ
20261125-chemistry-g07-2.summary: N'okpomọkụ edoziri, a mụbara nrụgide nke gas nke oke ya bụ 60 mL na 1 atm ruo 3 atm. Kedu oke gas a dị dịka iwu Boyle?
20261125-chemistry-g07-2.principle: Dịka iwu Boyle, mgbe okpomọkụ dị otu, $P_1 V_1 = P_2 V_2$ na-adị. $1\text{ atm} \times 60\text{ mL} = 3\text{ atm} \times V_2 \implies V_2 = 20\text{ mL}$.
20261125-chemistry-g07-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261125-chemistry-g08-1.title: Element, atom, ion na mmeghachi omume precipitate
20261125-chemistry-g08-1.summary: Gịnị bụ ihe kpatara atom, nke nwere nucleus na electron, na-abụ ihe na-anọghị n'akụkụ eletrik (neutral)?
20261125-chemistry-g08-1.principle: Atom bụ ihe neutral n'akụkụ eletrik n'ihi na nchikota (+) charge nke proton dị n'etiti nucleus na nchikota (-) charge nke electron ndị na-agagharị n'orbit bụ otu kpamkpam.
20261125-chemistry-g08-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261125-chemistry-g08-2.title: Element, atom, ion na mmeghachi omume precipitate
20261125-chemistry-g08-2.summary: Kedu nkọwa banyere nhazi 'ion', ebe atom neutral na-efunahụ ma ọ bụ nweta electron wee nwee charge, ziri ezi?
20261125-chemistry-g08-2.principle: Atom na-efunahụ electron nke ọkpụkpụ ọdụ iji bụrụ cation (ọkachasị metal), ma ọ bụ na-enweta electron iji mepụta anion nke na-eso octet rule (ọkachasị non-metal).
20261125-chemistry-g08-2.example: Sodium (Na) na-efunahụ otu electron ma ghọọ Na⁺.
20261125-chemistry-g08-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261125-chemistry-g09-1.title: Nchekwa oke, ịdị mgbe niile nke oke, exothermic na endothermic
20261125-chemistry-g09-1.summary: Gịnị bụ isi ihe kpatara iwu nchekwa nke oke ji eme mgbe mgbanwe kemịkalụ na-eme?
20261125-chemistry-g09-1.principle: Mgbe mmeghachi omume kemịkalụ na-eme, ụzọ atọm si ejikọta na-agbanwe ka ihe ọhụrụ pụta, mana ụdị na ọnụọgụ atọm adịghị apụta ma ọ bụ furu efu, a na-echekwa ha, ya mere ngụkọta oke adịghị agbanwe.
20261125-chemistry-g09-1.example: Cheta iwu nchekwa nke oke nke Lavoisier.
20261125-chemistry-g09-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261125-chemistry-g09-2.title: Nchekwa oke, ịdị mgbe niile nke oke, exothermic na endothermic
20261125-chemistry-g09-2.summary: Etinyere ntụ ọla kọpa n'ime crucible ma kpoo ya n'ikuku iji mepụta copper(II) oxide. Mgbe 4 g nke ọla kọpa meghachiri nke ọma, a mepụtara 5 g nke copper(II) oxide. Kedu oke oxygen jikọtara na oke ọla kọpa na oxygen?
20261125-chemistry-g09-2.principle: Oke oxygen meghachiri bụ $5\text{ g} - 4\text{ g} = 1\text{ g}$. Dịka iwu nke ọnụọgụ edoro si dị, oke ọla kọpa na oxygen n'ime copper(II) oxide bụ mgbe niile $4 : 1$.
20261125-chemistry-g09-2.example: Iwu nchekwa nke oke: (ọla kọpa 4 g) + (oxygen ? g) = copper oxide 5 g
20261125-chemistry-g09-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261125-chemistry-g10-1.title: Njikọ ionic, njikọ covalent na oxidation-reduction
20261125-chemistry-g10-1.summary: Kedu nsonaazụ nnwale kacha ziri ezi na-eji tụnyere ike nkwụ ọkụ eletrik nke ihe A (sodium chloride) na ihe B (sugar)?
20261125-chemistry-g10-1.principle: Sodium chloride, ihe jikọtara ionic, na-agbaze n'ime mmiri ma kewaa ka ọ bụrụ cations na anions, ya mere ọkụ eletrik na-aga n'ime ngwọta mmiri, mana sugar, ihe jikọtara covalent, na-agbaze dị ka molecule, enweghị ihe na-ebu ụgwọ eletrik, ya mere ọkụ eletrik anaghị agafe.
20261125-chemistry-g10-1.example: Ihe jikọtara ionic (NaCl) na-agbaze n'ime mmiri ka ọ bụrụ ions nwere ike ịkwaga n'onwe ha.
20261125-chemistry-g10-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261125-chemistry-g10-2.title: Njikọ ionic, njikọ covalent na oxidation-reduction
20261125-chemistry-g10-2.summary: Mgbe a na-etinye ngwọta mmiri sodium hydroxide (NaOH) nke nta nke nta n'ime hydrochloric acid (HCl) dị n'ọnụọgụ ụfọdụ, kedu nsonaazụ ziri ezi nke ịlele mgbanwe ọnụọgụ ions n'ime ngwọta na okpomọkụ?
20261125-chemistry-g10-2.principle: Ebe a na-ahapụ okpomọkụ neutralization n'oge neutralization, okpomọkụ nke ngwọta na-eru n'ebe kachasị elu mgbe ọ ruru ebe neutralization ebe mmeghachi omume zuru ezu. Chloride ion ($\text{Cl}^-$) bụ spectator ion na-anaghị emeghachi omume, ya mere ọnụọgụ ya na-adịgide otu.
20261125-chemistry-g10-2.example: Mgbe mmeghachi omume neutralization (H⁺ + OH⁻ → H₂O) na-eme, a na-ahapụ okpomọkụ neutralization.
20261125-chemistry-g10-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261125-chemistry-g11-1.title: Mole
20261125-chemistry-g11-1.summary: N'ime 11.2 L nke methane gas (CH₄, oke molecule 16) n'ime 0℃ na 1 atm, kedu ọnụọgụ mole nke methane na ngụkọta ọnụọgụ mole nke atọm hydrogen (H)?
20261125-chemistry-g11-1.principle: Ọnụọgụ mole nke methane bụ $n = \frac{11.2\text{ L}}{22.4\text{ L/mol}} = 0.5\text{ mol}$. Ebe $1$ molecule nke methane nwere atọm hydrogen $4$, ngụkọta mole nke atọm hydrogen bụ $0.5 \times 4 = 2.0\text{ mol}$.
20261125-chemistry-g11-1.example: N'ime 0℃ na 1 atm, 1 mol nke gas = 22.4 L.
20261125-chemistry-g11-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261125-chemistry-g11-2.title: Mole
20261125-chemistry-g11-2.summary: Kedu oke nke NaOH siri ike zuru ezu achọrọ iji kwadebe 500 mL nke ngwọta mmiri sodium hydroxide (NaOH, oke formula 40) 0.1 M?
20261125-chemistry-g11-2.principle: Ọnụọgụ mole nke $\text{NaOH}$ achọrọ bụ $n = M \times V = 0.1\text{ mol/L} \times 0.5\text{ L} = 0.05\text{ mol}$. Oke achọrọ bụ $w = n \times M_w = 0.05\text{ mol} \times 40\text{ g/mol} = 2.0\text{ g}$.
20261125-chemistry-g11-2.example: Molarity M = ọnụọgụ mole (mol) / olu ngwọta (L)

20261125-chemistry-g12-1.title: Ọsọ mmeghachi omume, ụkpụrụ Le Chatelier na batrị kemịkal
20261125-chemistry-g12-1.summary: Kedu nkọwa ziri ezi banyere mgbanwe na-eme mgbe a na-agbakwunye 'positive catalyst' n'ime mmeghachi omume kemịkalụ?
20261125-chemistry-g12-1.principle: Positive catalyst na-enye ụzọ mmeghachi omume ọhụrụ nwere activation energy dị ala, na-eme ka rate constants nke mmeghachi omume n'ihu na nke azụ dịkwuo elu n'otu ọnụọgụ. Ọ naghị agbanwe reaction enthalpy ($\Delta H$) na equilibrium constant ($K$) ma ọlị.
20261125-chemistry-g12-1.example: Catalyst anaghị agbanwe ọdịiche ume n'etiti ihe mmalite na ngwaahịa ikpeazụ (ΔH) ma ọlị.
20261125-chemistry-g12-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261125-chemistry-g12-2.title: Ọsọ mmeghachi omume, ụkpụrụ Le Chatelier na batrị kemịkal
20261125-chemistry-g12-2.summary: Maka mmeghachi omume 2NO(g) + O₂(g) → 2NO₂(g), site na usoro ọsọ mmalite, mgbe a debere [O₂] otu ma mee [NO] okpukpu abụọ, ọsọ ghọrọ okpukpu anọ, ma mgbe a debere [NO] otu ma mee [O₂] okpukpu abụọ, ọsọ ghọrọ okpukpu abụọ. Kedu iwu ọsọ na usoro mmeghachi omume zuru oke nke mmeghachi omume a?
20261125-chemistry-g12-2.principle: Ebe ọsọ bụ okpukpu $4$ mgbe $[\text{NO}]$ bụ okpukpu $2$, $m=2$, ma ebe ọsọ bụ okpukpu $2$ mgbe $[\text{O}_2]$ bụ okpukpu $2$, $n=1$. Iwu ọsọ bụ $v = k[\text{NO}]^2[\text{O}_2]$, ma usoro mmeghachi omume zuru oke bụ $2 + 1 = 3$.

20261119-english-g01-1.title: Chọta omume ndị na-adabaghị n'ọkwa ọdọ mmiri
20261119-english-g01-1.summary:
Ọkwa dị n'ọnụ ụzọ ọdọ mmiri (e dere n'okwu naanị, na-enweghị ihe oyiyi):

Pool Rules
1. No running.
2. Swim caps on, please.
3. Under 8? Come with a grown-up.

(grown-up = okenye)

Mmadụ anọ na-aga n'ọdọ mmiri.
Mina dị afọ 7. Ọ na-eso nne ya bịa, ma o nwere okpu.
Jun dị afọ 10. Ọ na-abịa naanị ya, ma o nweghị okpu.
Tom dị afọ 6. Ọ na-eso nwanne ya nwoke bịa. Nwanne ya dị afọ 9. Tom nwere okpu.
Sue dị afọ 11. Ọ na-eje ije gaa ọdọ mmiri naanị ya, ma o nwere okpu.
20261119-english-g01-1.principle: Jun enweghị okpu, ya mere ọ na-agbaji iwu 2. Tom dị n'okpuru 8, ma nwanne ya nwoke nke na-eso ya bịa dị afọ 9, ya mere ọ bụghị 'grown-up', ya mere Tom na-agbaji iwu 3. Mina soro nne ya bịa, ma Sue dị afọ 11, ya mere ọ dị mma ka ọ jee ije bịa naanị ya.
20261119-english-g01-1.example: Mee tebụl nwere afọ onye ọ bụla, onye ọ na-eso bịa, na okpu, otu n'otu.
20261119-english-g01-1.actionItem: Kwekọọ iwu atọ dị n'ọkwa ahụ na ọnọdụ onye ọ bụla, họrọ ikpe ndị na-agbaji iwu, ma kwuo ihe kpatara n'asụsụ Bekee.

20261119-english-g02-1.title: Ebee ka “Two tickets, please.” dị? Ịkpebi ma ozi e nyere ezuola
20261119-english-g02-1.summary:
Ị nụrụ nwoke na onye na-ere tiketi na-ekwu okwu. Ha ekwughị ebe ha nọ.

20261119-english-g02-2.title: Azịza dị aṅaa dabara ekele onye nkuzi? Ịtụle ókè nkwanye ùgwù
20261119-english-g02-2.summary:
Onye nkuzi sịrị n’ụtụtụ, “How are you today, Mina?”

Enyi gị Jin kwuru, “N’asụsụ Bekee, ikwu okwu n’ụzọ nkwanye ùgwù ka mma mgbe niile. I nwere ike ikwu otú ahụ nye mmadụ niile.”
20261119-english-g02-2.principle: b na d zara ekele ma jụọ onye nke ọzọ ajụjụ azụ, ya mere ha dabara onye nkuzi. a bụ nkịtị karịa, c na-ada ka okwu ọjọọ.

20261119-english-g03-1.title: Chọta oge ịgụ akwụkwọ n'usoro oge Saturday nke Mina
20261119-english-g03-1.summary:
Usoro oge Saturday nke Mina (e dere dị ka ederede naanị, na-enweghị ihe oyiyi):

10 a.m.: I can start my free time.
12 p.m. - 1 p.m.: Lunch
1 p.m. - 2 p.m.: Dance class
5 p.m.: Dinner. I must finish before dinner.

Mina chọrọ ịgụ akwụkwọ awa 1. Ọ na-amalite n'awa zuru ezu ma na-akwụsị n'awa zuru ezu.
20261119-english-g03-1.principle: Oge ezumike na-amalite na 10 a.m., ma 12 ruo 14 jupụtara na nri ehihie na ịgba egwu. Ọrụ ọ bụla adịghị n'usoro oge site na 15 ruo 16 na site na 16 ruo 17, ma ha na-agwụ tupu nri abalị.
20261119-english-g03-1.example: Gbanwee oge dị n'usoro oge ka ọ bụrụ ọnụọgụ awa 24 ma see eserese oge.
20261119-english-g03-1.actionItem: Chee oge mmalite ịgụ akwụkwọ dị iche nke na-emezu ọnọdụ niile dị n'usoro oge, ma kọwaa ihe mere oge ndị ọzọ anaghị arụ ọrụ.

20261119-english-g03-2.title: Gosi 'nchegbu' n'enweghị ikwu ya
20261119-english-g03-2.summary: Ị ga-ede ihe omume ebe enyi gị Mina na-echegbu onwe ya n'oge ule. Ederede na-ekwu mmetụta ozugbo na ederede na-egosi ya site n'omume na-eru onye na-agụ n'ụzọ dị iche.
20261119-english-g03-2.principle: Site n'aka oyi na ịlele elekere ugboro ugboro, onye na-agụ nwere ike ichee nchegbu. Ịmị ọnụ mgbe ọ na-ele window na-egosi ike ọgwụgwụ, ma ịmụmụ ọnụ ọchị mgbe ọ na-ede ngwa ngwa na-egosi udo ma ọ bụ ntụkwasị obi.
20261119-english-g03-2.example: Site na ederede atọ ọ bụla, họrọ ma dee omume Mina ma ọ bụ mgbanwe ahụ ya.
20261119-english-g03-2.actionItem: Dee obere ederede ebe onye na-agụ nwere ike ichee mmetụta site n'omume na ihe ngosi ahụ naanị, n'enweghị okwu mmetụta ọ bụla.

20261119-english-g04-1.title: Ndetu nne na oge egwuregwu Jisu
20261119-english-g04-1.summary:
'Ndetu nne hapụrụ n'elu tebụl (e dere dị ka ederede naanị, n'enweghị eserese):

Mina,
Today's plan:
3:30 p.m. Come home.
4:00 p.m. Piano class (30 minutes).
5:00 p.m. Take out the trash.
6:30 p.m. Dinner with Mom and Dad.

Mgbe ahụ enyi ya Jisu zigara ozi ederede. "Let's play at the park from 4:15 to 5:15 today!"'
20261119-english-g04-1.principle: Klaasị piano bụ 4:00-4:30, ya mere 4:15-4:30 na-adabere, ma ịtụpụ ahịhịa na 5:00 dabara n'ime 4:15-5:15. Ịlọta ụlọ na 3:30 na nri abalị na 6:30 dị n'èzí oge ogige.
20261119-english-g04-1.example: Tinye ahịrị ọ bụla n'akụkụ oge ogige '4:15-5:15' otu n'otu, ma lee ma ọ na-agwụ tupu ya ma ọ bụ na-amalite mgbe ya.
20261119-english-g04-1.actionItem: Tụnyere atụmatụ dị iche iche dị n'ndetu nne na oge enyi tụrụ aro, chọta ebe ha na-adabaghị, ma kwuo mba n'asụsụ Bekee ka ị na-atụ aro oge dị iche.

20261119-english-g04-2.title: Kpebie oge ịga ije nkịta na ọrụ ụlọ
20261119-english-g04-2.summary:
"Ndetu Papa hapụrụ (e dere dị ka ederede naanị, n'enweghị eserese):

Mina,
You come home at 4:00 p.m. I come home at 6:30 p.m.
- Walk the dog for 30 minutes. Not before 5:00 p.m. It is too hot.
- Do your homework for 60 minutes.
- Finish both before I come home.
- Do not do both at the same time.

N'okpuru, dee oge ọ bụla dị ka 'ole nkeji mgbe 4:00 p.m.'. Dịka ọmụmaatụ, ọ bụrụ na ị malite na 4:30, dee 30, ma ọ bụrụ na ị malite na 5:15, dee 75."

20261119-english-g05-2.title: 'Most popular' - ederede ahụ na-akwado ya?
20261119-english-g05-2.summary:
'Klaasị Mina nwere akụkụ ịgụ akwụkwọ nwere ebe a na-edebe akwụkwọ.

Our class has a reading corner. There are 20 books on the shelf. Twelve of them are about animals. Four are about space, and four are story books. The teacher did not buy any new books this year.

Mina says, "Animal books are the most popular in our class."'
20261119-english-g05-2.principle: Ederede naanị na-agwa ọnụọgụ akwụkwọ dị n'ebe a na-edebe akwụkwọ (akwụkwọ anụmanụ 12, wdg.). Ọ naghị ekwu akwụkwọ kedu ụmụ akwụkwọ na-agụ ma ọ bụ na-eji nke ukwuu, ya mere anyị enweghị ike ilele nkwupụta 'most popular'.
20261119-english-g05-2.example: Chee ihe 'popular' pụtara n'okwu Mina, ma chọọ ahịrị okwu dị n'ederede na-agwa gị nke ahụ.
20261119-english-g05-2.actionItem: Chee ma ozi ọnụọgụ dị n'ederede na-akwado nkwupụta (popular), ma mee ajụjụ Bekee nwere ike ịlele nkwupụta ahụ.

20261119-english-g06-2.title: Ime tebụl iji chọta ikpe ebe nkwupụta bụ eziokwu
20261119-english-g06-2.summary: Ụmụ akwụkwọ 20 n'otu klaasị nke ọ bụla tụrụ otu votu maka omume mgbe nri nta: bọl, nka, ma ọ bụ egwú. A na-akpọ votu ndị ahụ s (bọl), a (nka), na m (egwú).
20261119-english-g06-2.principle: Votu 8 karịrị nka (6) na egwú (6), ya mere ọ bụ nke kacha, ọ dịkwa ntakịrị karịa 10, ọkara nke 20, ya mere ọ bụghị ọkara. Ya mere a ziri ezi.

20261119-english-g07-1.title: Ben ọ ga-abịa oriri ahụ? Ịtụle ihe zoro n’azụ azịza ya
20261119-english-g07-1.summary:
Mkparịta ụka Jisu na Ben (ederede naanị, enweghị foto):

Jisu: Do you want to come to my birthday party on Saturday?
Ben: Saturday? Hmm. I have a soccer game in the morning.
Jisu: The party is at 4 p.m.
Ben: Oh, that might work. I'll probably be tired, though.
Jisu: So... are you coming?
Ben: Let me check with my mom first.
20261119-english-g07-1.principle: Egwuregwu bọọlụ bụ n’ụtụtụ, oriri bụ na 4 p.m., ya mere oge anaghị ekpuchikọ. Ben kwuru naanị na ike nwere ike gwụ ya; na njedebe o kwuru na ọ ga-ebu ụzọ jụọ mama ya. Ya mere e kpebiela ihe ụfọdụ (oge), ihe ọzọ ka fọdụrụ (ikike mama ya), a kpebeghịkwa.
20261119-english-g07-1.example: Kewaa okwu Ben n’akụkụ anọ: “soccer game,” “party time,” “tired,” na “mom.”
20261119-english-g07-1.actionItem: Kewaa okwu Ben n’ime mkparịta ụka ahụ ahịrị n’ahịrị, kewaa ihe e kpebiela na nke fọdụrụ, kpebie n’enweghị nkwupụta na “ọ ga-abịa” ma ọ bụ “ọ gaghị abịa.”

20261119-english-g09-1.title: Echiche zoro n’ime “anyị rere nri ehihie 200 pere mpe”

20261119-english-g10-1.title: Kedu ka anyị ga-esi dee ọkwa abụọ na-emegide ibe ha n'akwụkwọ akụkọ ụlọ akwụkwọ?
20261119-english-g10-1.summary:
Ị nọ n'otu ndị edemede nke akwụkwọ akụkọ bekee ụlọ akwụkwọ. Ọkwa abụọ banyere ememme dị iche n'ibe ha.

Ọkwa ụlọ akwụkwọ: "Festival: Friday, 4 p.m., in the gym. Free for all students."
Posta ụlọ ọrụ ụmụ akwụkwọ: "Festival: Friday, 5 p.m., in the gym. Tickets: 1,000 won."

I kwenyebeghị nke ziri ezi.
20261119-english-g10-1.principle: Ọ bụrụ na ekwenyeghị, ihe ziri ezi bụ ikwu ihe isi iyi abụọ ahụ nke ọ bụla na-ekwu ma gwa ndị na-agụ na a ka na-elele ya. Ịhọrọ otu akụkụ ma kwuo ya n'ike, ma ọ bụ ịgwa mmadụ ka ha ghara ịbịa n'enweghị ozi, na-eduhie ndị na-agụ.
20261119-english-g10-1.example: Tụnyere ozi mgbasa ozi ọ bụla na-enye ndị na-agụ na ihe ọ na-ezo.
20261119-english-g10-1.actionItem: Dee maka ndị na-agụ (ụmụ akwụkwọ) ihe na-ebufe ọkwa abụọ dị iche n'ụzọ ziri ezi, na-ekwu ihe ekwenyeghị na ihe ndị na-agụ kwesịrị ime.

20261119-english-g10-2.title: Otu ihe atụ nwere ike ịkwado ikwu 'mgbe niile'?
20261119-english-g10-2.summary:
"Nke a bụ akụkụ nke ederede e bipụtara n'akwụkwọ akụkọ ụlọ akwụkwọ (nọmba ahịrị na-amalite na 1).
1) Our school should ban phones from the building.
2) Last month, Mina got a new phone, and her math score dropped from 90 to 75.
3) So phones clearly make all students' grades worse.
4) Also, phones are noisy in the hallway, and some students look up answers during tests.
5) Therefore, the school should ban them for everyone."
20261119-english-g10-2.principle: Ahịrị 3 bụ nsogbu. Ikwu na akara ga-adị njọ "n'ezie" maka "ụmụ akwụkwọ niile" dabere naanị n'ịda nke akara otu nwa akwụkwọ (ahịrị 2) bụ nkwubi okwu dị ukwuu karịa ihe akaebe. Ịda akara nwere ike inwe ihe ndị ọzọ kpatara ya, dị ka isi ike ule ma ọ bụ ọnọdụ. Ahịrị 4 na-enye ihe kpatara dị iche na akara (mkpọtụ, ịghọgbu), ya mere a ga-atụle ya iche na nsogbu a. "Banned for everyone" n'ahịrị 5 dabekwara n'nkwubi okwu a, ma ebe nsogbu na-amalite bụ ahịrị 3.
20261119-english-g10-2.example: Maka ahịrị ọ bụla, kewaa 'ihe ọ kọrọ' na 'ihe ọ kwubiri'.
20261119-english-g10-2.actionItem: N'ederede arụmụka, chọta ahịrị ebe ihe akaebe anaghị akwado nkwupụta ahụ nke ọma, dee ya ọzọ ka ọ bụrụ ahịrị okwu nlezianya karịa, ma kpebie ihe akaebe ọzọ achọrọ.

'Nke a bụ akụkụ nke akụkọ ụlọ ọrụ ụmụ akwụkwọ.

20261119-english-g12-2.title: Otu ihe merenụ, isi okwu dị iche: ikpe na-agbanwe ka ozi na-abawanye
20261119-english-g12-2.summary: A na-ewepụta n'ogo akụkọ banyere kansụl obodo kpebiri ịbawanye ụgwọ ebe a na-ebu ụgbọala n'akụkụ ọdụ ụgbọ ala. Lelee ma ikpe gị na-agbanwe oge ọ bụla ozi na-abawanye.
20261119-english-g12-2.principle: Ka ozi na-abawanye, megharịa ikpe gị banyere otú ụda isi okwu na ihe e hapụrụ si gbadata n'otu akụkụ ma e tụnyere eziokwu, ma kọwaa otu ihe n'asụsụ Bekee.
20261119-english-g12-2.example: Kewaa okwu dị n'isi okwu na-enye eziokwu na ndị na-enye mmetụta.
20261119-english-g12-2.actionItem: Ka ozi na-abawanye, megharịa ikpe gị banyere otú ụda isi okwu na ihe e hapụrụ si gbadata n'otu akụkụ ma e tụnyere eziokwu, ma kọwaa otu ihe n'asụsụ Bekee.

english-g12-2.title: Otu ihe merenụ, isi okwu dị iche: ikpe na-agbanwe ka ozi na-abawanye
english-g12-2.summary: A na-ewepụta n'ogo akụkọ banyere kansụl obodo kpebiri ịbawanye ụgwọ ebe a na-ebu ụgbọala n'akụkụ ọdụ ụgbọ ala. Lelee ma ikpe gị na-agbanwe oge ọ bụla ozi na-abawanye.
english-g12-2.principle: Ka ozi na-abawanye, megharịa ikpe gị banyere otú ụda isi okwu na ihe e hapụrụ si gbadata n'otu akụkụ ma e tụnyere eziokwu, ma kọwaa otu ihe n'asụsụ Bekee.

20261121-english-g01-1.title: Chọta omume ndị na-adabaghị n'ọkwa ọdọ mmiri
20261121-english-g01-1.summary:
Ọkwa dị n'ọnụ ụzọ ọdọ mmiri (e dere n'okwu naanị, na-enweghị ihe oyiyi):

Pool Rules
1. No running.
2. Swim caps on, please.
3. Under 8? Come with a grown-up.

(grown-up = okenye)

Mmadụ anọ na-aga n'ọdọ mmiri.
Mina dị afọ 7. Ọ na-eso nne ya bịa, ma o nwere okpu.
Jun dị afọ 10. Ọ na-abịa naanị ya, ma o nweghị okpu.
Tom dị afọ 6. Ọ na-eso nwanne ya nwoke bịa. Nwanne ya dị afọ 9. Tom nwere okpu.
Sue dị afọ 11. Ọ na-eje ije gaa ọdọ mmiri naanị ya, ma o nwere okpu.
20261121-english-g01-1.principle: Jun enweghị okpu, ya mere ọ na-agbaji iwu 2. Tom dị n'okpuru 8, ma nwanne ya nwoke nke na-eso ya bịa dị afọ 9, ya mere ọ bụghị 'grown-up', ya mere Tom na-agbaji iwu 3. Mina soro nne ya bịa, ma Sue dị afọ 11, ya mere ọ dị mma ka ọ jee ije bịa naanị ya.
20261121-english-g01-1.example: Mee tebụl nwere afọ onye ọ bụla, onye ọ na-eso bịa, na okpu, otu n'otu.
20261121-english-g01-1.actionItem: Kwekọọ iwu atọ dị n'ọkwa ahụ na ọnọdụ onye ọ bụla, họrọ ikpe ndị na-agbaji iwu, ma kwuo ihe kpatara n'asụsụ Bekee.

20261121-english-g01-2.title: Dozie ahịrị na-ezighi ezi n'ọkwa ihe furu efu e depụtara
20261121-english-g01-2.summary:
Ọkwa dị n'ebe e ji ọkwa ụlọ akwụkwọ (e dere n'okwu naanị):

Lost and Found
Found: a blue water bottle, near Room 3.
Ask Ms. Park in Room 1 after school.

Enyi gị Jia hụrụ ọkwa a n'ihi na ọ na-achọ karama mmiri ya, ma zigara Hana ozi. Hana chọrọ itụnyere ya na ọkwa ahụ.
20261121-english-g01-2.principle: Ahịrị 4 adịghị mma. N'ọkwa ahụ, Ms. Park nọ n'Room 1, ma ozi ahụ na-ekwu Room 3, ya mere ọ dịghị mma. Blue dị n'ahịrị 2 bụ otu ihe ahụ dị n'ọkwa ahụ, ma Room 3 dị n'ahịrị 3 bụ ebe a hụrụ karama ahụ, ya mere ọ ziri ezi.
20261121-english-g01-2.example: Gosi okwu dị n'ọkwa ahụ (agba, ọnụọgụ ụlọ, aha mmadụ) otu n'otu ma kwekọọ ha na ahịrị nke ozi ahụ.
20261121-english-g01-2.actionItem: Tụnyere ọkwa ihe furu efu na ozi enyi depụtara site na ya, ahịrị n'ahịrị, chọta ahịrị na-ezighi ezi, ma dee ya ọzọ n'ụzọ ziri ezi.

20261121-english-g02-1.title: Ebee ka “Two tickets, please.” dị? Ịkpebi ma ozi e nyere ezuola
20261121-english-g02-1.summary:
Ị nụrụ nwoke na onye na-ere tiketi na-ekwu okwu. Ha ekwughị ebe ha nọ.

Man: Two tickets, please.
Clerk: Here you are. The show starts at 7:00.
20261121-english-g02-1.principle: Ticket na show bụ okwu a na-eji n’ọtụtụ ebe, dịka sinima ma ọ bụ ụlọ egwu. O siri ike iji ahịrị abụọ naanị kpebie otu.
20261121-english-g02-1.example: Chee ebe abụọ ma ọ bụ atọ a pụrụ ikwu ahịrị ndị a.
20261121-english-g02-1.actionItem: Kpebie ma a pụrụ ịmata ebe ahụ site n’ahịrị abụọ a nụrụ naanị, họrọkwa ihe ngosi mgbakwunye ga-ekewa ebe ndị nwere ike ime.

20261121-english-g02-2.title: Azịza dị aṅaa dabara ekele onye nkuzi? Ịtụle ókè nkwanye ùgwù
20261121-english-g02-2.summary:
Onye nkuzi sịrị n’ụtụtụ, “How are you today, Mina?”

Enyi gị Jin kwuru, “N’asụsụ Bekee, ikwu okwu n’ụzọ nkwanye ùgwù ka mma mgbe niile. I nwere ike ikwu otú ahụ nye mmadụ niile.”
20261121-english-g02-2.principle: b na d zara ekele ma jụọ onye nke ọzọ ajụjụ azụ, ya mere ha dabara onye nkuzi. a bụ nkịtị karịa, c na-ada ka okwu ọjọọ.
20261121-english-g02-2.example: Lelee iche ma azịza dabara ajụjụ na ma ọ dabara onye nkuzi.
20261121-english-g02-2.actionItem: Họrọ azịza dabara ekele onye nkuzi, kwuo ọnọdụ ebe nkwupụta “ịkwanyere ùgwù kacha mma mgbe niile” na-abụghị eziokwu.

20261121-english-g03-1.title: Chọta oge ịgụ akwụkwọ n'usoro oge Saturday nke Mina
20261121-english-g03-1.summary:
Usoro oge Saturday nke Mina (e dere dị ka ederede naanị, na-enweghị ihe oyiyi):

10 a.m.: I can start my free time.
12 p.m. - 1 p.m.: Lunch
1 p.m. - 2 p.m.: Dance class
5 p.m.: Dinner. I must finish before dinner.

Mina chọrọ ịgụ akwụkwọ awa 1. Ọ na-amalite n'awa zuru ezu ma na-akwụsị n'awa zuru ezu.
20261121-english-g03-1.principle: Oge ezumike na-amalite na 10 a.m., ma 12 ruo 14 jupụtara na nri ehihie na ịgba egwu. Ọrụ ọ bụla adịghị n'usoro oge site na 15 ruo 16 na site na 16 ruo 17, ma ha na-agwụ tupu nri abalị.
20261121-english-g03-1.example: Gbanwee oge dị n'usoro oge ka ọ bụrụ ọnụọgụ awa 24 ma see eserese oge.
20261121-english-g03-1.actionItem: Chee oge mmalite ịgụ akwụkwọ dị iche nke na-emezu ọnọdụ niile dị n'usoro oge, ma kọwaa ihe mere oge ndị ọzọ anaghị arụ ọrụ.

20261121-english-g03-2.title: Gosi 'nchegbu' n'enweghị ikwu ya
20261121-english-g03-2.summary: Ị ga-ede ihe omume ebe enyi gị Mina na-echegbu onwe ya n'oge ule. Ederede na-ekwu mmetụta ozugbo na ederede na-egosi ya site n'omume na-eru onye na-agụ n'ụzọ dị iche.
20261121-english-g03-2.principle: Site n'aka oyi na ịlele elekere ugboro ugboro, onye na-agụ nwere ike ichee nchegbu. Ịmị ọnụ mgbe ọ na-ele window na-egosi ike ọgwụgwụ, ma ịmụmụ ọnụ ọchị mgbe ọ na-ede ngwa ngwa na-egosi udo ma ọ bụ ntụkwasị obi.
20261121-english-g03-2.example: Site na ederede atọ ọ bụla, họrọ ma dee omume Mina ma ọ bụ mgbanwe ahụ ya.
20261121-english-g03-2.actionItem: Dee obere ederede ebe onye na-agụ nwere ike ichee mmetụta site n'omume na ihe ngosi ahụ naanị, n'enweghị okwu mmetụta ọ bụla.

20261121-english-g04-1.title: Ndetu nne na oge egwuregwu Jisu
20261121-english-g04-1.summary:
'Ndetu nne hapụrụ n'elu tebụl (e dere dị ka ederede naanị, n'enweghị eserese):

Mina,
Today's plan:
3:30 p.m. Come home.
4:00 p.m. Piano class (30 minutes).
5:00 p.m. Take out the trash.
6:30 p.m. Dinner with Mom and Dad.

Mgbe ahụ enyi ya Jisu zigara ozi ederede. "Let's play at the park from 4:15 to 5:15 today!"'
20261121-english-g04-1.principle: Klaasị piano bụ 4:00-4:30, ya mere 4:15-4:30 na-adabere, ma ịtụpụ ahịhịa na 5:00 dabara n'ime 4:15-5:15. Ịlọta ụlọ na 3:30 na nri abalị na 6:30 dị n'èzí oge ogige.
20261121-english-g04-1.example: Tinye ahịrị ọ bụla n'akụkụ oge ogige '4:15-5:15' otu n'otu, ma lee ma ọ na-agwụ tupu ya ma ọ bụ na-amalite mgbe ya.
20261121-english-g04-1.actionItem: Tụnyere atụmatụ dị iche iche dị n'ndetu nne na oge enyi tụrụ aro, chọta ebe ha na-adabaghị, ma kwuo mba n'asụsụ Bekee ka ị na-atụ aro oge dị iche.

20261121-english-g04-2.title: Kpebie oge ịga ije nkịta na ọrụ ụlọ
20261121-english-g04-2.summary:
"Ndetu Papa hapụrụ (e dere dị ka ederede naanị, n'enweghị eserese):

Mina,
You come home at 4:00 p.m. I come home at 6:30 p.m.
- Walk the dog for 30 minutes. Not before 5:00 p.m. It is too hot.
- Do your homework for 60 minutes.
- Finish both before I come home.
- Do not do both at the same time.

N'okpuru, dee oge ọ bụla dị ka 'ole nkeji mgbe 4:00 p.m.'. Dịka ọmụmaatụ, ọ bụrụ na ị malite na 4:30, dee 30, ma ọ bụrụ na ị malite na 5:15, dee 75."
20261121-english-g04-2.principle: Ọrụ ụlọ bụ 5:00-6:00 ma ije bụ 5:30-6:00, ya mere ọrụ abụọ ahụ na-adabere site na 5:30 ruo 6:00. Ije na-amalite mgbe 5:00 ma abụọ na-agwụ tupu 6:30, ya mere a na-edebe ọnọdụ ndị ọzọ.
20261121-english-g04-2.example: Gbakwunye oge ọ na-ewe (n'nkeji) na oge mmalite nke ọrụ ọ bụla iji chọta oge ọ na-agwụ.
20261121-english-g04-2.actionItem: Mee ọtụtụ njikọta dị iche iche nke oge ije na oge ọrụ ụlọ na-ezute ọnọdụ niile dị n'ndetu Papa.

20261121-english-g05-1.title: Echiche gị na-agbanwe ka ị na-agụ ihe nkwanye
20261121-english-g05-1.summary: Jun abụghị onye otu Green Library. Enyi ya Ara bụ onye otu Green Library. Ha abụọ ga-agụ ihe nkwanye dị n'ihu ọbá akwụkwọ otu ahịrị n'otu oge.
20261121-english-g05-1.principle: Gbanwee mkpebi gị oge ọ bụla a na-ekpughe ozi ihe nkwanye n'ọkwa, ma mee ajụjụ Bekee na-elele ozi nke anọghị n'ihe nkwanye.
20261121-english-g05-1.example: Lelee ma ahịrịokwu bụ ọhụrụ oge a na-agbanwe mkpebi gị gara aga.
20261121-english-g05-1.actionItem: Gbanwee mkpebi gị oge ọ bụla a na-ekpughe ozi ihe nkwanye n'ọkwa, ma mee ajụjụ Bekee na-elele ozi nke anọghị n'ihe nkwanye.

20261121-english-g05-2.title: 'Most popular' - ederede ahụ na-akwado ya?
20261121-english-g05-2.summary:
'Klaasị Mina nwere akụkụ ịgụ akwụkwọ nwere ebe a na-edebe akwụkwọ.

Our class has a reading corner. There are 20 books on the shelf. Twelve of them are about animals. Four are about space, and four are story books. The teacher did not buy any new books this year.

Mina says, "Animal books are the most popular in our class."'
20261121-english-g05-2.principle: Ederede naanị na-agwa ọnụọgụ akwụkwọ dị n'ebe a na-edebe akwụkwọ (akwụkwọ anụmanụ 12, wdg.). Ọ naghị ekwu akwụkwọ kedu ụmụ akwụkwọ na-agụ ma ọ bụ na-eji nke ukwuu, ya mere anyị enweghị ike ilele nkwupụta 'most popular'.
20261121-english-g05-2.example: Chee ihe 'popular' pụtara n'okwu Mina, ma chọọ ahịrị okwu dị n'ederede na-agwa gị nke ahụ.
20261121-english-g05-2.actionItem: Chee ma ozi ọnụọgụ dị n'ederede na-akwado nkwupụta (popular), ma mee ajụjụ Bekee nwere ike ịlele nkwupụta ahụ.

20261121-english-g06-1.title: Klọb akwụkwọ ọ̀ bụ ihe ịga nke ọma? Ịgbanwe ikpe gị ka ihe àmà na-abawanye
20261121-english-g06-1.summary: Otu klọb akwụkwọ ọhụrụ amalitela n'ụlọ akwụkwọ anyị. Onye nkụzi kwuru, "The club is a success." Ị ga-anata ihe àmà otu mpempe n'otu oge ma chee echiche ma nkwupụta a ziri ezi.
20261121-english-g06-1.principle: Ka a na-agbakwunye data otu mpempe n'otu oge, gbanwee ikpe gị banyere nkwupụta 'klọb akwụkwọ bụ ihe ịga nke ọma', ma mechie n'asụsụ Bekee site n'iji ihe àmà abụọ.
20261121-english-g06-1.example: Kewaa ihe data ị nwere ugbu a na-egosipụta na ihe ị ka maghị.
20261121-english-g06-1.actionItem: Ka a na-agbakwunye data otu mpempe n'otu oge, gbanwee ikpe gị banyere nkwupụta 'klọb akwụkwọ bụ ihe ịga nke ọma', ma mechie n'asụsụ Bekee site n'iji ihe àmà abụọ.

20261121-english-g06-2.title: Ime tebụl iji chọta ikpe ebe nkwupụta bụ eziokwu
20261121-english-g06-2.summary: Ụmụ akwụkwọ 20 n'otu klaasị nke ọ bụla tụrụ otu votu maka omume mgbe nri nta: bọl, nka, ma ọ bụ egwú. A na-akpọ votu ndị ahụ s (bọl), a (nka), na m (egwú).
20261121-english-g06-2.principle: Votu 8 karịrị nka (6) na egwú (6), ya mere ọ bụ nke kacha, ọ dịkwa ntakịrị karịa 10, ọkara nke 20, ya mere ọ bụghị ọkara. Ya mere a ziri ezi.
20261121-english-g06-2.example: Gbakwunye 8, 6, na 6, chọta ihe ọkara nke ụmụ akwụkwọ 20 bụ, ma tụnyere.
20261121-english-g06-2.actionItem: Mee ọtụtụ tebụl votu n'onwe gị nke nkwupụta bekee 'it got the most votes, but not half of the class' bụ eziokwu.

20261121-english-g07-1.title: Ben ọ ga-abịa oriri ahụ? Ịtụle ihe zoro n’azụ azịza ya
20261121-english-g07-1.summary:
Mkparịta ụka Jisu na Ben (ederede naanị, enweghị foto):

Jisu: Do you want to come to my birthday party on Saturday?
Ben: Saturday? Hmm. I have a soccer game in the morning.
Jisu: The party is at 4 p.m.
Ben: Oh, that might work. I'll probably be tired, though.
Jisu: So... are you coming?
Ben: Let me check with my mom first.
20261121-english-g07-1.principle: Egwuregwu bọọlụ bụ n’ụtụtụ, oriri bụ na 4 p.m., ya mere oge anaghị ekpuchikọ. Ben kwuru naanị na ike nwere ike gwụ ya; na njedebe o kwuru na ọ ga-ebu ụzọ jụọ mama ya. Ya mere e kpebiela ihe ụfọdụ (oge), ihe ọzọ ka fọdụrụ (ikike mama ya), a kpebeghịkwa.
20261121-english-g07-1.example: Kewaa okwu Ben n’akụkụ anọ: “soccer game,” “party time,” “tired,” na “mom.”
20261121-english-g07-1.actionItem: Kewaa okwu Ben n’ime mkparịta ụka ahụ ahịrị n’ahịrị, kewaa ihe e kpebiela na nke fọdụrụ, kpebie n’enweghị nkwupụta na “ọ ga-abịa” ma ọ bụ “ọ gaghị abịa.”

20261121-english-g07-2.title: “That’s fine.” ọ pụtara n’ezie na ọ dị mma?
20261121-english-g07-2.summary: Sam na Dad na-ekwu maka atụmatụ Friday. A ga-ekpughe mkparịta ụka ahụ n’akụkụ atọ. E dere ya dịka ederede, enweghị foto.
20261121-english-g07-2.principle: Site n’ịgụ ntakịrị mkparịta ụka n’otu oge, kpebie mmetụta zoro ezo nke onye na-ekwu okwu, megharịa mkpebi mbụ mgbe ihe ngosi ọhụrụ pụtara.
20261121-english-g07-2.example: Chọta otu ụda okwu ma ọ bụ okwu ọhụrụ n’akụkụ a.
