20261121-english-g07-2.actionItem: Site n’ịgụ ntakịrị mkparịta ụka n’otu oge, kpebie mmetụta zoro ezo nke onye na-ekwu okwu, megharịa mkpebi mbụ mgbe ihe ngosi ọhụrụ pụtara.

20261121-english-g08-1.title: Dee ọzọ nkwupụta na ịga ọbá akwụkwọ ugboro ugboro na-ebuli akara
20261121-english-g08-1.summary: Onye na-ede blog chọrọ ide nke a: 'Library visits make students' scores go up.' Ka anyị lelee ahịrịokwu a megide data.
20261121-english-g08-1.principle: Oge ọ bụla a kpughere data ọhụrụ, kpebie ọzọ ka ị nwere ike ịbụ onye doro anya banyere nkwupụta ahụ, ma dee ọzọ ahịrịokwu ikpeazụ.
20261121-english-g08-1.example: N'nzọụkwụ ọ bụla, lelee ma ozi ọhụrụ na-akwado mkpebi gara aga ma ọ bụ na-ama ya jijiji.
20261121-english-g08-1.actionItem: Oge ọ bụla a kpughere data ọhụrụ, kpebie ọzọ ka ị nwere ike ịbụ onye doro anya banyere nkwupụta ahụ, ma dee ọzọ ahịrịokwu ikpeazụ.

20261121-english-g08-2.title: Dozie ahịrị nwere ọnụọgụ na-ezighị ezi n'ederede blog nke ịhicha osimiri
20261121-english-g08-2.summary: Otu nwa akwụkwọ n'otu klaasị dere ederede a n'blog ụlọ akwụkwọ. (Ọ bụ naanị ederede. Ahịrị ọ bụla nwere nọmba.)
20261121-english-g08-2.principle: Ahịrị 3 na-ekwu na ha chịkọtara akpa 30 n'awa mbụ, ma ahịrị 4 na-ekwu na ngụkọta bụ akpa 18. Ngụkọta enweghị ike ịdị nta karịa ihe e chịkọtara n'awa mbụ. Ederede a naanị enweghị ike ịgwa ma ahịrị 3 ma ọ bụ ahịrị 4 na-ezighị ezi, ya mere ị nwere ike ịhọrọ ọ bụla.
20261121-english-g08-2.example: Chịkọta naanị ahịrị nwere ọnụọgụ ma tụnyere ha n'etiti onwe ha.
20261121-english-g08-2.actionItem: Chọta ahịrị ọnụọgụ abụọ n'ederede blog na-adabaghị n'ibe ha, ma dee ha ọzọ ka ha dabara ozi e kwenyesiri ike.

20261121-english-g09-1.title: Echiche zoro n’ime “anyị rere nri ehihie 200 pere mpe”
20261121-english-g09-1.summary:
E tinyere nke a n’elu bọọdụ n’ihu cafeteria ụlọ akwụkwọ.

“This month, the cafeteria sold 200 fewer lunches than last month. So students did not like the new menu.”
20261121-english-g09-1.principle: Iji si n’eziokwu na ahịa dara gaa “uto nri adabaghị ha,” ọnọdụ ndị ọzọ (ọnụ ọgụgụ ụmụ akwụkwọ, ụbọchị ụlọ akwụkwọ, wdg) ga-abụ otu. Ọ bụrụ ụmụ akwụkwọ ma ọ bụ ụbọchị ụlọ akwụkwọ pere mpe, ahịa ga-ada ọbụna ma uto nri adịghị agbanwe.
20261121-english-g09-1.example: Buru ụzọ dee n’asụsụ nke gị ihe nwere ike ịkpata “ere nri ehihie pere mpe.”
20261121-english-g09-1.actionItem: Chọpụta echiche a na-ekwughị nke dị mkpa ka nkwupụta wee bụrụ eziokwu, dee nkọwa ọzọ n’asụsụ Bekee nke na-eme ka echiche ahụ maa jijiji.

20261121-english-g09-2.title: Gbanwee nhọrọ ụlọ nri ka nkọwa ọzọ na-apụta otu n'otu
20261121-english-g09-2.summary: Otu ezinụlọ na-ahọrọ ụlọ nri maka nri ehihie tupu ihe nkiri (na-amalite na 3:00 p.m.). Oge nri ehihie bụ otu awa malite na 12:30. Ozi nkọwa na-apụta otu n'otu.
20261121-english-g09-2.principle: Gụọ nkọwa ụlọ nri n'ogo n'ogo, megharịa ikpe gị, ma dee n'asụsụ Bekee ọnọdụ nke ọkwa ị nwere ike ịtụkwasị obi.
20261121-english-g09-2.example: Chọta otu okwu ma ọ bụ nọmba ị na-ahụ na nke mbụ n’akụkụ a.
20261121-english-g09-2.actionItem: Gụọ nkọwa ụlọ nri n'ogo n'ogo, megharịa ikpe gị, ma dee n'asụsụ Bekee ọnọdụ nke ọkwa ị nwere ike ịtụkwasị obi.

20261121-english-g10-1.title: Kedu ka anyị ga-esi dee ọkwa abụọ na-emegide ibe ha n'akwụkwọ akụkọ ụlọ akwụkwọ?
20261121-english-g10-1.summary:
Ị nọ n'otu ndị edemede nke akwụkwọ akụkọ bekee ụlọ akwụkwọ. Ọkwa abụọ banyere ememme dị iche n'ibe ha.

Ọkwa ụlọ akwụkwọ: "Festival: Friday, 4 p.m., in the gym. Free for all students."
Posta ụlọ ọrụ ụmụ akwụkwọ: "Festival: Friday, 5 p.m., in the gym. Tickets: 1,000 won."

I kwenyebeghị nke ziri ezi.
20261121-english-g10-1.principle: Ọ bụrụ na ekwenyeghị, ihe ziri ezi bụ ikwu ihe isi iyi abụọ ahụ nke ọ bụla na-ekwu ma gwa ndị na-agụ na a ka na-elele ya. Ịhọrọ otu akụkụ ma kwuo ya n'ike, ma ọ bụ ịgwa mmadụ ka ha ghara ịbịa n'enweghị ozi, na-eduhie ndị na-agụ.
20261121-english-g10-1.example: Tụnyere ozi mgbasa ozi ọ bụla na-enye ndị na-agụ na ihe ọ na-ezo.
20261121-english-g10-1.actionItem: Dee maka ndị na-agụ (ụmụ akwụkwọ) ihe na-ebufe ọkwa abụọ dị iche n'ụzọ ziri ezi, na-ekwu ihe ekwenyeghị na ihe ndị na-agụ kwesịrị ime.

20261121-english-g10-2.title: Otu ihe atụ nwere ike ịkwado ikwu 'mgbe niile'?
20261121-english-g10-2.summary:
"Nke a bụ akụkụ nke ederede e bipụtara n'akwụkwọ akụkọ ụlọ akwụkwọ (nọmba ahịrị na-amalite na 1).
1) Our school should ban phones from the building.
2) Last month, Mina got a new phone, and her math score dropped from 90 to 75.
3) So phones clearly make all students' grades worse.
4) Also, phones are noisy in the hallway, and some students look up answers during tests.
5) Therefore, the school should ban them for everyone."
20261121-english-g10-2.principle: Ahịrị 3 bụ nsogbu. Ikwu na akara ga-adị njọ "n'ezie" maka "ụmụ akwụkwọ niile" dabere naanị n'ịda nke akara otu nwa akwụkwọ (ahịrị 2) bụ nkwubi okwu dị ukwuu karịa ihe akaebe. Ịda akara nwere ike inwe ihe ndị ọzọ kpatara ya, dị ka isi ike ule ma ọ bụ ọnọdụ. Ahịrị 4 na-enye ihe kpatara dị iche na akara (mkpọtụ, ịghọgbu), ya mere a ga-atụle ya iche na nsogbu a. "Banned for everyone" n'ahịrị 5 dabekwara n'nkwubi okwu a, ma ebe nsogbu na-amalite bụ ahịrị 3.
20261121-english-g10-2.example: Maka ahịrị ọ bụla, kewaa 'ihe ọ kọrọ' na 'ihe ọ kwubiri'.
20261121-english-g10-2.actionItem: N'ederede arụmụka, chọta ahịrị ebe ihe akaebe anaghị akwado nkwupụta ahụ nke ọma, dee ya ọzọ ka ọ bụrụ ahịrị okwu nlezianya karịa, ma kpebie ihe akaebe ọzọ achọrọ.

20261121-english-g11-1.title: Ntụziaka ọrụ na-adịghị doo anya: gịnị ka ị kwesịrị ịjụ buru ụzọ?
20261121-english-g11-1.summary:
Nke a bụ email onye ọrụ ọzụzụ Jiho natara site n'onye isi otu Ms. Han.

Hi Jiho,
Please send the sales summary to the client before the meeting.
Thanks,
Ms. Han

Eziokwu Jiho maara: Kalenda otu na-egosi nnọkọ na Aurora Co. na Tuesday n'elekere 10:00 na nnọkọ na Blue Pine Ltd. na Thursday n'elekere 14:00. Folda ekekọrịtara nwere faịlụ nchịkọta ire ahịa dị iche maka July, August na September.
20261121-english-g11-1.principle: Ọ bụrụ na e kpebighị onye ahịa na oge, ị pụrụ izipu faịlụ na-ezighị ezi nye onye ahịa na-ezighị ezi. Maka udi faịlụ, ị pụrụ ịtọ ihe ndabara dị ka PDF ma mara ya ọkwa, ma ọ bụrụ na ọ nọ n'ọrụ enweghị ihe ọ metụtara n'ọrụ ahụ n'onwe ya.
20261121-english-g11-1.example: Lelee ma 'nye onye,' 'gịnị,' na 'tupu mgbe ole' nke ọ bụla na-apụta dị ka otu ihe kpọmkwem n'email ahụ.
20261121-english-g11-1.actionItem: Site n'email ọrụ na-adịghị doo anya, họpụta ozi ndị a ga-ekwenye tupu ime ihe, ma dee email ajụjụ nke dị mfe izaghachi.

20261121-english-g11-2.title: Ọ bụ n'ihi klọb ịgụ akwụkwọ? Kedu ozi ga-eme ka anyị mara?
20261121-english-g11-2.summary:
'Nke a bụ akụkụ nke akụkọ ụlọ ọrụ ụmụ akwụkwọ.

"Students who joined the school reading club had higher English test scores than students who did not (average 82 vs 74). So the reading club raises English scores."

Nwa akwụkwọ Mina chọrọ ilele ma nkwubi okwu a ziri ezi. Ụmụ akwụkwọ na-esonye na klọb site n'ịrịọ ma ọ bụrụ na ha chọrọ.'
20261121-english-g11-2.principle: Ọ bụrụ na ị maara akara tupu ịsonye, ị nwere ike itụnyere ma akara ndị otu dị elu na mbụ ma ọ bụ gbadara mgbe ha sonyechara. N'ihi na ụmụ akwụkwọ na-esonye site n'ịrịọ, ụmụ akwụkwọ nwere ike ịbụ ndị dị mma n'Bekee na mbụ sonyere karịa.
20261121-english-g11-2.example: Chee otu eziokwu bụ na ụmụ akwụkwọ na-esonye 'site n'ịrịọ ma ọ bụrụ na ha chọrọ' nwere ike imetụta ebe mmalite nke otu abụọ ahụ.
20261121-english-g11-2.actionItem: Họrọ ozi achọrọ iji mara ma oghere akara n'etiti ndị otu klọb na ndị na-abụghị ndị otu bụ mmetụta nke klọb, ma dee n'asụsụ Bekee ajụjụ iji nweta ozi ahụ.

20261121-english-g12-1.title: Ụmụ akwụkwọ na-eri nri ụtụtụ nwere akara dị elu: gịnị ọzọ ka anyị chọrọ ịmara?
20261121-english-g12-1.summary:
Nke a bụ nkwupụta sitere n'akụkọ ụlọ akwụkwọ. "Students who eat breakfast get higher test scores, so the school should provide free breakfast." Dịka ihe akaebe, e gosipụtara nsonaazụ nyocha nke ụmụ akwụkwọ 200 dị otú a.

Group | Number of students | Average score
Students who eat breakfast | 130 | 82
Students who skip breakfast | 70 | 74
20261121-english-g12-1.principle: b na-elele ihe kpatara ndị ọzọ (ụra, oge ọmụmụ), c na-elele nsonaazụ nke mmeghachi omume n'ezie, e na-elelekwa ịdị mma nke itụnyere. a na d abụghị ihe akaebe banyere ma nri na-ebuli akara.
20261121-english-g12-1.example: Lelee ma ozi ọ bụla na-enyere aka ịzaa ajụjụ, 'Mmekọrịta dị n'etiti nri ụtụtụ na akara ọ̀ bụ ihe kpatara?'
20261121-english-g12-1.actionItem: Kpee ikpe ma nsonaazụ nyocha na-agwa anyị banyere "ihe kpatara," họrọ ozi ọzọ achọrọ maka mkpebi ahụ, ma tụọ aro n'Bekee usoro itụnyere iji lelee mmetụta nke nri n'efu.

20261121-english-g12-2.title: Otu ihe merenụ, isi okwu dị iche: ikpe na-agbanwe ka ozi na-abawanye
20261121-english-g12-2.summary: A na-ewepụta n'ogo akụkọ banyere kansụl obodo kpebiri ịbawanye ụgwọ ebe a na-ebu ụgbọala n'akụkụ ọdụ ụgbọ ala. Lelee ma ikpe gị na-agbanwe oge ọ bụla ozi na-abawanye.
20261121-english-g12-2.principle: Ka ozi na-abawanye, megharịa ikpe gị banyere otú ụda isi okwu na ihe e hapụrụ si gbadata n'otu akụkụ ma e tụnyere eziokwu, ma kọwaa otu ihe n'asụsụ Bekee.
20261121-english-g12-2.example: Kewaa okwu dị n'isi okwu na-enye eziokwu na ndị na-enye mmetụta.
20261121-english-g12-2.actionItem: Ka ozi na-abawanye, megharịa ikpe gị banyere otú ụda isi okwu na ihe e hapụrụ si gbadata n'otu akụkụ ma e tụnyere eziokwu, ma kọwaa otu ihe n'asụsụ Bekee.

20261122-english-g01-1.title: Chọta omume ndị na-adabaghị n'ọkwa ọdọ mmiri
20261122-english-g01-1.summary:
Ọkwa dị n'ọnụ ụzọ ọdọ mmiri (e dere n'okwu naanị, na-enweghị ihe oyiyi):

Pool Rules
1. No running.
2. Swim caps on, please.
3. Under 8? Come with a grown-up.

(grown-up = okenye)

Mmadụ anọ na-aga n'ọdọ mmiri.
Mina dị afọ 7. Ọ na-eso nne ya bịa, ma o nwere okpu.
Jun dị afọ 10. Ọ na-abịa naanị ya, ma o nweghị okpu.
Tom dị afọ 6. Ọ na-eso nwanne ya nwoke bịa. Nwanne ya dị afọ 9. Tom nwere okpu.
Sue dị afọ 11. Ọ na-eje ije gaa ọdọ mmiri naanị ya, ma o nwere okpu.
20261122-english-g01-1.principle: Jun enweghị okpu, ya mere ọ na-agbaji iwu 2. Tom dị n'okpuru 8, ma nwanne ya nwoke nke na-eso ya bịa dị afọ 9, ya mere ọ bụghị 'grown-up', ya mere Tom na-agbaji iwu 3. Mina soro nne ya bịa, ma Sue dị afọ 11, ya mere ọ dị mma ka ọ jee ije bịa naanị ya.
20261122-english-g01-1.example: Mee tebụl nwere afọ onye ọ bụla, onye ọ na-eso bịa, na okpu, otu n'otu.
20261122-english-g01-1.actionItem: Kwekọọ iwu atọ dị n'ọkwa ahụ na ọnọdụ onye ọ bụla, họrọ ikpe ndị na-agbaji iwu, ma kwuo ihe kpatara n'asụsụ Bekee.

20261122-english-g01-2.title: Dozie ahịrị na-ezighi ezi n'ọkwa ihe furu efu e depụtara
20261122-english-g01-2.summary:
Ọkwa dị n'ebe e ji ọkwa ụlọ akwụkwọ (e dere n'okwu naanị):

Lost and Found
Found: a blue water bottle, near Room 3.
Ask Ms. Park in Room 1 after school.

Enyi gị Jia hụrụ ọkwa a n'ihi na ọ na-achọ karama mmiri ya, ma zigara Hana ozi. Hana chọrọ itụnyere ya na ọkwa ahụ.
20261122-english-g01-2.principle: Ahịrị 4 adịghị mma. N'ọkwa ahụ, Ms. Park nọ n'Room 1, ma ozi ahụ na-ekwu Room 3, ya mere ọ dịghị mma. Blue dị n'ahịrị 2 bụ otu ihe ahụ dị n'ọkwa ahụ, ma Room 3 dị n'ahịrị 3 bụ ebe a hụrụ karama ahụ, ya mere ọ ziri ezi.
20261122-english-g01-2.example: Gosi okwu dị n'ọkwa ahụ (agba, ọnụọgụ ụlọ, aha mmadụ) otu n'otu ma kwekọọ ha na ahịrị nke ozi ahụ.
20261122-english-g01-2.actionItem: Tụnyere ọkwa ihe furu efu na ozi enyi depụtara site na ya, ahịrị n'ahịrị, chọta ahịrị na-ezighi ezi, ma dee ya ọzọ n'ụzọ ziri ezi.

20261122-english-g02-1.title: Ebee ka “Two tickets, please.” dị? Ịkpebi ma ozi e nyere ezuola
20261122-english-g02-1.summary:
Ị nụrụ nwoke na onye na-ere tiketi na-ekwu okwu. Ha ekwughị ebe ha nọ.

Man: Two tickets, please.
Clerk: Here you are. The show starts at 7:00.
20261122-english-g02-1.principle: Ticket na show bụ okwu a na-eji n’ọtụtụ ebe, dịka sinima ma ọ bụ ụlọ egwu. O siri ike iji ahịrị abụọ naanị kpebie otu.
20261122-english-g02-1.example: Chee ebe abụọ ma ọ bụ atọ a pụrụ ikwu ahịrị ndị a.
20261122-english-g02-1.actionItem: Kpebie ma a pụrụ ịmata ebe ahụ site n’ahịrị abụọ a nụrụ naanị, họrọkwa ihe ngosi mgbakwunye ga-ekewa ebe ndị nwere ike ime.

20261122-english-g02-2.title: Azịza dị aṅaa dabara ekele onye nkuzi? Ịtụle ókè nkwanye ùgwù
20261122-english-g02-2.summary:
Onye nkuzi sịrị n’ụtụtụ, “How are you today, Mina?”

Enyi gị Jin kwuru, “N’asụsụ Bekee, ikwu okwu n’ụzọ nkwanye ùgwù ka mma mgbe niile. I nwere ike ikwu otú ahụ nye mmadụ niile.”
20261122-english-g02-2.principle: b na d zara ekele ma jụọ onye nke ọzọ ajụjụ azụ, ya mere ha dabara onye nkuzi. a bụ nkịtị karịa, c na-ada ka okwu ọjọọ.
20261122-english-g02-2.example: Lelee iche ma azịza dabara ajụjụ na ma ọ dabara onye nkuzi.
20261122-english-g02-2.actionItem: Họrọ azịza dabara ekele onye nkuzi, kwuo ọnọdụ ebe nkwupụta “ịkwanyere ùgwù kacha mma mgbe niile” na-abụghị eziokwu.

20261122-english-g03-1.title: Chọta oge ịgụ akwụkwọ n'usoro oge Saturday nke Mina
20261122-english-g03-1.summary:
Usoro oge Saturday nke Mina (e dere dị ka ederede naanị, na-enweghị ihe oyiyi):

10 a.m.: I can start my free time.
12 p.m. - 1 p.m.: Lunch
1 p.m. - 2 p.m.: Dance class
5 p.m.: Dinner. I must finish before dinner.

Mina chọrọ ịgụ akwụkwọ awa 1. Ọ na-amalite n'awa zuru ezu ma na-akwụsị n'awa zuru ezu.
20261122-english-g03-1.principle: Oge ezumike na-amalite na 10 a.m., ma 12 ruo 14 jupụtara na nri ehihie na ịgba egwu. Ọrụ ọ bụla adịghị n'usoro oge site na 15 ruo 16 na site na 16 ruo 17, ma ha na-agwụ tupu nri abalị.
20261122-english-g03-1.example: Gbanwee oge dị n'usoro oge ka ọ bụrụ ọnụọgụ awa 24 ma see eserese oge.
20261122-english-g03-1.actionItem: Chee oge mmalite ịgụ akwụkwọ dị iche nke na-emezu ọnọdụ niile dị n'usoro oge, ma kọwaa ihe mere oge ndị ọzọ anaghị arụ ọrụ.

20261122-english-g03-2.title: Gosi 'nchegbu' n'enweghị ikwu ya
20261122-english-g03-2.summary: Ị ga-ede ihe omume ebe enyi gị Mina na-echegbu onwe ya n'oge ule. Ederede na-ekwu mmetụta ozugbo na ederede na-egosi ya site n'omume na-eru onye na-agụ n'ụzọ dị iche.
20261122-english-g03-2.principle: Site n'aka oyi na ịlele elekere ugboro ugboro, onye na-agụ nwere ike ichee nchegbu. Ịmị ọnụ mgbe ọ na-ele window na-egosi ike ọgwụgwụ, ma ịmụmụ ọnụ ọchị mgbe ọ na-ede ngwa ngwa na-egosi udo ma ọ bụ ntụkwasị obi.
20261122-english-g03-2.example: Site na ederede atọ ọ bụla, họrọ ma dee omume Mina ma ọ bụ mgbanwe ahụ ya.
20261122-english-g03-2.actionItem: Dee obere ederede ebe onye na-agụ nwere ike ichee mmetụta site n'omume na ihe ngosi ahụ naanị, n'enweghị okwu mmetụta ọ bụla.

20261122-english-g04-1.title: Ndetu nne na oge egwuregwu Jisu
20261122-english-g04-1.summary:
'Ndetu nne hapụrụ n'elu tebụl (e dere dị ka ederede naanị, n'enweghị eserese):

Mina,
Today's plan:
3:30 p.m. Come home.
4:00 p.m. Piano class (30 minutes).
5:00 p.m. Take out the trash.
6:30 p.m. Dinner with Mom and Dad.

Mgbe ahụ enyi ya Jisu zigara ozi ederede. "Let's play at the park from 4:15 to 5:15 today!"'
20261122-english-g04-1.principle: Klaasị piano bụ 4:00-4:30, ya mere 4:15-4:30 na-adabere, ma ịtụpụ ahịhịa na 5:00 dabara n'ime 4:15-5:15. Ịlọta ụlọ na 3:30 na nri abalị na 6:30 dị n'èzí oge ogige.
20261122-english-g04-1.example: Tinye ahịrị ọ bụla n'akụkụ oge ogige '4:15-5:15' otu n'otu, ma lee ma ọ na-agwụ tupu ya ma ọ bụ na-amalite mgbe ya.
20261122-english-g04-1.actionItem: Tụnyere atụmatụ dị iche iche dị n'ndetu nne na oge enyi tụrụ aro, chọta ebe ha na-adabaghị, ma kwuo mba n'asụsụ Bekee ka ị na-atụ aro oge dị iche.

20261122-english-g04-2.title: Kpebie oge ịga ije nkịta na ọrụ ụlọ
20261122-english-g04-2.summary:
"Ndetu Papa hapụrụ (e dere dị ka ederede naanị, n'enweghị eserese):

Mina,
You come home at 4:00 p.m. I come home at 6:30 p.m.
- Walk the dog for 30 minutes. Not before 5:00 p.m. It is too hot.
- Do your homework for 60 minutes.
- Finish both before I come home.
- Do not do both at the same time.

N'okpuru, dee oge ọ bụla dị ka 'ole nkeji mgbe 4:00 p.m.'. Dịka ọmụmaatụ, ọ bụrụ na ị malite na 4:30, dee 30, ma ọ bụrụ na ị malite na 5:15, dee 75."
20261122-english-g04-2.principle: Ọrụ ụlọ bụ 5:00-6:00 ma ije bụ 5:30-6:00, ya mere ọrụ abụọ ahụ na-adabere site na 5:30 ruo 6:00. Ije na-amalite mgbe 5:00 ma abụọ na-agwụ tupu 6:30, ya mere a na-edebe ọnọdụ ndị ọzọ.
20261122-english-g04-2.example: Gbakwunye oge ọ na-ewe (n'nkeji) na oge mmalite nke ọrụ ọ bụla iji chọta oge ọ na-agwụ.
20261122-english-g04-2.actionItem: Mee ọtụtụ njikọta dị iche iche nke oge ije na oge ọrụ ụlọ na-ezute ọnọdụ niile dị n'ndetu Papa.

20261122-english-g05-1.title: Echiche gị na-agbanwe ka ị na-agụ ihe nkwanye
20261122-english-g05-1.summary: Jun abụghị onye otu Green Library. Enyi ya Ara bụ onye otu Green Library. Ha abụọ ga-agụ ihe nkwanye dị n'ihu ọbá akwụkwọ otu ahịrị n'otu oge.
20261122-english-g05-1.principle: Gbanwee mkpebi gị oge ọ bụla a na-ekpughe ozi ihe nkwanye n'ọkwa, ma mee ajụjụ Bekee na-elele ozi nke anọghị n'ihe nkwanye.
20261122-english-g05-1.example: Lelee ma ahịrịokwu bụ ọhụrụ oge a na-agbanwe mkpebi gị gara aga.
20261122-english-g05-1.actionItem: Gbanwee mkpebi gị oge ọ bụla a na-ekpughe ozi ihe nkwanye n'ọkwa, ma mee ajụjụ Bekee na-elele ozi nke anọghị n'ihe nkwanye.

20261122-english-g05-2.title: 'Most popular' - ederede ahụ na-akwado ya?
20261122-english-g05-2.summary:
'Klaasị Mina nwere akụkụ ịgụ akwụkwọ nwere ebe a na-edebe akwụkwọ.

Our class has a reading corner. There are 20 books on the shelf. Twelve of them are about animals. Four are about space, and four are story books. The teacher did not buy any new books this year.

Mina says, "Animal books are the most popular in our class."'
20261122-english-g05-2.principle: Ederede naanị na-agwa ọnụọgụ akwụkwọ dị n'ebe a na-edebe akwụkwọ (akwụkwọ anụmanụ 12, wdg.). Ọ naghị ekwu akwụkwọ kedu ụmụ akwụkwọ na-agụ ma ọ bụ na-eji nke ukwuu, ya mere anyị enweghị ike ilele nkwupụta 'most popular'.
20261122-english-g05-2.example: Chee ihe 'popular' pụtara n'okwu Mina, ma chọọ ahịrị okwu dị n'ederede na-agwa gị nke ahụ.
20261122-english-g05-2.actionItem: Chee ma ozi ọnụọgụ dị n'ederede na-akwado nkwupụta (popular), ma mee ajụjụ Bekee nwere ike ịlele nkwupụta ahụ.

20261122-english-g06-1.title: Klọb akwụkwọ ọ̀ bụ ihe ịga nke ọma? Ịgbanwe ikpe gị ka ihe àmà na-abawanye
20261122-english-g06-1.summary: Otu klọb akwụkwọ ọhụrụ amalitela n'ụlọ akwụkwọ anyị. Onye nkụzi kwuru, "The club is a success." Ị ga-anata ihe àmà otu mpempe n'otu oge ma chee echiche ma nkwupụta a ziri ezi.
20261122-english-g06-1.principle: Ka a na-agbakwunye data otu mpempe n'otu oge, gbanwee ikpe gị banyere nkwupụta 'klọb akwụkwọ bụ ihe ịga nke ọma', ma mechie n'asụsụ Bekee site n'iji ihe àmà abụọ.
20261122-english-g06-1.example: Kewaa ihe data ị nwere ugbu a na-egosipụta na ihe ị ka maghị.
20261122-english-g06-1.actionItem: Ka a na-agbakwunye data otu mpempe n'otu oge, gbanwee ikpe gị banyere nkwupụta 'klọb akwụkwọ bụ ihe ịga nke ọma', ma mechie n'asụsụ Bekee site n'iji ihe àmà abụọ.

20261122-english-g06-2.title: Ime tebụl iji chọta ikpe ebe nkwupụta bụ eziokwu
20261122-english-g06-2.summary: Ụmụ akwụkwọ 20 n'otu klaasị nke ọ bụla tụrụ otu votu maka omume mgbe nri nta: bọl, nka, ma ọ bụ egwú. A na-akpọ votu ndị ahụ s (bọl), a (nka), na m (egwú).
20261122-english-g06-2.principle: Votu 8 karịrị nka (6) na egwú (6), ya mere ọ bụ nke kacha, ọ dịkwa ntakịrị karịa 10, ọkara nke 20, ya mere ọ bụghị ọkara. Ya mere a ziri ezi.
20261122-english-g06-2.example: Gbakwunye 8, 6, na 6, chọta ihe ọkara nke ụmụ akwụkwọ 20 bụ, ma tụnyere.
20261122-english-g06-2.actionItem: Mee ọtụtụ tebụl votu n'onwe gị nke nkwupụta bekee 'it got the most votes, but not half of the class' bụ eziokwu.

20261122-english-g07-1.title: Ben ọ ga-abịa oriri ahụ? Ịtụle ihe zoro n’azụ azịza ya
20261122-english-g07-1.summary:
Mkparịta ụka Jisu na Ben (ederede naanị, enweghị foto):

Jisu: Do you want to come to my birthday party on Saturday?
Ben: Saturday? Hmm. I have a soccer game in the morning.
Jisu: The party is at 4 p.m.
Ben: Oh, that might work. I'll probably be tired, though.
Jisu: So... are you coming?
Ben: Let me check with my mom first.
20261122-english-g07-1.principle: Egwuregwu bọọlụ bụ n’ụtụtụ, oriri bụ na 4 p.m., ya mere oge anaghị ekpuchikọ. Ben kwuru naanị na ike nwere ike gwụ ya; na njedebe o kwuru na ọ ga-ebu ụzọ jụọ mama ya. Ya mere e kpebiela ihe ụfọdụ (oge), ihe ọzọ ka fọdụrụ (ikike mama ya), a kpebeghịkwa.
20261122-english-g07-1.example: Kewaa okwu Ben n’akụkụ anọ: “soccer game,” “party time,” “tired,” na “mom.”
20261122-english-g07-1.actionItem: Kewaa okwu Ben n’ime mkparịta ụka ahụ ahịrị n’ahịrị, kewaa ihe e kpebiela na nke fọdụrụ, kpebie n’enweghị nkwupụta na “ọ ga-abịa” ma ọ bụ “ọ gaghị abịa.”

20261122-english-g07-2.title: “That’s fine.” ọ pụtara n’ezie na ọ dị mma?
20261122-english-g07-2.summary: Sam na Dad na-ekwu maka atụmatụ Friday. A ga-ekpughe mkparịta ụka ahụ n’akụkụ atọ. E dere ya dịka ederede, enweghị foto.
20261122-english-g07-2.principle: Site n’ịgụ ntakịrị mkparịta ụka n’otu oge, kpebie mmetụta zoro ezo nke onye na-ekwu okwu, megharịa mkpebi mbụ mgbe ihe ngosi ọhụrụ pụtara.
20261122-english-g07-2.example: Chọta otu ụda okwu ma ọ bụ okwu ọhụrụ n’akụkụ a.
20261122-english-g07-2.actionItem: Site n’ịgụ ntakịrị mkparịta ụka n’otu oge, kpebie mmetụta zoro ezo nke onye na-ekwu okwu, megharịa mkpebi mbụ mgbe ihe ngosi ọhụrụ pụtara.

20261122-english-g08-1.title: Dee ọzọ nkwupụta na ịga ọbá akwụkwọ ugboro ugboro na-ebuli akara
20261122-english-g08-1.summary: Onye na-ede blog chọrọ ide nke a: 'Library visits make students' scores go up.' Ka anyị lelee ahịrịokwu a megide data.
20261122-english-g08-1.principle: Oge ọ bụla a kpughere data ọhụrụ, kpebie ọzọ ka ị nwere ike ịbụ onye doro anya banyere nkwupụta ahụ, ma dee ọzọ ahịrịokwu ikpeazụ.
20261122-english-g08-1.example: N'nzọụkwụ ọ bụla, lelee ma ozi ọhụrụ na-akwado mkpebi gara aga ma ọ bụ na-ama ya jijiji.
20261122-english-g08-1.actionItem: Oge ọ bụla a kpughere data ọhụrụ, kpebie ọzọ ka ị nwere ike ịbụ onye doro anya banyere nkwupụta ahụ, ma dee ọzọ ahịrịokwu ikpeazụ.

20261122-english-g08-2.title: Dozie ahịrị nwere ọnụọgụ na-ezighị ezi n'ederede blog nke ịhicha osimiri
20261122-english-g08-2.summary: Otu nwa akwụkwọ n'otu klaasị dere ederede a n'blog ụlọ akwụkwọ. (Ọ bụ naanị ederede. Ahịrị ọ bụla nwere nọmba.)
20261122-english-g08-2.principle: Ahịrị 3 na-ekwu na ha chịkọtara akpa 30 n'awa mbụ, ma ahịrị 4 na-ekwu na ngụkọta bụ akpa 18. Ngụkọta enweghị ike ịdị nta karịa ihe e chịkọtara n'awa mbụ. Ederede a naanị enweghị ike ịgwa ma ahịrị 3 ma ọ bụ ahịrị 4 na-ezighị ezi, ya mere ị nwere ike ịhọrọ ọ bụla.
20261122-english-g08-2.example: Chịkọta naanị ahịrị nwere ọnụọgụ ma tụnyere ha n'etiti onwe ha.
20261122-english-g08-2.actionItem: Chọta ahịrị ọnụọgụ abụọ n'ederede blog na-adabaghị n'ibe ha, ma dee ha ọzọ ka ha dabara ozi e kwenyesiri ike.

20261122-english-g09-1.title: Echiche zoro n’ime “anyị rere nri ehihie 200 pere mpe”
20261122-english-g09-1.summary:
E tinyere nke a n’elu bọọdụ n’ihu cafeteria ụlọ akwụkwọ.

“This month, the cafeteria sold 200 fewer lunches than last month. So students did not like the new menu.”
20261122-english-g09-1.principle: Iji si n’eziokwu na ahịa dara gaa “uto nri adabaghị ha,” ọnọdụ ndị ọzọ (ọnụ ọgụgụ ụmụ akwụkwọ, ụbọchị ụlọ akwụkwọ, wdg) ga-abụ otu. Ọ bụrụ ụmụ akwụkwọ ma ọ bụ ụbọchị ụlọ akwụkwọ pere mpe, ahịa ga-ada ọbụna ma uto nri adịghị agbanwe.
20261122-english-g09-1.example: Buru ụzọ dee n’asụsụ nke gị ihe nwere ike ịkpata “ere nri ehihie pere mpe.”
20261122-english-g09-1.actionItem: Chọpụta echiche a na-ekwughị nke dị mkpa ka nkwupụta wee bụrụ eziokwu, dee nkọwa ọzọ n’asụsụ Bekee nke na-eme ka echiche ahụ maa jijiji.

20261122-english-g09-2.title: Gbanwee nhọrọ ụlọ nri ka nkọwa ọzọ na-apụta otu n'otu
20261122-english-g09-2.summary: Otu ezinụlọ na-ahọrọ ụlọ nri maka nri ehihie tupu ihe nkiri (na-amalite na 3:00 p.m.). Oge nri ehihie bụ otu awa malite na 12:30. Ozi nkọwa na-apụta otu n'otu.
20261122-english-g09-2.principle: Gụọ nkọwa ụlọ nri n'ogo n'ogo, megharịa ikpe gị, ma dee n'asụsụ Bekee ọnọdụ nke ọkwa ị nwere ike ịtụkwasị obi.
20261122-english-g09-2.example: Chọta otu okwu ma ọ bụ nọmba ị na-ahụ na nke mbụ n’akụkụ a.
20261122-english-g09-2.actionItem: Gụọ nkọwa ụlọ nri n'ogo n'ogo, megharịa ikpe gị, ma dee n'asụsụ Bekee ọnọdụ nke ọkwa ị nwere ike ịtụkwasị obi.

20261122-english-g10-1.title: Kedu ka anyị ga-esi dee ọkwa abụọ na-emegide ibe ha n'akwụkwọ akụkọ ụlọ akwụkwọ?
20261122-english-g10-1.summary:
Ị nọ n'otu ndị edemede nke akwụkwọ akụkọ bekee ụlọ akwụkwọ. Ọkwa abụọ banyere ememme dị iche n'ibe ha.

Ọkwa ụlọ akwụkwọ: "Festival: Friday, 4 p.m., in the gym. Free for all students."
Posta ụlọ ọrụ ụmụ akwụkwọ: "Festival: Friday, 5 p.m., in the gym. Tickets: 1,000 won."

I kwenyebeghị nke ziri ezi.
20261122-english-g10-1.principle: Ọ bụrụ na ekwenyeghị, ihe ziri ezi bụ ikwu ihe isi iyi abụọ ahụ nke ọ bụla na-ekwu ma gwa ndị na-agụ na a ka na-elele ya. Ịhọrọ otu akụkụ ma kwuo ya n'ike, ma ọ bụ ịgwa mmadụ ka ha ghara ịbịa n'enweghị ozi, na-eduhie ndị na-agụ.
20261122-english-g10-1.example: Tụnyere ozi mgbasa ozi ọ bụla na-enye ndị na-agụ na ihe ọ na-ezo.
20261122-english-g10-1.actionItem: Dee maka ndị na-agụ (ụmụ akwụkwọ) ihe na-ebufe ọkwa abụọ dị iche n'ụzọ ziri ezi, na-ekwu ihe ekwenyeghị na ihe ndị na-agụ kwesịrị ime.

20261122-english-g10-2.title: Otu ihe atụ nwere ike ịkwado ikwu 'mgbe niile'?
20261122-english-g10-2.summary:
"Nke a bụ akụkụ nke ederede e bipụtara n'akwụkwọ akụkọ ụlọ akwụkwọ (nọmba ahịrị na-amalite na 1).
1) Our school should ban phones from the building.
2) Last month, Mina got a new phone, and her math score dropped from 90 to 75.
3) So phones clearly make all students' grades worse.
4) Also, phones are noisy in the hallway, and some students look up answers during tests.
5) Therefore, the school should ban them for everyone."
20261122-english-g10-2.principle: Ahịrị 3 bụ nsogbu. Ikwu na akara ga-adị njọ "n'ezie" maka "ụmụ akwụkwọ niile" dabere naanị n'ịda nke akara otu nwa akwụkwọ (ahịrị 2) bụ nkwubi okwu dị ukwuu karịa ihe akaebe. Ịda akara nwere ike inwe ihe ndị ọzọ kpatara ya, dị ka isi ike ule ma ọ bụ ọnọdụ. Ahịrị 4 na-enye ihe kpatara dị iche na akara (mkpọtụ, ịghọgbu), ya mere a ga-atụle ya iche na nsogbu a. "Banned for everyone" n'ahịrị 5 dabekwara n'nkwubi okwu a, ma ebe nsogbu na-amalite bụ ahịrị 3.
20261122-english-g10-2.example: Maka ahịrị ọ bụla, kewaa 'ihe ọ kọrọ' na 'ihe ọ kwubiri'.
20261122-english-g10-2.actionItem: N'ederede arụmụka, chọta ahịrị ebe ihe akaebe anaghị akwado nkwupụta ahụ nke ọma, dee ya ọzọ ka ọ bụrụ ahịrị okwu nlezianya karịa, ma kpebie ihe akaebe ọzọ achọrọ.

20261122-english-g11-1.title: Ntụziaka ọrụ na-adịghị doo anya: gịnị ka ị kwesịrị ịjụ buru ụzọ?
20261122-english-g11-1.summary:
Nke a bụ email onye ọrụ ọzụzụ Jiho natara site n'onye isi otu Ms. Han.

Hi Jiho,
Please send the sales summary to the client before the meeting.
Thanks,
Ms. Han

Eziokwu Jiho maara: Kalenda otu na-egosi nnọkọ na Aurora Co. na Tuesday n'elekere 10:00 na nnọkọ na Blue Pine Ltd. na Thursday n'elekere 14:00. Folda ekekọrịtara nwere faịlụ nchịkọta ire ahịa dị iche maka July, August na September.
20261122-english-g11-1.principle: Ọ bụrụ na e kpebighị onye ahịa na oge, ị pụrụ izipu faịlụ na-ezighị ezi nye onye ahịa na-ezighị ezi. Maka udi faịlụ, ị pụrụ ịtọ ihe ndabara dị ka PDF ma mara ya ọkwa, ma ọ bụrụ na ọ nọ n'ọrụ enweghị ihe ọ metụtara n'ọrụ ahụ n'onwe ya.
20261122-english-g11-1.example: Lelee ma 'nye onye,' 'gịnị,' na 'tupu mgbe ole' nke ọ bụla na-apụta dị ka otu ihe kpọmkwem n'email ahụ.
20261122-english-g11-1.actionItem: Site n'email ọrụ na-adịghị doo anya, họpụta ozi ndị a ga-ekwenye tupu ime ihe, ma dee email ajụjụ nke dị mfe izaghachi.

20261122-english-g11-2.title: Ọ bụ n'ihi klọb ịgụ akwụkwọ? Kedu ozi ga-eme ka anyị mara?
20261122-english-g11-2.summary:
'Nke a bụ akụkụ nke akụkọ ụlọ ọrụ ụmụ akwụkwọ.

"Students who joined the school reading club had higher English test scores than students who did not (average 82 vs 74). So the reading club raises English scores."

Nwa akwụkwọ Mina chọrọ ilele ma nkwubi okwu a ziri ezi. Ụmụ akwụkwọ na-esonye na klọb site n'ịrịọ ma ọ bụrụ na ha chọrọ.'
20261122-english-g11-2.principle: Ọ bụrụ na ị maara akara tupu ịsonye, ị nwere ike itụnyere ma akara ndị otu dị elu na mbụ ma ọ bụ gbadara mgbe ha sonyechara. N'ihi na ụmụ akwụkwọ na-esonye site n'ịrịọ, ụmụ akwụkwọ nwere ike ịbụ ndị dị mma n'Bekee na mbụ sonyere karịa.
20261122-english-g11-2.example: Chee otu eziokwu bụ na ụmụ akwụkwọ na-esonye 'site n'ịrịọ ma ọ bụrụ na ha chọrọ' nwere ike imetụta ebe mmalite nke otu abụọ ahụ.
20261122-english-g11-2.actionItem: Họrọ ozi achọrọ iji mara ma oghere akara n'etiti ndị otu klọb na ndị na-abụghị ndị otu bụ mmetụta nke klọb, ma dee n'asụsụ Bekee ajụjụ iji nweta ozi ahụ.

20261122-english-g12-1.title: Ụmụ akwụkwọ na-eri nri ụtụtụ nwere akara dị elu: gịnị ọzọ ka anyị chọrọ ịmara?
20261122-english-g12-1.summary:
Nke a bụ nkwupụta sitere n'akụkọ ụlọ akwụkwọ. "Students who eat breakfast get higher test scores, so the school should provide free breakfast." Dịka ihe akaebe, e gosipụtara nsonaazụ nyocha nke ụmụ akwụkwọ 200 dị otú a.

Group | Number of students | Average score
Students who eat breakfast | 130 | 82
Students who skip breakfast | 70 | 74
20261122-english-g12-1.principle: b na-elele ihe kpatara ndị ọzọ (ụra, oge ọmụmụ), c na-elele nsonaazụ nke mmeghachi omume n'ezie, e na-elelekwa ịdị mma nke itụnyere. a na d abụghị ihe akaebe banyere ma nri na-ebuli akara.
20261122-english-g12-1.example: Lelee ma ozi ọ bụla na-enyere aka ịzaa ajụjụ, 'Mmekọrịta dị n'etiti nri ụtụtụ na akara ọ̀ bụ ihe kpatara?'
20261122-english-g12-1.actionItem: Kpee ikpe ma nsonaazụ nyocha na-agwa anyị banyere "ihe kpatara," họrọ ozi ọzọ achọrọ maka mkpebi ahụ, ma tụọ aro n'Bekee usoro itụnyere iji lelee mmetụta nke nri n'efu.

20261122-english-g12-2.title: Otu ihe merenụ, isi okwu dị iche: ikpe na-agbanwe ka ozi na-abawanye
20261122-english-g12-2.summary: A na-ewepụta n'ogo akụkọ banyere kansụl obodo kpebiri ịbawanye ụgwọ ebe a na-ebu ụgbọala n'akụkụ ọdụ ụgbọ ala. Lelee ma ikpe gị na-agbanwe oge ọ bụla ozi na-abawanye.
20261122-english-g12-2.principle: Ka ozi na-abawanye, megharịa ikpe gị banyere otú ụda isi okwu na ihe e hapụrụ si gbadata n'otu akụkụ ma e tụnyere eziokwu, ma kọwaa otu ihe n'asụsụ Bekee.
20261122-english-g12-2.example: Kewaa okwu dị n'isi okwu na-enye eziokwu na ndị na-enye mmetụta.
20261122-english-g12-2.actionItem: Ka ozi na-abawanye, megharịa ikpe gị banyere otú ụda isi okwu na ihe e hapụrụ si gbadata n'otu akụkụ ma e tụnyere eziokwu, ma kọwaa otu ihe n'asụsụ Bekee.

20261123-english-g01-1.title: Chọta omume ndị na-adabaghị n'ọkwa ọdọ mmiri
20261123-english-g01-1.summary:
Ọkwa dị n'ọnụ ụzọ ọdọ mmiri (e dere n'okwu naanị, na-enweghị ihe oyiyi):

Pool Rules
1. No running.
2. Swim caps on, please.
3. Under 8? Come with a grown-up.

(grown-up = okenye)

Mmadụ anọ na-aga n'ọdọ mmiri.
Mina dị afọ 7. Ọ na-eso nne ya bịa, ma o nwere okpu.
Jun dị afọ 10. Ọ na-abịa naanị ya, ma o nweghị okpu.
Tom dị afọ 6. Ọ na-eso nwanne ya nwoke bịa. Nwanne ya dị afọ 9. Tom nwere okpu.
Sue dị afọ 11. Ọ na-eje ije gaa ọdọ mmiri naanị ya, ma o nwere okpu.
20261123-english-g01-1.principle: Jun enweghị okpu, ya mere ọ na-agbaji iwu 2. Tom dị n'okpuru 8, ma nwanne ya nwoke nke na-eso ya bịa dị afọ 9, ya mere ọ bụghị 'grown-up', ya mere Tom na-agbaji iwu 3. Mina soro nne ya bịa, ma Sue dị afọ 11, ya mere ọ dị mma ka ọ jee ije bịa naanị ya.
20261123-english-g01-1.example: Mee tebụl nwere afọ onye ọ bụla, onye ọ na-eso bịa, na okpu, otu n'otu.
20261123-english-g01-1.actionItem: Kwekọọ iwu atọ dị n'ọkwa ahụ na ọnọdụ onye ọ bụla, họrọ ikpe ndị na-agbaji iwu, ma kwuo ihe kpatara n'asụsụ Bekee.

20261123-english-g01-2.title: Dozie ahịrị na-ezighi ezi n'ọkwa ihe furu efu e depụtara
20261123-english-g01-2.summary:
Ọkwa dị n'ebe e ji ọkwa ụlọ akwụkwọ (e dere n'okwu naanị):

Lost and Found
Found: a blue water bottle, near Room 3.
Ask Ms. Park in Room 1 after school.

Enyi gị Jia hụrụ ọkwa a n'ihi na ọ na-achọ karama mmiri ya, ma zigara Hana ozi. Hana chọrọ itụnyere ya na ọkwa ahụ.
20261123-english-g01-2.principle: Ahịrị 4 adịghị mma. N'ọkwa ahụ, Ms. Park nọ n'Room 1, ma ozi ahụ na-ekwu Room 3, ya mere ọ dịghị mma. Blue dị n'ahịrị 2 bụ otu ihe ahụ dị n'ọkwa ahụ, ma Room 3 dị n'ahịrị 3 bụ ebe a hụrụ karama ahụ, ya mere ọ ziri ezi.
20261123-english-g01-2.example: Gosi okwu dị n'ọkwa ahụ (agba, ọnụọgụ ụlọ, aha mmadụ) otu n'otu ma kwekọọ ha na ahịrị nke ozi ahụ.
20261123-english-g01-2.actionItem: Tụnyere ọkwa ihe furu efu na ozi enyi depụtara site na ya, ahịrị n'ahịrị, chọta ahịrị na-ezighi ezi, ma dee ya ọzọ n'ụzọ ziri ezi.

20261123-english-g02-1.title: Ebee ka “Two tickets, please.” dị? Ịkpebi ma ozi e nyere ezuola
20261123-english-g02-1.summary:
Ị nụrụ nwoke na onye na-ere tiketi na-ekwu okwu. Ha ekwughị ebe ha nọ.

Man: Two tickets, please.
Clerk: Here you are. The show starts at 7:00.
20261123-english-g02-1.principle: Ticket na show bụ okwu a na-eji n’ọtụtụ ebe, dịka sinima ma ọ bụ ụlọ egwu. O siri ike iji ahịrị abụọ naanị kpebie otu.
20261123-english-g02-1.example: Chee ebe abụọ ma ọ bụ atọ a pụrụ ikwu ahịrị ndị a.
20261123-english-g02-1.actionItem: Kpebie ma a pụrụ ịmata ebe ahụ site n’ahịrị abụọ a nụrụ naanị, họrọkwa ihe ngosi mgbakwunye ga-ekewa ebe ndị nwere ike ime.

20261123-english-g02-2.title: Azịza dị aṅaa dabara ekele onye nkuzi? Ịtụle ókè nkwanye ùgwù
20261123-english-g02-2.summary:
Onye nkuzi sịrị n’ụtụtụ, “How are you today, Mina?”

Enyi gị Jin kwuru, “N’asụsụ Bekee, ikwu okwu n’ụzọ nkwanye ùgwù ka mma mgbe niile. I nwere ike ikwu otú ahụ nye mmadụ niile.”
20261123-english-g02-2.principle: b na d zara ekele ma jụọ onye nke ọzọ ajụjụ azụ, ya mere ha dabara onye nkuzi. a bụ nkịtị karịa, c na-ada ka okwu ọjọọ.
20261123-english-g02-2.example: Lelee iche ma azịza dabara ajụjụ na ma ọ dabara onye nkuzi.
20261123-english-g02-2.actionItem: Họrọ azịza dabara ekele onye nkuzi, kwuo ọnọdụ ebe nkwupụta “ịkwanyere ùgwù kacha mma mgbe niile” na-abụghị eziokwu.

20261123-english-g03-1.title: Chọta oge ịgụ akwụkwọ n'usoro oge Saturday nke Mina
20261123-english-g03-1.summary:
Usoro oge Saturday nke Mina (e dere dị ka ederede naanị, na-enweghị ihe oyiyi):

10 a.m.: I can start my free time.
12 p.m. - 1 p.m.: Lunch
1 p.m. - 2 p.m.: Dance class
5 p.m.: Dinner. I must finish before dinner.

Mina chọrọ ịgụ akwụkwọ awa 1. Ọ na-amalite n'awa zuru ezu ma na-akwụsị n'awa zuru ezu.
20261123-english-g03-1.principle: Oge ezumike na-amalite na 10 a.m., ma 12 ruo 14 jupụtara na nri ehihie na ịgba egwu. Ọrụ ọ bụla adịghị n'usoro oge site na 15 ruo 16 na site na 16 ruo 17, ma ha na-agwụ tupu nri abalị.
20261123-english-g03-1.example: Gbanwee oge dị n'usoro oge ka ọ bụrụ ọnụọgụ awa 24 ma see eserese oge.
20261123-english-g03-1.actionItem: Chee oge mmalite ịgụ akwụkwọ dị iche nke na-emezu ọnọdụ niile dị n'usoro oge, ma kọwaa ihe mere oge ndị ọzọ anaghị arụ ọrụ.

20261123-english-g03-2.title: Gosi 'nchegbu' n'enweghị ikwu ya
20261123-english-g03-2.summary: Ị ga-ede ihe omume ebe enyi gị Mina na-echegbu onwe ya n'oge ule. Ederede na-ekwu mmetụta ozugbo na ederede na-egosi ya site n'omume na-eru onye na-agụ n'ụzọ dị iche.
20261123-english-g03-2.principle: Site n'aka oyi na ịlele elekere ugboro ugboro, onye na-agụ nwere ike ichee nchegbu. Ịmị ọnụ mgbe ọ na-ele window na-egosi ike ọgwụgwụ, ma ịmụmụ ọnụ ọchị mgbe ọ na-ede ngwa ngwa na-egosi udo ma ọ bụ ntụkwasị obi.
20261123-english-g03-2.example: Site na ederede atọ ọ bụla, họrọ ma dee omume Mina ma ọ bụ mgbanwe ahụ ya.
20261123-english-g03-2.actionItem: Dee obere ederede ebe onye na-agụ nwere ike ichee mmetụta site n'omume na ihe ngosi ahụ naanị, n'enweghị okwu mmetụta ọ bụla.

20261123-english-g04-1.title: Ndetu nne na oge egwuregwu Jisu
20261123-english-g04-1.summary:
'Ndetu nne hapụrụ n'elu tebụl (e dere dị ka ederede naanị, n'enweghị eserese):

Mina,
Today's plan:
3:30 p.m. Come home.
4:00 p.m. Piano class (30 minutes).
5:00 p.m. Take out the trash.
6:30 p.m. Dinner with Mom and Dad.

Mgbe ahụ enyi ya Jisu zigara ozi ederede. "Let's play at the park from 4:15 to 5:15 today!"'
20261123-english-g04-1.principle: Klaasị piano bụ 4:00-4:30, ya mere 4:15-4:30 na-adabere, ma ịtụpụ ahịhịa na 5:00 dabara n'ime 4:15-5:15. Ịlọta ụlọ na 3:30 na nri abalị na 6:30 dị n'èzí oge ogige.
20261123-english-g04-1.example: Tinye ahịrị ọ bụla n'akụkụ oge ogige '4:15-5:15' otu n'otu, ma lee ma ọ na-agwụ tupu ya ma ọ bụ na-amalite mgbe ya.
20261123-english-g04-1.actionItem: Tụnyere atụmatụ dị iche iche dị n'ndetu nne na oge enyi tụrụ aro, chọta ebe ha na-adabaghị, ma kwuo mba n'asụsụ Bekee ka ị na-atụ aro oge dị iche.

20261123-english-g04-2.title: Kpebie oge ịga ije nkịta na ọrụ ụlọ
20261123-english-g04-2.summary:
"Ndetu Papa hapụrụ (e dere dị ka ederede naanị, n'enweghị eserese):

Mina,
You come home at 4:00 p.m. I come home at 6:30 p.m.
- Walk the dog for 30 minutes. Not before 5:00 p.m. It is too hot.
- Do your homework for 60 minutes.
- Finish both before I come home.
- Do not do both at the same time.

N'okpuru, dee oge ọ bụla dị ka 'ole nkeji mgbe 4:00 p.m.'. Dịka ọmụmaatụ, ọ bụrụ na ị malite na 4:30, dee 30, ma ọ bụrụ na ị malite na 5:15, dee 75."
20261123-english-g04-2.principle: Ọrụ ụlọ bụ 5:00-6:00 ma ije bụ 5:30-6:00, ya mere ọrụ abụọ ahụ na-adabere site na 5:30 ruo 6:00. Ije na-amalite mgbe 5:00 ma abụọ na-agwụ tupu 6:30, ya mere a na-edebe ọnọdụ ndị ọzọ.
20261123-english-g04-2.example: Gbakwunye oge ọ na-ewe (n'nkeji) na oge mmalite nke ọrụ ọ bụla iji chọta oge ọ na-agwụ.
20261123-english-g04-2.actionItem: Mee ọtụtụ njikọta dị iche iche nke oge ije na oge ọrụ ụlọ na-ezute ọnọdụ niile dị n'ndetu Papa.

20261123-english-g05-1.title: Echiche gị na-agbanwe ka ị na-agụ ihe nkwanye
20261123-english-g05-1.summary: Jun abụghị onye otu Green Library. Enyi ya Ara bụ onye otu Green Library. Ha abụọ ga-agụ ihe nkwanye dị n'ihu ọbá akwụkwọ otu ahịrị n'otu oge.
20261123-english-g05-1.principle: Gbanwee mkpebi gị oge ọ bụla a na-ekpughe ozi ihe nkwanye n'ọkwa, ma mee ajụjụ Bekee na-elele ozi nke anọghị n'ihe nkwanye.
20261123-english-g05-1.example: Lelee ma ahịrịokwu bụ ọhụrụ oge a na-agbanwe mkpebi gị gara aga.
20261123-english-g05-1.actionItem: Gbanwee mkpebi gị oge ọ bụla a na-ekpughe ozi ihe nkwanye n'ọkwa, ma mee ajụjụ Bekee na-elele ozi nke anọghị n'ihe nkwanye.

20261123-english-g05-2.title: 'Most popular' - ederede ahụ na-akwado ya?
20261123-english-g05-2.summary:
'Klaasị Mina nwere akụkụ ịgụ akwụkwọ nwere ebe a na-edebe akwụkwọ.

Our class has a reading corner. There are 20 books on the shelf. Twelve of them are about animals. Four are about space, and four are story books. The teacher did not buy any new books this year.

Mina says, "Animal books are the most popular in our class."'
20261123-english-g05-2.principle: Ederede naanị na-agwa ọnụọgụ akwụkwọ dị n'ebe a na-edebe akwụkwọ (akwụkwọ anụmanụ 12, wdg.). Ọ naghị ekwu akwụkwọ kedu ụmụ akwụkwọ na-agụ ma ọ bụ na-eji nke ukwuu, ya mere anyị enweghị ike ilele nkwupụta 'most popular'.
20261123-english-g05-2.example: Chee ihe 'popular' pụtara n'okwu Mina, ma chọọ ahịrị okwu dị n'ederede na-agwa gị nke ahụ.
20261123-english-g05-2.actionItem: Chee ma ozi ọnụọgụ dị n'ederede na-akwado nkwupụta (popular), ma mee ajụjụ Bekee nwere ike ịlele nkwupụta ahụ.

20261123-english-g06-1.title: Klọb akwụkwọ ọ̀ bụ ihe ịga nke ọma? Ịgbanwe ikpe gị ka ihe àmà na-abawanye
20261123-english-g06-1.summary: Otu klọb akwụkwọ ọhụrụ amalitela n'ụlọ akwụkwọ anyị. Onye nkụzi kwuru, "The club is a success." Ị ga-anata ihe àmà otu mpempe n'otu oge ma chee echiche ma nkwupụta a ziri ezi.
20261123-english-g06-1.principle: Ka a na-agbakwunye data otu mpempe n'otu oge, gbanwee ikpe gị banyere nkwupụta 'klọb akwụkwọ bụ ihe ịga nke ọma', ma mechie n'asụsụ Bekee site n'iji ihe àmà abụọ.
20261123-english-g06-1.example: Kewaa ihe data ị nwere ugbu a na-egosipụta na ihe ị ka maghị.
20261123-english-g06-1.actionItem: Ka a na-agbakwunye data otu mpempe n'otu oge, gbanwee ikpe gị banyere nkwupụta 'klọb akwụkwọ bụ ihe ịga nke ọma', ma mechie n'asụsụ Bekee site n'iji ihe àmà abụọ.

20261123-english-g06-2.title: Ime tebụl iji chọta ikpe ebe nkwupụta bụ eziokwu
20261123-english-g06-2.summary: Ụmụ akwụkwọ 20 n'otu klaasị nke ọ bụla tụrụ otu votu maka omume mgbe nri nta: bọl, nka, ma ọ bụ egwú. A na-akpọ votu ndị ahụ s (bọl), a (nka), na m (egwú).
20261123-english-g06-2.principle: Votu 8 karịrị nka (6) na egwú (6), ya mere ọ bụ nke kacha, ọ dịkwa ntakịrị karịa 10, ọkara nke 20, ya mere ọ bụghị ọkara. Ya mere a ziri ezi.
20261123-english-g06-2.example: Gbakwunye 8, 6, na 6, chọta ihe ọkara nke ụmụ akwụkwọ 20 bụ, ma tụnyere.
20261123-english-g06-2.actionItem: Mee ọtụtụ tebụl votu n'onwe gị nke nkwupụta bekee 'it got the most votes, but not half of the class' bụ eziokwu.

20261123-english-g07-1.title: Ben ọ ga-abịa oriri ahụ? Ịtụle ihe zoro n’azụ azịza ya
20261123-english-g07-1.summary:
Mkparịta ụka Jisu na Ben (ederede naanị, enweghị foto):

Jisu: Do you want to come to my birthday party on Saturday?
Ben: Saturday? Hmm. I have a soccer game in the morning.
Jisu: The party is at 4 p.m.
Ben: Oh, that might work. I'll probably be tired, though.
Jisu: So... are you coming?
Ben: Let me check with my mom first.
20261123-english-g07-1.principle: Egwuregwu bọọlụ bụ n’ụtụtụ, oriri bụ na 4 p.m., ya mere oge anaghị ekpuchikọ. Ben kwuru naanị na ike nwere ike gwụ ya; na njedebe o kwuru na ọ ga-ebu ụzọ jụọ mama ya. Ya mere e kpebiela ihe ụfọdụ (oge), ihe ọzọ ka fọdụrụ (ikike mama ya), a kpebeghịkwa.
20261123-english-g07-1.example: Kewaa okwu Ben n’akụkụ anọ: “soccer game,” “party time,” “tired,” na “mom.”
20261123-english-g07-1.actionItem: Kewaa okwu Ben n’ime mkparịta ụka ahụ ahịrị n’ahịrị, kewaa ihe e kpebiela na nke fọdụrụ, kpebie n’enweghị nkwupụta na “ọ ga-abịa” ma ọ bụ “ọ gaghị abịa.”

20261123-english-g07-2.title: “That’s fine.” ọ pụtara n’ezie na ọ dị mma?
20261123-english-g07-2.summary: Sam na Dad na-ekwu maka atụmatụ Friday. A ga-ekpughe mkparịta ụka ahụ n’akụkụ atọ. E dere ya dịka ederede, enweghị foto.
20261123-english-g07-2.principle: Site n’ịgụ ntakịrị mkparịta ụka n’otu oge, kpebie mmetụta zoro ezo nke onye na-ekwu okwu, megharịa mkpebi mbụ mgbe ihe ngosi ọhụrụ pụtara.
20261123-english-g07-2.example: Chọta otu ụda okwu ma ọ bụ okwu ọhụrụ n’akụkụ a.
20261123-english-g07-2.actionItem: Site n’ịgụ ntakịrị mkparịta ụka n’otu oge, kpebie mmetụta zoro ezo nke onye na-ekwu okwu, megharịa mkpebi mbụ mgbe ihe ngosi ọhụrụ pụtara.

20261123-english-g08-1.title: Dee ọzọ nkwupụta na ịga ọbá akwụkwọ ugboro ugboro na-ebuli akara
20261123-english-g08-1.summary: Onye na-ede blog chọrọ ide nke a: 'Library visits make students' scores go up.' Ka anyị lelee ahịrịokwu a megide data.
20261123-english-g08-1.principle: Oge ọ bụla a kpughere data ọhụrụ, kpebie ọzọ ka ị nwere ike ịbụ onye doro anya banyere nkwupụta ahụ, ma dee ọzọ ahịrịokwu ikpeazụ.
20261123-english-g08-1.example: N'nzọụkwụ ọ bụla, lelee ma ozi ọhụrụ na-akwado mkpebi gara aga ma ọ bụ na-ama ya jijiji.
20261123-english-g08-1.actionItem: Oge ọ bụla a kpughere data ọhụrụ, kpebie ọzọ ka ị nwere ike ịbụ onye doro anya banyere nkwupụta ahụ, ma dee ọzọ ahịrịokwu ikpeazụ.

20261123-english-g08-2.title: Dozie ahịrị nwere ọnụọgụ na-ezighị ezi n'ederede blog nke ịhicha osimiri
20261123-english-g08-2.summary: Otu nwa akwụkwọ n'otu klaasị dere ederede a n'blog ụlọ akwụkwọ. (Ọ bụ naanị ederede. Ahịrị ọ bụla nwere nọmba.)
20261123-english-g08-2.principle: Ahịrị 3 na-ekwu na ha chịkọtara akpa 30 n'awa mbụ, ma ahịrị 4 na-ekwu na ngụkọta bụ akpa 18. Ngụkọta enweghị ike ịdị nta karịa ihe e chịkọtara n'awa mbụ. Ederede a naanị enweghị ike ịgwa ma ahịrị 3 ma ọ bụ ahịrị 4 na-ezighị ezi, ya mere ị nwere ike ịhọrọ ọ bụla.
20261123-english-g08-2.example: Chịkọta naanị ahịrị nwere ọnụọgụ ma tụnyere ha n'etiti onwe ha.
20261123-english-g08-2.actionItem: Chọta ahịrị ọnụọgụ abụọ n'ederede blog na-adabaghị n'ibe ha, ma dee ha ọzọ ka ha dabara ozi e kwenyesiri ike.

20261123-english-g09-1.title: Echiche zoro n’ime “anyị rere nri ehihie 200 pere mpe”
20261123-english-g09-1.summary:
E tinyere nke a n’elu bọọdụ n’ihu cafeteria ụlọ akwụkwọ.

“This month, the cafeteria sold 200 fewer lunches than last month. So students did not like the new menu.”
20261123-english-g09-1.principle: Iji si n’eziokwu na ahịa dara gaa “uto nri adabaghị ha,” ọnọdụ ndị ọzọ (ọnụ ọgụgụ ụmụ akwụkwọ, ụbọchị ụlọ akwụkwọ, wdg) ga-abụ otu. Ọ bụrụ ụmụ akwụkwọ ma ọ bụ ụbọchị ụlọ akwụkwọ pere mpe, ahịa ga-ada ọbụna ma uto nri adịghị agbanwe.
20261123-english-g09-1.example: Buru ụzọ dee n’asụsụ nke gị ihe nwere ike ịkpata “ere nri ehihie pere mpe.”
20261123-english-g09-1.actionItem: Chọpụta echiche a na-ekwughị nke dị mkpa ka nkwupụta wee bụrụ eziokwu, dee nkọwa ọzọ n’asụsụ Bekee nke na-eme ka echiche ahụ maa jijiji.

20261123-english-g09-2.title: Gbanwee nhọrọ ụlọ nri ka nkọwa ọzọ na-apụta otu n'otu
20261123-english-g09-2.summary: Otu ezinụlọ na-ahọrọ ụlọ nri maka nri ehihie tupu ihe nkiri (na-amalite na 3:00 p.m.). Oge nri ehihie bụ otu awa malite na 12:30. Ozi nkọwa na-apụta otu n'otu.
20261123-english-g09-2.principle: Gụọ nkọwa ụlọ nri n'ogo n'ogo, megharịa ikpe gị, ma dee n'asụsụ Bekee ọnọdụ nke ọkwa ị nwere ike ịtụkwasị obi.
20261123-english-g09-2.example: Chọta otu okwu ma ọ bụ nọmba ị na-ahụ na nke mbụ n’akụkụ a.
20261123-english-g09-2.actionItem: Gụọ nkọwa ụlọ nri n'ogo n'ogo, megharịa ikpe gị, ma dee n'asụsụ Bekee ọnọdụ nke ọkwa ị nwere ike ịtụkwasị obi.

20261123-english-g10-1.title: Kedu ka anyị ga-esi dee ọkwa abụọ na-emegide ibe ha n'akwụkwọ akụkọ ụlọ akwụkwọ?
20261123-english-g10-1.summary:
Ị nọ n'otu ndị edemede nke akwụkwọ akụkọ bekee ụlọ akwụkwọ. Ọkwa abụọ banyere ememme dị iche n'ibe ha.

Ọkwa ụlọ akwụkwọ: "Festival: Friday, 4 p.m., in the gym. Free for all students."
Posta ụlọ ọrụ ụmụ akwụkwọ: "Festival: Friday, 5 p.m., in the gym. Tickets: 1,000 won."

I kwenyebeghị nke ziri ezi.
20261123-english-g10-1.principle: Ọ bụrụ na ekwenyeghị, ihe ziri ezi bụ ikwu ihe isi iyi abụọ ahụ nke ọ bụla na-ekwu ma gwa ndị na-agụ na a ka na-elele ya. Ịhọrọ otu akụkụ ma kwuo ya n'ike, ma ọ bụ ịgwa mmadụ ka ha ghara ịbịa n'enweghị ozi, na-eduhie ndị na-agụ.
20261123-english-g10-1.example: Tụnyere ozi mgbasa ozi ọ bụla na-enye ndị na-agụ na ihe ọ na-ezo.
20261123-english-g10-1.actionItem: Dee maka ndị na-agụ (ụmụ akwụkwọ) ihe na-ebufe ọkwa abụọ dị iche n'ụzọ ziri ezi, na-ekwu ihe ekwenyeghị na ihe ndị na-agụ kwesịrị ime.

20261123-english-g10-2.title: Otu ihe atụ nwere ike ịkwado ikwu 'mgbe niile'?
20261123-english-g10-2.summary:
"Nke a bụ akụkụ nke ederede e bipụtara n'akwụkwọ akụkọ ụlọ akwụkwọ (nọmba ahịrị na-amalite na 1).
1) Our school should ban phones from the building.
2) Last month, Mina got a new phone, and her math score dropped from 90 to 75.
3) So phones clearly make all students' grades worse.
4) Also, phones are noisy in the hallway, and some students look up answers during tests.
5) Therefore, the school should ban them for everyone."
20261123-english-g10-2.principle: Ahịrị 3 bụ nsogbu. Ikwu na akara ga-adị njọ "n'ezie" maka "ụmụ akwụkwọ niile" dabere naanị n'ịda nke akara otu nwa akwụkwọ (ahịrị 2) bụ nkwubi okwu dị ukwuu karịa ihe akaebe. Ịda akara nwere ike inwe ihe ndị ọzọ kpatara ya, dị ka isi ike ule ma ọ bụ ọnọdụ. Ahịrị 4 na-enye ihe kpatara dị iche na akara (mkpọtụ, ịghọgbu), ya mere a ga-atụle ya iche na nsogbu a. "Banned for everyone" n'ahịrị 5 dabekwara n'nkwubi okwu a, ma ebe nsogbu na-amalite bụ ahịrị 3.
20261123-english-g10-2.example: Maka ahịrị ọ bụla, kewaa 'ihe ọ kọrọ' na 'ihe ọ kwubiri'.
20261123-english-g10-2.actionItem: N'ederede arụmụka, chọta ahịrị ebe ihe akaebe anaghị akwado nkwupụta ahụ nke ọma, dee ya ọzọ ka ọ bụrụ ahịrị okwu nlezianya karịa, ma kpebie ihe akaebe ọzọ achọrọ.

20261123-english-g11-1.title: Ntụziaka ọrụ na-adịghị doo anya: gịnị ka ị kwesịrị ịjụ buru ụzọ?
20261123-english-g11-1.summary:
Nke a bụ email onye ọrụ ọzụzụ Jiho natara site n'onye isi otu Ms. Han.

Hi Jiho,
Please send the sales summary to the client before the meeting.
Thanks,
Ms. Han

Eziokwu Jiho maara: Kalenda otu na-egosi nnọkọ na Aurora Co. na Tuesday n'elekere 10:00 na nnọkọ na Blue Pine Ltd. na Thursday n'elekere 14:00. Folda ekekọrịtara nwere faịlụ nchịkọta ire ahịa dị iche maka July, August na September.
20261123-english-g11-1.principle: Ọ bụrụ na e kpebighị onye ahịa na oge, ị pụrụ izipu faịlụ na-ezighị ezi nye onye ahịa na-ezighị ezi. Maka udi faịlụ, ị pụrụ ịtọ ihe ndabara dị ka PDF ma mara ya ọkwa, ma ọ bụrụ na ọ nọ n'ọrụ enweghị ihe ọ metụtara n'ọrụ ahụ n'onwe ya.
20261123-english-g11-1.example: Lelee ma 'nye onye,' 'gịnị,' na 'tupu mgbe ole' nke ọ bụla na-apụta dị ka otu ihe kpọmkwem n'email ahụ.
20261123-english-g11-1.actionItem: Site n'email ọrụ na-adịghị doo anya, họpụta ozi ndị a ga-ekwenye tupu ime ihe, ma dee email ajụjụ nke dị mfe izaghachi.

20261123-english-g11-2.title: Ọ bụ n'ihi klọb ịgụ akwụkwọ? Kedu ozi ga-eme ka anyị mara?
20261123-english-g11-2.summary:
'Nke a bụ akụkụ nke akụkọ ụlọ ọrụ ụmụ akwụkwọ.

"Students who joined the school reading club had higher English test scores than students who did not (average 82 vs 74). So the reading club raises English scores."

Nwa akwụkwọ Mina chọrọ ilele ma nkwubi okwu a ziri ezi. Ụmụ akwụkwọ na-esonye na klọb site n'ịrịọ ma ọ bụrụ na ha chọrọ.'
20261123-english-g11-2.principle: Ọ bụrụ na ị maara akara tupu ịsonye, ị nwere ike itụnyere ma akara ndị otu dị elu na mbụ ma ọ bụ gbadara mgbe ha sonyechara. N'ihi na ụmụ akwụkwọ na-esonye site n'ịrịọ, ụmụ akwụkwọ nwere ike ịbụ ndị dị mma n'Bekee na mbụ sonyere karịa.
20261123-english-g11-2.example: Chee otu eziokwu bụ na ụmụ akwụkwọ na-esonye 'site n'ịrịọ ma ọ bụrụ na ha chọrọ' nwere ike imetụta ebe mmalite nke otu abụọ ahụ.
20261123-english-g11-2.actionItem: Họrọ ozi achọrọ iji mara ma oghere akara n'etiti ndị otu klọb na ndị na-abụghị ndị otu bụ mmetụta nke klọb, ma dee n'asụsụ Bekee ajụjụ iji nweta ozi ahụ.

20261123-english-g12-1.title: Ụmụ akwụkwọ na-eri nri ụtụtụ nwere akara dị elu: gịnị ọzọ ka anyị chọrọ ịmara?
20261123-english-g12-1.summary:
Nke a bụ nkwupụta sitere n'akụkọ ụlọ akwụkwọ. "Students who eat breakfast get higher test scores, so the school should provide free breakfast." Dịka ihe akaebe, e gosipụtara nsonaazụ nyocha nke ụmụ akwụkwọ 200 dị otú a.

Group | Number of students | Average score
Students who eat breakfast | 130 | 82
Students who skip breakfast | 70 | 74
20261123-english-g12-1.principle: b na-elele ihe kpatara ndị ọzọ (ụra, oge ọmụmụ), c na-elele nsonaazụ nke mmeghachi omume n'ezie, e na-elelekwa ịdị mma nke itụnyere. a na d abụghị ihe akaebe banyere ma nri na-ebuli akara.
20261123-english-g12-1.example: Lelee ma ozi ọ bụla na-enyere aka ịzaa ajụjụ, 'Mmekọrịta dị n'etiti nri ụtụtụ na akara ọ̀ bụ ihe kpatara?'
20261123-english-g12-1.actionItem: Kpee ikpe ma nsonaazụ nyocha na-agwa anyị banyere "ihe kpatara," họrọ ozi ọzọ achọrọ maka mkpebi ahụ, ma tụọ aro n'Bekee usoro itụnyere iji lelee mmetụta nke nri n'efu.

20261123-english-g12-2.title: Otu ihe merenụ, isi okwu dị iche: ikpe na-agbanwe ka ozi na-abawanye
20261123-english-g12-2.summary: A na-ewepụta n'ogo akụkọ banyere kansụl obodo kpebiri ịbawanye ụgwọ ebe a na-ebu ụgbọala n'akụkụ ọdụ ụgbọ ala. Lelee ma ikpe gị na-agbanwe oge ọ bụla ozi na-abawanye.
20261123-english-g12-2.principle: Ka ozi na-abawanye, megharịa ikpe gị banyere otú ụda isi okwu na ihe e hapụrụ si gbadata n'otu akụkụ ma e tụnyere eziokwu, ma kọwaa otu ihe n'asụsụ Bekee.
20261123-english-g12-2.example: Kewaa okwu dị n'isi okwu na-enye eziokwu na ndị na-enye mmetụta.
20261123-english-g12-2.actionItem: Ka ozi na-abawanye, megharịa ikpe gị banyere otú ụda isi okwu na ihe e hapụrụ si gbadata n'otu akụkụ ma e tụnyere eziokwu, ma kọwaa otu ihe n'asụsụ Bekee.

20261124-english-g01-1.title: Chọta omume ndị na-adabaghị n'ọkwa ọdọ mmiri
20261124-english-g01-1.summary:
Ọkwa dị n'ọnụ ụzọ ọdọ mmiri (e dere n'okwu naanị, na-enweghị ihe oyiyi):

Pool Rules
1. No running.
2. Swim caps on, please.
3. Under 8? Come with a grown-up.

(grown-up = okenye)

Mmadụ anọ na-aga n'ọdọ mmiri.
Mina dị afọ 7. Ọ na-eso nne ya bịa, ma o nwere okpu.
Jun dị afọ 10. Ọ na-abịa naanị ya, ma o nweghị okpu.
Tom dị afọ 6. Ọ na-eso nwanne ya nwoke bịa. Nwanne ya dị afọ 9. Tom nwere okpu.
Sue dị afọ 11. Ọ na-eje ije gaa ọdọ mmiri naanị ya, ma o nwere okpu.
20261124-english-g01-1.principle: Jun enweghị okpu, ya mere ọ na-agbaji iwu 2. Tom dị n'okpuru 8, ma nwanne ya nwoke nke na-eso ya bịa dị afọ 9, ya mere ọ bụghị 'grown-up', ya mere Tom na-agbaji iwu 3. Mina soro nne ya bịa, ma Sue dị afọ 11, ya mere ọ dị mma ka ọ jee ije bịa naanị ya.
20261124-english-g01-1.example: Mee tebụl nwere afọ onye ọ bụla, onye ọ na-eso bịa, na okpu, otu n'otu.
20261124-english-g01-1.actionItem: Kwekọọ iwu atọ dị n'ọkwa ahụ na ọnọdụ onye ọ bụla, họrọ ikpe ndị na-agbaji iwu, ma kwuo ihe kpatara n'asụsụ Bekee.

20261124-english-g01-2.title: Dozie ahịrị na-ezighi ezi n'ọkwa ihe furu efu e depụtara
20261124-english-g01-2.summary:
Ọkwa dị n'ebe e ji ọkwa ụlọ akwụkwọ (e dere n'okwu naanị):

Lost and Found
Found: a blue water bottle, near Room 3.
Ask Ms. Park in Room 1 after school.

Enyi gị Jia hụrụ ọkwa a n'ihi na ọ na-achọ karama mmiri ya, ma zigara Hana ozi. Hana chọrọ itụnyere ya na ọkwa ahụ.
20261124-english-g01-2.principle: Ahịrị 4 adịghị mma. N'ọkwa ahụ, Ms. Park nọ n'Room 1, ma ozi ahụ na-ekwu Room 3, ya mere ọ dịghị mma. Blue dị n'ahịrị 2 bụ otu ihe ahụ dị n'ọkwa ahụ, ma Room 3 dị n'ahịrị 3 bụ ebe a hụrụ karama ahụ, ya mere ọ ziri ezi.
20261124-english-g01-2.example: Gosi okwu dị n'ọkwa ahụ (agba, ọnụọgụ ụlọ, aha mmadụ) otu n'otu ma kwekọọ ha na ahịrị nke ozi ahụ.
20261124-english-g01-2.actionItem: Tụnyere ọkwa ihe furu efu na ozi enyi depụtara site na ya, ahịrị n'ahịrị, chọta ahịrị na-ezighi ezi, ma dee ya ọzọ n'ụzọ ziri ezi.

20261124-english-g02-1.title: Ebee ka “Two tickets, please.” dị? Ịkpebi ma ozi e nyere ezuola
20261124-english-g02-1.summary:
Ị nụrụ nwoke na onye na-ere tiketi na-ekwu okwu. Ha ekwughị ebe ha nọ.

Man: Two tickets, please.
Clerk: Here you are. The show starts at 7:00.
20261124-english-g02-1.principle: Ticket na show bụ okwu a na-eji n’ọtụtụ ebe, dịka sinima ma ọ bụ ụlọ egwu. O siri ike iji ahịrị abụọ naanị kpebie otu.
20261124-english-g02-1.example: Chee ebe abụọ ma ọ bụ atọ a pụrụ ikwu ahịrị ndị a.
20261124-english-g02-1.actionItem: Kpebie ma a pụrụ ịmata ebe ahụ site n’ahịrị abụọ a nụrụ naanị, họrọkwa ihe ngosi mgbakwunye ga-ekewa ebe ndị nwere ike ime.

20261124-english-g02-2.title: Azịza dị aṅaa dabara ekele onye nkuzi? Ịtụle ókè nkwanye ùgwù
20261124-english-g02-2.summary:
Onye nkuzi sịrị n’ụtụtụ, “How are you today, Mina?”

Enyi gị Jin kwuru, “N’asụsụ Bekee, ikwu okwu n’ụzọ nkwanye ùgwù ka mma mgbe niile. I nwere ike ikwu otú ahụ nye mmadụ niile.”
20261124-english-g02-2.principle: b na d zara ekele ma jụọ onye nke ọzọ ajụjụ azụ, ya mere ha dabara onye nkuzi. a bụ nkịtị karịa, c na-ada ka okwu ọjọọ.
20261124-english-g02-2.example: Lelee iche ma azịza dabara ajụjụ na ma ọ dabara onye nkuzi.
20261124-english-g02-2.actionItem: Họrọ azịza dabara ekele onye nkuzi, kwuo ọnọdụ ebe nkwupụta “ịkwanyere ùgwù kacha mma mgbe niile” na-abụghị eziokwu.

20261124-english-g03-1.title: Chọta oge ịgụ akwụkwọ n'usoro oge Saturday nke Mina
20261124-english-g03-1.summary:
Usoro oge Saturday nke Mina (e dere dị ka ederede naanị, na-enweghị ihe oyiyi):

10 a.m.: I can start my free time.
12 p.m. - 1 p.m.: Lunch
1 p.m. - 2 p.m.: Dance class
5 p.m.: Dinner. I must finish before dinner.

Mina chọrọ ịgụ akwụkwọ awa 1. Ọ na-amalite n'awa zuru ezu ma na-akwụsị n'awa zuru ezu.
20261124-english-g03-1.principle: Oge ezumike na-amalite na 10 a.m., ma 12 ruo 14 jupụtara na nri ehihie na ịgba egwu. Ọrụ ọ bụla adịghị n'usoro oge site na 15 ruo 16 na site na 16 ruo 17, ma ha na-agwụ tupu nri abalị.
20261124-english-g03-1.example: Gbanwee oge dị n'usoro oge ka ọ bụrụ ọnụọgụ awa 24 ma see eserese oge.
20261124-english-g03-1.actionItem: Chee oge mmalite ịgụ akwụkwọ dị iche nke na-emezu ọnọdụ niile dị n'usoro oge, ma kọwaa ihe mere oge ndị ọzọ anaghị arụ ọrụ.

20261124-english-g03-2.title: Gosi 'nchegbu' n'enweghị ikwu ya
20261124-english-g03-2.summary: Ị ga-ede ihe omume ebe enyi gị Mina na-echegbu onwe ya n'oge ule. Ederede na-ekwu mmetụta ozugbo na ederede na-egosi ya site n'omume na-eru onye na-agụ n'ụzọ dị iche.
20261124-english-g03-2.principle: Site n'aka oyi na ịlele elekere ugboro ugboro, onye na-agụ nwere ike ichee nchegbu. Ịmị ọnụ mgbe ọ na-ele window na-egosi ike ọgwụgwụ, ma ịmụmụ ọnụ ọchị mgbe ọ na-ede ngwa ngwa na-egosi udo ma ọ bụ ntụkwasị obi.
20261124-english-g03-2.example: Site na ederede atọ ọ bụla, họrọ ma dee omume Mina ma ọ bụ mgbanwe ahụ ya.
20261124-english-g03-2.actionItem: Dee obere ederede ebe onye na-agụ nwere ike ichee mmetụta site n'omume na ihe ngosi ahụ naanị, n'enweghị okwu mmetụta ọ bụla.

20261124-english-g04-1.title: Ndetu nne na oge egwuregwu Jisu
20261124-english-g04-1.summary:
'Ndetu nne hapụrụ n'elu tebụl (e dere dị ka ederede naanị, n'enweghị eserese):

Mina,
Today's plan:
3:30 p.m. Come home.
4:00 p.m. Piano class (30 minutes).
5:00 p.m. Take out the trash.
6:30 p.m. Dinner with Mom and Dad.

Mgbe ahụ enyi ya Jisu zigara ozi ederede. "Let's play at the park from 4:15 to 5:15 today!"'
20261124-english-g04-1.principle: Klaasị piano bụ 4:00-4:30, ya mere 4:15-4:30 na-adabere, ma ịtụpụ ahịhịa na 5:00 dabara n'ime 4:15-5:15. Ịlọta ụlọ na 3:30 na nri abalị na 6:30 dị n'èzí oge ogige.
20261124-english-g04-1.example: Tinye ahịrị ọ bụla n'akụkụ oge ogige '4:15-5:15' otu n'otu, ma lee ma ọ na-agwụ tupu ya ma ọ bụ na-amalite mgbe ya.
20261124-english-g04-1.actionItem: Tụnyere atụmatụ dị iche iche dị n'ndetu nne na oge enyi tụrụ aro, chọta ebe ha na-adabaghị, ma kwuo mba n'asụsụ Bekee ka ị na-atụ aro oge dị iche.

20261124-english-g04-2.title: Kpebie oge ịga ije nkịta na ọrụ ụlọ
20261124-english-g04-2.summary:
"Ndetu Papa hapụrụ (e dere dị ka ederede naanị, n'enweghị eserese):

Mina,
You come home at 4:00 p.m. I come home at 6:30 p.m.
- Walk the dog for 30 minutes. Not before 5:00 p.m. It is too hot.
- Do your homework for 60 minutes.
- Finish both before I come home.
- Do not do both at the same time.

N'okpuru, dee oge ọ bụla dị ka 'ole nkeji mgbe 4:00 p.m.'. Dịka ọmụmaatụ, ọ bụrụ na ị malite na 4:30, dee 30, ma ọ bụrụ na ị malite na 5:15, dee 75."
20261124-english-g04-2.principle: Ọrụ ụlọ bụ 5:00-6:00 ma ije bụ 5:30-6:00, ya mere ọrụ abụọ ahụ na-adabere site na 5:30 ruo 6:00. Ije na-amalite mgbe 5:00 ma abụọ na-agwụ tupu 6:30, ya mere a na-edebe ọnọdụ ndị ọzọ.
20261124-english-g04-2.example: Gbakwunye oge ọ na-ewe (n'nkeji) na oge mmalite nke ọrụ ọ bụla iji chọta oge ọ na-agwụ.
20261124-english-g04-2.actionItem: Mee ọtụtụ njikọta dị iche iche nke oge ije na oge ọrụ ụlọ na-ezute ọnọdụ niile dị n'ndetu Papa.

20261124-english-g05-1.title: Echiche gị na-agbanwe ka ị na-agụ ihe nkwanye
20261124-english-g05-1.summary: Jun abụghị onye otu Green Library. Enyi ya Ara bụ onye otu Green Library. Ha abụọ ga-agụ ihe nkwanye dị n'ihu ọbá akwụkwọ otu ahịrị n'otu oge.
20261124-english-g05-1.principle: Gbanwee mkpebi gị oge ọ bụla a na-ekpughe ozi ihe nkwanye n'ọkwa, ma mee ajụjụ Bekee na-elele ozi nke anọghị n'ihe nkwanye.
20261124-english-g05-1.example: Lelee ma ahịrịokwu bụ ọhụrụ oge a na-agbanwe mkpebi gị gara aga.
20261124-english-g05-1.actionItem: Gbanwee mkpebi gị oge ọ bụla a na-ekpughe ozi ihe nkwanye n'ọkwa, ma mee ajụjụ Bekee na-elele ozi nke anọghị n'ihe nkwanye.

20261124-english-g05-2.title: 'Most popular' - ederede ahụ na-akwado ya?
20261124-english-g05-2.summary:
'Klaasị Mina nwere akụkụ ịgụ akwụkwọ nwere ebe a na-edebe akwụkwọ.

Our class has a reading corner. There are 20 books on the shelf. Twelve of them are about animals. Four are about space, and four are story books. The teacher did not buy any new books this year.

Mina says, "Animal books are the most popular in our class."'
20261124-english-g05-2.principle: Ederede naanị na-agwa ọnụọgụ akwụkwọ dị n'ebe a na-edebe akwụkwọ (akwụkwọ anụmanụ 12, wdg.). Ọ naghị ekwu akwụkwọ kedu ụmụ akwụkwọ na-agụ ma ọ bụ na-eji nke ukwuu, ya mere anyị enweghị ike ilele nkwupụta 'most popular'.
20261124-english-g05-2.example: Chee ihe 'popular' pụtara n'okwu Mina, ma chọọ ahịrị okwu dị n'ederede na-agwa gị nke ahụ.
20261124-english-g05-2.actionItem: Chee ma ozi ọnụọgụ dị n'ederede na-akwado nkwupụta (popular), ma mee ajụjụ Bekee nwere ike ịlele nkwupụta ahụ.

20261124-english-g06-1.title: Klọb akwụkwọ ọ̀ bụ ihe ịga nke ọma? Ịgbanwe ikpe gị ka ihe àmà na-abawanye
20261124-english-g06-1.summary: Otu klọb akwụkwọ ọhụrụ amalitela n'ụlọ akwụkwọ anyị. Onye nkụzi kwuru, "The club is a success." Ị ga-anata ihe àmà otu mpempe n'otu oge ma chee echiche ma nkwupụta a ziri ezi.
20261124-english-g06-1.principle: Ka a na-agbakwunye data otu mpempe n'otu oge, gbanwee ikpe gị banyere nkwupụta 'klọb akwụkwọ bụ ihe ịga nke ọma', ma mechie n'asụsụ Bekee site n'iji ihe àmà abụọ.
20261124-english-g06-1.example: Kewaa ihe data ị nwere ugbu a na-egosipụta na ihe ị ka maghị.
20261124-english-g06-1.actionItem: Ka a na-agbakwunye data otu mpempe n'otu oge, gbanwee ikpe gị banyere nkwupụta 'klọb akwụkwọ bụ ihe ịga nke ọma', ma mechie n'asụsụ Bekee site n'iji ihe àmà abụọ.

20261124-english-g06-2.title: Ime tebụl iji chọta ikpe ebe nkwupụta bụ eziokwu
20261124-english-g06-2.summary: Ụmụ akwụkwọ 20 n'otu klaasị nke ọ bụla tụrụ otu votu maka omume mgbe nri nta: bọl, nka, ma ọ bụ egwú. A na-akpọ votu ndị ahụ s (bọl), a (nka), na m (egwú).
20261124-english-g06-2.principle: Votu 8 karịrị nka (6) na egwú (6), ya mere ọ bụ nke kacha, ọ dịkwa ntakịrị karịa 10, ọkara nke 20, ya mere ọ bụghị ọkara. Ya mere a ziri ezi.
20261124-english-g06-2.example: Gbakwunye 8, 6, na 6, chọta ihe ọkara nke ụmụ akwụkwọ 20 bụ, ma tụnyere.
20261124-english-g06-2.actionItem: Mee ọtụtụ tebụl votu n'onwe gị nke nkwupụta bekee 'it got the most votes, but not half of the class' bụ eziokwu.

20261124-english-g07-1.title: Ben ọ ga-abịa oriri ahụ? Ịtụle ihe zoro n’azụ azịza ya
20261124-english-g07-1.summary:
Mkparịta ụka Jisu na Ben (ederede naanị, enweghị foto):

Jisu: Do you want to come to my birthday party on Saturday?
Ben: Saturday? Hmm. I have a soccer game in the morning.
Jisu: The party is at 4 p.m.
Ben: Oh, that might work. I'll probably be tired, though.
Jisu: So... are you coming?
Ben: Let me check with my mom first.
20261124-english-g07-1.principle: Egwuregwu bọọlụ bụ n’ụtụtụ, oriri bụ na 4 p.m., ya mere oge anaghị ekpuchikọ. Ben kwuru naanị na ike nwere ike gwụ ya; na njedebe o kwuru na ọ ga-ebu ụzọ jụọ mama ya. Ya mere e kpebiela ihe ụfọdụ (oge), ihe ọzọ ka fọdụrụ (ikike mama ya), a kpebeghịkwa.
20261124-english-g07-1.example: Kewaa okwu Ben n’akụkụ anọ: “soccer game,” “party time,” “tired,” na “mom.”
20261124-english-g07-1.actionItem: Kewaa okwu Ben n’ime mkparịta ụka ahụ ahịrị n’ahịrị, kewaa ihe e kpebiela na nke fọdụrụ, kpebie n’enweghị nkwupụta na “ọ ga-abịa” ma ọ bụ “ọ gaghị abịa.”

20261124-english-g07-2.title: “That’s fine.” ọ pụtara n’ezie na ọ dị mma?
20261124-english-g07-2.summary: Sam na Dad na-ekwu maka atụmatụ Friday. A ga-ekpughe mkparịta ụka ahụ n’akụkụ atọ. E dere ya dịka ederede, enweghị foto.
20261124-english-g07-2.principle: Site n’ịgụ ntakịrị mkparịta ụka n’otu oge, kpebie mmetụta zoro ezo nke onye na-ekwu okwu, megharịa mkpebi mbụ mgbe ihe ngosi ọhụrụ pụtara.
20261124-english-g07-2.example: Chọta otu ụda okwu ma ọ bụ okwu ọhụrụ n’akụkụ a.
20261124-english-g07-2.actionItem: Site n’ịgụ ntakịrị mkparịta ụka n’otu oge, kpebie mmetụta zoro ezo nke onye na-ekwu okwu, megharịa mkpebi mbụ mgbe ihe ngosi ọhụrụ pụtara.

20261124-english-g08-1.title: Dee ọzọ nkwupụta na ịga ọbá akwụkwọ ugboro ugboro na-ebuli akara
20261124-english-g08-1.summary: Onye na-ede blog chọrọ ide nke a: 'Library visits make students' scores go up.' Ka anyị lelee ahịrịokwu a megide data.
20261124-english-g08-1.principle: Oge ọ bụla a kpughere data ọhụrụ, kpebie ọzọ ka ị nwere ike ịbụ onye doro anya banyere nkwupụta ahụ, ma dee ọzọ ahịrịokwu ikpeazụ.
20261124-english-g08-1.example: N'nzọụkwụ ọ bụla, lelee ma ozi ọhụrụ na-akwado mkpebi gara aga ma ọ bụ na-ama ya jijiji.
20261124-english-g08-1.actionItem: Oge ọ bụla a kpughere data ọhụrụ, kpebie ọzọ ka ị nwere ike ịbụ onye doro anya banyere nkwupụta ahụ, ma dee ọzọ ahịrịokwu ikpeazụ.

20261124-english-g08-2.title: Dozie ahịrị nwere ọnụọgụ na-ezighị ezi n'ederede blog nke ịhicha osimiri
20261124-english-g08-2.summary: Otu nwa akwụkwọ n'otu klaasị dere ederede a n'blog ụlọ akwụkwọ. (Ọ bụ naanị ederede. Ahịrị ọ bụla nwere nọmba.)
20261124-english-g08-2.principle: Ahịrị 3 na-ekwu na ha chịkọtara akpa 30 n'awa mbụ, ma ahịrị 4 na-ekwu na ngụkọta bụ akpa 18. Ngụkọta enweghị ike ịdị nta karịa ihe e chịkọtara n'awa mbụ. Ederede a naanị enweghị ike ịgwa ma ahịrị 3 ma ọ bụ ahịrị 4 na-ezighị ezi, ya mere ị nwere ike ịhọrọ ọ bụla.
20261124-english-g08-2.example: Chịkọta naanị ahịrị nwere ọnụọgụ ma tụnyere ha n'etiti onwe ha.
20261124-english-g08-2.actionItem: Chọta ahịrị ọnụọgụ abụọ n'ederede blog na-adabaghị n'ibe ha, ma dee ha ọzọ ka ha dabara ozi e kwenyesiri ike.

20261124-english-g09-1.title: Echiche zoro n’ime “anyị rere nri ehihie 200 pere mpe”
20261124-english-g09-1.summary:
E tinyere nke a n’elu bọọdụ n’ihu cafeteria ụlọ akwụkwọ.

“This month, the cafeteria sold 200 fewer lunches than last month. So students did not like the new menu.”
20261124-english-g09-1.principle: Iji si n’eziokwu na ahịa dara gaa “uto nri adabaghị ha,” ọnọdụ ndị ọzọ (ọnụ ọgụgụ ụmụ akwụkwọ, ụbọchị ụlọ akwụkwọ, wdg) ga-abụ otu. Ọ bụrụ ụmụ akwụkwọ ma ọ bụ ụbọchị ụlọ akwụkwọ pere mpe, ahịa ga-ada ọbụna ma uto nri adịghị agbanwe.
20261124-english-g09-1.example: Buru ụzọ dee n’asụsụ nke gị ihe nwere ike ịkpata “ere nri ehihie pere mpe.”
20261124-english-g09-1.actionItem: Chọpụta echiche a na-ekwughị nke dị mkpa ka nkwupụta wee bụrụ eziokwu, dee nkọwa ọzọ n’asụsụ Bekee nke na-eme ka echiche ahụ maa jijiji.

20261124-english-g09-2.title: Gbanwee nhọrọ ụlọ nri ka nkọwa ọzọ na-apụta otu n'otu
20261124-english-g09-2.summary: Otu ezinụlọ na-ahọrọ ụlọ nri maka nri ehihie tupu ihe nkiri (na-amalite na 3:00 p.m.). Oge nri ehihie bụ otu awa malite na 12:30. Ozi nkọwa na-apụta otu n'otu.
20261124-english-g09-2.principle: Gụọ nkọwa ụlọ nri n'ogo n'ogo, megharịa ikpe gị, ma dee n'asụsụ Bekee ọnọdụ nke ọkwa ị nwere ike ịtụkwasị obi.
20261124-english-g09-2.example: Chọta otu okwu ma ọ bụ nọmba ị na-ahụ na nke mbụ n’akụkụ a.
20261124-english-g09-2.actionItem: Gụọ nkọwa ụlọ nri n'ogo n'ogo, megharịa ikpe gị, ma dee n'asụsụ Bekee ọnọdụ nke ọkwa ị nwere ike ịtụkwasị obi.

20261124-english-g10-1.title: Kedu ka anyị ga-esi dee ọkwa abụọ na-emegide ibe ha n'akwụkwọ akụkọ ụlọ akwụkwọ?
20261124-english-g10-1.summary:
Ị nọ n'otu ndị edemede nke akwụkwọ akụkọ bekee ụlọ akwụkwọ. Ọkwa abụọ banyere ememme dị iche n'ibe ha.

Ọkwa ụlọ akwụkwọ: "Festival: Friday, 4 p.m., in the gym. Free for all students."
Posta ụlọ ọrụ ụmụ akwụkwọ: "Festival: Friday, 5 p.m., in the gym. Tickets: 1,000 won."

I kwenyebeghị nke ziri ezi.
20261124-english-g10-1.principle: Ọ bụrụ na ekwenyeghị, ihe ziri ezi bụ ikwu ihe isi iyi abụọ ahụ nke ọ bụla na-ekwu ma gwa ndị na-agụ na a ka na-elele ya. Ịhọrọ otu akụkụ ma kwuo ya n'ike, ma ọ bụ ịgwa mmadụ ka ha ghara ịbịa n'enweghị ozi, na-eduhie ndị na-agụ.
20261124-english-g10-1.example: Tụnyere ozi mgbasa ozi ọ bụla na-enye ndị na-agụ na ihe ọ na-ezo.
20261124-english-g10-1.actionItem: Dee maka ndị na-agụ (ụmụ akwụkwọ) ihe na-ebufe ọkwa abụọ dị iche n'ụzọ ziri ezi, na-ekwu ihe ekwenyeghị na ihe ndị na-agụ kwesịrị ime.

20261124-english-g10-2.title: Otu ihe atụ nwere ike ịkwado ikwu 'mgbe niile'?
20261124-english-g10-2.summary:
"Nke a bụ akụkụ nke ederede e bipụtara n'akwụkwọ akụkọ ụlọ akwụkwọ (nọmba ahịrị na-amalite na 1).
1) Our school should ban phones from the building.
2) Last month, Mina got a new phone, and her math score dropped from 90 to 75.
3) So phones clearly make all students' grades worse.
4) Also, phones are noisy in the hallway, and some students look up answers during tests.
5) Therefore, the school should ban them for everyone."
20261124-english-g10-2.principle: Ahịrị 3 bụ nsogbu. Ikwu na akara ga-adị njọ "n'ezie" maka "ụmụ akwụkwọ niile" dabere naanị n'ịda nke akara otu nwa akwụkwọ (ahịrị 2) bụ nkwubi okwu dị ukwuu karịa ihe akaebe. Ịda akara nwere ike inwe ihe ndị ọzọ kpatara ya, dị ka isi ike ule ma ọ bụ ọnọdụ. Ahịrị 4 na-enye ihe kpatara dị iche na akara (mkpọtụ, ịghọgbu), ya mere a ga-atụle ya iche na nsogbu a. "Banned for everyone" n'ahịrị 5 dabekwara n'nkwubi okwu a, ma ebe nsogbu na-amalite bụ ahịrị 3.
20261124-english-g10-2.example: Maka ahịrị ọ bụla, kewaa 'ihe ọ kọrọ' na 'ihe ọ kwubiri'.
20261124-english-g10-2.actionItem: N'ederede arụmụka, chọta ahịrị ebe ihe akaebe anaghị akwado nkwupụta ahụ nke ọma, dee ya ọzọ ka ọ bụrụ ahịrị okwu nlezianya karịa, ma kpebie ihe akaebe ọzọ achọrọ.

20261124-english-g11-1.title: Ntụziaka ọrụ na-adịghị doo anya: gịnị ka ị kwesịrị ịjụ buru ụzọ?
20261124-english-g11-1.summary:
Nke a bụ email onye ọrụ ọzụzụ Jiho natara site n'onye isi otu Ms. Han.

Hi Jiho,
Please send the sales summary to the client before the meeting.
Thanks,
Ms. Han

Eziokwu Jiho maara: Kalenda otu na-egosi nnọkọ na Aurora Co. na Tuesday n'elekere 10:00 na nnọkọ na Blue Pine Ltd. na Thursday n'elekere 14:00. Folda ekekọrịtara nwere faịlụ nchịkọta ire ahịa dị iche maka July, August na September.
20261124-english-g11-1.principle: Ọ bụrụ na e kpebighị onye ahịa na oge, ị pụrụ izipu faịlụ na-ezighị ezi nye onye ahịa na-ezighị ezi. Maka udi faịlụ, ị pụrụ ịtọ ihe ndabara dị ka PDF ma mara ya ọkwa, ma ọ bụrụ na ọ nọ n'ọrụ enweghị ihe ọ metụtara n'ọrụ ahụ n'onwe ya.
20261124-english-g11-1.example: Lelee ma 'nye onye,' 'gịnị,' na 'tupu mgbe ole' nke ọ bụla na-apụta dị ka otu ihe kpọmkwem n'email ahụ.
20261124-english-g11-1.actionItem: Site n'email ọrụ na-adịghị doo anya, họpụta ozi ndị a ga-ekwenye tupu ime ihe, ma dee email ajụjụ nke dị mfe izaghachi.

20261124-english-g11-2.title: Ọ bụ n'ihi klọb ịgụ akwụkwọ? Kedu ozi ga-eme ka anyị mara?
20261124-english-g11-2.summary:
'Nke a bụ akụkụ nke akụkọ ụlọ ọrụ ụmụ akwụkwọ.

"Students who joined the school reading club had higher English test scores than students who did not (average 82 vs 74). So the reading club raises English scores."

Nwa akwụkwọ Mina chọrọ ilele ma nkwubi okwu a ziri ezi. Ụmụ akwụkwọ na-esonye na klọb site n'ịrịọ ma ọ bụrụ na ha chọrọ.'
20261124-english-g11-2.principle: Ọ bụrụ na ị maara akara tupu ịsonye, ị nwere ike itụnyere ma akara ndị otu dị elu na mbụ ma ọ bụ gbadara mgbe ha sonyechara. N'ihi na ụmụ akwụkwọ na-esonye site n'ịrịọ, ụmụ akwụkwọ nwere ike ịbụ ndị dị mma n'Bekee na mbụ sonyere karịa.
20261124-english-g11-2.example: Chee otu eziokwu bụ na ụmụ akwụkwọ na-esonye 'site n'ịrịọ ma ọ bụrụ na ha chọrọ' nwere ike imetụta ebe mmalite nke otu abụọ ahụ.
20261124-english-g11-2.actionItem: Họrọ ozi achọrọ iji mara ma oghere akara n'etiti ndị otu klọb na ndị na-abụghị ndị otu bụ mmetụta nke klọb, ma dee n'asụsụ Bekee ajụjụ iji nweta ozi ahụ.

20261124-english-g12-1.title: Ụmụ akwụkwọ na-eri nri ụtụtụ nwere akara dị elu: gịnị ọzọ ka anyị chọrọ ịmara?
20261124-english-g12-1.summary:
Nke a bụ nkwupụta sitere n'akụkọ ụlọ akwụkwọ. "Students who eat breakfast get higher test scores, so the school should provide free breakfast." Dịka ihe akaebe, e gosipụtara nsonaazụ nyocha nke ụmụ akwụkwọ 200 dị otú a.

Group | Number of students | Average score
Students who eat breakfast | 130 | 82
Students who skip breakfast | 70 | 74
20261124-english-g12-1.principle: b na-elele ihe kpatara ndị ọzọ (ụra, oge ọmụmụ), c na-elele nsonaazụ nke mmeghachi omume n'ezie, e na-elelekwa ịdị mma nke itụnyere. a na d abụghị ihe akaebe banyere ma nri na-ebuli akara.
20261124-english-g12-1.example: Lelee ma ozi ọ bụla na-enyere aka ịzaa ajụjụ, 'Mmekọrịta dị n'etiti nri ụtụtụ na akara ọ̀ bụ ihe kpatara?'
20261124-english-g12-1.actionItem: Kpee ikpe ma nsonaazụ nyocha na-agwa anyị banyere "ihe kpatara," họrọ ozi ọzọ achọrọ maka mkpebi ahụ, ma tụọ aro n'Bekee usoro itụnyere iji lelee mmetụta nke nri n'efu.

20261124-english-g12-2.title: Otu ihe merenụ, isi okwu dị iche: ikpe na-agbanwe ka ozi na-abawanye
20261124-english-g12-2.summary: A na-ewepụta n'ogo akụkọ banyere kansụl obodo kpebiri ịbawanye ụgwọ ebe a na-ebu ụgbọala n'akụkụ ọdụ ụgbọ ala. Lelee ma ikpe gị na-agbanwe oge ọ bụla ozi na-abawanye.
20261124-english-g12-2.principle: Ka ozi na-abawanye, megharịa ikpe gị banyere otú ụda isi okwu na ihe e hapụrụ si gbadata n'otu akụkụ ma e tụnyere eziokwu, ma kọwaa otu ihe n'asụsụ Bekee.
20261124-english-g12-2.example: Kewaa okwu dị n'isi okwu na-enye eziokwu na ndị na-enye mmetụta.
20261124-english-g12-2.actionItem: Ka ozi na-abawanye, megharịa ikpe gị banyere otú ụda isi okwu na ihe e hapụrụ si gbadata n'otu akụkụ ma e tụnyere eziokwu, ma kọwaa otu ihe n'asụsụ Bekee.

20261125-english-g01-1.title: Chọta omume ndị na-adabaghị n'ọkwa ọdọ mmiri
20261125-english-g01-1.summary:
Ọkwa dị n'ọnụ ụzọ ọdọ mmiri (e dere n'okwu naanị, na-enweghị ihe oyiyi):

Pool Rules
1. No running.
2. Swim caps on, please.
3. Under 8? Come with a grown-up.

(grown-up = okenye)

Mmadụ anọ na-aga n'ọdọ mmiri.
Mina dị afọ 7. Ọ na-eso nne ya bịa, ma o nwere okpu.
Jun dị afọ 10. Ọ na-abịa naanị ya, ma o nweghị okpu.
Tom dị afọ 6. Ọ na-eso nwanne ya nwoke bịa. Nwanne ya dị afọ 9. Tom nwere okpu.
Sue dị afọ 11. Ọ na-eje ije gaa ọdọ mmiri naanị ya, ma o nwere okpu.
20261125-english-g01-1.principle: Jun enweghị okpu, ya mere ọ na-agbaji iwu 2. Tom dị n'okpuru 8, ma nwanne ya nwoke nke na-eso ya bịa dị afọ 9, ya mere ọ bụghị 'grown-up', ya mere Tom na-agbaji iwu 3. Mina soro nne ya bịa, ma Sue dị afọ 11, ya mere ọ dị mma ka ọ jee ije bịa naanị ya.
20261125-english-g01-1.example: Mee tebụl nwere afọ onye ọ bụla, onye ọ na-eso bịa, na okpu, otu n'otu.
20261125-english-g01-1.actionItem: Kwekọọ iwu atọ dị n'ọkwa ahụ na ọnọdụ onye ọ bụla, họrọ ikpe ndị na-agbaji iwu, ma kwuo ihe kpatara n'asụsụ Bekee.

20261125-english-g01-2.title: Dozie ahịrị na-ezighi ezi n'ọkwa ihe furu efu e depụtara
20261125-english-g01-2.summary:
Ọkwa dị n'ebe e ji ọkwa ụlọ akwụkwọ (e dere n'okwu naanị):

Lost and Found
Found: a blue water bottle, near Room 3.
Ask Ms. Park in Room 1 after school.

Enyi gị Jia hụrụ ọkwa a n'ihi na ọ na-achọ karama mmiri ya, ma zigara Hana ozi. Hana chọrọ itụnyere ya na ọkwa ahụ.
20261125-english-g01-2.principle: Ahịrị 4 adịghị mma. N'ọkwa ahụ, Ms. Park nọ n'Room 1, ma ozi ahụ na-ekwu Room 3, ya mere ọ dịghị mma. Blue dị n'ahịrị 2 bụ otu ihe ahụ dị n'ọkwa ahụ, ma Room 3 dị n'ahịrị 3 bụ ebe a hụrụ karama ahụ, ya mere ọ ziri ezi.
20261125-english-g01-2.example: Gosi okwu dị n'ọkwa ahụ (agba, ọnụọgụ ụlọ, aha mmadụ) otu n'otu ma kwekọọ ha na ahịrị nke ozi ahụ.
20261125-english-g01-2.actionItem: Tụnyere ọkwa ihe furu efu na ozi enyi depụtara site na ya, ahịrị n'ahịrị, chọta ahịrị na-ezighi ezi, ma dee ya ọzọ n'ụzọ ziri ezi.

20261125-english-g02-1.title: Ebee ka “Two tickets, please.” dị? Ịkpebi ma ozi e nyere ezuola
20261125-english-g02-1.summary:
Ị nụrụ nwoke na onye na-ere tiketi na-ekwu okwu. Ha ekwughị ebe ha nọ.

Man: Two tickets, please.
Clerk: Here you are. The show starts at 7:00.
20261125-english-g02-1.principle: Ticket na show bụ okwu a na-eji n’ọtụtụ ebe, dịka sinima ma ọ bụ ụlọ egwu. O siri ike iji ahịrị abụọ naanị kpebie otu.
20261125-english-g02-1.example: Chee ebe abụọ ma ọ bụ atọ a pụrụ ikwu ahịrị ndị a.
20261125-english-g02-1.actionItem: Kpebie ma a pụrụ ịmata ebe ahụ site n’ahịrị abụọ a nụrụ naanị, họrọkwa ihe ngosi mgbakwunye ga-ekewa ebe ndị nwere ike ime.

20261125-english-g02-2.title: Azịza dị aṅaa dabara ekele onye nkuzi? Ịtụle ókè nkwanye ùgwù
20261125-english-g02-2.summary:
Onye nkuzi sịrị n’ụtụtụ, “How are you today, Mina?”

Enyi gị Jin kwuru, “N’asụsụ Bekee, ikwu okwu n’ụzọ nkwanye ùgwù ka mma mgbe niile. I nwere ike ikwu otú ahụ nye mmadụ niile.”
20261125-english-g02-2.principle: b na d zara ekele ma jụọ onye nke ọzọ ajụjụ azụ, ya mere ha dabara onye nkuzi. a bụ nkịtị karịa, c na-ada ka okwu ọjọọ.
20261125-english-g02-2.example: Lelee iche ma azịza dabara ajụjụ na ma ọ dabara onye nkuzi.
20261125-english-g02-2.actionItem: Họrọ azịza dabara ekele onye nkuzi, kwuo ọnọdụ ebe nkwupụta “ịkwanyere ùgwù kacha mma mgbe niile” na-abụghị eziokwu.

20261125-english-g03-1.title: Chọta oge ịgụ akwụkwọ n'usoro oge Saturday nke Mina
20261125-english-g03-1.summary:
Usoro oge Saturday nke Mina (e dere dị ka ederede naanị, na-enweghị ihe oyiyi):

10 a.m.: I can start my free time.
12 p.m. - 1 p.m.: Lunch
1 p.m. - 2 p.m.: Dance class
5 p.m.: Dinner. I must finish before dinner.

Mina chọrọ ịgụ akwụkwọ awa 1. Ọ na-amalite n'awa zuru ezu ma na-akwụsị n'awa zuru ezu.
20261125-english-g03-1.principle: Oge ezumike na-amalite na 10 a.m., ma 12 ruo 14 jupụtara na nri ehihie na ịgba egwu. Ọrụ ọ bụla adịghị n'usoro oge site na 15 ruo 16 na site na 16 ruo 17, ma ha na-agwụ tupu nri abalị.
20261125-english-g03-1.example: Gbanwee oge dị n'usoro oge ka ọ bụrụ ọnụọgụ awa 24 ma see eserese oge.
20261125-english-g03-1.actionItem: Chee oge mmalite ịgụ akwụkwọ dị iche nke na-emezu ọnọdụ niile dị n'usoro oge, ma kọwaa ihe mere oge ndị ọzọ anaghị arụ ọrụ.

20261125-english-g03-2.title: Gosi 'nchegbu' n'enweghị ikwu ya
20261125-english-g03-2.summary: Ị ga-ede ihe omume ebe enyi gị Mina na-echegbu onwe ya n'oge ule. Ederede na-ekwu mmetụta ozugbo na ederede na-egosi ya site n'omume na-eru onye na-agụ n'ụzọ dị iche.
20261125-english-g03-2.principle: Site n'aka oyi na ịlele elekere ugboro ugboro, onye na-agụ nwere ike ichee nchegbu. Ịmị ọnụ mgbe ọ na-ele window na-egosi ike ọgwụgwụ, ma ịmụmụ ọnụ ọchị mgbe ọ na-ede ngwa ngwa na-egosi udo ma ọ bụ ntụkwasị obi.
20261125-english-g03-2.example: Site na ederede atọ ọ bụla, họrọ ma dee omume Mina ma ọ bụ mgbanwe ahụ ya.
20261125-english-g03-2.actionItem: Dee obere ederede ebe onye na-agụ nwere ike ichee mmetụta site n'omume na ihe ngosi ahụ naanị, n'enweghị okwu mmetụta ọ bụla.

20261125-english-g04-1.title: Ndetu nne na oge egwuregwu Jisu
20261125-english-g04-1.summary:
'Ndetu nne hapụrụ n'elu tebụl (e dere dị ka ederede naanị, n'enweghị eserese):

Mina,
Today's plan:
3:30 p.m. Come home.
4:00 p.m. Piano class (30 minutes).
5:00 p.m. Take out the trash.
6:30 p.m. Dinner with Mom and Dad.

Mgbe ahụ enyi ya Jisu zigara ozi ederede. "Let's play at the park from 4:15 to 5:15 today!"'
20261125-english-g04-1.principle: Klaasị piano bụ 4:00-4:30, ya mere 4:15-4:30 na-adabere, ma ịtụpụ ahịhịa na 5:00 dabara n'ime 4:15-5:15. Ịlọta ụlọ na 3:30 na nri abalị na 6:30 dị n'èzí oge ogige.
20261125-english-g04-1.example: Tinye ahịrị ọ bụla n'akụkụ oge ogige '4:15-5:15' otu n'otu, ma lee ma ọ na-agwụ tupu ya ma ọ bụ na-amalite mgbe ya.
20261125-english-g04-1.actionItem: Tụnyere atụmatụ dị iche iche dị n'ndetu nne na oge enyi tụrụ aro, chọta ebe ha na-adabaghị, ma kwuo mba n'asụsụ Bekee ka ị na-atụ aro oge dị iche.

20261125-english-g04-2.title: Kpebie oge ịga ije nkịta na ọrụ ụlọ
20261125-english-g04-2.summary:
"Ndetu Papa hapụrụ (e dere dị ka ederede naanị, n'enweghị eserese):

Mina,
You come home at 4:00 p.m. I come home at 6:30 p.m.
- Walk the dog for 30 minutes. Not before 5:00 p.m. It is too hot.
- Do your homework for 60 minutes.
- Finish both before I come home.
- Do not do both at the same time.

N'okpuru, dee oge ọ bụla dị ka 'ole nkeji mgbe 4:00 p.m.'. Dịka ọmụmaatụ, ọ bụrụ na ị malite na 4:30, dee 30, ma ọ bụrụ na ị malite na 5:15, dee 75."
20261125-english-g04-2.principle: Ọrụ ụlọ bụ 5:00-6:00 ma ije bụ 5:30-6:00, ya mere ọrụ abụọ ahụ na-adabere site na 5:30 ruo 6:00. Ije na-amalite mgbe 5:00 ma abụọ na-agwụ tupu 6:30, ya mere a na-edebe ọnọdụ ndị ọzọ.
20261125-english-g04-2.example: Gbakwunye oge ọ na-ewe (n'nkeji) na oge mmalite nke ọrụ ọ bụla iji chọta oge ọ na-agwụ.
20261125-english-g04-2.actionItem: Mee ọtụtụ njikọta dị iche iche nke oge ije na oge ọrụ ụlọ na-ezute ọnọdụ niile dị n'ndetu Papa.

20261125-english-g05-1.title: Echiche gị na-agbanwe ka ị na-agụ ihe nkwanye
