20261126-math-g01-1.title: Kedu ọdịdị ihe dị n'ime igbe?
20261126-math-g01-1.summary: E kechiri anya gị, ị na-emetụ ihe dị n'ime igbe, ị na-anụ clues n'otu n'otu. Ihe dị n'ime igbe bụ otu n'ime ọdịdị igbe, cylinder, ma ọ bụ bọọlụ.
20261126-math-g01-1.principle: Oge ọ bụla i nwetara clue ọzọ, belata shapes ndị nwere ike, dozie echiche mbụ gị ka ọ dabara clue ọhụrụ.
20261126-math-g01-1.example: Dee ọdịdị igbe, silinda na bọọlụ, ma maka akara ọ bụla kaa ọdịdị ndị ga-ekwe omume.
20261126-math-g01-1.actionItem: Oge ọ bụla i nwetara clue ọzọ, belata shapes ndị nwere ike, dozie echiche mbụ gị ka ọ dabara clue ọhụrụ.

20261126-math-g02-1.title: Nọmba a gachara 1, 2, 4 ọ bụ naanị otu?
20261126-math-g02-1.summary: Otu enyi na klaasị anyị na-egwu egwuregwu usoro nọmba ebe ha na-egosi ọnụọgụ otu n'otu oge. Enyi ahụ ekpebiela otu ụkpụrụ wee gwa gị otu nọmba ọzọ n'otu oge.
20261126-math-g02-1.principle: Mụta na naanị ọnụọgụ ole na ole mbụ adịghị atụdo ụkpụrụ ahụ na otu, yana na ị ga-edozirịrị ụkpụrụ ahụ mgbe ekpughere nọmba ọhụrụ, wee mee usoro ọnụọgụ dabara adaba n'onwe gị.
20261126-math-g02-1.example: Dee ọdịiche dị n'etiti ọnụọgụ agbataobi.
20261126-math-g02-1.actionItem: Mụta na naanị ọnụọgụ ole na ole mbụ adịghị atụdo ụkpụrụ ahụ na otu, yana na ị ga-edozirịrị ụkpụrụ ahụ mgbe ekpughere nọmba ọhụrụ, wee mee usoro ọnụọgụ dabara adaba n'onwe gị.

20261126-math-g03-1.title: Ụzọ dị iche iche iji kesaa candies iri asaa na abụọ n'otu n'otu n'etiti efere (72)
20261126-math-g03-1.summary: Ịchọrọ itinye candies 72 na efere, na-ekekọrịta ha n'otu n'otu na-enweghị nke fọdụrụ. Ọnụọgụ candies na efere ọ bụla na-agbanwe dabere n'efere ole ị na-eji.
20261126-math-g03-1.principle: Ị nwere ike kesaa swiiti ahụ n'enweghị onye ọ bụla fọdụrụ naanị mgbe ọnụ ọgụgụ nke okpukpu okpukpu karịa ọnụ ọgụgụ nke swiiti na otu efere bụ 72. 4×18, 6×12, na 9×8 bụ 72, na ọ dịghị ọnụ ọgụgụ a mụbara site na 5 ma ọ bụ 7 na-eme 72.
20261126-math-g03-1.example: Maka ọnụ ọgụgụ epekele ọ bụla, kewaa 72 site na nọmba ahụ wee lelee ma ọ dị nke fọdụrụ.
20261126-math-g03-1.actionItem: Chọta ụzọ dị iche iche ị ga-esi kerịta nke dabara ọnọdụ (ọnụ ọgụgụ nke efere na ọnụ ọgụgụ swiiti na efere nke ọ bụla) n'otu oge, kọwaakwa otú ọnụ ọgụgụ nke efere na ọnụ ọgụgụ nke candies dị n'otu efere jikọtara ọnụ.

20261126-math-g04-1.title: Ilele nkọwa Seohyeon
20261126-math-g04-1.summary: Seohyeon kọwaara enyi nke a. E nwere njehie n'nkọwa a.
20261126-math-g04-1.principle: Ahịrị 3 bụ ebe ọ buru ụzọ gaa n'ụzọ na-ezighi ezi. Square nwere akụkụ anọ hà, ma nke ahụ apụtaghị nke megidere, "ọ bụrụ na akụkụ anọ hà, ọ bụ square." Ahịrị 4 na-eketa otu njehie ahụ, ma ebe mbụ na-ezighi ezi bụ ahịrị 3.
20261126-math-g04-1.example: Gụọ ahịrị ọ bụla edegharịrị n'ụdị "ọ bụrụ na ..., mgbe ahụ ...," ma dee maka ahịrị ọ bụla ma ọ na-aga n'otu ntụzi dị ka nkwupụta dị n'ahịrị tupu ya.
20261126-math-g04-1.actionItem: Chọta njehie echiche n'nkọwa 'Ọ bụrụ na akụkụ anọ niile bụ otu, ọ bụ square,' ma kọwaa quadrilateral nke bụ ihe atụ na-emegide.

20261126-math-g05-1.title: Ọnụọgụ Otu Ndị A Ga-ekesa Hà Nhata: Idozi Azịza
20261126-math-g05-1.summary: Ị chọrọ ikesa swiiti 48 na chọkọlet 36 hà nhata n'enweghị ihe fọdụrụ n'etiti ọtụtụ otu. Hayun chọtara ọnụọgụ otu dị ka nke a.
20261126-math-g05-1.principle: Ahịrị 2 bụ ebe mbụ ezighị ezi. Ọnụọgụ otu ndị na-ekesa 48 hà nhata ga-abụrịrị ọnụọgụ nke na-ekewa 48 n'enweghị ihe fọdụrụ, ya bụ, ihe nkewa nke 48. Okpukpu nwere ike ịbụ nke karịrị 48, ma mgbe ahụ swiiti adịghị ezuru. Ahịrị 4 kwukwara ihe nke ga-ahapụ ụfọdụ otu na-enweghị otu swiiti ọ bụla na otu 144. Ahịrị 1 detuo nsogbu ahụ nke ọma, ma 144 dị n'ahịrị 3 ziri ezi dị ka least common multiple nke 48 na 36.
20261126-math-g05-1.example: Gụọ ahịrị ọ bụla ma chee echiche ma ihe o kwuru kwere omume n'ezie n'ọnọdụ nke swiiti 48 na chọkọlet 36.
20261126-math-g05-1.actionItem: Chọta ma dozie ebe n'azịza ebe a họrọ mmekọrịta ezighị ezi n'etiti ọnụọgụ (ihe nkewa/okpukpu), ma tụlee ikpe niile dabara n'ọnọdụ ndị ahụ.

20261126-math-g06-1.title: Ka Mmiri ara ehi Strawberry Nọgide n’Otu Ụtọ Mgbe A Na-emekwu
20261126-math-g06-1.summary: Suyeon ji iko strawberry 3 na iko mmiri ara ehi 2 mee mmiri ara ehi strawberry, ụtọ ya dabara. Ọ chọrọ imekwu nke otu ụtọ ahụ, Suyeon chere, “Ọ bụrụ na m tinye iko strawberry 3 ọzọ, m ga-etinyekwa iko mmiri ara ehi 3 ọzọ.”
20261126-math-g06-1.principle: Jiri data lelee na ịgbakwunye otu ọnụ ọgụgụ na-agbanwe ụtọ, dozie mkpebi gị site n’iji nha nhata oke na-edobe oke otu.
20261126-math-g06-1.example: N’usoro nke ọ bụla, dee oke strawberry na mmiri ara ehi n’otu ụzọ, tụnyere.
20261126-math-g06-1.actionItem: Jiri data lelee na ịgbakwunye otu ọnụ ọgụgụ na-agbanwe ụtọ, dozie mkpebi gị site n’iji nha nhata oke na-edobe oke otu.

20261126-math-g07-1.title: Frequency buru ibu ọ̀ pụtara na ha mere nke ọma?
20261126-math-g07-1.summary:
Klaasị 1 (ụmụ akwụkwọ 20) na Klaasị 2 (ụmụ akwụkwọ 50) mere otu nnwale mgbakọ na mwepụ. Frequency distribution table nke akara kewara n'oke atọ bụ nke a.
Oke / Klaasị 1 (ụmụ akwụkwọ 20) / Klaasị 2 (ụmụ akwụkwọ 50)
N'okpuru akara 60 / ụmụ akwụkwọ 2 / ụmụ akwụkwọ 10
Akara 60 ma ọ bụ karịa ma n'okpuru akara 80 / ụmụ akwụkwọ 10 / ụmụ akwụkwọ 25
Akara 80 ma ọ bụ karịa / ụmụ akwụkwọ 8 / ụmụ akwụkwọ 15
Minji kwuru, "E nwere ụmụ akwụkwọ karịa nwere akara 80 ma ọ bụ karịa n'Klaasị 2, 15, ya mere Klaasị 2 mere nke ọma karịa n'nnwale ahụ."
20261126-math-g07-1.principle: N'okwu nke òkè, maka akara 80 ma ọ bụ karịa, Klaasị 1 nwere 8/20=40% ma Klaasị 2 nwere 15/50=30%, ya mere Klaasị 1 dị elu; maka n'okpuru akara 60, Klaasị 1 nwere 2/20=10% ma Klaasị 2 nwere 10/50=20%, ya mere Klaasị 2 bụ okpukpu 2 nke Klaasị 1. Enweghị ike ịmata nkezi site n'tebụl nwere oke e kewara, nkwubi okwu na-atụnyere naanị ọnụọgụ ụmụ akwụkwọ nwekwara nkwado adịghị ike.
20261126-math-g07-1.example: Maka klaasị ọ bụla, kewaa ọnụọgụ ụmụ akwụkwọ n'oke ahụ site n'ngụkọta ọnụọgụ ụmụ akwụkwọ nke klaasị ahụ.
20261126-math-g07-1.actionItem: Mụta nsogbu nke itụnyere frequencies dịka ha dị mgbe klaasị abụọ nwere ọnụọgụ ụmụ akwụkwọ dị iche, ma kewaa ihe tebụl na-enye gị ohere ikwu n'ụzọ doro anya na ihe ọ naghị enye.

20261126-math-g08-1.title: Ndetu kedu ka anyị chọrọ iji chọta ọnụahịa?
20261126-math-g08-1.summary: Anyị chọrọ ịmata ọnụahịa otu pensụl, x won, na ọnụahịa otu akwụkwọ ndetu, y won, n'ụlọ ahịa akwụkwọ. Onye nwe ya gosiri anyị ndetu 5 bụ eziokwu. Ndetu A: pensụl 2 na akwụkwọ ndetu 3 na-efu 3,100 won. Ndetu B: pensụl 4 na akwụkwọ ndetu 6 na-efu 6,200 won. Ndetu C: Akwụkwọ ndetu na-efu 200 won karịa pensụl. Ndetu D: pensụl 6 na akwụkwọ ndetu 9 na-efu 9,300 won. Ndetu E: pensụl 5 na akwụkwọ ndetu 5 na-efu 6,000 won.
20261126-math-g08-1.principle: Ndetu A,B,D nwere otu oke pensụl na akwụkwọ ndetu, 2:3; ego ha bụ otutu otu (ugboro 1,2,3), ya mere ha na-emegharị otu ozi ahụ. Naanị ndetu ndị a agaghị ekpebi otu azịza. Ọ bụrụ i jikọta ndetu nwere oke ọnụ ọgụgụ dị iche (C,E), nhata abụọ ahụ na-enye ozi dị iche, ya mere ọnụ ahịa doro anya. (Pensụl 500원, akwụkwọ ndetu 700원.) (1 2)
20261126-math-g08-1.example: Degharịa ndetu n’ụdị “pensụl □+akwụkwọ ndetu □=□원,” tụnyere ndetu abụọ n’akụkụ ibe ha.
20261126-math-g08-1.actionItem: Mgbe ị na-eguzobe nha ndị a na-edozi n'otu oge, kpebie ma nha ndị ahụ na-enye ozi dị iche, ma mee nha nke na-enyeghị ozi ọhụrụ n'onwe gị.

20261126-math-g09-1.title: Ọ bụrụ sin A=3/5, ọ̀ bụ otu ọbụna mgbe triangle na-aghọ nke buru ibu?
20261126-math-g09-1.summary: N'triangle kwụ ọtọ ABC, ∠C=90°, akụkụ BC bụ akụkụ megidere ∠A, akụkụ AC bụ akụkụ dị nso ∠A (ọ bụghị hypotenuse), ma akụkụ AB bụ hypotenuse. A na-agụ sin A dị ka 'sine A' ma a na-agụ cos A dị ka 'cosine A.' N'triangle ndị a, sin A=3/5 (3 n'elu 5).
20261126-math-g09-1.principle: Ọ bụrụ na ị gbasaa akụkụ atọ niile site n'otu okpukpu, dị ka (AB, BC, AC)=(5, 3, 4), (10, 6, 8), (15, 9, 12), sin A=3/5 na-anọgide otu.
20261126-math-g09-1.example: Dị ka ihe atụ kacha dị mfe, mgbe BC=3 na AB=5, chọta ogologo akụkụ fọdụrụ AC site n'usoro Pythagoras.
20261126-math-g09-1.actionItem: Mee ọtụtụ triangle kwụ ọtọ nwere otu uru sin A, tụọ nkwupụta ụmụ akwụkwọ abụọ site n'iji nsonaazụ ndị ahụ, ma kọwaa ihe mere ratio trigonometric ji edozi site n'nha nke akụkụ.

20261126-math-g10-1.title: Ahịrị ahụ ọ ga-emetụ okirikiri? Mgbe a na-ekpughe ozi n'otu akụkụ n'otu oge
20261126-math-g10-1.summary: E nwere okirikiri x²+y²=25 (ebe etiti ya bụ isi mmalite, okirikiri ya bụ 5) na ahịrị y=x+k. Gbanwee uru k ma lelee ọnụ ọgụgụ ebe ahịrị na okirikiri na-ezukọ.
20261126-math-g10-1.principle: Buo amụma ọnọdụ ahịrị na okirikiri dịka uru konstanti k si dị, degharịa mkpebi gị mgbe e nyere ozi ọhụrụ, ma machie oke k nke ha na-emetụ.
20261126-math-g10-1.example: Ị nwere ike ịlele ọnụ ọgụgụ ebe ha na-agbakọta site n'azịza ihe nhata ị nwetara mgbe ị na-edozi ihe nhata ahịrị na nke okirikiri ọnụ.
20261126-math-g10-1.actionItem: Buo amụma ọnọdụ ahịrị na okirikiri dịka uru konstanti k si dị, degharịa mkpebi gị mgbe e nyere ozi ọhụrụ, ma machie oke k nke ha na-emetụ.

20261126-math-g11-1.title: Chọta ahịrị ebe azịza nha logarithm nwere nsogbu
20261126-math-g11-1.summary: Minho dozie nha log₂(x−1) + log₂(x−3) = 3 ma zaa, ‘Azịza bụ x=5 na x=−1, abụọ.’ Ma a gụọ ya n'olu dị elu, ọ bụ ‘log base 2 of (x minus 1) plus log base 2 of (x minus 3) equals 3’.
20261126-math-g11-1.principle: Ebe mbụ ọ na-agbagọ bụ ahịrị 2. Mgbe a jikọtara ngụkọta logarithm abụọ ka ọ bụrụ otu logarithm, ọnọdụ x−1>0 na x−3>0 nke ihe e dere n'ime logarithm kwụsịrị n'okwu ahụ, ma e deghị ọnọdụ ndị ahụ n'iche. Yabụ n'ahịrị 5 e nakweere mgbọrọgwụ abụọ ahụ, ma ahịrị 6 bụ nkwubi okwu ahụ. Ihe e dere n'ime logarithm ga-abụ nke dị mma, yabụ achọrọ x>3. Ọ bụrụ na x=−1, mgbe ahụ x−1=−2 na x−3=−4, ihe ndị e dere n'ime logarithm adịghị mma, yabụ nha ahụ enweghị nkọwa. Ọ bụrụ na x=5, log₂4 + log₂2 = 2+1 = 3, yabụ ọ dị. Yabụ azịza bụ naanị uru x=5.
20261126-math-g11-1.example: Mgbe ọ bụla okwu gbanwere, gụọ ka ị na-elele na ọ pụtara otu ihe na ahịrị gara aga.
20261126-math-g11-1.actionItem: Chọta ma dozie nsogbu sitere n'ịlele ọnọdụ nke ihe e dere n'ime logarithm (argument) n'azịza nha logarithm.

20261126-math-g12-1.title: Ọ na-ekwu dị mma, ma onye ahụ ọ na-arịa ọrịa n'ezie?
20261126-math-g12-1.summary: Ule maka otu ọrịa pụtara ‘dị mma’. Ị chọrọ ịmata puru ihe na onye nwere nsonaazụ dị mma na-arịa ọrịa ahụ n'ezie. Kpebie ozi achọrọ iji kpebie puru ihe a.
20261126-math-g12-1.principle: Ndị nwere nsonaazụ dị mma bụ ‘ndị ọrịa nwere nsonaazụ dị mma’ na ‘ndị ahụike nwere nsonaazụ dị mma’. Yabụ ịchọrọ òkè ndị ọrịa, puru ihe na onye ọrịa nwere nsonaazụ dị mma, na puru ihe na onye ahụike nwere nsonaazụ dị mma.
20261126-math-g12-1.example: Chetara otu ndị abụọ ka e nwere ike ikewa ndị nwere nsonaazụ dị mma.
20261126-math-g12-1.actionItem: Họrọ ozi achọrọ iji chọta puru ihe n'ihu ọnọdụ, ma jiri ọnụọgụ kọwaa ihe mere izi ezi nke ule ji dị iche na ‘puru ihe nke ịrịa ọrịa mgbe nsonaazụ dị mma’.

20261126-physics-g01-1.title: Ihe ndị magnet na-adọta na ike magnet
20261126-physics-g01-1.summary: Gịnị na-eme mgbe e weta okpuru N na S nke magnet nso ibe ha?
20261126-physics-g01-1.principle: Okpuru magnet dị iche (N na S) na-adọta ibe ha site n'ike mkpali (attraction), ebe okpuru ndị yiri ibe ha na-ezipụ ibe ha site n'ike mgbapụ (repulsion).
20261126-physics-g01-1.example: Chee echiche banyere ihe na-eme mgbe okpuru magnet dị iche na-ezute.
20261126-physics-g01-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261126-physics-g02-1.title: Mkpọtụ na mbufe ụda
20261126-physics-g02-1.summary: A tụrụ ihe ụda (tuning fork) site na hama rabba ma kpọkọta ya nwayọọ n'elu mmiri n'ime ihe ọnụ mmiri. Gịnị na-eme?
20261126-physics-g02-1.principle: Ihe ụda na-ekwu ụda na-ama jijiji, ya mere mgbe ọ metụrụ mmiri, ọ na-efesa mmiri n'akụkụ niile ma na-eme ebili mmiri.
20261126-physics-g02-1.example: Ihe ụda na-ekwu ụda na-ama jijiji ngwa ngwa.
20261126-physics-g02-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261126-physics-g03-1.title: Mgbasa ìhè n'ahịrị kwụ ọtọ na mgbanwe onyinyo
20261126-physics-g03-1.summary: E debere akwụkwọ atọ nwere oghere n'usoro n'ihu ọkụ ọkụ ọkụ. Kedu ka e kwesịrị ịhazi oghere ahụ ka a hụ ìhè n'akụkụ nke ọzọ?
20261126-physics-g03-1.principle: Ìhè na-agbasa n'ahịrị kwụ ọtọ, ya mere ọ nwere ike ịgafe oghere niile naanị mgbe oghere atọ ahụ dị n'otu ahịrị.
20261126-physics-g03-1.example: Ìhè enweghị ike gafere n'ụzọ gbagọrọ agbagọ.
20261126-physics-g03-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261126-physics-g04-1.title: Ihe nha abụọ na ụkpụrụ nhazi
20261126-physics-g04-1.summary: E kwụrụ ibu 20 g n'ebe dị n'ogo 4 sistemụ n'aka ekpe site n'ebe mkpọchi nke ihe nha abụọ. Kedu ibu e kwesịrị ịkwụ n'aka nri n'ogo 2 sistemụ ka ihe nha ahụ dị n'ahụ nhazi?
20261126-physics-g04-1.principle: Dị ka ụkpụrụ nhazi si dị, oge aka ekpe ($4\text{ nkeji} \times 20\text{ g} = 80$) na oge aka nri ($2\text{ nkeji} \times ? = 80$) ga-abụ otu, ya mere a ga-akwụ ibu $40\text{ g}$.
20261126-physics-g04-1.example: Gbakọọ (anya aka ekpe × ibu) = (anya aka nri × ibu).
20261126-physics-g04-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261126-physics-g05-1.title: Nkọwa ọsọ na ntụnyere
20261126-physics-g05-1.summary: Kedu n'ime nkọwa sayensị ndị a gbasara ntụnyere ọsọ nke ihe ziri ezi?
20261126-physics-g05-1.principle: Mgbe e gafere otu ụzọ, ka oge dị mkpụmkpụ, ka ọ na-adị ngwa, ma mgbe e ji otu oge gaa, ka ụzọ e gafere dị ogologo, ka ọsọ dị ukwuu.
20261126-physics-g05-1.example: N'asọmpi ọsọ, onye mbụ na-eru ebe njedebe n'oge kacha nta.
20261126-physics-g05-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261126-physics-g06-1.title: Njikọ circuit na onyinyo convex lens
20261126-physics-g06-1.summary: A chọrọ iji batrị otu, bọlb abụọ na switch jikọọ ya site na waya ka bọlb nwee ike enwu. Kedu ọnọdụ 'circuit mechiri emechi' nke ọkụ na-enwu bụ nke ziri ezi?
20261126-physics-g06-1.principle: Ka ọkụ eletrik gafee, a ga-eme circuit mechiri emechi nke jikọtara na-agbaghị agba site n'otu okpuru batrị gafee akụrụngwa eletrik ruo n'okpuru nke ọzọ.
20261126-physics-g06-1.example: Ọkụ eletrik nwere ike ịgafe naanị mgbe waya jikọtara ma ọ dịghị agbaji.
20261126-physics-g06-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261126-physics-g07-1.title: Nhazi ike ndọda, ikpuru na buoyancy
20261126-physics-g07-1.summary: Onye mbara igwe nke ibu ya bụ 60 kg n'Ụwa rutere n'elu Ọnwa. Kedu nkọwa gbasara 'ibu (mass)' na 'ịdị arọ (weight)' ya n'ọnwa ziri ezi? (Ike ndọda Ọnwa bụ 1/6 nke Ụwa.)
20261126-physics-g07-1.principle: Ibu bụ ọnụọgụ ihe nke ahụ, ya mere ọ na-adị otu (60 kg) n'agbanyeghị ebe, mana ịdị arọ bụ ike ndọda, ya mere n'Ọnwa ọ na-ebelata ruo 1/6 nke Ụwa, ihe dị ka 98 N.
20261126-physics-g07-1.example: Ibu bụ ọnụọgụ ihe ahụ nwere, ya mere ọ naghị agbanwe site n'ebe.
20261126-physics-g07-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261126-physics-g08-1.title: Iwu Ohm na ikike ọkụ
20261126-physics-g08-1.summary: E tinyere voltage 30 V n'ọnụ waya nichrome nke nguzogide ya bụ 10 Ω. Kedu ike ọkụ eletrik na-agafe waya ahụ?
20261126-physics-g08-1.principle: Dị ka iwu Ohm si dị, ike ọkụ eletrik bụ $I = \frac{V}{R} = \frac{30\text{ V}}{10\,\Omega} = 3\text{ A}$.
20261126-physics-g08-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261126-physics-g09-1.title: Ọrụ na mgbanwe ume mechanical
20261126-physics-g09-1.summary: N'ihe gbasara physics, kedu ọnọdụ ka 'ọrụ sayensị' e rụrụ bụ efu?
20261126-physics-g09-1.principle: Mgbe ị na-eje ije n'ụzọ dị larịị na-ebu igbe, ike ị na-eji (ike elu na-ejide ibu) na ntụziaka mmegharị (dị larịị) na-eme akụkụ ziri ezi nke $90^\circ$, yabụ ọ dịghị akụkụ nke ike na-arụ ọrụ n'ntụziaka mmegharị, ọrụ e rụrụ bụkwa $0$.
20261126-physics-g09-1.example: Ọrụ sayensị bụ W = F × s × cos(θ).
20261126-physics-g09-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261126-physics-g10-1.title: Ọgbaghara na nchekwa, mmepụta kwụ ọtọ na ike ndọda
20261126-physics-g10-1.summary: Nso n'elu ụwa, n'ime bọọlụ ígwè abụọ A na B n'otu ịdị elu, a hapụrụ A site n'izu ike ka ọ daa n'efu, a gbapụrụ B n'ike n'akụkụ larịị. Kedu nkọwa ziri ezi gbasara mmegharị ha? (Ghara ileghara ọgbụgba ikuku.)
20261126-physics-g10-1.principle: Mmegharị larịị na-adịgide adịgide na mmegharị ọdịda n'efu kwụ ọtọ adabereghị n'ibe ibe. Bọọlụ abụọ ahụ na-ada kwụ ọtọ n'otu ọsọ ike ndọda $g$, yabụ ha na-eru n'ala n'otu oge.
20261126-physics-g10-1.example: Chee banyere nnwere onwe nke mmegharị.
20261126-physics-g10-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261126-physics-g11-1.title: Iwu mmegharị Newton na tiori mmekọrịta pụrụ iche
20261126-physics-g11-1.summary: Kedu ihe bụ ọdịiche physics bụ isi kachasị ziri ezi n'etiti 'mmekọrịta mmeghachi omume (action-reaction)' na 'nhaịlịgide ike abụọ'?
20261126-physics-g11-1.principle: Mmeghachi omume na-arụ ọrụ n'ihe abụọ dị iche na-emekọrịta, yabụ enweghị ike ijikọta ike abụọ ahụ, mana ike nhaịlịgide abụọ na-arụ ọrụ n'otu ihe, yabụ enwere ike ijikọta ha, ike niile ghọọkwa 0.
20261126-physics-g11-1.example: Mmeghachi omume: ike A na-etinye na B na ike B na-etinye na A
20261126-physics-g11-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261126-physics-g12-1.title: Mmetụta photoelectric, ụdị abụọ nke ìhè na ụwa nta
20261126-physics-g12-1.summary: Kedu nsonaazụ nke nnwale photoelectric effect nke Einstein enweghị ike ikwu site na 'echiche ebili mmiri nke ìhè' ma 'echiche photon (akụkụ) nke ìhè' naanị na-akọwa ya kpamkpam?
20261126-physics-g12-1.principle: Echiche ebili mmiri na-ahụ ọdịnihu na ume na-achịkọta n'oge, mana na photoelectric effect otu photon dị n'elu threshold frequency na-agbagwo electron ozugbo ma na-ebufe ume ya, yabụ a na-ewepụta electron ozugbo na-enweghị igbu oge.
20261126-physics-g12-1.example: Dabere n'echiche ebili mmiri, ọbụna ìhè adịghị ike ma e tinye ya ogologo oge kwesịrị ịchịkọta ume wee wepụta electron, mana n'eziokwu a na-ewepụta ya ozugbo.
20261126-physics-g12-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261126-chemistry-g01-1.title: Àgwà dị iche iche nke ihe na ngwa
20261126-chemistry-g01-1.summary: N'ime ndị a, kedu nke jikọtara 'ihe (ọkpụrụkpụ)' nwere ụdị doro anya na ojiji pụrụ iche na 'ihe e ji mee ya (ngwa)' ziri ezi?
20261126-chemistry-g01-1.principle: Ihe nwere ụdị na ojiji bụ 'ihe', ma ihe bụ isi e ji mee ihe ahụ bụ 'ngwa'.
20261126-chemistry-g01-1.example: 'Ihe' bụ aha ihe e mechara a na-eji, 'ngwa' bụ aha ihe e ji mee ya.
20261126-chemistry-g01-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261126-chemistry-g02-1.title: Ihe na-agbaze n'ime mmiri na ngwakọta
20261126-chemistry-g02-1.summary: Mgbe e tinyere otu ngaji shuga n'ime beaker nwere mmiri ọkụ ma were osisi gilaasị kpoo ya, kedu nkọwa ziri ezi banyere ihe na-eme?
20261126-chemistry-g02-1.principle: Mgbe shuga gbaze n'ime mmiri, ụmụ shuga na-agbasa n'etiti ụmụ mmiri nke ọma, ya mere a naghị ahụ ha, ma mmiri shuga na-adị doro anya.
20261126-chemistry-g02-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261126-chemistry-g03-1.title: Ọnọdụ atọ nke ihe: ihe siri ike, mmiri na gas
20261126-chemistry-g03-1.summary: Kedu ọnọdụ ihe nke ụdị ya na-agbanwe n'efu dabere n'ihe e debere ya n'ime, ma oke ya (volume) anaghị agbanwe ma na-anọgide n'otu?
20261126-chemistry-g03-1.principle: Mmiri nwere njikọ n'etiti molekul na-agbanwe agbanwe karịa nke ihe siri ike, ya mere ụdị ya na-agbanwe dabere n'ihe e debere ya, ma n'ihi na mkpali dọtara n'etiti molekul na-anọgide, oke ya na-adị otu.
20261126-chemistry-g03-1.example: Chee echiche mgbe i na-awụsa mmiri ma ọ bụ mmiri ara ehi n'iko ọzọ.
20261126-chemistry-g03-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261126-chemistry-g04-1.title: Evaporation, ịsị, condensation na mgbanwe oke nke ice
20261126-chemistry-g04-1.summary: Mgbe e wepụrụ kan ihe ọṅụṅụ oyi n'ime friji wee hapụ ya nwa oge n'elu tebụl, ntanye mmiri pụtara n'elu kan ahụ. Ebee ka mmiri ndị a si bia?
20261126-chemistry-g04-1.principle: Ikuku mmiri dị n'ime ikuku na-ezute elu kan oyi, na-efunahụ okpomọkụ, wee gbanwee ka ọ bụrụ mmiri mmiri, nke a bụ 'condensation (liquefaction)'.
20261126-chemistry-g04-1.example: Ikuku mmiri anaghị ahụ anya na-adị n'ikuku mgbe niile.
20261126-chemistry-g04-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261126-chemistry-g05-1.title: Solute, solvent, solution na nchịkọta
20261126-chemistry-g05-1.summary: E gbazere gram 50 shuga kpamkpam n'ime gram 200 mmiri. Kedu nke jikọtara 'solvent', 'solute', na 'solution' n'ime mmiri shuga a ziri ezi?
20261126-chemistry-g05-1.principle: Mmiri nke na-agbaze bụ 'solvent', shuga nke na-agbaze bụ 'solute', ma ngwakọta doro anya ebe ha abụọ jikọtara nke ọma bụ 'solution'.
20261126-chemistry-g05-1.example: Mmiri na-agbaze = solvent, ihe na-agbaze = solute, ngwakọta zuru ezu = solution.
20261126-chemistry-g05-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261126-chemistry-g06-1.title: Acid, base na ihe atọ nke ọkụ
20261126-chemistry-g06-1.summary: Mgbe e wụsara ngwọta dị iche iche n'ime red cabbage indicator, ngwọta A gbanwere ka ọ bụrụ uhie, ma ngwọta B gbanwere ka ọ bụrụ acha anụnụ anụnụ wee bụrụ odo odo. Kedu àgwà nke ngwọta abụọ ahụ ziri ezi?
20261126-chemistry-g06-1.principle: Red cabbage indicator na-agbanwe ka ọ bụrụ uhie n'acid, ma ọ na-agbanwe ka ọ bụrụ acha anụnụ anụnụ, akwụkwọ ndụ akwụkwọ ndụ, na odo odo n'ime base.
20261126-chemistry-g06-1.example: Mmiri ahụ red cabbage, nke bụ indicator okike, nwere pigment anthocyanin.
20261126-chemistry-g06-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261126-chemistry-g07-1.title: Iwu Boyle, iwu Charles na mgbanwe ọnọdụ
20261126-chemistry-g07-1.summary: Gịnị bụ isi ihe kpatara 'nrụgide gas' a na-enwe n'akụkụ mgbidi nke akpa mechiri emechi nwere gas?
20261126-chemistry-g07-1.principle: Nrụgide gas na-apụta site n'ike n'otu mpaghara nke ụmụ gas na-agba mgbidi n'ime akpa ahụ mgbe ha na-eme mmegharị n'efu n'agaghị kwụsị.
20261126-chemistry-g07-1.example: Molekul gas na-efe n'ọsọ ọsọ dị ukwuu.
20261126-chemistry-g07-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261126-chemistry-g08-1.title: Element, atom, ion na mmeghachi omume precipitate
20261126-chemistry-g08-1.summary: Gịnị bụ ihe kpatara atom, nke nwere nucleus na electron, na-abụ ihe na-anọghị n'akụkụ eletrik (neutral)?
20261126-chemistry-g08-1.principle: Atom bụ ihe neutral n'akụkụ eletrik n'ihi na nchikota (+) charge nke proton dị n'etiti nucleus na nchikota (-) charge nke electron ndị na-agagharị n'orbit bụ otu kpamkpam.
20261126-chemistry-g08-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261126-chemistry-g09-1.title: Nchekwa oke, ịdị mgbe niile nke oke, exothermic na endothermic
20261126-chemistry-g09-1.summary: Gịnị bụ isi ihe kpatara iwu nchekwa nke oke ji eme mgbe mgbanwe kemịkalụ na-eme?
20261126-chemistry-g09-1.principle: Mgbe mmeghachi omume kemịkalụ na-eme, ụzọ atọm si ejikọta na-agbanwe ka ihe ọhụrụ pụta, mana ụdị na ọnụọgụ atọm adịghị apụta ma ọ bụ furu efu, a na-echekwa ha, ya mere ngụkọta oke adịghị agbanwe.
20261126-chemistry-g09-1.example: Cheta iwu nchekwa nke oke nke Lavoisier.
20261126-chemistry-g09-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261126-chemistry-g10-1.title: Njikọ ionic, njikọ covalent na oxidation-reduction
20261126-chemistry-g10-1.summary: Kedu nsonaazụ nnwale kacha ziri ezi na-eji tụnyere ike nkwụ ọkụ eletrik nke ihe A (sodium chloride) na ihe B (sugar)?
20261126-chemistry-g10-1.principle: Sodium chloride, ihe jikọtara ionic, na-agbaze n'ime mmiri ma kewaa ka ọ bụrụ cations na anions, ya mere ọkụ eletrik na-aga n'ime ngwọta mmiri, mana sugar, ihe jikọtara covalent, na-agbaze dị ka molecule, enweghị ihe na-ebu ụgwọ eletrik, ya mere ọkụ eletrik anaghị agafe.
20261126-chemistry-g10-1.example: Ihe jikọtara ionic (NaCl) na-agbaze n'ime mmiri ka ọ bụrụ ions nwere ike ịkwaga n'onwe ha.
20261126-chemistry-g10-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261126-chemistry-g11-1.title: Mole
20261126-chemistry-g11-1.summary: N'ime 11.2 L nke methane gas (CH₄, oke molecule 16) n'ime 0℃ na 1 atm, kedu ọnụọgụ mole nke methane na ngụkọta ọnụọgụ mole nke atọm hydrogen (H)?
20261126-chemistry-g11-1.principle: Ọnụọgụ mole nke methane bụ $n = \frac{11.2\text{ L}}{22.4\text{ L/mol}} = 0.5\text{ mol}$. Ebe $1$ molecule nke methane nwere atọm hydrogen $4$, ngụkọta mole nke atọm hydrogen bụ $0.5 \times 4 = 2.0\text{ mol}$.
20261126-chemistry-g11-1.example: N'ime 0℃ na 1 atm, 1 mol nke gas = 22.4 L.
20261126-chemistry-g11-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261126-chemistry-g12-1.title: Ọsọ mmeghachi omume, ụkpụrụ Le Chatelier na batrị kemịkal
20261126-chemistry-g12-1.summary: Kedu nkọwa ziri ezi banyere mgbanwe na-eme mgbe a na-agbakwunye 'positive catalyst' n'ime mmeghachi omume kemịkalụ?
20261126-chemistry-g12-1.principle: Positive catalyst na-enye ụzọ mmeghachi omume ọhụrụ nwere activation energy dị ala, na-eme ka rate constants nke mmeghachi omume n'ihu na nke azụ dịkwuo elu n'otu ọnụọgụ. Ọ naghị agbanwe reaction enthalpy ($\Delta H$) na equilibrium constant ($K$) ma ọlị.
20261126-chemistry-g12-1.example: Catalyst anaghị agbanwe ọdịiche ume n'etiti ihe mmalite na ngwaahịa ikpeazụ (ΔH) ma ọlị.
20261126-chemistry-g12-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261126-english-g01-1.title: Chọta omume ndị na-adabaghị n'ọkwa ọdọ mmiri
20261126-english-g01-1.summary:
Ọkwa dị n'ọnụ ụzọ ọdọ mmiri (e dere n'okwu naanị, na-enweghị ihe oyiyi):

Pool Rules
1. No running.
2. Swim caps on, please.
3. Under 8? Come with a grown-up.

(grown-up = okenye)

Mmadụ anọ na-aga n'ọdọ mmiri.
Mina dị afọ 7. Ọ na-eso nne ya bịa, ma o nwere okpu.
Jun dị afọ 10. Ọ na-abịa naanị ya, ma o nweghị okpu.
Tom dị afọ 6. Ọ na-eso nwanne ya nwoke bịa. Nwanne ya dị afọ 9. Tom nwere okpu.
Sue dị afọ 11. Ọ na-eje ije gaa ọdọ mmiri naanị ya, ma o nwere okpu.
20261126-english-g01-1.principle: Jun enweghị okpu, ya mere ọ na-agbaji iwu 2. Tom dị n'okpuru 8, ma nwanne ya nwoke nke na-eso ya bịa dị afọ 9, ya mere ọ bụghị 'grown-up', ya mere Tom na-agbaji iwu 3. Mina soro nne ya bịa, ma Sue dị afọ 11, ya mere ọ dị mma ka ọ jee ije bịa naanị ya.
20261126-english-g01-1.example: Mee tebụl nwere afọ onye ọ bụla, onye ọ na-eso bịa, na okpu, otu n'otu.
20261126-english-g01-1.actionItem: Kwekọọ iwu atọ dị n'ọkwa ahụ na ọnọdụ onye ọ bụla, họrọ ikpe ndị na-agbaji iwu, ma kwuo ihe kpatara n'asụsụ Bekee.

20261126-english-g02-1.title: Ebee ka “Two tickets, please.” dị? Ịkpebi ma ozi e nyere ezuola
20261126-english-g02-1.summary:
Ị nụrụ nwoke na onye na-ere tiketi na-ekwu okwu. Ha ekwughị ebe ha nọ.

Man: Two tickets, please.
Clerk: Here you are. The show starts at 7:00.
20261126-english-g02-1.principle: Ticket na show bụ okwu a na-eji n’ọtụtụ ebe, dịka sinima ma ọ bụ ụlọ egwu. O siri ike iji ahịrị abụọ naanị kpebie otu.
20261126-english-g02-1.example: Chee ebe abụọ ma ọ bụ atọ a pụrụ ikwu ahịrị ndị a.
20261126-english-g02-1.actionItem: Kpebie ma a pụrụ ịmata ebe ahụ site n’ahịrị abụọ a nụrụ naanị, họrọkwa ihe ngosi mgbakwunye ga-ekewa ebe ndị nwere ike ime.

20261126-english-g03-1.title: Chọta oge ịgụ akwụkwọ n'usoro oge Saturday nke Mina
20261126-english-g03-1.summary:
Usoro oge Saturday nke Mina (e dere dị ka ederede naanị, na-enweghị ihe oyiyi):

10 a.m.: I can start my free time.
12 p.m. - 1 p.m.: Lunch
1 p.m. - 2 p.m.: Dance class
5 p.m.: Dinner. I must finish before dinner.

Mina chọrọ ịgụ akwụkwọ awa 1. Ọ na-amalite n'awa zuru ezu ma na-akwụsị n'awa zuru ezu.
20261126-english-g03-1.principle: Oge ezumike na-amalite na 10 a.m., ma 12 ruo 14 jupụtara na nri ehihie na ịgba egwu. Ọrụ ọ bụla adịghị n'usoro oge site na 15 ruo 16 na site na 16 ruo 17, ma ha na-agwụ tupu nri abalị.
20261126-english-g03-1.example: Gbanwee oge dị n'usoro oge ka ọ bụrụ ọnụọgụ awa 24 ma see eserese oge.
20261126-english-g03-1.actionItem: Chee oge mmalite ịgụ akwụkwọ dị iche nke na-emezu ọnọdụ niile dị n'usoro oge, ma kọwaa ihe mere oge ndị ọzọ anaghị arụ ọrụ.

20261126-english-g04-1.title: Ndetu nne na oge egwuregwu Jisu
20261126-english-g04-1.summary:
'Ndetu nne hapụrụ n'elu tebụl (e dere dị ka ederede naanị, n'enweghị eserese):

Mina,
Today's plan:
3:30 p.m. Come home.
4:00 p.m. Piano class (30 minutes).
5:00 p.m. Take out the trash.
6:30 p.m. Dinner with Mom and Dad.

Mgbe ahụ enyi ya Jisu zigara ozi ederede. "Let's play at the park from 4:15 to 5:15 today!"'
20261126-english-g04-1.principle: Klaasị piano bụ 4:00-4:30, ya mere 4:15-4:30 na-adabere, ma ịtụpụ ahịhịa na 5:00 dabara n'ime 4:15-5:15. Ịlọta ụlọ na 3:30 na nri abalị na 6:30 dị n'èzí oge ogige.
20261126-english-g04-1.example: Tinye ahịrị ọ bụla n'akụkụ oge ogige '4:15-5:15' otu n'otu, ma lee ma ọ na-agwụ tupu ya ma ọ bụ na-amalite mgbe ya.
20261126-english-g04-1.actionItem: Tụnyere atụmatụ dị iche iche dị n'ndetu nne na oge enyi tụrụ aro, chọta ebe ha na-adabaghị, ma kwuo mba n'asụsụ Bekee ka ị na-atụ aro oge dị iche.

20261126-english-g05-1.title: Echiche gị na-agbanwe ka ị na-agụ ihe nkwanye
20261126-english-g05-1.summary: Jun abụghị onye otu Green Library. Enyi ya Ara bụ onye otu Green Library. Ha abụọ ga-agụ ihe nkwanye dị n'ihu ọbá akwụkwọ otu ahịrị n'otu oge.
20261126-english-g05-1.principle: Gbanwee mkpebi gị oge ọ bụla a na-ekpughe ozi ihe nkwanye n'ọkwa, ma mee ajụjụ Bekee na-elele ozi nke anọghị n'ihe nkwanye.
20261126-english-g05-1.example: Lelee ma ahịrịokwu bụ ọhụrụ oge a na-agbanwe mkpebi gị gara aga.
20261126-english-g05-1.actionItem: Gbanwee mkpebi gị oge ọ bụla a na-ekpughe ozi ihe nkwanye n'ọkwa, ma mee ajụjụ Bekee na-elele ozi nke anọghị n'ihe nkwanye.

20261126-english-g06-1.title: Klọb akwụkwọ ọ̀ bụ ihe ịga nke ọma? Ịgbanwe ikpe gị ka ihe àmà na-abawanye
20261126-english-g06-1.summary: Otu klọb akwụkwọ ọhụrụ amalitela n'ụlọ akwụkwọ anyị. Onye nkụzi kwuru, "The club is a success." Ị ga-anata ihe àmà otu mpempe n'otu oge ma chee echiche ma nkwupụta a ziri ezi.
20261126-english-g06-1.principle: Ka a na-agbakwunye data otu mpempe n'otu oge, gbanwee ikpe gị banyere nkwupụta 'klọb akwụkwọ bụ ihe ịga nke ọma', ma mechie n'asụsụ Bekee site n'iji ihe àmà abụọ.
20261126-english-g06-1.example: Kewaa ihe data ị nwere ugbu a na-egosipụta na ihe ị ka maghị.
20261126-english-g06-1.actionItem: Ka a na-agbakwunye data otu mpempe n'otu oge, gbanwee ikpe gị banyere nkwupụta 'klọb akwụkwọ bụ ihe ịga nke ọma', ma mechie n'asụsụ Bekee site n'iji ihe àmà abụọ.

20261126-english-g07-1.title: Ben ọ ga-abịa oriri ahụ? Ịtụle ihe zoro n’azụ azịza ya
20261126-english-g07-1.summary:
Mkparịta ụka Jisu na Ben (ederede naanị, enweghị foto):

Jisu: Do you want to come to my birthday party on Saturday?
Ben: Saturday? Hmm. I have a soccer game in the morning.
Jisu: The party is at 4 p.m.
Ben: Oh, that might work. I'll probably be tired, though.
Jisu: So... are you coming?
Ben: Let me check with my mom first.
20261126-english-g07-1.principle: Egwuregwu bọọlụ bụ n’ụtụtụ, oriri bụ na 4 p.m., ya mere oge anaghị ekpuchikọ. Ben kwuru naanị na ike nwere ike gwụ ya; na njedebe o kwuru na ọ ga-ebu ụzọ jụọ mama ya. Ya mere e kpebiela ihe ụfọdụ (oge), ihe ọzọ ka fọdụrụ (ikike mama ya), a kpebeghịkwa.
20261126-english-g07-1.example: Kewaa okwu Ben n’akụkụ anọ: “soccer game,” “party time,” “tired,” na “mom.”
20261126-english-g07-1.actionItem: Kewaa okwu Ben n’ime mkparịta ụka ahụ ahịrị n’ahịrị, kewaa ihe e kpebiela na nke fọdụrụ, kpebie n’enweghị nkwupụta na “ọ ga-abịa” ma ọ bụ “ọ gaghị abịa.”

20261126-english-g08-1.title: Dee ọzọ nkwupụta na ịga ọbá akwụkwọ ugboro ugboro na-ebuli akara
20261126-english-g08-1.summary: Onye na-ede blog chọrọ ide nke a: 'Library visits make students' scores go up.' Ka anyị lelee ahịrịokwu a megide data.
20261126-english-g08-1.principle: Oge ọ bụla a kpughere data ọhụrụ, kpebie ọzọ ka ị nwere ike ịbụ onye doro anya banyere nkwupụta ahụ, ma dee ọzọ ahịrịokwu ikpeazụ.
20261126-english-g08-1.example: N'nzọụkwụ ọ bụla, lelee ma ozi ọhụrụ na-akwado mkpebi gara aga ma ọ bụ na-ama ya jijiji.
20261126-english-g08-1.actionItem: Oge ọ bụla a kpughere data ọhụrụ, kpebie ọzọ ka ị nwere ike ịbụ onye doro anya banyere nkwupụta ahụ, ma dee ọzọ ahịrịokwu ikpeazụ.

20261126-english-g09-1.title: Echiche zoro n’ime “anyị rere nri ehihie 200 pere mpe”
20261126-english-g09-1.summary:
E tinyere nke a n’elu bọọdụ n’ihu cafeteria ụlọ akwụkwọ.

“This month, the cafeteria sold 200 fewer lunches than last month. So students did not like the new menu.”
20261126-english-g09-1.principle: Iji si n’eziokwu na ahịa dara gaa “uto nri adabaghị ha,” ọnọdụ ndị ọzọ (ọnụ ọgụgụ ụmụ akwụkwọ, ụbọchị ụlọ akwụkwọ, wdg) ga-abụ otu. Ọ bụrụ ụmụ akwụkwọ ma ọ bụ ụbọchị ụlọ akwụkwọ pere mpe, ahịa ga-ada ọbụna ma uto nri adịghị agbanwe.
20261126-english-g09-1.example: Buru ụzọ dee n’asụsụ nke gị ihe nwere ike ịkpata “ere nri ehihie pere mpe.”
20261126-english-g09-1.actionItem: Chọpụta echiche a na-ekwughị nke dị mkpa ka nkwupụta wee bụrụ eziokwu, dee nkọwa ọzọ n’asụsụ Bekee nke na-eme ka echiche ahụ maa jijiji.

20261126-english-g10-1.title: Kedu ka anyị ga-esi dee ọkwa abụọ na-emegide ibe ha n'akwụkwọ akụkọ ụlọ akwụkwọ?
20261126-english-g10-1.summary:
Ị nọ n'otu ndị edemede nke akwụkwọ akụkọ bekee ụlọ akwụkwọ. Ọkwa abụọ banyere ememme dị iche n'ibe ha.

Ọkwa ụlọ akwụkwọ: "Festival: Friday, 4 p.m., in the gym. Free for all students."
Posta ụlọ ọrụ ụmụ akwụkwọ: "Festival: Friday, 5 p.m., in the gym. Tickets: 1,000 won."

I kwenyebeghị nke ziri ezi.
20261126-english-g10-1.principle: Ọ bụrụ na ekwenyeghị, ihe ziri ezi bụ ikwu ihe isi iyi abụọ ahụ nke ọ bụla na-ekwu ma gwa ndị na-agụ na a ka na-elele ya. Ịhọrọ otu akụkụ ma kwuo ya n'ike, ma ọ bụ ịgwa mmadụ ka ha ghara ịbịa n'enweghị ozi, na-eduhie ndị na-agụ.
20261126-english-g10-1.example: Tụnyere ozi mgbasa ozi ọ bụla na-enye ndị na-agụ na ihe ọ na-ezo.
20261126-english-g10-1.actionItem: Dee maka ndị na-agụ (ụmụ akwụkwọ) ihe na-ebufe ọkwa abụọ dị iche n'ụzọ ziri ezi, na-ekwu ihe ekwenyeghị na ihe ndị na-agụ kwesịrị ime.

20261126-english-g11-1.title: Ntụziaka ọrụ na-adịghị doo anya: gịnị ka ị kwesịrị ịjụ buru ụzọ?
20261126-english-g11-1.summary:
Nke a bụ email onye ọrụ ọzụzụ Jiho natara site n'onye isi otu Ms. Han.

Hi Jiho,
Please send the sales summary to the client before the meeting.
Thanks,
Ms. Han

Eziokwu Jiho maara: Kalenda otu na-egosi nnọkọ na Aurora Co. na Tuesday n'elekere 10:00 na nnọkọ na Blue Pine Ltd. na Thursday n'elekere 14:00. Folda ekekọrịtara nwere faịlụ nchịkọta ire ahịa dị iche maka July, August na September.
20261126-english-g11-1.principle: Ọ bụrụ na e kpebighị onye ahịa na oge, ị pụrụ izipu faịlụ na-ezighị ezi nye onye ahịa na-ezighị ezi. Maka udi faịlụ, ị pụrụ ịtọ ihe ndabara dị ka PDF ma mara ya ọkwa, ma ọ bụrụ na ọ nọ n'ọrụ enweghị ihe ọ metụtara n'ọrụ ahụ n'onwe ya.
20261126-english-g11-1.example: Lelee ma 'nye onye,' 'gịnị,' na 'tupu mgbe ole' nke ọ bụla na-apụta dị ka otu ihe kpọmkwem n'email ahụ.
20261126-english-g11-1.actionItem: Site n'email ọrụ na-adịghị doo anya, họpụta ozi ndị a ga-ekwenye tupu ime ihe, ma dee email ajụjụ nke dị mfe izaghachi.

20261126-english-g12-1.title: Ụmụ akwụkwọ na-eri nri ụtụtụ nwere akara dị elu: gịnị ọzọ ka anyị chọrọ ịmara?
20261126-english-g12-1.summary:
Nke a bụ nkwupụta sitere n'akụkọ ụlọ akwụkwọ. "Students who eat breakfast get higher test scores, so the school should provide free breakfast." Dịka ihe akaebe, e gosipụtara nsonaazụ nyocha nke ụmụ akwụkwọ 200 dị otú a.

Group | Number of students | Average score
Students who eat breakfast | 130 | 82
Students who skip breakfast | 70 | 74
20261126-english-g12-1.principle: b na-elele ihe kpatara ndị ọzọ (ụra, oge ọmụmụ), c na-elele nsonaazụ nke mmeghachi omume n'ezie, e na-elelekwa ịdị mma nke itụnyere. a na d abụghị ihe akaebe banyere ma nri na-ebuli akara.
20261126-english-g12-1.example: Lelee ma ozi ọ bụla na-enyere aka ịzaa ajụjụ, 'Mmekọrịta dị n'etiti nri ụtụtụ na akara ọ̀ bụ ihe kpatara?'
20261126-english-g12-1.actionItem: Kpee ikpe ma nsonaazụ nyocha na-agwa anyị banyere "ihe kpatara," họrọ ozi ọzọ achọrọ maka mkpebi ahụ, ma tụọ aro n'Bekee usoro itụnyere iji lelee mmetụta nke nri n'efu.

20261126-korean-l1-1.title: Kedu akara na-eduga n'ebe a na-ebu ụgbọala?
20261126-korean-l1-1.summary:
Onye nleta na-anya ụgbọala n'ụlọ akwụkwọ ma chọọ ịhapụ ụgbọala otu awa. A na-ahụ akara atọ (enweghị ihe oyiyi, ya mere a kọwara ha n'okwu).

Akara A: mkpụrụedemede ọcha '주차 금지' na bọọdụ ọbara ọbara. Gburugburu ọbara ọbara nwere akara ịgbagọ na-agafe obere ihe oyiyi ụgbọala. E guzobere ya n'ogige ụlọ akwụkwọ.
Akara B: bọọdụ ọcha na mkpụrụedemede ọcha '방문자 주차장' na akụ na-atụ aka n'aka nri. Ọ guzo n'akụkụ ụzọ.
Akara C: bọọdụ ndụ akwụkwọ ndụ na mkpụrụedemede ọcha '주차장 출구' na akụ na-atụ aka azụ n'ụzọ. Ọ kwụ n'elu ụzọ nta ebe ụgbọala na-apụ.

Okwu: 주차(장) = ebe a na-ebu ụgbọala; 방문자 = onye nleta; 입구 = ọnụ ụzọ mbanye; 출구 = ọnụ ụzọ ọpụpụ.
20261126-korean-l1-1.principle: Akara B bụ maka ndị nleta, na-akpọ ebe a na-ebu ụgbọala ma nye ntụzi. Akara A nwere otu okwu mbụ ahụ mana nwere akara machibido. Akara C na-akpọkwa ebe a na-ebu ụgbọala, ma 출구 pụtara ọnụ ụzọ ọpụpụ, ya mere ọ na-egosi ebe ụgbọala na-apụ.
20261126-korean-l1-1.example: Depụta ihe akara ọ bụla na-ekwu n'okwu, na ihe akara ya ma ọ bụ akụ na-agbakwunye.
20261126-korean-l1-1.actionItem: Gụọ akara ụzọ dị mkpụmkpụ atọ, jikọta okwu ndị ahụ na akụ na akara akọwara, ma kpee ikpe nke n'ime ha na-eduga n'ezie onye nleta ebe ọ ga-ebu ụgbọala; chebe ikpe gị megide ọkara ịgụ enyi.

20261126-korean-l2-1.title: Onye na-apụ, onye na-anọ?
20261126-korean-l2-1.summary:
지우 bụ nwa akwụkwọ ma na-ekwu okwu n'ụzọ nsọpụrụ nye ndị toro eto. Ugboro atọ 지우 na-asị ka ọ dị. Lelee onye na-apụ na onye na-anọ n'ebe ọ nọ.

Onọdụ 1: 지우 na-agwụcha ikwu okwu n'ime ụlọ 선생님 ma na-apụ. 선생님 na-anọ n'tebụl.
Onọdụ 2: 지우 na 선생님 na-apụ n'ụlọ akwụkwọ ọnụ. N'ọnụ ụzọ ama ha na-aga n'ntụziaka dị iche.
Onọdụ 3: 지우 na-eri nri abalị n'ụlọ 할머니. Mgbe ahụ 지우 na-alaghachi. 할머니 na-anọ n'ụlọ.
20261126-korean-l2-1.principle: 안녕히 계세요 bụ nke onye na-apụ na-agwa onye na-anọ. 지우 na-apụ ma 선생님 na-anọ n'tebụl.
20261126-korean-l2-1.example: Jụọ: onye na-apụ, na onye na-anọ n'ime ụlọ?
20261126-korean-l2-1.actionItem: Kpebie nke n'ime ikele ikpeazụ dabara site n'onye na-apụ na onye na-anọ, lee ikpe ebe ndị abụọ na-apụ, ma dee ikele ikpeazụ nwere nsọpụrụ na ekele.

20261126-korean-l3-1.title: Onye nyere ego obere?
20261126-korean-l3-1.summary:
Ndị klaasị abụọ, 지우 na 하나, na-agwa okwu n'okwu nkwanye ùgwù -요. Korea na-ahapụkarị isiokwu (onye na-eme omume). (댁 = okwu nkwanye ùgwù maka ụlọ mmadụ.)

지우: 어제 뭐 했어요?
하나: 할머니 댁에 갔어요. 맛있는 밥을 먹었어요. 용돈도 주셨어요.
지우: 좋았겠어요!
20261126-korean-l3-1.principle: Ederede ahụ anaghị akpọ isiokwu, ma ụdị verb na-egosi na onye nyere ya bụ onye a ga-asọpụrụ, ma naanị onye dị otú ahụ n'akụkọ bụ 할머니, onye 하나 gara n'ụlọ ya. 'Ikekwe' ziri ezi: ederede anaghị ekwu ya ozugbo.
20261126-korean-l3-1.example: Lelee njedebe nke 주셨어요 ma tụnyere ya na 먹었어요 n'ahịrị tupu ya.
20261126-korean-l3-1.actionItem: Chepụta onye isiokwu a hapụrụ na-atụ aka na ya, tụọ aka n'ihe akaebe dị n'ederede, ma kwuo otú ichepụta na-agbanwe mgbe e wepụrụ otu ihe ngosi.

20261126-korean-l4-1.title: Ịdebanye ụlọ
20261126-korean-l4-1.summary:
Otu gị chọrọ iji ụlọ mgbe ụlọ akwụkwọ gasịrị. Gụọ ọkwa ahụ na ozi sitere n'onye otu gị 서준.

[방과 후 교실 이용 안내]
- 이용 시간: 오후 1시 ~ 6시
- 한 번에 1시간이나 2시간 쓸 수 있어요.
- 오후 3시 ~ 4시는 청소 시간이라 쓸 수 없어요.

서준: 저는 수업이 2시에 끝나서 2시 전에는 갈 수 없어요. 시작 시간은 정각으로 해 주세요.
20261126-korean-l4-1.principle: 2시 ~ 4시 gụnyere 3시 ~ 4시, mgbe a na-ehicha ụlọ ahụ. A ga-elele atụmatụ ọ bụla maka oge ya niile, ọ bụghị naanị mmalite ya.
20261126-korean-l4-1.example: Dee awa mmalite na awa ọgwụgwụ nke atụmatụ ahụ.
20261126-korean-l4-1.actionItem: Jikọta iwu ụlọ site n'ọkwa na ozi onye otu gị ma chọta ọtụtụ atụmatụ ịdebanye dị iche na-emezu ọnọdụ niile.

20261126-korean-l5-1.title: Ọkwa njem ụlọ akwụkwọ nwere nsogbu oge
20261126-korean-l5-1.summary: Klaasị gị natara ọkwa a site n'aka onye nkụzi site n'ozi.
20261126-korean-l5-1.principle: Ahịrị 3 na 4 na-ese okwu: klaasị na-eru ogige na 11:30, ma nri ehihie 'mgbe ịbịa' bụ na 11:00. Ahịrị 1, 2 na 5 kwekọrọ.
20261126-korean-l5-1.example: Tinye oge elekere nke ahịrị n'usoro ma tụnyere.
20261126-korean-l5-1.actionItem: Chọta mgbagha n'ọkwa njem, kpebie ihe enwere ike ikwubi, ma dee ajụjụ nsọpụrụ nke na-edozi ya.

20261126-korean-l6-1.title: Ebee ka m na-etinye akwụkwọ?
20261126-korean-l6-1.summary: Ọ bụ 4:20 p.m. Ị nọ n'ebe 주민센터 (ụlọ ọrụ ọrụ obodo) na-anabata. Ị chọrọ itinye akwụkwọ maka paspọtụ. Ị nweghị n'aka ma ị nwere foto paspọtụ n'akpa gị.
20261126-korean-l6-1.principle: Gbanwee ịgụ gị nke nzaghachi onye ọrụ ka ọtụtụ nke mgbanwe ozi na-apụta, wee jụọ ajụjụ na-esote nwere ezi uche.
20261126-korean-l6-1.example: Kpebie site n'iji naanị ihe ị gụworo ruo ugbu a.
20261126-korean-l6-1.actionItem: Gbanwee ịgụ gị nke nzaghachi onye ọrụ ka ọtụtụ nke mgbanwe ozi na-apụta, wee jụọ ajụjụ na-esote nwere ezi uche.

20261126-life-all-1.title: Hapụ etiti microwave n'efu
20261126-life-all-1.summary: Ọ bụrụ na ị tinye nri n'ụdị donut n'akụkụ efere, microwave na-ekpo ya n'otu n'otu karị.
20261126-life-all-1.principle: Microwave na-ekpo ọkụ site na wave guzo 2.45GHz, ma dabere na ogologo wave $\lambda = c/f \approx 12.2\ \mathrm{cm}$, ebe ọkụ na ebe oyi na-apụta.
20261126-life-all-1.example: Etiti efere na-adịkarị oyi n'ihi na microwave dị ntakịrị n'ebe ahụ. Ọ bụrụ na ị tụọ nri gburugburu akụkụ ma kpalie ya otu ugboro n'etiti oge, ọdịiche okpomọkụ nwere ike ibelata karịa 20°C.
20261126-life-all-1.actionItem: Taa, hapụ etiti n'efu, tinye nri n'akụkụ efere, ma kpalie ya otu ugboro n'ọkara oge.
